manualTranslations.zh: 齊郡王簡，字叔亮。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian, Prince of Qi Commandery, was styled Shuliang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian, Prince of Qi Commandery, was styled Shuliang.

manualTranslations.zh: 太和五年封，位中都大官。
manualTranslations.literal: He was enfeoffed in Taihe year 5 and held office as Chief Official of the Central Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed in Taihe year 5 and served as Chief Official of the Central Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 簡母，沮渠牧犍女也。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian's mother was a daughter of Juqu Mujian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian's mother was a daughter of Juqu Mujian.

manualTranslations.zh: 簡性貌特類外祖。
manualTranslations.literal: In nature and appearance, Jian especially resembled his maternal grandfather.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In temperament and looks, Jian closely resembled his maternal grandfather.

manualTranslations.zh: 後為內都大官。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he became Chief Official of the Inner Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he became Chief Official of the Inner Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖嘗與簡俱朝文明太后於皇信堂，簡居帝之右，行家人禮。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu once attended on Empress Dowager Wenming with Jian at Huangxin Hall; Jian occupied the emperor's right side, and they observed the rites of family members.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu once paid court to Empress Dowager Wenming with Jian at Huangxin Hall. Jian sat to the emperor's right, and they observed family rites.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷太保。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to Grand Protector.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Grand Protector.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖仁孝，以諸父零落，存者唯簡。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozu was benevolent and filial; his uncles had fallen away, and only Jian remained alive.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu was benevolent and filial; his uncles had died off, and only Jian remained.

manualTranslations.zh: 每見，立以待之，俟坐，致敬問起居，停簡拜伏。
manualTranslations.literal: whenever he saw Jian, he stood waiting for him; after Jian was seated, he showed respect, asked after his health, and stopped Jian from bowing prostrate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: whenever he saw Jian, he stood to wait for him; once Jian was seated, Gaozu respectfully asked after his health and prevented him from bowing prostrate.

manualTranslations.zh: 簡性好酒，不能理公私之事。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian loved wine by nature and could not manage public or private affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian loved wine by nature and could not manage public or private affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 妻常氏，燕郡公常喜女也，文明太后以賜簡。
manualTranslations.literal: His wife, Lady Chang, was a daughter of Chang Xi, Duke of Yan Commandery, and Empress Dowager Wenming bestowed her on Jian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His wife, Lady Chang, was a daughter of Chang Xi, Duke of Yan Commandery, and Empress Dowager Wenming gave her to Jian.

manualTranslations.zh: 性幹綜家事，頗節斷簡酒，乃至盜竊，求乞婢侍，卒不能禁。
manualTranslations.literal: By nature she was capable at managing household affairs and rather sharply restricted Jian's wine; he went so far as to steal it and beg maidservants and attendants for it, but in the end she could not stop him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: She was naturally capable in managing household affairs and tried hard to limit Jian's drinking; he even stole and begged wine from maidservants and attendants, and in the end she could not stop him.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十三年薨。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the twenty-third year.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-third year.

manualTranslations.zh: 時高祖不豫，詔曰：「叔父薨背，痛慕摧絕，不自勝任，但虛頓床枕，未堪奉赴，當力疾發哀。」
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Gaozu was unwell. He issued an edict: "My uncle has died and departed; grief and longing crush me beyond what I can bear. But I am weak and prostrate on bed and pillow and cannot yet go to attend in person. I shall force myself through illness to send forth mourning."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozu was ill at the time and issued an edict: "My uncle has passed away; grief and longing crush me beyond endurance. I am weak and confined to bed, and cannot yet attend in person, but I will force myself through illness to express my mourning."

manualTranslations.zh: 諡曰靈王。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously named Prince Ling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously named Prince Ling.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗時，改諡曰順。
manualTranslations.literal: In Shizong's time, the posthumous name was changed to Shun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Shizong's time, the posthumous name was changed to Shun.

manualTranslations.zh: 子祐，字伯授，襲。
manualTranslations.literal: His son You, styled Boshou, succeeded him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son You, styled Boshou, succeeded him.

manualTranslations.zh: 母常氏，高祖以納不以禮，不許其為妃。
manualTranslations.literal: His mother, Lady Chang, had been taken by Gaozu in a manner that did not conform to ritual, so he did not permit her to become the princess.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Gaozu had not taken his mother, Lady Chang, according to proper ritual, he did not permit her to be made princess.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗以母從子貴，詔特拜為齊國太妃。
manualTranslations.literal: Shizong, on the grounds that a mother follows the rank of her son, issued an edict specially appointing her Grand Princess Dowager of Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizong held that a mother follows the rank of her son and issued an edict specially appointing her Grand Princess Dowager of Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 祐位涇州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: You held office as Inspector of Jingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You served as Inspector of Jingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨，諡曰敬。
manualTranslations.literal: When he died, he was posthumously named Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When he died, he was posthumously named Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 河間王若，字叔儒。
manualTranslations.literal: Ruo, Prince of Hejian, was styled Shuru.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ruo, Prince of Hejian, was styled Shuru.

manualTranslations.zh: 年十六，未封而薨，追封河間，諡曰孝。
manualTranslations.literal: At age sixteen he died before being enfeoffed; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Hejian and given the posthumous name Xiao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at sixteen before receiving a fief; he was posthumously made Prince of Hejian and given the posthumous name Xiao.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔京兆康王子太安為後。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict made Taian, son of Prince Kang of Jingzhao, his heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Taian, son of Prince Kang of Jingzhao, as his heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 太安於若為從弟，非相後之義，廢之，以齊郡王子琛繼。
manualTranslations.literal: Taian was Ruo's younger cousin, which was not the principle for making one heir to another, so he was removed and Chen, son of the Prince of Qi Commandery, was made successor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taian was Ruo's younger cousin, which did not accord with the principles of succession, so he was removed and Chen, son of the Prince of Qi Commandery, succeeded instead.

sourceRange.text: 謐兄諶，字興伯，性平和。自通直正員郎，遷太子庶子、司空司馬、鴻臚少卿。遷後將軍、肆州刺史，固辭不拜。改授平南將軍、光祿少卿。轉黃門侍郎，進號安南將軍、光祿大夫。出為散騎常侍、中軍將軍、相州刺史。罷州，除宗正卿、都官尚書。以親例封上蔡縣開國公，食邑四百戶，讓而不受。莊帝初，拜車騎將軍、儀同三司、尚書左僕射；封魏郡王，食邑一千戶。又加侍中。諶本年長，應襲王封，其父靈王寵愛其弟謐，以為世子。莊帝詔復諶封趙郡王。進號驃騎大將軍，加開府，遷司空公。出帝時，轉太保、司州牧、太尉公，又遷太師，錄尚書事。孝靜初，為大司馬，三年薨，贈假黃鉞、侍中、都督、冀州刺史，諡曰孝懿。諶無他才識，歷位雖重，時人忽之。

manualTranslations.zh: 謐兄諶，字興伯，性平和。
manualTranslations.literal: Mi's elder brother Chen, styled Xingbo, was even-tempered by nature.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mi's elder brother Chen, styled Xingbo, was even-tempered by nature.

manualTranslations.zh: 自通直正員郎，遷太子庶子、司空司馬、鴻臚少卿。
manualTranslations.literal: From Direct Regular Gentleman he was promoted to Palace Attendant to the Heir Apparent, Marshal of the Minister of Works, and Junior Chamberlain for Dependencies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He began as Direct Regular Gentleman and was promoted to Palace Attendant to the Heir Apparent, Marshal of the Minister of Works, and Junior Chamberlain for Dependencies.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷後將軍、肆州刺史，固辭不拜。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to General of the Rear and Inspector of Sizhou, but firmly declined and did not accept the appointment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to General of the Rear and Inspector of Sizhou, but firmly declined the appointment.

manualTranslations.zh: 改授平南將軍、光祿少卿。
manualTranslations.literal: His appointment was changed to General Who Pacifies the South and Junior Chamberlain for Splendid Happiness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was instead appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Junior Chamberlain for Splendid Happiness.

manualTranslations.zh: 轉黃門侍郎，進號安南將軍、光祿大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Yellow Gate Attendant and advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the South and Grandee of Splendid Happiness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yellow Gate Attendant and advanced to General Who Pacifies the South and Grandee of Splendid Happiness.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為散騎常侍、中軍將軍、相州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out to serve as Regular Mounted Attendant, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Xiangzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Regular Mounted Attendant, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Xiangzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 罷州，除宗正卿、都官尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: After leaving the province, he was appointed Minister of the Imperial Clan and Director of the Ministry of Justice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After leaving provincial office, he was appointed Minister of the Imperial Clan and Director of the Ministry of Justice.

manualTranslations.zh: 以親例封上蔡縣開國公，食邑四百戶，讓而不受。
manualTranslations.literal: Under the kinship precedent he was enfeoffed as Founding Duke of Shangcai County, with a food estate of four hundred households, but he yielded it and did not accept.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under the kinship precedent he was enfeoffed as Founding Duke of Shangcai County, with a food estate of four hundred households, but he declined it.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊帝初，拜車騎將軍、儀同三司、尚書左僕射；
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Zhuang's reign, he was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal in Ceremonial to the Three Excellencies, and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Zhuang's reign, he was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal in Ceremonial to the Three Excellencies, and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing;

manualTranslations.zh: 封魏郡王，食邑一千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: he was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei Commandery, with a food estate of one thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei Commandery, with a food estate of one thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 又加侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: He was also given the additional office of Attendant-in-Ordinary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was also made Attendant-in-Ordinary.

manualTranslations.zh: 諶本年長，應襲王封，其父靈王寵愛其弟謐，以為世子。
manualTranslations.literal: Chen was originally the elder and should have inherited the princely fief, but his father Prince Ling favored his younger brother Mi and made him heir.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen was the elder and should have inherited the princely fief, but his father Prince Ling favored his younger brother Mi and made him heir.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊帝詔復諶封趙郡王。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Zhuang issued an edict restoring Chen's fief as Prince of Zhao Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhuang restored Chen's fief as Prince of Zhao Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 進號驃騎大將軍，加開府，遷司空公。
manualTranslations.literal: He advanced in title to General-in-Chief of Agile Cavalry, was granted the Open Office, and was promoted to Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He advanced to General-in-Chief of Agile Cavalry, was granted the Open Office, and was promoted to Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 出帝時，轉太保、司州牧、太尉公，又遷太師，錄尚書事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the time of the Deposed Emperor, he was transferred to Grand Guardian, Governor of Sizhou, and Grand Commandant, then promoted again to Grand Preceptor and Recorder of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under the Deposed Emperor he became Grand Guardian, Governor of Sizhou, and Grand Commandant, then was promoted again to Grand Preceptor and Recorder of the Masters of Writing.

localRange.text: 校勘記臣謂宜述元志「元」疑當作「先」。願欲傳之來葉諸本「葉」作「業」，冊府卷五七〈六三四頁〉作「葉」。按「來業」語晦，今據改。卒聞教武百衲本、南本「卒」作「臣」，不可通。北、汲、殿、局四本此字缺，旁注「疑」字。今據冊府卷三一二〈三六八六頁〉改。加衞大將軍按下云：「尋授車騎將軍、左光祿大夫」，衞大將軍班在車騎將軍上〈卷一一三官氏志〉，似是貶降。但下文廣陵王羽以征東大將軍為衞將軍；高陽王雍先是征南大將軍，改鎮北大將軍，後為相州刺史，所帶軍號却止是鎮北將軍。與此同例，或是先後制度不同。卒贈撫軍將軍儀同三司青州刺史按墓誌集釋元譚墓誌〈圖版一七五〉稱「建義元年，歲次戊申，四月十三日，龍飛之會，橫離大禍」，則元譚也於河陰被殺。傳止稱「卒」，似善終。疑誤。夷人寧悅北史卷一九、御覽卷七０三〈三一三七頁〉「夷人」作「夷夏」。按御覽引魏書，却與北史同，則舊本亦作「夷夏」。人命之本事冊府卷六九〈七七五頁〉「本」作「大」，疑是。若賞不盡能諸本「賞」作「實」，冊府〈同上卷頁〉作「賞」。按上云「行賞得人」，這裏意謂行賞而和他的能力不稱，前後相貫，「實」字訛，今據改。民斯下矣按語不可解，「民」字疑訛。謂長兼尚書于果曰諸本「果」訛「杲」，據北史卷一九、本書卷三一于栗磾附于果傳改。可為中李慈銘魏書札記〈以下簡稱李慈銘〉云：「北史〈卷一九〉『中』下有『第』字，此脫。羽進號衞將軍按上文早說「加衞將軍」，何待這時進號。前後必有一誤。為牧之道亦難亦易百衲本、汲本「亦難亦易」作「非難亦易」，南、北、殿、局四本作「非難非易」。北史卷一九、御覽卷二五四〈一一九六頁〉作「亦易亦難」。冊府卷一五六〈一八九二頁〉作「亦難亦易」。按「非難亦易」必誤，南本以下當是以意改。御覽此段雖標「後魏書」，實出北史，如作「帝誡曰」不作「高祖誡曰」，又無下「又當愛賢士」云云，可證。今據冊府改。或任官外戍通典卷一五載元雍表「任」作「征」。按「征官」指征行之官，故與「外戍」連文，疑「任」字訛。甄琛啟云諸本「琛」皆作「深」。按語見卷六八甄琛傳，「深」乃形訛，今改正。以功封安德縣開國公諸本「德」作「得」。墓誌集釋元端墓誌〈圖版一七九〉作「安德郡開國公」。按卷一０六上地形志上冀州安德郡，云：「太和中置，尋併勃海，中興中復」，郡屬有安德縣。「安得」顯為「安德」之訛，今改正。據地形志，元端封爵時，在此郡併入勃海郡後，復郡前，當時並無安德郡。雖北魏封邑都是虛封，太和以前更是隨意立名，不必有此郡，但太和定制後這種情況已有所改變。「安德」既無此郡，傳作「縣公」未必誤，今不改。至夜守者以聞詳哭數聲而暴死李慈銘云：「『守者以聞』，『以』字衍。上既云『呈奏』矣，不得又言『以聞』。且方『以聞』，不言害詳事，何得便言『詳哭數聲而死』？北史〈卷一九〉『攬得呈奏』下云：『帝密令害之。此傳當脫一句，故下云：『至夜，守者聞詳哭數聲而死。蓋莫知其死狀也。相州行臺甄密先受朝旨諸本無「密」字。按「甄」下不應不書名。通鑑卷一五二〈四七四七頁〉作「甄密」。甄密為相州行臺亦見卷六八本傳，這裏脫「密」字，今據補。顥弟頊諸本「頊」作「瑱」。據北史卷一九、冊府卷二八一〈三三一二頁〉、墓誌集釋元頊墓誌〈圖版一八四〉改，參卷一０校記。

sourceRange.text: 高祖臨崩，顧命詳為司空輔政。世宗即位，以詳有營構之勤，增邑一千戶。詳以帝居諒闇，不受。世宗覽政，遷侍中、大將軍、錄尚書事。咸陽王禧之謀反也，詳表求解任。詔曰：「一人之身，愆不累德，形乖性別，忠逆固殊。是以父殛子興，義高唐世；弟戮兄登，迹顯周魯。禧之與國，異體同氣，既肆無君之逆，安顧弟友之親。叔父忠顯二朝，誠貫廟社，實勗贊沖昧，保乂鴻猷，豈容以微介之慮，忘阿衡之重，貂章即已敕還，願不再述。祚屬眇躬，言及斯事，臨紙慚恨，惋慨兼深。」詳重表陳解，詔復不許。除太傅，領司徒，侍中、錄尚書事如故。詳固辭，詔遣敦勸，乃受。

manualTranslations.zh: 咸陽王禧之謀反也，詳表求解任。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xi, Prince of Xianyang, plotted rebellion, Xiang memorialized requesting to be relieved of office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xi, Prince of Xianyang, plotted rebellion, Xiang submitted a memorial asking to resign.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔曰：「一人之身，愆不累德，形乖性別，忠逆固殊。
manualTranslations.literal: The edict said: "In a single person's body, faults do not implicate virtue; when form is different and nature distinct, loyalty and rebellion are surely separate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The edict said: "In one person's own body, faults do not taint virtue; when form and nature differ, loyalty and rebellion are plainly distinct.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以父殛子興，義高唐世；
manualTranslations.literal: Thus when a father was executed and a son rose, the principle stood high in the age of Tang;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus, when a father was executed and his son rose, the principle stood high in the age of Tang;

manualTranslations.zh: 弟戮兄登，迹顯周魯。
manualTranslations.literal: when a younger brother was put to death and an elder brother ascended, the precedent was manifest in Zhou and Lu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when a younger brother was put to death and his elder brother ascended, the precedent was clear in Zhou and Lu.

manualTranslations.zh: 禧之與國，異體同氣，既肆無君之逆，安顧弟友之親。
manualTranslations.literal: Xi and the state are of different bodies but the same vital breath; since he has wantonly committed rebellion against his ruler, how could he look to the affection of brotherly friendship?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xi and the state are separate bodies but share one breath; since he has committed rebellion against his ruler, how could he still expect the affection due between brothers?

manualTranslations.zh: 叔父忠顯二朝，誠貫廟社，實勗贊沖昧，保乂鴻猷，豈容以微介之慮，忘阿衡之重，貂章即已敕還，願不再述。
manualTranslations.literal: Uncle's loyalty was manifest through two reigns, and his sincerity penetrates the ancestral temples and altars. He truly encouraged and supported Our youthful ignorance and preserved the great plan. How could We, because of a slight concern, forget the weight of an Aheng? The sable-tail insignia has already been ordered returned; We hope you will not mention this again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Uncle's loyalty has shone through two reigns, and his sincerity reaches the temples and altars. You truly aided Our youthful ignorance and safeguarded the great plan. How could We forget the weight of an Aheng over so slight a concern? The sable-tail insignia has already been ordered returned; We hope you will not raise this again.

manualTranslations.literal: The throne has fallen to Our insignificant person; when speech reaches this matter, facing the paper We feel shame and resentment, and regret and indignation are both deep."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The throne has fallen to Our unworthy person; when We speak of this matter, We face the paper with shame and resentment, and with regret and indignation both deep."

items.acceptedSourceText: 高祖臨崩，顧命詳為司空輔政。世宗即位，以詳有營構之勤，增邑一千戶。詳以帝居諒闇，不受。世宗覽政，遷侍中、大將軍、錄尚書事。咸陽王禧之謀反也，詳表求解任。詔曰：「一人之身，愆不累德，形乖性別，忠逆固殊。是以父殛子興，義高唐世；弟戮兄登，迹顯周魯。禧之與國，異體同氣，既肆無君之逆，安顧弟友之親。叔父忠顯二朝，誠貫廟社，實勗贊沖昧，保乂鴻猷，豈容以微介之慮，忘阿衡之重，貂章即已敕還，願不再述。祚屬眇躬，言及斯事，臨紙慚恨，惋慨兼深。」詳重表陳解，詔復不許。除太傅，領司徒，侍中、錄尚書事如故。詳固辭，詔遣敦勸，乃受。

localRange.text: 校勘記但汝以我親諸本「以我親」作「亦我」二字。冊府卷二八六宋本如上摘句，明本〈三三六五頁〉作「以親」二字。按「但汝亦我」語不可解，顯誤，今據宋本冊府改補。比鳳皇未至諸本「至」作「一」，下注「疑」字，今據冊府卷二六九〈三一八四頁〉改。以其舅潘僧固為冀州樂陵太守北史卷一九彭城王勰傳「樂陵」作「長樂」。按冀州有長樂，無樂陵，樂陵屬青州，見卷一０六地形志上及中。此傳當誤。于時齊州民劉均房頃等扇動三齊蕭衍遣將彭群王辯等搔擾邊陲卷九肅宗紀孝昌三年三月「房頃」作「房須」，參卷九校記[二０]。又諸本「彭」下有「城」字，「群」作「郡」。按卷九肅宗紀孝昌三年正月、卷七九鹿悆傳、冊府卷一二一〈一四五一頁〉均作「彭群、王辯」，彭群是人名。這裏「群」訛「郡」，後人又妄加「城」字。今據刪正。錄尚書事相按「相」上當脫「丞」字，或「相」下脫「國」字。

sourceRange.text: 嫡子劭，字子訥，襲封。善武藝，少有氣節。肅宗初，蕭衍遣將犯邊，劭上表曰：「偽豎遊魂，闚覦邊境，勞兵兼時，日有千金之費。臣仰籍先資，紹饗厚秩，思以埃塵，用裨山海。臣國封徐州，去軍差近，謹奉粟九千斛、絹六百匹、國吏二百人，以充軍用。」靈太后嘉其至意，而不許之。起家宗正少卿。又除使持節、假散騎常侍、平東將軍、青州刺史。于時，齊州民劉均、房頃等，扇動三齊。蕭衍遣將彭群、王辯等搔擾邊陲，劭頻有防拒之效。孝昌末，靈太后失德，四方紛擾，劭遂有異志。為安豐王延明所啟，乃徵入為御史中尉。莊帝即位，尊為無上王。尋遇害河陰。追諡曰孝宣皇帝，妻李氏為文恭皇后。有二子。

manualTranslations.zh: 嫡子劭，字子訥，襲封。
manualTranslations.literal: His legitimate son Shao, styled Zinuo, succeeded to the fief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His legitimate son Shao, styled Zinuo, succeeded to the fief.

manualTranslations.zh: 善武藝，少有氣節。
manualTranslations.literal: He was skilled in martial arts and in youth had mettle and integrity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was skilled in arms and showed mettle and integrity from youth.

manualTranslations.zh: 肅宗初，蕭衍遣將犯邊，劭上表曰：「偽豎遊魂，闚覦邊境，勞兵兼時，日有千金之費。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in Suzong's reign, Xiao Yan sent generals to violate the border, and Shao submitted a memorial: "The false upstart's wandering remnant peers covetously at the frontier, wearying the troops for months at a time and costing a thousand pieces of gold each day.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Suzong's reign, Xiao Yan sent generals to raid the border, and Shao submitted a memorial: "The false upstart's lingering remnant covets the frontier, exhausting the troops for months and costing a thousand pieces of gold each day.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣仰籍先資，紹饗厚秩，思以埃塵，用裨山海。
manualTranslations.literal: Your minister relies on ancestral resources and continues to enjoy generous emoluments; I think to use my speck of dust to aid the mountains and seas.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I rely on inherited resources and continue to enjoy generous emoluments; I wish to offer my speck of dust in aid of the mountains and seas.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣國封徐州，去軍差近，謹奉粟九千斛、絹六百匹、國吏二百人，以充軍用。」
manualTranslations.literal: My state's fief is Xuzhou, somewhat near the army, and I respectfully offer nine thousand hu of grain, six hundred bolts of silk, and two hundred officials of the fief to fill out military needs."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: My fief is Xuzhou, somewhat near the army, and I respectfully offer nine thousand hu of grain, six hundred bolts of silk, and two hundred fief officials for military use."

manualTranslations.zh: 靈太后嘉其至意，而不許之。
manualTranslations.literal: Empress Dowager Ling praised his utmost intent but did not allow it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Ling praised his devotion but did not allow it.

manualTranslations.zh: 起家宗正少卿。
manualTranslations.literal: He began his career as Junior Minister of the Imperial Clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He began his career as Junior Minister of the Imperial Clan.

manualTranslations.zh: 又除使持節、假散騎常侍、平東將軍、青州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was also appointed Bearer of the Staff, Acting Regular Mounted Attendant, General Who Pacifies the East, and Inspector of Qingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was also appointed Bearer of the Staff, Acting Regular Mounted Attendant, General Who Pacifies the East, and Inspector of Qingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 于時，齊州民劉均、房頃等，扇動三齊。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, the Qizhou commoners Liu Jun, Fang Qing, and others were stirring up the Three Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, the Qizhou commoners Liu Jun, Fang Qing, and others were stirring up the Three Qi region.

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭衍遣將彭群、王辯等搔擾邊陲，劭頻有防拒之效。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao Yan sent generals Peng Qun, Wang Bian, and others to harass the frontier, and Shao repeatedly rendered effective defense and resistance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan sent generals Peng Qun, Wang Bian, and others to harass the frontier, and Shao repeatedly distinguished himself in defense.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昌末，靈太后失德，四方紛擾，劭遂有異志。
manualTranslations.literal: Late in Xiaochang, Empress Dowager Ling lost virtue and the four quarters were in turmoil, so Shao came to harbor other designs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Late in Xiaochang, when Empress Dowager Ling lost virtue and the realm was in turmoil, Shao came to harbor designs of his own.

manualTranslations.zh: 為安豐王延明所啟，乃徵入為御史中尉。
manualTranslations.literal: Prince of Anfeng Yanming reported him, and he was then summoned in to serve as Censor-in-Chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prince of Anfeng Yanming reported him, and he was summoned in to serve as Censor-in-Chief.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊帝即位，尊為無上王。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Zhuang ascended the throne, Shao was honored as Prince Without Superior.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhuang ascended the throne, Shao was honored as Prince Without Superior.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋遇害河陰。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was killed at Heyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was killed at Heyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 追諡曰孝宣皇帝，妻李氏為文恭皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously he was titled Emperor Xiaoxuan, and his wife Lady Li was made Empress Wengong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was titled Emperor Xiaoxuan, and his wife Lady Li was made Empress Wengong.

manualTranslations.zh: 有二子。
manualTranslations.literal: He had two sons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had two sons.

sourceRange.text: 論曰：庶人險暴之性，自幼而長，終以廢黜，不得其終。斯乃硃、均之性，堯、舜不能訓也。京兆早有令問，晚致顛覆，習於所染，可不慎乎！清河器識才譽，以懿親作輔，時鐘屯詖，始遘牆茨之逼。運屬道消，晚扼凶權之手。悲哉！廣平早歲驕盈，汝南性致狂逸，揆其終始，俱不足論。而悅以天人所棄，卒嬰猜懼之毒，蓋地逼之尤也。category:魏書

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷二十二諸本目錄此卷注闕。卷後當有宋人校語，傳本脫去。殿本考證云：「魏收書闕，後人所補。檢傳文也是以北史卷一九孝文五王傳補，溢出字句，當出高氏小史。北史五王傳也有殘缺，如廣平王懷傳只存三十五字，汝南王悅傳也多缺文，此傳亦同。廣平文穆王懷卷一一出帝紀作「廣平武穆王」。墓誌集釋元懷墓誌〈圖版一九三〉稱「諡曰武穆」。集釋卷四歷據元悌〈圖版一九四〉、元誨〈一九五〉、元靈耀〈一０九〉、元夫人趙光〈六四〉諸墓誌及洛陽伽藍記卷二平等寺條、金石錄卷二一范陽王碑跋，證傳作「文穆」應是「武穆」之誤。常置左右年四歲太皇太后親為立名恂字元道於是大赦御覽卷一四八〈七二三頁〉「常置左右」下作「詔曰：『昔塗山有育，美名列於夏典；任姒作配，昌發顯於周書。故能輯熙丕緒，祚延八百。自元子誕育，於今四載，而名表未孚於四方，茂實未昭於朝掖，非所以憲章遠猷，允光禮度者也。太皇太后親發明旨，為之立名，依德協義，名恂字元道。國祚永隆，儲貳有寄，無窮之兆，於是而始。乃大赦天下。這是魏書元恂傳原文。此傳自「年四歲」至「於是大赦」，乃北史據此段文字簡括。今日親見吾也通志卷八四下孝文六王傳「今」作「如」，疑是。自以職求侍要通志卷八四下作「自以職非親要」，疑是。五利僥終嬰於顯戮殿本考證云：「載懌表諫，終於此句，文尚未了，定係殘缺。通志卷八四下此句下有：「此事可為至鑒，靈太后深納之。按表文未完，並未提出如何處理辦法，所謂「深納之」者何指？知通志只是以意補上兩句，並非原文。冊府卷二八八〈三三九六頁〉「五利僥」作「五利之詐」，又將此句和上「新垣〈加『之』字〉姦不登於明堂」移在表首，文義稍順，當亦以表文不完，意為改易，亦非原文。此傳本出北史，北史此下脫文如何，已不可知。檢通典卷一六有如下文字：孝明帝時，清河王懌以官人失序，上表曰：「孝文帝制出身之人，本以門品高下有恒。若準資蔭，自公卿令僕之子，甲乙丙丁之族，上則散騎秘著，下逮御史長兼，皆條例昭然，文無虧沒。自此或身非三事之子，解褐公府正佐；地非甲乙之類，而得上宰行僚。自茲以降，亦多乖舛。且參軍事專，非出身之職，今必釋褐而居；秘著本為起家之官，今或遷轉以至。斯皆仰失先準，有違明令。非所謂式遵遺範，奉順成規。此雖官人之失，相循已久，然推其彌漫，抑亦有由。何者？信一人之明，當九流之廣，必令該鑑氏族，辨照人倫，才識有限，固難審悉。所以州置中正之官，清定門冑，品藻高卑，四海畫一，專尸衡石，任實不輕。故自置中正以來，暨於太和之日，莫不高擬其人，妙盡茲選。皆須名位重於鄉國，才德允於具瞻，然後可以品裁州郡，綜覈人物。今之所置，多非其人，乞明為敕制，使官人選才，備依先旨，無令能否乖方，違才易務。并革退中正，一依前軌。庶清源有歸，流序允穆。靈太后詔依表施行而終不能用。通典所載北魏詔令章奏一般即出魏書，如此文上面所引高祐、韓顯宗兩疏皆見本傳，則上引元懌表也必出魏書本傳原文。北史於詔令章奏多刪去不錄，或節略。此表可能不錄，但亦應記其事。今此傳一無所見，疑「五利僥」云云下所脫不止諫優重惠憐表後段，并脫元懌上表論選舉事。叉黨人通直郎宋維希叉旨諸本及北史卷一九「宋維」作「宗準愛」，通志卷八四下作「宋準」。按卷一六京兆王黎附元叉傳稱：「叉遂令通直郎宋維告司染都尉韓文殊欲謀逆立懌。卷六０韓麒麟附韓子熙傳，子熙等上書為元懌辯白也說「宋維小子」云云。宋維，附卷六三宋弁傳，傳中也記載此事。這裏「宗準」顯為「宋維」之訛，鄭樵所見北史此傳「宋」尚未訛「宗」。今改正。「愛」字或是衍文，或「爰」字之訛，今刪。為之劈面者數百人殿本考證云：「劈面係剺面之訛。按通志正作「剺面」。悅為大剉碓置於州門錢氏考異卷三八云：「此悅都督徐州時事，其上又有脫文。按卷九肅宗紀正光四年十二月稱：「以太尉、汝南王悅為太保、徐州刺史。通志卷一八四下此句上有「遷太保，出為徐州刺史」，當是據紀增。衍遣其將軍王辯送置於境上諸本「王辯」作「王僧辯」。按卷五八楊昱傳見梁將軍「王辯」，梁書卷三三羊侃傳作「王弁」，而本書卷一０孝莊帝紀也作「王僧辯」。王辯又見卷九肅宗紀孝昌三年正月、卷二一下彭城王勰附元劭傳、卷七九鹿悆傳。「僧」字乃後人妄加，今刪。參卷一０校記[四]。出帝初除大司馬卒按卷一一出帝紀太昌元年十二月明記元悅被殺。北史卷一九也說悅和前廢帝〈廣陵王恭〉並為孝武帝〈即出帝〉「前後害之」，本不誤。此傳後半不出北史，但書「卒」，似善終，刪節失當。

sourceRange.text: 論曰：庶人險暴之性，自幼而長，終以廢黜，不得其終。斯乃硃、均之性，堯、舜不能訓也。京兆早有令問，晚致顛覆，習於所染，可不慎乎！清河器識才譽，以懿親作輔，時鐘屯詖，始遘牆茨之逼。運屬道消，晚扼凶權之手。悲哉！廣平早歲驕盈，汝南性致狂逸，揆其終始，俱不足論。而悅以天人所棄，卒嬰猜懼之毒，蓋地逼之尤也。category:魏書

manualTranslations.zh: 論曰：庶人險暴之性，自幼而長，終以廢黜，不得其終。
manualTranslations.literal: The appraisal says: The commoner's dangerous and violent nature grew from childhood; in the end he was deposed and did not attain a proper end.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: The commoner's dangerous and violent nature grew from childhood; in the end he was deposed and did not come to a proper end.

manualTranslations.zh: 斯乃硃、均之性，堯、舜不能訓也。
manualTranslations.literal: This was the nature of Zhu and Jun; Yao and Shun could not instruct it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Such was the nature of Zhu and Jun; Yao and Shun could not instruct it.

manualTranslations.zh: 京兆早有令問，晚致顛覆，習於所染，可不慎乎！
manualTranslations.literal: Jingzhao early had fair renown, but late came to ruin; habituation to what stains one--can one fail to be cautious!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jingzhao early won fair renown, but late came to ruin; once habituated to what stains one, can one fail to be cautious!

manualTranslations.zh: 清河器識才譽，以懿親作輔，時鐘屯詖，始遘牆茨之逼。
manualTranslations.literal: Qinghe had capacity, insight, talent, and reputation, and as an excellent kinsman served as assistant, but the time fell on hardship and crookedness, and he first met the pressure of the wall-thorns.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qinghe had capacity, insight, talent, and reputation, and as an excellent kinsman served as assistant, but the age fell into hardship and crookedness, and he first met the pressure of the wall-thorns.

manualTranslations.zh: 運屬道消，晚扼凶權之手。
manualTranslations.literal: His fortunes belonged to a time when the Way declined, and late he was gripped in the hands of violent power.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His fortunes met a time when the Way declined, and late he was throttled by violent power.

manualTranslations.zh: 悲哉！
manualTranslations.literal: Alas!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Alas!

manualTranslations.zh: 廣平早歲驕盈，汝南性致狂逸，揆其終始，俱不足論。
manualTranslations.literal: Guangping was arrogant and full in his early years, and Runan by nature reached wild excess; weighing their ends from their beginnings, both are not worth discussing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guangping was arrogant and full in his early years, and Runan by nature ran to wild excess; judged from beginning to end, neither is worth discussing.

manualTranslations.zh: 而悅以天人所棄，卒嬰猜懼之毒，蓋地逼之尤也。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Yue, abandoned by Heaven and men, finally suffered the poison of suspicion and fear; this was likely the extreme result of being pressed too close by position.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Yue, abandoned by Heaven and men, finally suffered the poison of suspicion and fear; this was likely the extreme result of a prince pressed too near the throne.

localRange.text: 校勘記操立碑於大邗城南錢氏考異卷三八云：「此傳載衞操所立碑……惜為史臣改竄，失其本真。篇首云：『魏軒轅之苗裔。考其時未有魏號，以文義度之當云『鮮卑拓跋氏』也。碑為猗㐌而立，必書晉所授官爵及猗㐌、猗盧二人名，篇乃稱『桓穆二帝』，亦史臣所改。外動亦攘北史卷二０本傳「動」作「勳」。按「外勳亦攘」，意為對外有攘患之功，碑末有「勳攘大患」句也是此意。似作「勳」是。白部大人絜佛叛諸本「白」作「曰」。冊府卷三五二〈四一八０頁〉作「白」。按卷一序紀力微之三十九年稱：「夏四月祭天，諸部君長悉來助祭，唯白部大人觀望不至。又猗盧之三年稱「白部大人叛入西河」。「曰」字訛，今據冊府改。自立功名之地諸本無「名」字。殿本考證云：「『功』字下北史〈卷二０〉有『名』字，應以彼為是。按「功名」與上「馳驟」對文，這裏脫「名」字，今據北史補。

sourceRange.text: 」又云：「非桓天挺，忠孝自然。孰能超常，不為異端。回動大眾，感公之言。功濟方州，勳烈光延。升平之日，納貢充蕃。憑瞻鑾蓋，步趾三川。有德無祿，大命不延。年三十有九，以永興二年六月二十四日，寢疾薨殂。背棄華殿，雲中名都。國失惠主，哀感欷歔。悲痛煩冤，載號載呼。舉國崩絕，攀援靡訴。遠近齊軌，奔赴梓廬。人百其身，盈塞門塗。高山其頹，茂林凋枯。仰訴造化，痛延悲夫。」又云：桓帝「忠於晉室，駿奔長衢。隆冬凄凄，四出行誅。蒙犯霜雪，疹入脉膚。用致薨殞，不永桑榆。以死勤事，經勳同模。垂名金石，載美晉書。平北哀悼，祭以豐厨，考行論勳，諡曰義烈。功施於人，祀典所說。

manualTranslations.zh: 又云：「非桓天挺，忠孝自然。
manualTranslations.literal: It also says: "Huan was endowed by Heaven, loyal and filial by nature.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It also says: "Huan was endowed by Heaven, loyal and filial by nature.

manualTranslations.zh: 孰能超常，不為異端。
manualTranslations.literal: Who could transcend the ordinary and not become a strange aberration?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Who else could transcend the ordinary without becoming an aberration?

manualTranslations.zh: 回動大眾，感公之言。
manualTranslations.literal: He turned and moved the multitude, who were stirred by the lord's words.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He stirred the multitude, moved by the lord's words.

manualTranslations.zh: 功濟方州，勳烈光延。
manualTranslations.literal: His merit aided a whole province, and his achievements shone and spread.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His merit aided a whole province, and his achievements shone far and wide.

manualTranslations.zh: 升平之日，納貢充蕃。
manualTranslations.literal: In days of peace, he offered tribute and filled the frontier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In days of peace, he offered tribute and strengthened the frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 憑瞻鑾蓋，步趾三川。
manualTranslations.literal: Leaning on them, he looked toward the imperial canopies and set foot in the Three Rivers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Trusting in them, he looked toward the imperial canopies and set foot in the Three Rivers.

manualTranslations.zh: 有德無祿，大命不延。
manualTranslations.literal: He had virtue but no allotted fortune; his great span did not extend.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had virtue but no allotted fortune, and his great span did not extend.

manualTranslations.zh: 年三十有九，以永興二年六月二十四日，寢疾薨殂。
manualTranslations.literal: At age thirty-nine, on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month of Yongxing year 2, he fell ill and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At thirty-nine, on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month of Yongxing year 2, he fell ill and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 背棄華殿，雲中名都。
manualTranslations.literal: He turned his back on the splendid hall, the famed capital in Yunzhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He left behind the splendid hall and the famed capital of Yunzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 國失惠主，哀感欷歔。
manualTranslations.literal: The state lost a kindly lord; grief moved sobs and sighs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The state lost a kindly lord; grief stirred sobs and sighs.

manualTranslations.zh: 悲痛煩冤，載號載呼。
manualTranslations.literal: Sorrow and pain, vexation and anguish: they wailed and cried.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sorrow and pain, anguish and wrong: they wailed and cried.

manualTranslations.zh: 舉國崩絕，攀援靡訴。
manualTranslations.literal: The whole state collapsed in despair, clutching for support with nowhere to appeal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The whole state collapsed in despair, clutching for support with nowhere to appeal.

manualTranslations.zh: 遠近齊軌，奔赴梓廬。
manualTranslations.literal: Far and near followed the same road, hurrying to the coffin hut.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Far and near followed the same road, hurrying to the coffin hut.

manualTranslations.zh: 人百其身，盈塞門塗。
manualTranslations.literal: People would have given a hundred lives for his one, filling and blocking gate and road.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: People would have given a hundred lives for his one, filling and blocking the gates and roads.

manualTranslations.zh: 高山其頹，茂林凋枯。
manualTranslations.literal: The high mountain had fallen; the luxuriant forest had withered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The high mountain had fallen; the luxuriant forest had withered.

manualTranslations.zh: 仰訴造化，痛延悲夫。」
manualTranslations.literal: They looked up and appealed to Creation, pain prolonging their grief."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They looked up and appealed to Creation, pain prolonging their grief."

manualTranslations.zh: 又云：桓帝「忠於晉室，駿奔長衢。
manualTranslations.literal: Again it says: Emperor Huan "was loyal to the Jin house and hastened along the long road.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Again it says: Emperor Huan "was loyal to the Jin house and hastened along the long road.

manualTranslations.zh: 隆冬凄凄，四出行誅。
manualTranslations.literal: In bleak midwinter, he went out in all directions to carry out punishment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In bleak midwinter, he went out in all directions to carry out punishment.

manualTranslations.zh: 蒙犯霜雪，疹入脉膚。
manualTranslations.literal: He braved frost and snow, and illness entered his veins and skin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He braved frost and snow until illness entered his veins and skin.

manualTranslations.zh: 用致薨殞，不永桑榆。
manualTranslations.literal: Thus he came to die and fall, not prolonging his twilight years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus he came to die, not prolonging his twilight years.

manualTranslations.zh: 以死勤事，經勳同模。
manualTranslations.literal: He was diligent in service unto death, matching the model of meritorious service.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served diligently unto death, matching the model of meritorious service.

manualTranslations.zh: 垂名金石，載美晉書。
manualTranslations.literal: His name was handed down on metal and stone, and his excellence was recorded in the Book of Jin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His name was handed down on metal and stone, and his excellence was recorded in the Book of Jin.

manualTranslations.zh: 平北哀悼，祭以豐厨，考行論勳，諡曰義烈。
manualTranslations.literal: The General Who Pacifies the North mourned him, sacrificed with abundant kitchens, examined his conduct and discussed his merit, and gave him the posthumous name Yilie.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The General Who Pacifies the North mourned him, sacrificed with abundant offerings, examined his conduct and discussed his merit, and gave him the posthumous name Yilie.

manualTranslations.zh: 功施於人，祀典所說。」
manualTranslations.literal: His merit was bestowed on the people; it is what the sacrificial canons commend."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His merit benefited the people; it is what the sacrificial canons commend."

manualTranslations.zh: 其頌又稱：桓帝「金堅玉剛。
manualTranslations.literal: Its eulogy further states: Emperor Huan "was firm as metal and hard as jade.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Its eulogy further states: Emperor Huan "was firm as metal and hard as jade.

manualTranslations.zh: 應期順會，王有北方。
manualTranslations.literal: He answered the time and followed its convergence, ruling in the north.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He answered the moment and followed its convergence, ruling in the north.

manualTranslations.zh: 行能濟國，武平四荒。
manualTranslations.literal: His conduct could aid the state, and his martial power pacified the four wastes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His conduct aided the state, and his martial power pacified the four wastes.

manualTranslations.zh: 無思不服，區域大康。
manualTranslations.literal: None who thought of him failed to submit; the region was greatly at peace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: None who thought of him failed to submit; the region was greatly at peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 世路紛糾，運遭播揚。
manualTranslations.literal: The roads of the age tangled in disorder, and his fortunes met dispersal and upheaval.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The roads of the age tangled in disorder, and his fortunes met upheaval.

manualTranslations.zh: 羯胡因釁，敢害并土。
manualTranslations.literal: The Jie barbarians seized on disorder and dared to harm Bing's lands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Jie barbarians seized on disorder and dared to harm the lands of Bing.

manualTranslations.zh: 哀痛下民，死亡失所。
manualTranslations.literal: He grieved for the lower people, who were dying and losing their homes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He grieved for the common people, dying and driven from their homes.

manualTranslations.zh: 率眾百萬，平夷險阻。
manualTranslations.literal: He led a million people, leveling dangers and obstacles.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He led a million people, leveling dangers and obstacles.

manualTranslations.zh: 存亡繼絕，一州蒙祜。
manualTranslations.literal: He preserved the dying and continued the severed, and one province received blessing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He preserved the dying and continued the severed, and one province received his blessing.

manualTranslations.zh: 功烈桓桓，龍文虎武。
manualTranslations.literal: His meritorious achievements blazed, dragon-patterned and tiger-martial.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His achievements blazed, dragon-patterned and tiger-martial.

manualTranslations.zh: 朱邑小善，遺愛桐鄉。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhu Yi's small goodness left love in Tongxiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhu Yi's small goodness left love in Tongxiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 勳攘大患，六郡無。
manualTranslations.literal: His merit drove off a great calamity, and the six commanderies were spared.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His merit drove off a great calamity, and the six commanderies were spared.

manualTranslations.zh: 闕悉之來，由功而存。
manualTranslations.literal: After the lacuna, all who came were preserved through his merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the lacuna, all who came were preserved through his merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 刊石勒銘，垂示後昆。」
manualTranslations.literal: They carved stone and engraved an inscription, handing it down as a display to later descendants."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They carved stone and engraved an inscription, handing it down as a display to later descendants."

manualTranslations.zh: 時晉光熙元年秋也。
manualTranslations.literal: This was in the autumn of Jin Guangxi year 1.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This was in the autumn of Jin Guangxi year 1.

sourceRange.text: 長子衡，字伯玉，少以孝行著稱。學崔浩書，頗亦類焉。天安元年，擢為內祕書中散，班下詔命及御所覽書，多其迹也。衡舉李沖、李元愷、程駿等，終為名器，世以是稱之。承明元年，遷內都坐令，善折獄，高祖嘉之。太和二年，襲爵武陵公，鎮西將軍。遷給事中。車駕巡狩，以衡為大都督長史。衡涉獵書史，陳備禦之方，便國利民之策，凡五十餘條。以本將軍除泰州刺史，徙爵齊郡公。先是，河東年饑，劫盜大起，衡至，修龔遂之法，勸課農桑，周年之間，寇盜止息。十二年卒，年五十四。贈散騎常侍、左光祿大夫、本將軍、冀州刺史，帛一千匹、穀一千斛，諡曰惠公。衡有五子。

context.beforeSource: 延興二年卒，年六十三，遺命薄葬，斂以時服。
context.afterSource: 長子敞，字公世，襲爵，例降為侯。

manualTranslations.zh: 長子衡，字伯玉，少以孝行著稱。
manualTranslations.literal: Eldest son Heng, styled Boyu, in youth was known for filial conduct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His eldest son Heng, whose style was Boyu, was known from youth for filial conduct.

manualTranslations.zh: 學崔浩書，頗亦類焉。
manualTranslations.literal: He studied Cui Hao's calligraphy, and it too rather resembled it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He studied Cui Hao's calligraphy, and his hand came to resemble it closely.

manualTranslations.zh: 天安元年，擢為內祕書中散，班下詔命及御所覽書，多其迹也。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tian'an he was promoted to Consultant in the Inner Secretariat; among edicts and commands issued to the ranks and books read by the emperor, many were in his hand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tian'an he was promoted to Consultant in the Inner Secretariat; many edicts issued to the officials and writings read by the emperor were in his hand.

manualTranslations.zh: 衡舉李沖、李元愷、程駿等，終為名器，世以是稱之。
manualTranslations.literal: Heng recommended Li Chong, Li Yuankai, Cheng Jun, and others; in the end they became noted vessels, and the age praised him for this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Heng recommended Li Chong, Li Yuankai, Cheng Jun, and others, all of whom became men of distinction; people praised him for it.

manualTranslations.zh: 承明元年，遷內都坐令，善折獄，高祖嘉之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Chengming he was transferred to Director of the Inner Duzuo; he was skilled at deciding cases, and Emperor Gaozu commended him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chengming he became Director of the Inner Duzuo, where he judged cases well and earned Emperor Gaozu's praise.

manualTranslations.zh: 太和二年，襲爵武陵公，鎮西將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Taihe he inherited the title Duke of Wuling and General Who Stabilizes the West.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Taihe he inherited the titles Duke of Wuling and General Who Stabilizes the West.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷給事中。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was then promoted to Palace Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 車駕巡狩，以衡為大都督長史。
manualTranslations.literal: When the imperial carriage went on tours of inspection, Heng was made chief clerk to the grand commander-in-chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the emperor's inspection tours, Heng served as chief clerk to the grand commander-in-chief.

manualTranslations.zh: 衡涉獵書史，陳備禦之方，便國利民之策，凡五十餘條。
manualTranslations.literal: Heng browsed broadly in books and histories and set out methods for defense and plans to benefit the state and the people, more than fifty items in all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Heng read widely in books and histories and submitted more than fifty proposals on defense and policies beneficial to the state and the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 以本將軍除泰州刺史，徙爵齊郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: With his original general's title he was appointed Inspector of Tai Province, and his title was transferred to Duke of Qi Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Holding his original generalship, he was appointed Inspector of Tai Province and transferred in title to Duke of Qi Commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，河東年饑，劫盜大起，衡至，修龔遂之法，勸課農桑，周年之間，寇盜止息。
manualTranslations.literal: Before this, in Hedong there had been a year of famine and robbery had greatly arisen; when Heng arrived, he restored Gong Sui's methods, urged farming and sericulture, and within a year bandits and robbers stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, Hedong had suffered famine and robbery had become widespread. When Heng arrived, he followed Gong Sui's methods, encouraged farming and sericulture, and within a year brought banditry to an end.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年卒，年五十四。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the twelfth year, aged fifty-four.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth year, aged fifty-four.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈散騎常侍、左光祿大夫、本將軍、冀州刺史，帛一千匹、穀一千斛，諡曰惠公。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, his original generalship, and Inspector of Ji Province, with one thousand bolts of silk and one thousand hu of grain; his posthumous title was Duke Hui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, his original generalship, and Inspector of Ji Province, along with one thousand bolts of silk and one thousand hu of grain; his posthumous title was Duke Hui.

manualTranslations.zh: 衡有五子。
manualTranslations.literal: Heng had five sons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Heng had five sons.

localRange.text: 校勘記公達委身於魏武諸本「達」作「遠」，冊府卷七六五〈九０九五頁〉作「達」。按荀攸字公達〈三國志卷一０〉，曹操輔佐中著名人物不聞有「公遠」其人，今據冊府改。延弟白澤諸本「延」下有「孫」字，北史卷二一張袞傳作「度子白澤」，則是延弟。「孫」字衍，今刪。下民難辯按此句和上文不貫。冊府卷五四一〈六四八五頁〉作「不亦難辨」，連接上文「而欲使事靜民安，治清務簡，至於委任責成」為句，疑是。水鏡前禮冊府〈同上卷頁〉「水」作「永」，疑是。次子簡字沖亮北史卷二一崔宏傳「沖」作「仲」。按簡兄浩字伯淵〈卷三五本傳〉，弟恬字叔玄，簡是次子，作「仲亮」是。太祖初張森楷云：「玄伯以太祖中年歸魏，簡安得於太祖初入官，疑為『太宗』或『世祖』之誤。為兄渾誄手筆草本諸本「誄」訛「誅」，今據北史卷二一改。以一子繼浩弟覽妻封氏北史卷二一「浩」字下有「與浩」二字，「以一子繼浩」為句。疑此傳脫二字，但如此傳也可通，今不補。拜陝城鎮將二崤地嶮諸本「鎮」下有「西」字，下無「二」字，顯誤，今據冊府卷四一二〈四八九八頁〉、北史卷二一改。北史「二」作「三」，今從冊府。以本將軍除泰州刺史諸本「泰」作「秦」。按云「河東民饑」，則即卷一０六下地形志下治蒲坂之秦州，此「秦州」乃「泰州」之訛。這裏「秦」也是「泰」之訛。今改正。參卷一０六下校記[三九]。與崔賾相親諸本「賾」訛「頤」，今據墓誌集釋盧令媛墓誌〈圖版三七〉改。參卷三二校記[一一]。生子文華卷四三劉休賓傳「文華」作「文曄」，疑作「曄」是。始睦來降也百衲、南、汲、局四本「睦」作「陸」，北、殿二本作「睦」。按上云「柔孫睦，正光三年自郁州歸降」。作「睦」是，今從北、殿本。僕臣白曜按崔道固豈得稱白曜為「僕臣」。卷五０慕容白曜傳，白曜攻青、齊時，官尚書右僕射。這裏「僕」下當脫「射」字。與房法壽畢薩諸人皆不穆按青齊降魏諸將無「畢薩」其人，「薩」當是「薛」之訛，指薛安都。討海賊於黃郭諸本「賊」訛「戒」，今據冊府卷三七二〈四四二四頁〉改。且大人出本無所在況從上聖至天子天孫者乎冊府卷三七二〈四四二五頁〉作「且大人之出，本無所在，況從聖繼聖至夫〈冊府宋本作「天」〉子孫者乎」。較明白，此傳當有訛脫。所稱稍竭諸本「竭」訛「蝎」，今據冊府〈同上卷頁〉改。武夫效勇於疆埸諸本「勇」訛「通」，今據冊府〈同上卷頁〉改。羣情背去獨留者謬矣冊府〈同上卷頁〉「背去」作「皆去」，與下「獨留」對文，當是。但「背去」亦通，今不改。況枉連城矣冊府〈同上卷頁〉「況」作「沉」，疑是。但檢宋本冊府也作「況」，今不改。超進非一諸本「超進」訛「起崖」，下注「疑」字，今據冊府〈同上卷頁〉改，並刪「疑」字。與都督源子恭守丹谷戰歿諸本「丹谷」作「單父」，冊府卷四二五〈五０五五頁〉作「丹父」。按源子恭守丹谷，見卷一０莊帝紀永安三年十月和卷四一本傳。莊帝紀永安三年十二月壬寅更明云：「尒朱兆寇丹谷，都督崔伯鳳戰死。冊府「丹」字不誤，「谷」已訛「父」，舊本當同冊府，後人又妄改「丹」為「單」，今改正。中書學生諸本「中」下無「書」字。按「中書學生」屢見，下子羨條即云「歷中書學生」，今補「書」字。

localRange.text: 許謙，字元遜，代人也。少有文才，善天文圖讖之學。建國時，將家歸附，昭成嘉之，擢為代王郎中令，兼掌文記。與燕鳳俱授獻明帝經。從征衞辰，以功賜僮隸三十戶。昭成崩後，謙徙長安。苻堅從弟行唐公洛鎮和龍，請謙之鎮。未幾，以繼母老辭還。登國初，遂歸太祖。太祖悅，以為右司馬，與張袞等參贊初基。慕容寶來寇也，太祖使謙告難於姚興。興遣將楊佛嵩率眾來援，而佛嵩稽緩。太祖命謙為書以遺佛嵩曰：「夫杖順以翦遺，乘義而攻昧，未有非其運而顯功，無其時而著業。慕容無道，侵我疆埸，師老兵疲，天亡期至，是以遣使命軍，必望克赴。將軍據方邵之任，總熊虎之師，事與機會，今其時也。因此而舉，役不再駕，千載之勳，一朝可立。然後高會雲中，進師三魏，舉觴稱壽，不亦綽乎。佛嵩乃倍道兼行。太祖大悅，賜謙爵關內侯。重遣謙與佛嵩盟曰：「昔殷湯有鳴條之誓，周武有河陽之盟，所以藉神靈，昭忠信，夫親仁善隣，古之令軌，歃血割牲，以敦永穆。今既盟之後，言歸其好，分災恤患，休戚是同。有違此盟，神祗斯殛。寶敗，佛嵩乃還。明年，慕容垂復來寇。太祖謂謙曰：「今事急矣，非卿豈能復致姚師，卿其行也。謙未發而垂退，乃止。及聞垂死，謙上書勸進。太祖善之。并州平，以謙為陽曲護軍，賜爵平舒侯、安遠將軍。皇始元年卒官，時年六十三。贈平東將軍、左光祿大夫、幽州刺史、高陽公，諡曰文。子洛陽，襲。從征慕容寶，為冠軍司馬。後為祁令。太宗追錄謙功，以洛陽為雁門太守。洛陽家田三生嘉禾，皆異壟合穎，世祖善之。進爵北地公，加鎮南將軍。出為明壘鎮將，居八年，卒。諡曰恭。子寄生，襲爵，降為侯。皇興元年卒。洛陽弟安國，中山太守。安國弟安都，廣寧、滄水二郡太守。加揚威將軍。賜爵東光子。天安初卒。贈平遠將軍、冀州刺史、東光侯，諡曰烈。子白虎，襲爵。為侍御中散。後以罪免官，奪爵。

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷二十五諸本目錄此卷注「闕」。百衲本、南本、汲本卷末殘存宋人校語：「魏收書列傳第十三。局本下補「亡」字。殿本考證云：「魏收書闕，後人所補。按此卷以北史卷二二長孫嵩、長孫道生傳補，附長孫稚傳有溢出語，當出於高氏小史。嵩率舊人及鄉邑七百餘家叛顯走北史卷二二長孫嵩傳「鄉邑」作「庶師」。按「庶師」和「舊人」對舉。「舊人」指拓跋本部人，「庶師」當是指非本部的諸族人。疑這裏的「鄉邑」乃後人所改。於是叔孫建等尋河趣洛遂入關按尋河趣洛者是叔孫建所領魏軍，入關者是劉裕所統的晉軍，這裏牽連敍述，遂似叔孫建等入關。疑「遂入關」上脫「裕」字。尚書劉潔武京侯安原請先平馮跋卷三０安原傳「武京」作「武原」。按晉書卷一五地理志下徐州彭城國有「武原縣」。地不屬魏，但當時封邑取南朝郡縣名的很多。「武京」不聞有此縣，此傳「京」字疑誤。帝乃問幽微於天師寇謙之北史卷二二「微」作「徵」，「微」當是「徵」之訛。杜超之贊成之按杜超，卷八三外戚傳有傳。可能是雙名「超之」，單稱作「超」，也可能涉上「寇謙之」而衍「之」字。高宗時自頌先世勳重諸本「宗」作「祖」。按事見卷五高宗紀興安二年歲末，「祖」字訛，今改正。進爵汝陰公張森楷云：「以前初無封爵之文，而云『進爵』，疑誤。按此傳以北史卷二二長孫道生傳補，當是李延壽刪節之失。這種刪節失當，下文還有，如「帝以其祖道生佐命先朝」，不知為何帝；「以本使達鄴城」，不知為何使。今不悉出校記。子抗北史卷二二「抗」作「瓬」。旁無姻妾北史卷二二「姻」作「姬」，是。

localRange.text: 校勘記追斬至長城下冊府卷三八一〈四五二八頁〉「長城」作「其城」。按和龍距古長城甚遠，疑作「其」是。越勒部按「勒」當是「勤」之訛，詳卷一一三校記越勒氏條。下同，不再列舉。第八子觀北史卷二０尉古真傳「觀」作「歡」。魏書當因避高歡諱改。進爵漁陽公諸本「漁」作「源」。北史卷二０作「漁陽王」，節去由公進王事。按卷五高宗紀太安三年正月見「漁陽公尉眷」，和平四年五月書「漁陽王尉眷薨」。「源陽」無此郡名，今據改。東涼州刺史北史卷二０無「東」字。按「東涼州」無考，「東」字當是衍文。

sourceRange.text: 眷弟地干，機悟有才藝，馳馬立射五的，時人莫能及。太宗時，為左機令。世祖少而善之，即位，擢為庫部尚書，加散騎常侍、左光祿大夫，領侍輦郎。地干奉上忠謹，尤善嘲笑。世祖見其效人舉措，忻悅不能自勝。甚見親愛，參軍國大謀。世祖將征平涼，試衝車以攻冢，地干為索所罥，折脅而卒。世祖親往臨撫，哭之甚慟。贈中領軍將軍、燕郡公，諡曰惠，贈賜豐厚。

manualTranslations.zh: 眷弟地干，機悟有才藝，馳馬立射五的，時人莫能及。
manualTranslations.literal: Juan's younger brother Diggan was quick-witted and had talent and skill; galloping on horseback he could shoot five standing targets, and no one of the time could match him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Juan's younger brother Diggan was clever and gifted; at a gallop he could hit five standing targets, and none of his contemporaries could match him.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗時，為左機令。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taizong's time he served as Left Ji Director.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Taizong he served as Left Ji Director.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖少而善之，即位，擢為庫部尚書，加散騎常侍、左光祿大夫，領侍輦郎。
manualTranslations.literal: Shizu liked him from youth, and when he ascended the throne promoted him to Minister of the Storehouse, added Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and put him in charge of the Palace Carriage Attendants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizu had favored him from youth; after taking the throne he promoted Diggan to Minister of the Storehouse, added Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and placed him over the Palace Carriage Attendants.

manualTranslations.zh: 地干奉上忠謹，尤善嘲笑。
manualTranslations.literal: Diggan served the throne with loyalty and care and was especially good at joking mimicry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Diggan served the ruler loyally and carefully, and he excelled at playful mimicry.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖見其效人舉措，忻悅不能自勝。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizu saw him imitate people's gestures and manners, he was delighted beyond self-control.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizu loved watching him imitate other men's gestures and manners and could hardly contain his delight.

manualTranslations.zh: 甚見親愛，參軍國大謀。
manualTranslations.literal: He was very much favored and loved and took part in great plans of army and state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was deeply favored and took part in major plans of war and government.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖將征平涼，試衝車以攻冢，地干為索所罥，折脅而卒。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizu was about to campaign against Pingliang, he tested a battering cart by using it to attack a tomb; Diggan was caught by a cable, broke his ribs, and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before Shizu's campaign against Pingliang, a battering cart was tested against a tomb; Diggan was caught in a cable, broke his ribs, and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖親往臨撫，哭之甚慟。
manualTranslations.literal: Shizu personally went to attend and comfort him, and wept over him with great grief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizu went in person to mourn him and wept bitterly.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈中領軍將軍、燕郡公，諡曰惠，贈賜豐厚。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted General of the Central Guard and Duke of Yan Commandery, with the posthumous title Hui, and the posthumous gifts were generous.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made General of the Central Guard and Duke of Yan Commandery, given the posthumous title Hui, and richly endowed.

items.acceptedSourceText: 眷弟地干，機悟有才藝，馳馬立射五的，時人莫能及。太宗時，為左機令。世祖少而善之，即位，擢為庫部尚書，加散騎常侍、左光祿大夫，領侍輦郎。地干奉上忠謹，尤善嘲笑。世祖見其效人舉措，忻悅不能自勝。甚見親愛，參軍國大謀。世祖將征平涼，試衝車以攻冢，地干為索所罥，折脅而卒。世祖親往臨撫，哭之甚慟。贈中領軍將軍、燕郡公，諡曰惠，贈賜豐厚。

sourceRange.text: 受興弟陳，世祖時為羽林郎。征和龍，賊自西門出，將犯外圍，陳擊退之，追斬至長城下。以功賜爵五等男。又從征涼州，為都將領。入官，遷殿中給事中，進爵為子，遷駕部尚書。復出為北鎮都將。陳性寬厚，好學愛士，所歷輒為人追思之。高宗即位，進爵吳郡公，加安東將軍。興光二年卒。贈散騎常侍、吳郡王，諡曰恭，陪葬金陵。

manualTranslations.zh: 受興弟陳，世祖時為羽林郎。
manualTranslations.literal: Shouxing's younger brother Chen, in Shizu's time, was Gentleman of the Feathered Forest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shouxing's younger brother Chen served under Shizu as a Gentleman of the Feathered Forest.

manualTranslations.zh: 征和龍，賊自西門出，將犯外圍，陳擊退之，追斬至長城下。
manualTranslations.literal: On the campaign against Helong, the enemy came out from the west gate and was about to attack the outer encirclement; Chen struck and drove them back, pursuing and beheading them as far as the foot of the Long Wall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the campaign against Helong, enemy troops came out the west gate to strike the outer ring. Chen beat them back and pursued them, cutting them down as far as the Long Wall.

manualTranslations.zh: 以功賜爵五等男。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit he was granted the fifth-rank baronetcy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For this merit he was enfeoffed as a fifth-rank baron.

manualTranslations.zh: 又從征涼州，為都將領。
manualTranslations.literal: He also followed the campaign against Liangzhou and served as a front commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later joined the Liangzhou campaign as a front commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 入官，遷殿中給事中，進爵為子，遷駕部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: Entering court office, he was transferred to Palace Secretariat Attendant, advanced in title to viscount, and transferred to Minister of the Carriage Bureau.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Brought into court, he became Palace Secretariat Attendant, was advanced to viscount, and then became Minister of the Carriage Bureau.

manualTranslations.zh: 復出為北鎮都將。
manualTranslations.literal: He again went out as commander of the northern garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was later sent out again as commander of the northern garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 陳性寬厚，好學愛士，所歷輒為人追思之。
manualTranslations.literal: Chen's nature was generous and kind; he loved learning and cared for men of service, and wherever he served people afterwards remembered him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen was generous by nature, loved learning, and cared for men of talent; wherever he served, people remembered him fondly.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗即位，進爵吳郡公，加安東將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozong ascended the throne, Chen's title was advanced to Duke of Wu Commandery and he was additionally made General Who Stabilizes the East.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Gaozong's accession Chen was raised to Duke of Wu Commandery and additionally made general who stabilizes the east.

manualTranslations.zh: 興光二年卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the second year of Xingguang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Xingguang 2.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈散騎常侍、吳郡王，諡曰恭，陪葬金陵。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry and Prince of Wu Commandery, with the posthumous title Gong, and was buried with attendance at Jinling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry and Prince of Wu Commandery, given the posthumous title Gong, and buried in attendance at Jinling.

sourceRange.text: 諾長子眷，忠謹有父風。太宗時，執事左右，為大官令。時侍臣受斤亡入蠕蠕，詔眷追之，遂至虜庭。大檀問其故，眷曰：「受斤負罪天子，逃刑在此，不時執送，是以來取。」眷遂擒受斤於大檀前。左右救之，乃免。由是，以驍烈聞。遷司衞監。太宗幸幽州，詔眷輔世祖居守。後征河南，督高車騎，臨陣衝突，所向無前，賊憚之。世祖即位，命眷與散騎常侍劉庫仁等八人分典四部，綰奏機要。賜爵山桑侯，加陳兵將軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 諾長子眷，忠謹有父風。
manualTranslations.literal: Nuo's eldest son Juan was loyal and careful and had his father's manner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Nuo's eldest son Juan was loyal and careful and had his father's manner.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗時，執事左右，為大官令。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taizong's time he served at the ruler's side and became Director of the Imperial Kitchens.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Taizong he served at court and became Director of the Imperial Kitchens.

manualTranslations.zh: 時侍臣受斤亡入蠕蠕，詔眷追之，遂至虜庭。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the attendant Shoujin fled to the Rouran; an edict ordered Juan to pursue him, and he went all the way to the enemy court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the attendant Shoujin fled to the Rouran, Juan was ordered to pursue him and reached the enemy court itself.

manualTranslations.zh: 大檀問其故，眷曰：「受斤負罪天子，逃刑在此，不時執送，是以來取。」
manualTranslations.literal: Datan asked the reason; Juan said, "Shoujin offended against the Son of Heaven and fled punishment here. Because you did not seize and send him back promptly, I have come to take him."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Datan asked why he had come. Juan answered, "Shoujin offended the Son of Heaven and fled here from punishment. Since you did not seize him and send him back at once, I have come to take him."

manualTranslations.zh: 眷遂擒受斤於大檀前。
manualTranslations.literal: Juan then seized Shoujin in front of Datan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Juan then seized Shoujin in Datan's presence.

localRange.text: 校勘記崇外甥于桓等謀執太祖以應之諸本及北史卷二０穆崇傳「桓」都作「植」。冊府卷一三四〈一六一六頁〉作「桓」。按卷二太祖紀記此事百衲本、南本作「桓」，他本作「植」。北史卷一魏紀一、本書及北史卷一五窟咄傳作「桓」。冊府此條採自穆崇傳，却也作「桓」。知「植」字訛，今據冊府改。下同。蕃欵素著諸本「欵」作「教」。冊府卷三五三〈四一九二頁〉作「欵」。按「欵」是「欵服」「誠欵」之意，意謂作為「藩臣」的「忠誠」態度素著，「教」字訛，今據改。徵為侍中尚書右僕射北史卷二０「右」作「左」。按卷七上高祖紀太和十二年四月、十二月並見「左僕射穆亮」。疑作「左」是。故屈卿光之南、北、殿、局四本「光」作「先」，百衲本、汲本作「光」。按這是說穆觀當國子助教，於此官有光，今從百衲本。以選為廣平王懷國郎中令諸本「廣」作「高」，北史卷二０作「廣」。按廣平王懷，本書卷二二、北史卷一九有傳，「高」字顯訛，今據改。河州羌却鐵怱反諸本「怱」作「忽」，卷九肅宗紀神龜元年、卷一０五之四天象志四記此事作「怱」。卷四一源賀附源子恭傳作「忽」，而北史卷二八源子恭傳作「怱」。按却鐵怱乃羌人名。周書三朝本屢見「傍乞鐵怱」，殿本也常訛作「忽」。今據紀改。阿至羅國主副羅越居為蠕蠕所破百衲本「阿」作「河」，他本作「何」，冊府卷七二八〈八六六０頁〉作「阿」。按北史卷六齊紀上，北齊書卷一神武紀上〈補〉永熙二年、卷二神武紀下〈補〉武定三年並見「阿至羅」，今據冊府改。

localRange.text: 校勘記擒其將狄伯支唐小方等三十餘人北史卷二０賀狄干傳「三十」作「四十」。按卷二太祖紀天興五年十月、卷九五姚萇傳都作「四十」，此傳「三」字訛。諸將猶不進北史卷二五劉潔傳「進」作「集」，當是。諸阿附者登進諸本「進」訛「長」，不可通，今據冊府卷三三八〈四０００頁〉改。弼發上邽高平汧城諸軍討之諸本「汧」作「沂」，冊府卷四二八〈五０九八頁〉作「峅」，通鑑卷一二四〈三九００頁〉作「岍」。胡注：「『岍城』意當作『汧城』。按秦隴一帶無「沂城」，或「峅城」。汧城即漢汧縣故城，在今陝西隴縣，地當隴砥要道，卷四下世祖紀下太平真君六年十一月記蓋吳領導的起義軍「殺汧城守將」。知其地駐有軍隊。北魏末年即在汧城設置東秦州〈見太平寰宇記卷二九〉。「汧」是水名，「岍」是山名，皆在其地，故亦寫作「岍城」。「沂」是「汧」之訛，「峅」是「岍」之訛。今改「汧城」。弼覽見之御覽卷四二八〈一九七０頁〉作「弼覽而善之」。按「覽」「見」重複，疑御覽是。雁門平原人也按卷一０六上地形志上肆州雁門郡有「原平」，無「平原」。原平乃漢晉舊縣，歷見地志。這裏「平原」當是「原平」誤倒。濟南公崔徽鎮長安諸本「徽」作「徵」。北史卷二五張黎傳、冊府卷四０六〈四八二六頁〉作「徽」。按崔徽附卷二四崔玄伯傳，今據改。

localRange.text: 校勘記討越勒部於鹿那山冊府卷三二三〈三八一五頁〉「勒」作「勤」，北史卷二０奚斤傳「鹿」作「跋」。按「越勒」疑作「越勤」是，參卷一一三校記越勒氏條。「鹿」字，卷三０閭大肥傳、卷九八高車傳〈補〉都作「跋」。疑此傳誤。出為瓦城鎮將冊府卷一七三宋本「瓦」作「万」，明本〈二０九四頁〉作「萬」。按「瓦城」「万〈或萬〉城」不見他處，「瓦」「万」當都是「凡」之訛。參卷四上校記凡城條。劉義符前東牟太守清河張幸先匿孤山張森楷云；「張彝傳〈卷六四〉及南燕錄並云幸是慕容超東牟太守，不聞仕宋。此『劉義符』三字恐誤。

sourceRange.text: 周觀，代人也。驍勇有膂力，每在軍陳，必應募先登。以功進為軍將長史，尋轉軍將。擊赫連屈丐有功，賜爵安川子，遷北鎮軍將。世祖即位，從討蠕蠕。以軍功進為都副將，鎮雲中。神䴥中，又討蠕蠕，大獲，增爵為侯。從征平涼，進爵金城公，遷為都將。從破離石胡，加散騎常侍。轉高平鎮將。觀善撫士卒，號有威名。真君初，詔觀統五軍西討禿髮保周於張掖。徙其民數百家，將置於京師，至武威，輒與諸將私分之。世祖大怒，黜觀為金城侯，改授內都大官。出除平南將軍、秦州刺史，復爵金城公。撫馭失和，民薛永宗聚眾於汾曲以叛。觀討永宗，為流矢所中。世祖幸蒲坂，觀聞帝至，驚怖而起，瘡重遂卒。世祖怒，絕其爵。

context.beforeSource: 子多侯襲爵。
context.afterSource: 子豆，初為三郎，遷軍將。

manualTranslations.zh: 周觀，代人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhou Guan was a man of Dai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhou Guan was a man of Dai.

manualTranslations.zh: 驍勇有膂力，每在軍陳，必應募先登。
manualTranslations.literal: He was fierce and brave, had physical strength, and whenever he was in the battle line he always answered the summons and went up first.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Brave and strong, whenever the army formed for battle he volunteered to be first over the walls.

manualTranslations.zh: 以功進為軍將長史，尋轉軍將。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit he was advanced to chief clerk to an army commander, and soon transferred to army commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His merit brought promotion to chief clerk to an army commander, and soon afterward to army commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 擊赫連屈丐有功，賜爵安川子，遷北鎮軍將。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit in attacking Helian Qubugai, he was granted the title Viscount of Anchuan and promoted to army commander of the Northern Garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After distinguishing himself against Helian Qubugai, he was enfeoffed as Viscount of Anchuan and promoted to army commander of the Northern Garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖即位，從討蠕蠕。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shizu took the throne, Guan followed in the campaign against the Rouran.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu came to the throne, Guan joined the campaign against the Rouran.

manualTranslations.zh: 以軍功進為都副將，鎮雲中。
manualTranslations.literal: For military merit he was advanced to chief deputy commander and garrisoned Yunzhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For military merit he was promoted to chief deputy commander and posted to Yunzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 神䴥中，又討蠕蠕，大獲，增爵為侯。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Shenjia era he again campaigned against the Rouran, made great captures, and had his title increased to marquis.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Shenjia era he again campaigned against the Rouran, won large captures, and was raised to marquis.

manualTranslations.zh: 從征平涼，進爵金城公，遷為都將。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the campaign against Pingliang, was advanced in title to Duke of Jincheng, and was promoted to chief commander.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He joined the Pingliang campaign, was promoted to Duke of Jincheng, and became chief commander.

manualTranslations.zh: 從破離石胡，加散騎常侍。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed in defeating the Hu of Lishi and was additionally made Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He helped defeat the Hu of Lishi and received the added post of Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 轉高平鎮將。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to garrison commander of Gaoping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to command the Gaoping garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 觀善撫士卒，號有威名。
manualTranslations.literal: Guan was good at soothing soldiers and was known for an awe-inspiring reputation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guan handled his soldiers well and had a formidable reputation.

manualTranslations.zh: 真君初，詔觀統五軍西討禿髮保周於張掖。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenjun, an edict ordered Guan to command five armies and campaign west against Tufa Baozhou at Zhangye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the start of Zhenjun, Guan was ordered to lead five armies west against Tufa Baozhou at Zhangye.

manualTranslations.zh: 徙其民數百家，將置於京師，至武威，輒與諸將私分之。
manualTranslations.literal: He relocated several hundred of their households, intending to place them at the capital, but when he reached Wuwei he privately divided them with the other generals.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was moving several hundred households to settle at the capital, but at Wuwei he and the other generals privately divided them among themselves.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖大怒，黜觀為金城侯，改授內都大官。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Shizu was greatly angered, demoted Guan to Marquis of Jincheng, and changed his appointment to Grand Director of Internal Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu was furious, demoted Guan to Marquis of Jincheng, and reassigned him as Grand Director of Internal Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 出除平南將軍、秦州刺史，復爵金城公。
manualTranslations.literal: He was sent out as General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Qin Province, and his title Duke of Jincheng was restored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was later sent out as General Who Pacifies the South and inspector of Qin Province, with his title Duke of Jincheng restored.

manualTranslations.zh: 撫馭失和，民薛永宗聚眾於汾曲以叛。
manualTranslations.literal: His pacification and governance lost harmony, and the commoner Xue Yongzong gathered followers in the bends of the Fen River and rebelled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His rule alienated the people, and Xue Yongzong gathered followers along the bends of the Fen River in rebellion.

manualTranslations.zh: 觀討永宗，為流矢所中。
manualTranslations.literal: Guan campaigned against Yongzong and was struck by a stray arrow.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guan marched against Yongzong and was hit by a stray arrow.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖幸蒲坂，觀聞帝至，驚怖而起，瘡重遂卒。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shizu visited Puban, Guan heard the emperor had arrived, rose in fear, and because his wound was serious he then died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu came to Puban, Guan heard of the emperor's arrival, rose in terror, and his wound worsened; he died soon after.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖怒，絕其爵。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Shizu was angry and cut off his title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu was angry and extinguished his title.

sourceRange.text: 樓伏連，代人也。世為酋帥。伏連忠厚有器量，年十三，襲父位，領部落。太祖初，從破賀蘭部。又從平中山，為太守，斬逆賊張翹。從征姚平於柴壁，以功賜爵安邑侯。太祖時，為晉兵將軍、并州刺史。伏連招誘西河胡曹成等七十餘人，襲殺赫連屈孑吐京護軍及其守士三百餘人，并擒叛胡阿度支等二百餘家。太宗嘉之，拜成等將軍，賜爵列侯。徵伏連為內都大官。世祖即位，進為廣陵公，轉衞尉，徙光祿勳。世祖征蠕蠕，伏連留鎮京師，進爵為王，加平南大將軍。又除假節、督河西諸軍、鎮西大將軍，出鎮統萬。真君十年薨，諡曰恭王。

context.beforeSource: 為乙渾所殺。
context.afterSource: 子真，襲，降爵為公。

manualTranslations.zh: 樓伏連，代人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Lou Fulian was a man of Dai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lou Fulian was a man of Dai.

manualTranslations.zh: 世為酋帥。
manualTranslations.literal: His family for generations were chieftains.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His family had been chieftains for generations.

manualTranslations.zh: 伏連忠厚有器量，年十三，襲父位，領部落。
manualTranslations.literal: Fulian was loyal, generous, and had capacity; at age thirteen he inherited his father's position and led the tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fulian was loyal and broad-minded; at thirteen he inherited his father's position and took command of the tribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖初，從破賀蘭部。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Taizu's reign he followed in defeating the Helan tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Taizu's reign he took part in defeating the Helan tribe.

manualTranslations.zh: 又從平中山，為太守，斬逆賊張翹。
manualTranslations.literal: He also followed in pacifying Zhongshan, became administrator, and executed the rebel bandit Zhang Qiao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also helped pacify Zhongshan, served as administrator, and executed the rebel Zhang Qiao.

manualTranslations.zh: 從征姚平於柴壁，以功賜爵安邑侯。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the campaign against Yao Ping at Chaibi and for merit was granted the title Marquis of Anyi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against Yao Ping at Chaibi and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Anyi for his service.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖時，為晉兵將軍、并州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taizu's time he was General of Jin Troops and Inspector of Bing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Taizu he served as General of Jin Troops and inspector of Bing Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 伏連招誘西河胡曹成等七十餘人，襲殺赫連屈孑吐京護軍及其守士三百餘人，并擒叛胡阿度支等二百餘家。
manualTranslations.literal: Fulian recruited more than seventy Xihe Hu, including Cao Cheng, made a surprise attack and killed Helian Qujie's Tujing Protector of the Army and more than three hundred of his guards, and also captured more than two hundred households of rebellious Hu, including Aduzhi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fulian recruited Cao Cheng and over seventy Xihe Hu, then struck by surprise, killing Helian Qujie's Tujing protector of the army and more than three hundred guards; he also captured over two hundred households of rebel Hu, including Aduzhi.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗嘉之，拜成等將軍，賜爵列侯。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Taizong praised this, appointed Cheng and the others generals, and granted them titles as ranked marquises.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong commended this, made Cheng and the others generals, and enfeoffed them among the ranked marquises.

manualTranslations.zh: 徵伏連為內都大官。
manualTranslations.literal: Fulian was summoned to serve as Grand Director of Internal Affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fulian was recalled as Grand Director of Internal Affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖即位，進為廣陵公，轉衞尉，徙光祿勳。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shizu took the throne, Fulian was advanced to Duke of Guangling, transferred to Commandant of Guards, and moved to Grand Master of Splendid Service.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu came to the throne, Fulian was promoted to Duke of Guangling, then served as Commandant of Guards and Grand Master of Splendid Service.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖征蠕蠕，伏連留鎮京師，進爵為王，加平南大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shizu campaigned against the Rouran, Fulian remained to garrison the capital, was advanced in title to prince, and was additionally made Grand General Who Pacifies the South.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu marched against the Rouran, Fulian stayed behind to hold the capital; he was raised to princely rank and made Grand General Who Pacifies the South.

manualTranslations.zh: 又除假節、督河西諸軍、鎮西大將軍，出鎮統萬。
manualTranslations.literal: He was also appointed Acting Bearer of the Staff, Commander of the armies in Hexi, and Grand General Who Guards the West, and was sent out to garrison Tongwan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was also made Acting Bearer of the Staff, commander of the Hexi armies, and Grand General Who Guards the West, and was posted to Tongwan.

manualTranslations.zh: 真君十年薨，諡曰恭王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year of Zhenjun he died, with the posthumous title King Gong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Zhenjun 10 and was posthumously titled King Gong.

sourceRange.text: 清河王紹之亂，太宗在外，使夜告同，令收合百工伎巧，眾皆響應奉迎。太宗即位，命同與南平公長孫嵩並理民訟。又詔與肥如侯賀護持節循察并定二州及諸山居雜胡、丁零，宣詔撫慰，問其疾苦，糾舉守宰不法。同至并州，表曰：「竊見并州所部守宰，多不奉法。又刺史擅用御府鍼工古彤為晉陽令，交通財賄，共為姦利。請案律治罪。」太宗從之，於是郡國肅然。同東出井陘，至鉅鹿，發眾四戶一人，欲治大嶺山，通天門關，又築塢於宋子，以鎮靜郡縣。護疾同得眾心，因此使人告同築城聚眾，欲圖大事。太宗以同擅徵發於外，檻車徵還，召羣官議其罪。皆曰：「同擅興事役，勞擾百姓，宜應窮治，以肅來犯。」太宗以同雖專命，而本在為公，意無不善，釋之。

manualTranslations.zh: 清河王紹之亂，太宗在外，使夜告同，令收合百工伎巧，眾皆響應奉迎。
manualTranslations.literal: During the revolt of Prince Shao of Qinghe, Emperor Taizong was away; he sent a night message to Tong, ordering him to gather the craftsmen and skilled artisans, and all responded and welcomed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During Prince Shao of Qinghe's revolt, Emperor Taizong was away from court. He sent word to Tong by night to gather the craftsmen and artisans, and they all answered the call and welcomed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗即位，命同與南平公長孫嵩並理民訟。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Taizong took the throne, he ordered Tong and Duke of Nanping Zhangsun Song jointly to adjudicate the people's lawsuits.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Emperor Taizong came to the throne, he ordered Tong and Zhangsun Song, Duke of Nanping, to hear the people's lawsuits together.

manualTranslations.zh: 又詔與肥如侯賀護持節循察并定二州及諸山居雜胡、丁零，宣詔撫慰，問其疾苦，糾舉守宰不法。
manualTranslations.literal: He also ordered Tong and Marquis of Feiru He Hu to carry credentials and inspect Bing and Ding provinces and the various mountain-dwelling mixed Hu and Dingling, proclaiming the edict, soothing them, asking about their hardships, and exposing prefects and magistrates who violated the law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also sent Tong with He Hu, Marquis of Feiru, bearing credentials to inspect Bing and Ding provinces and the mixed Hu and Dingling living in the mountains, proclaim the edict, comfort them, ask about their sufferings, and report lawless prefects and magistrates.

manualTranslations.zh: 同至并州，表曰：「竊見并州所部守宰，多不奉法。
manualTranslations.literal: When Tong reached Bing Province, he memorialized: "I have privately observed that many of the prefects and magistrates under Bing Province do not uphold the law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Tong reached Bing Province, he reported, "I have observed privately that many prefects and magistrates under Bing Province fail to observe the law.

manualTranslations.zh: 又刺史擅用御府鍼工古彤為晉陽令，交通財賄，共為姦利。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, the inspector without authorization used Gu Tong, a needle craftsman of the Imperial Workshop, as magistrate of Jinyang; they exchanged goods and bribes and together pursued illicit gain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover, the inspector unlawfully appointed Gu Tong, a needle craftsman from the Imperial Workshop, as magistrate of Jinyang; together they exchanged bribes and sought illicit profit.

manualTranslations.zh: 請案律治罪。」
manualTranslations.literal: I request that their crimes be investigated and punished according to the law."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I request that they be investigated and punished according to the law."

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗從之，於是郡國肅然。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Taizong followed this, and thereafter the commanderies and kingdoms became solemn.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong accepted the recommendation, and the commanderies and kingdoms became orderly and awed.

manualTranslations.zh: 同東出井陘，至鉅鹿，發眾四戶一人，欲治大嶺山，通天門關，又築塢於宋子，以鎮靜郡縣。
manualTranslations.literal: Tong went east out through Jingxing and reached Julu; he levied one person from every four households, intending to repair Daling Mountain, open Tianmen Pass, and also build a fort at Songzi to pacify the commanderies and counties.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tong then went east through Jingxing to Julu, levied one man from every four households to repair Daling Mountain and open Tianmen Pass, and built a fort at Songzi to stabilize the commanderies and counties.

manualTranslations.zh: 護疾同得眾心，因此使人告同築城聚眾，欲圖大事。
manualTranslations.literal: Hu was jealous that Tong had won the people's hearts, and because of this he sent someone to accuse Tong of building fortifications and gathering followers, intending to plot a great affair.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hu grew jealous that Tong had won popular support, and sent someone to accuse him of building fortifications and gathering men for a great plot.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗以同擅徵發於外，檻車徵還，召羣官議其罪。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Taizong, because Tong had arbitrarily levied people outside, summoned him back in a prison cart and called the officials to deliberate on his crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Tong had levied labor on his own while away from court, Emperor Taizong recalled him in a prison cart and convened the officials to judge his offense.

manualTranslations.zh: 皆曰：「同擅興事役，勞擾百姓，宜應窮治，以肅來犯。」
manualTranslations.literal: They all said: "Tong arbitrarily initiated works and labor, toiling and disturbing the people; he should be fully investigated and punished, to make later offenders solemn."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They all said, "Tong began public works on his own authority and burdened the people. He should be fully prosecuted, to warn future offenders."

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗以同雖專命，而本在為公，意無不善，釋之。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Taizong considered that although Tong had acted beyond orders, his original purpose was for the public good and his intent was not bad, so he released him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong judged that although Tong had exceeded his orders, he had meant to serve the public good and had no evil intent, so he released him.

sourceRange.text: 建孫度，太宗時為虎牢鎮監軍。世祖即位，徵拜殿中給事，遷尚書。從征赫連昌，討蠕蠕，並有功，賜爵濟陽公，加散騎常侍，平南將軍。詔度率五千騎與叔孫建合擊劉義隆兗州刺史竺靈秀於湖陸，大破之。後出鎮長安，假節，都督秦、涇、梁、益、雍五州諸軍事，開府。卒，諡曰莊。

context.afterSource: 子安都，襲，降爵為侯。

manualTranslations.zh: 建孫度，太宗時為虎牢鎮監軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian's grandson Du, in Emperor Taizong's time, was military supervisor of the Hulao garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jian's grandson Du served under Emperor Taizong as military supervisor of the Hulao garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖即位，徵拜殿中給事，遷尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shizu took the throne, Du was summoned and appointed Palace Attendant, then promoted to Master of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu came to the throne, Du was summoned as Palace Attendant and later promoted to Master of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 從征赫連昌，討蠕蠕，並有功，賜爵濟陽公，加散騎常侍，平南將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the campaign against Helian Chang and the attack on the Rouran, had merit in both, was granted the title Duke of Jiyang, and was additionally made Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry and General Who Pacifies the South.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against Helian Chang and the expedition against the Rouran, earning merit in both; he was enfeoffed as Duke of Jiyang and given the additional posts of Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry and General Who Pacifies the South.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔度率五千騎與叔孫建合擊劉義隆兗州刺史竺靈秀於湖陸，大破之。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered Du to lead five thousand cavalry and, with Shusun Jian, jointly attack Liu Yilong's Inspector of Yan Province Zhu Lingxiu at Hulu, greatly defeating him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was ordered to lead five thousand cavalry and join Shusun Jian in attacking Liu Yilong's Yan Province inspector Zhu Lingxiu at Hulu, where they routed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 後出鎮長安，假節，都督秦、涇、梁、益、雍五州諸軍事，開府。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he went out to garrison Chang'an, with acting credentials, as Commander of military affairs in Qin, Jing, Liang, Yi, and Yong provinces, and opened an office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he was posted to Chang'an as Acting Bearer of the Staff, commander of military affairs in Qin, Jing, Liang, Yi, and Yong provinces, with an open headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，諡曰莊。
manualTranslations.literal: He died, with the posthumous title Zhuang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous title Zhuang.

sourceRange.text: 出為征南將軍、定州刺史。在州清慎，然率多酒醉，治日甚少。徵為殿中尚書，加侍中、特進。高宗末，遷司徒。顯祖即位，以尼有大功於先朝，彌加尊重，賜別戶三十。皇興四年，車駕北征，帝親誓眾，而尼昏醉，兵陳不整。顯祖以其功重，特恕之，免官而已。延興四年薨。

manualTranslations.zh: 出為征南將軍、定州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as General Who Campaigns South and Inspector of Ding Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was sent out as General Who Campaigns South and inspector of Ding Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 在州清慎，然率多酒醉，治日甚少。
manualTranslations.literal: In the province he was clean and cautious, but he was usually drunk, and the days on which he governed were very few.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the province he was honest and careful, but he was usually drunk and spent very few days actually governing.

manualTranslations.zh: 徵為殿中尚書，加侍中、特進。
manualTranslations.literal: He was summoned as Palace Master of Writing and was additionally made Palace Attendant and Special Advancement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was recalled as Palace Master of Writing and given the added ranks of Palace Attendant and Special Advancement.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗末，遷司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: At the end of Emperor Gaozong's reign he was promoted to Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Late in Emperor Gaozong's reign he was promoted to Minister over the Masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 顯祖即位，以尼有大功於先朝，彌加尊重，賜別戶三十。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xianzu took the throne, because Ni had great merit under the previous court, he treated him with still greater respect and bestowed thirty special households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xianzu came to the throne, he honored Ni all the more for his great service to the previous reign and granted him thirty special households.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇興四年，車駕北征，帝親誓眾，而尼昏醉，兵陳不整。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Huangxing, the imperial carriage campaigned north, and the emperor personally pledged the troops, but Ni was drunk and dazed, and the army's formations were not orderly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Huangxing 4, when the emperor campaigned north and personally addressed the troops, Ni was so drunk and befuddled that the army formations were in disorder.

manualTranslations.zh: 顯祖以其功重，特恕之，免官而已。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Xianzu, because his merit was weighty, specially pardoned him and merely dismissed him from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Ni's service was so great, Emperor Xianzu gave him a special pardon and only dismissed him from office.

manualTranslations.zh: 延興四年薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Yanxing he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Yanxing 4.

items.acceptedSourceText: 出為征南將軍、定州刺史。在州清慎，然率多酒醉，治日甚少。徵為殿中尚書，加侍中、特進。高宗末，遷司徒。顯祖即位，以尼有大功於先朝，彌加尊重，賜別戶三十。皇興四年，車駕北征，帝親誓眾，而尼昏醉，兵陳不整。顯祖以其功重，特恕之，免官而已。延興四年薨。

localRange.text: 劉尼，代人也。本姓獨孤氏。曾祖敦，有功於太祖，為方面大人。父婁，冠軍將軍，卒贈并州刺史。尼少壯健，有膂力，勇果善射，世祖見而善之，拜羽林中郎，賜爵昌國子，加振威將軍。宗愛既殺南安王余於東廟，祕之，惟尼知狀。尼勸愛立高宗。愛自以負罪於景穆，聞而驚曰：「君大癡人，皇孫若立，豈忘正平時事乎？尼曰：「若爾，今欲立誰？愛曰：「待還宮，擢諸王子賢者而立之。尼懼其有變，密以狀告殿中尚書源賀，賀時與尼俱典兵宿衞。仍共南部尚書陸麗謀曰：「宗愛既立南安，還復殺之。今不能奉戴皇孫，以順民望，社稷危矣。將欲如何？麗曰：「唯有密奉皇孫耳。於是賀與尚書長孫渴侯嚴兵守衞，尼與麗迎高宗於苑中。麗抱高宗於馬上，入京城。尼馳還東廟，大呼曰：「宗愛殺南安王，大逆不道。皇孫已登大位，有詔，宿衞之士皆可還宮。眾咸唱萬歲。賀及渴侯登執宗愛、賈周等，勒兵而入，奉高宗於宮門外，入登永安殿。以尼為內行長，進爵建昌侯。遷散騎常侍、安南將軍。又進爵東安公。尋遷尚書右僕射，加侍中，進封為王。子社生，襲爵。世宗時，寧朔將軍、步兵校尉。熙平初卒。贈龍驤將軍、朔州刺史，諡曰克。

localRange.text: 校勘記還為左大夫諸本「左」下衍「右」字，今據北史卷二０王建傳，冊府卷三五二〈四一八二頁〉、卷三八一〈四五二六頁〉、卷九四三〈一一一０八頁〉刪。賜僮隸五千戶冊府卷三八一〈四五二六頁〉「千」作「十」。按魏初賜奴婢、隸戶一般是數十戶，從未有這樣大的數字，如同卷安同「賜隸戶三十」，劉尼「賜別戶三十」，宿石「賜奴婢十七戶」。「千」字當是「十」之訛。烏丸庫傉官鳴聚黨為寇諸本「庫傉官鳴」作「庫侲宮鳴」。按卷二太祖紀天興元年三月記「漁陽羣盜庫傉官韜聚眾反」，七月又記「漁陽羣盜庫傉官韜復聚黨為寇，詔冠軍將軍王建討平之」。卷一一三官氏志：「庫褥官氏，後改為庫氏。「庫傉官」是烏丸姓，「傉」或作「褥」，作「辱」。這裏「侲宮」二字顯為「傉官」之訛，今改正。其名，紀作「韜」，可能一人二名，也可能是二人，今不改。遣斤鎮慮虒以撫慰之諸本「慮虒」倒作「虒慮」。按「慮虒」漢縣。卷一０六上地形志上肆州永安郡驢夷條云：「二漢屬太原，曰『慮虒』，晉罷，太和十年復，改。此時縣尚未復改，承用廢縣舊名。今乙正。同長子屈百衲本卷末有宋人校語云：「同父名屈，同長子又名屈，同雖胡人，祖孫不應同名。諸本無此校語，殿本入考證，却不說明是宋人語。按「屈」是音譯，祖孫同名是常事。至于衡關通鑑卷一二一〈三八一九頁〉「衡」作「潼」。卷二五崔浩傳、卷三七司馬楚之傳敍此事都作「潼關」，冊府卷三五三〈四一八六頁〉又作「衞關」。按寰宇記卷二九華陰縣潼關條引三輔記：「潼關本名衝關，河水自龍門衝激至華山東，故以名之。元和志卷二潼關條亦云：「河在關內，南流衝激關山，因謂之『衝關』。潼，廣韻亦讀尺容切，與「衝」音義俱同。知「潼關」亦名「衝關」。這裏「衡」與冊府「衛」字都是「衝」字之訛。為北中道都大將北史卷二五宿石傳「北」下有「征」字，按此字不應省，當是此傳脫去。來大千北史卷二五本傳「千」作「干」。太宗即位諸本「太宗」作「太祖」，北史卷二五周幾傳作「明元」。張森楷云：「上已云『父千，有功太祖之世』，則此不應復云『太祖即位』，『祖』當是『宗』之誤。按張說是，今據北史改。以功進爵為子諸本脫「爵」字，今據北史卷二五尉撥傳、冊府卷三五三〈四一八八頁〉補。
