localRange.text: 校勘記都督兗相二州諸軍事諸本「相」作「桓」。按魏無「桓州」。下列官銜又有「枋頭都將」，枋頭在相州，「桓」字訛，今改正。所由遣私奴索官家羽林御覽卷四二八〈一九七０頁〉「所由」作「何由」。按「所由」常見於唐代文書，指主管的官吏，魏時罕見，疑作「何由」是。會二年正月礿祭諸本「礿」作「初」。按卷二一上咸陽王禧傳、卷二一下彭城王勰傳都作「礿祭」。通鑑卷一四四〈四四八二頁〉也作「礿祭」。「礿」是皇帝春祭宗廟之名，「初」乃形訛，今改正。尋除左右郎將北史卷二三于忠傳、御覽卷二四０〈一一三八頁〉「右」作「中」。按「左右郎將」乃左中郎將和右中郎將的合稱，疑作「左中郎將」是。又自矯旨為儀同三司諸本「矯」下脫「旨」字，今據北史卷二三于忠傳、冊府卷五一九〈六二０六頁〉補。崔光與忠雖同受召冊府〈同上卷頁〉「召」作「詔」。按崔光與于忠同在門下，上文說忠「乃諷朝廷，同在門下者皆加封邑」，所以說「雖同受詔」。據傳文和卷六七崔光傳別無「同受召」的事。疑「召」字為「詔」之訛。但忠以光意望崇重逼光冊府〈同上卷頁〉「意望」作「聲望」，「逼光」下有「為助」二字。按文義作「聲望」較長，「逼光」下有二字語意也較完足，疑此傳訛脫。但如傳文亦可通，今不改。榮遍宮闈諸本「闈」訛「閨」，今據冊府卷八六三〈一０二五二頁〉改。于氏自曾祖四世貴盛一皇后四贈三公領軍尚書令三開國公北史卷二三于栗磾附于勁傳後作「自栗磾至勁，累世貴盛，一皇后，四贈公，三領軍，二尚書令，三開國公」。本書于勁在卷八三下外戚傳下，外戚傳以北史補，故傳後語與北史同。按這句話本當在忠傳後，北史移在勁傳後，實誤，別見卷八三下校記。這裏「領軍」和「尚書令」上脫去數目字。疑「三公」二字誤倒，當同北史作「四贈公，三領軍」，「尚書令」上脫「二」字。

localRange.text: 校勘記漢太傅裒之後錢氏考異卷二八云：「唐書宰相世系表〈卷七一下〉後漢渤海太守高洪，居渤海蓨縣，『四世孫裒，字宣仁，太子太傅』，此即湖之祖也。此『太傅』上當有『太子』二字。漢時太傅為上公，除授者甚少，安得『高裒』其人乎？按這種祖先官爵大抵據子孫所編的譜牒，多不可信。不僅漢無官居太傅的高裒，連「太子太傅」也難究詰。天安中張森楷云：「據下云『高宗深重之』，『天安』是顯祖〈拓跋弘〉年號。疑『天安』為『太安』之誤。『太安』是高宗〈拓跋濬〉第三年號。追贈使持節侍中都督青徐齊濟兗五州諸軍事〈至〉青州刺史諸本上「青」字作「壽」。錢氏考異卷二八云：「『壽』當作『青』，地形志無壽州。按錢說是，所贈刺史是青州，都督諸州的第一州照例為所任刺史之州。今改正。何往非善冊府卷八九五〈一０五九三頁〉「往」作「知」。按鄰伍是勸他遷居，不是阻他遷居或出行，「往」字答非所問。疑作「知」是。子嶽武定末侍中太傅公按北齊書卷一三清河王岳傳武定六年除太尉，至高洋稱帝後，天保五年，進太保。他從未為太傅，「傅」字當是「尉」之訛。〈闕〉帶金城太守神龜初卒原文上不注「闕」字，和上文「卒贈龍驤將軍、涇州刺史」句相連，不提行。按前已記「卒」，下又說「神龜初卒」，哪有一人「卒」二次之理！且金城郡屬河州，不屬涇州〈見卷一０六下地形志下〉，不可能以涇州刺史帶金城太守。又北魏帶太守的例為州之長史、別駕和戍主，刺史也不會有「帶太守」是名號。因知此處所述實是二人。所云「卒，贈龍驤將軍、涇州刺史」者是高真，其「帶金城太守，神龜初卒」者乃另一人，傳脫去其名和歷官事迹，和上文相連，以致語不可解。今提行上注「闕」字。參下校記[八]。永興末按「永興」乃拓跋嗣年號〈四０八－四一三〉，後來元脩曾改元永興〈五三二〉，旋即發覺重了上代年號，又改「永熙」。元脩的「永興」，不過幾天，談不上「初」或「末」。上文稱貫父仁死於正光中〈五一九－五二四〉，這裏「永興」當是「永熙」之訛。拔弟䐗兒諸本於䐗兒傳末有宋人校語云：「傳無拔事，而載拔弟䐗兒，不知拔何人也。〈殿本入考證，未說明出於宋人校語。按上文「帶金城太守，神龜初卒」者當即是拔。其人應是高真子，高仁父。據下文，䐗兒孫永樂。永樂，北齊書卷一四有傳，乃高歡從祖兄子，則其祖䐗兒、伯祖拔乃高歡伯叔輩。高真是高歡伯祖〈歡祖謐之兄〉，其子正應為歡之伯叔，輩行相當。因疑上文「涇州刺史」下脫去「子拔」和歷官事迹，只殘留「帶金城太守，神龜初卒」九字。正因拔在河州任官，故拔子仁亦為河州別駕，而拔弟徽後來被河州當地士夫推為「行河州事」以抗變亂軍，情事亦合。顯國弟達武定中驃騎將軍行滄州事墓誌集釋有高建墓誌〈圖版三０九〉，稱曾祖湖，祖拔，父猛。敍高建的終官為「行滄州事」。誌之拔即此傳之高湖子、高達祖各拔。〈非「拔弟䐗兒」之拔，一為湖子，一為湖孫，各拔乃鮮卑名，不嫌伯姪同名。誌之猛即傳之高達父猛虎。世次終官均合，故集釋七以為傳「達」字為「建」之訛。按墓誌集釋又有高建妻王氏誌〈圖版三一０之二〉稱建為「神武皇帝再從弟」，與傳所敍高達的行輩也相符，集釋說是。沃野鎮長按「長」下疑脫「史」字，或「長」是「將」之訛。嚴弟賾南本以下諸本及北史卷二四崔逞傳「賾」都作「頤」，獨百衲本作「賾」。又卷二四崔玄伯附崔模傳、卷三五崔浩傳、卷一０一氐傳〈補〉並作「頤」，唯卷四上世祖紀上延和二年九月戊午條作「賾」。按墓誌集釋盧令媛墓誌〈圖版三七〉稱曾祖度世，「夫人清河崔氏，父賾，散騎常侍、大鴻臚卿、使持節、平東將軍、青冀二州刺史、清河侯」。歷官、封爵與此傳相符。知百衲本作「賾」獨是，今從之。以下他處訛「頤」均據改，不再出校記。後稍遷散騎常侍諸本「常侍」作「尚書」，北史卷二四作「常侍」。按「散騎尚書」不知是散騎侍郎還是散騎常侍，尚書也不知何曹，魏書敍歷官一般不作如此簡稱，檢盧令媛墓誌記崔賾官位也作「散騎常侍」，別無尚書的記載〈見上條校記〉。知「尚書」乃「常侍」之訛，今據北史改。逞兄適北史卷二四「適」作「遹」。張森楷云：「據其字『寧祖』，似以作『遹』為是。按「遹」有紹述、繼承之義，張說是。諡曰文百衲本、南本、汲本、局本「文」作「孝」，汲、局二本下注「一作『文』」。北、殿二本及北史卷二四封懿傳附見封興之作「文」。按唐書卷七一下宰相世系表也作「文」。這裏「孝」字當是下行「孝琬」的「孝」字錯簡而誤，今從北、殿本。子孝琬字子倩百衲本、南本、汲本無「孝」字，北本、殿本及北史卷二四封懿傳附孝琬有，又「子倩」作「士倩」。按北齊書卷二一封隆之傳作「孝琬字子倩」。此傳百衲等本孝琬的「孝」字錯簡在上行，今從北、殿本。又下文「孝琬弟孝琰」，上「孝」字，百衲等本訛作「子」，也從北、殿本。孝琬之字則北齊書也作「子倩」，今從百衲等本。天平中驃騎大將軍青州刺史按北齊書卷二一封隆之附封延之傳，興和初〈五三九〉才除中堅將軍，豈有天平中〈五三四－五三八〉先已官驃騎大將軍之理？北齊書稱興和二年，延之死後贈驃騎大將軍，此或是舉贈官，而年號有誤。又延之先是「行晉州事」，贈官是「冀州刺史」，此云「青州刺史」，也不合。

sourceRange.text: 渾少有父風，任俠好氣，以父母在，常自退抑。晚乃折節受經業，遂覽群籍，被服類儒者。太祖時，以善隸書為內侍左右。太宗世，遷前鋒將軍，從幸河南。還，以選給事東宮。世祖即位，為中書侍郎，加振威將軍。從征赫連昌，為驍騎將軍。遷侍中、安南將軍，領儀曹尚書，賜爵濮陽公。

manualTranslations.zh: 渾少有父風，任俠好氣，以父母在，常自退抑。
manualTranslations.literal: Hun in youth had his father's style, was chivalrous and spirited, and because his parents were alive, he always withdrew and restrained himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In youth Hun had his father's manner, chivalrous and spirited, but while his parents lived he kept himself modest and restrained.

manualTranslations.zh: 晚乃折節受經業，遂覽群籍，被服類儒者。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he changed his conduct, received instruction in the classics, and then read many books; his clothing and dress resembled those of a Confucian scholar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he reformed his conduct, studied the classics, read widely, and dressed like a Confucian scholar.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖時，以善隸書為內侍左右。
manualTranslations.literal: In Taizu's time, because he was skilled in clerical script, he served as an inner attendant at the emperor's side.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Taizu, his skill in clerical script won him a post as inner attendant at the emperor's side.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗世，遷前鋒將軍，從幸河南。
manualTranslations.literal: In Emperor Taizong's reign he was promoted to Vanguard General and followed the imperial visit to Henan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Taizong he became Vanguard General and accompanied the imperial journey to Henan.

manualTranslations.zh: 還，以選給事東宮。
manualTranslations.literal: After returning, he was selected to serve in the Eastern Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After his return he was selected for service in the Eastern Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖即位，為中書侍郎，加振威將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shizu took the throne, Hun became Palace Secretariat Gentleman and was additionally made General Who Quells Might.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu came to the throne, Hun became Palace Secretariat Gentleman and received the added title General Who Quells Might.

manualTranslations.zh: 從征赫連昌，為驍騎將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the campaign against Helian Chang and became General of Agile Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He joined the campaign against Helian Chang and was made General of Agile Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷侍中、安南將軍，領儀曹尚書，賜爵濮陽公。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to Palace Attendant and General Who Pacifies the South, concurrently led the Ministry of Protocol, and was granted the title Duke of Puyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Palace Attendant and General Who Pacifies the South, put in charge of the Ministry of Protocol, and enfeoffed as Duke of Puyang.

sourceRange.text: 須長子垣，字長生，沉深有局量。少纂家業，尤善書計。太祖初，給事諸曹。太宗世，遷將作監，統京師諸署。世祖即位，稍遷尚書右僕射，加侍中。以破平涼功，賜爵濟北公，加平南將軍。後轉中領軍。恭宗在東宮，垣領太子少傅。後督諸軍東伐，進號鎮東大將軍。師次和龍，馮文通致牛酒以犒軍，獻甲三千。垣責其不送侍子，數之以王命，遂掠男女六千口而還。垣在宮公正，內外稱其平當。世祖信任之，委以大政，車駕出征，常居中留鎮。與襄城公盧魯元俱賜甲第，世祖數臨幸，賞賜隆厚。真君四年，墜馬卒，時年五十五。時世祖幸陰山，恭宗遣使乘傳奏狀，世祖甚悼惜之，謂使人曰：「汝等殺朕良臣，何用乘馬！」遂令步歸。贈征西大將軍，諡曰成公。

context.beforeSource: 卒，贈青州刺史，諡曰莊。
context.afterSource: 長子觀，早卒。

context.afterLocal: 長子觀，早卒。

manualTranslations.zh: 須長子垣，字長生，沉深有局量。
manualTranslations.literal: Xu's eldest son Yuan, styled Changsheng, was deep and had breadth of ability.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xu's eldest son Yuan, whose style name was Changsheng, was deep, steady, and broad in capacity.

manualTranslations.zh: 少纂家業，尤善書計。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he continued the family occupation and was especially skilled in writing and calculation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he carried on the family work and excelled especially at writing and accounting.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖初，給事諸曹。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Taizu's reign he served in the various bureaus.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Taizu's reign he served in the various bureaus.

manualTranslations.zh: 太宗世，遷將作監，統京師諸署。
manualTranslations.literal: In Emperor Taizong's reign he was promoted to Director of Construction and oversaw the various offices of the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Taizong he was promoted to Director of Construction, overseeing the offices in the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖即位，稍遷尚書右僕射，加侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shizu took the throne, Yuan was gradually promoted to Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and was additionally made Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu came to the throne, Yuan rose to Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing with the added rank of Palace Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 以破平涼功，賜爵濟北公，加平南將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit in defeating Pingliang, he was granted the title Duke of Jibei and additionally made General Who Pacifies the South.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his service in the defeat of Pingliang, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Jibei and made General Who Pacifies the South.

manualTranslations.zh: 後轉中領軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he was transferred to General of the Central Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was later transferred to General of the Central Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 恭宗在東宮，垣領太子少傅。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gongzong was in the Eastern Palace, Yuan concurrently held the post of Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While Gongzong was in the Eastern Palace, Yuan also served as Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 後督諸軍東伐，進號鎮東大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he commanded the armies on an eastern campaign and was advanced in title to Grand General Who Guards the East.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he commanded the armies on an eastern expedition and was promoted to Grand General Who Guards the East.

manualTranslations.zh: 師次和龍，馮文通致牛酒以犒軍，獻甲三千。
manualTranslations.literal: When the army halted at Helong, Feng Wentong sent oxen and wine to reward the army and offered three thousand suits of armor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the army reached Helong, Feng Wentong sent oxen and wine for the troops and presented three thousand suits of armor.

manualTranslations.zh: 垣責其不送侍子，數之以王命，遂掠男女六千口而還。
manualTranslations.literal: Yuan rebuked him for not sending an attendant son, reproved him with the royal command, and then plundered six thousand men and women and returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuan rebuked him for failing to send a hostage son, denounced him in the name of the royal command, and returned after carrying off six thousand men and women.

manualTranslations.zh: 垣在宮公正，內外稱其平當。
manualTranslations.literal: Yuan was fair and upright in the palace, and those inside and outside praised his evenness and propriety.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At court Yuan was fair and upright, and both palace and public praised his balanced judgment.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖信任之，委以大政，車駕出征，常居中留鎮。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Shizu trusted him and entrusted him with great affairs of government; whenever the imperial carriage went out on campaign, Yuan usually remained in the center to garrison it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu trusted him with major affairs of state; whenever the emperor went out on campaign, Yuan usually stayed behind to hold the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 與襄城公盧魯元俱賜甲第，世祖數臨幸，賞賜隆厚。
manualTranslations.literal: He and Duke of Xiangcheng Lu Luyuan were both granted first-rank residences; Emperor Shizu frequently visited them, and rewards and gifts were abundant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He and Lu Luyuan, Duke of Xiangcheng, were each granted a first-rank residence; Emperor Shizu often visited them and bestowed generous rewards.

manualTranslations.zh: 真君四年，墜馬卒，時年五十五。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenjun he fell from a horse and died, aged fifty-five.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Zhenjun 4 he fell from a horse and died, aged fifty-five.

manualTranslations.zh: 時世祖幸陰山，恭宗遣使乘傳奏狀，世祖甚悼惜之，謂使人曰：「汝等殺朕良臣，何用乘馬！」
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Emperor Shizu was visiting Yinshan; Gongzong sent envoys by relay to report the circumstances, and Emperor Shizu greatly mourned and regretted him, saying to the envoys: "You have killed my good minister; what use have you for riding horses!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu was then at Yinshan, and Gongzong sent envoys by relay to report what had happened. Shizu mourned Yuan deeply and told the envoys, "You have killed my good minister. What use have you for horses!"

manualTranslations.zh: 遂令步歸。
manualTranslations.literal: He therefore ordered them to return on foot.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He therefore ordered them to walk back.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈征西大將軍，諡曰成公。
manualTranslations.literal: Yuan was posthumously granted Grand General Who Campaigns West, with the posthumous title Duke Cheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuan was posthumously made Grand General Who Campaigns West and given the posthumous title Duke Cheng.

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷三十三諸本卷末有宋人校語〈殿本入考證〉云：「此傳全寫高氏小史，疑收書亡而後人補之。史臣論亦悉出北史諸論，合而成文。然頗詳備，與本史它卷略同。豈非小史全載本史乎？字子皮北史卷二七屈遵傳「皮」作「度」。張森楷云：「『遵』『度』義協，疑『度』字為是。須長子垣南、北、殿、局四本及北史卷二七「垣」作「恒」，百衲本、汲本作「垣」，冊府卷一四一〈一七０七頁〉作「桓」。按史臣論南、北、殿本也同作「垣」。通鑑卷一二二〈三八五八頁〉作「垣」，考異無文。今從百衲本。觀弟道賜襲祖爵北史卷二七無「祖」字。張森楷云：「屈遵傳末之『子須襲』，即是襲遵爵，傳至孫車渠，當高祖初，未嘗中絕，道賜豈得復襲之。且垣濟北公之爵，不應不置後。疑『祖』字是衍文。與安平公叔孫建將兵自平原東渡諸本無「孫」字。按事見卷三太宗紀〈補〉泰常七年十二月、卷二九叔孫建傳，「叔孫建」不能稱「叔建」，今補「孫」字。大破劉義隆將翟廣等於土樓諸本「土」作「玉」，冊府卷三五二〈四一八四頁〉作「土」。按「土樓」地名，事見本書卷二九奚斤傳、宋書卷九五索虜傳。通鑑卷一一九〈三七五０頁〉胡注：「土樓在虎牢東。九域志：澶州臨河縣有土樓鎮。「玉」字訛，今據改。輔脊自壯御覽卷八一七〈三六三五頁〉引後魏書、卷九０一〈三九九七頁〉引北史，冊府卷四五五〈五三九二頁〉「脊」作「絹」。按作「絹」較明白，但作「脊」是說驢背負絹而高大，亦通，今不改。正光二年卒按斌父軌死於真君二年〈四四一〉，至正光二年〈五二一〉，凡八十年，斌似不得死於是年，「正光」疑是「興光」之訛。隨從征伐諸本「伐」作「代」。張森楷云：「『代』當作『伐』，『代』是魏之舊號，不當云征。按千秋已降魏，也無「征代」之理。張說是，今改正。天下何書最善北史卷二七李先傳、冊府卷一０四〈一二三七頁〉「何書」作「何者」。通鑑卷一一一〈三０八八頁〉作「何物」，意與「何者」同。疑魏書本同北史，但作「何書」亦通，今不改。退又乏糧北史卷二七「退」作「住」，疑是。死時猶有遺玉屑數斗北史卷二七「斗」作「升」。按上文說李預所椎的玉器環璧之類止七十枚，所得玉屑，服食之餘，恐無數斗之多。疑作「升」是。高宗以秀東宮舊臣進爵陽都子加振威將軍北史卷二七賈彝傳此處作「獻文即位，進爵陽都子」。按下面接着說「時丞相乙渾，擅作威福」，正是獻文帝〈拓跋弘〉時，似「高宗」〈拓跋濬〉應作「顯祖」，即北史之「獻文」。但此傳敍進爵是因彝是「東宮舊臣」，即曾為拓跋晃〈濬父即恭宗〉的太子中庶子。則進爵應該在濬即位後，不會在拓跋弘即位後追敍。知這裏「加振威將軍」下當有脫文，却非「高宗」字訛。侍中和匹等議北史卷二八薛提傳「匹」作「延」。按卷九四宗愛傳作「和疋」，通鑑卷一二六〈三九七三頁〉作「和𤴓」。疑本作「疋」，又寫作「𤴓」，即「雅」字，或讀作「匹」，故又寫作「匹」，訛作「延」。賈彝早播時學北史卷二七傳論「學」作「譽」，是。

sourceRange.text: 王憲，字顯則，北海劇人也。祖猛，苻堅丞相。父休，河東太守。憲幼孤，隨伯父永在鄴。苻丕稱尊號，復以永為丞相。永為慕容永所殺，憲奔清河，匿於民家。皇始中，輿駕次趙郡之高邑，憲乃歸誠。太祖見之，曰：「此王猛孫也。」厚禮待之，以為本州中正，領選曹事，兼掌門下。世祖即位，行廷尉卿。出為上谷太守，加中壘將軍，賜爵高唐子。清身率下，風化大行。尋拜外都大官，後為中都。歷任二曹，斷獄稱旨，進爵劇縣侯，加龍驤將軍。出為并州刺史，加安南將軍，進爵北海公，境內清肅。及還京師，以憲元老，特賜錦繡布帛綿綵珍羞禮膳。天安初卒，年八十九。贈鎮南將軍、青州刺史，諡曰康。

manualTranslations.zh: 王憲，字顯則，北海劇人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Xian, styled Xianze, was a man of Ju in Beihai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Xian, whose style name was Xianze, came from Ju in Beihai.

manualTranslations.zh: 祖猛，苻堅丞相。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandfather Meng was Fu Jian's chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandfather Meng had been Fu Jian's chancellor.

manualTranslations.zh: 父休，河東太守。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Xiu was Administrator of Hedong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Xiu served as Administrator of Hedong.

manualTranslations.zh: 憲幼孤，隨伯父永在鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: Xian was orphaned young and followed his father's elder brother Yong in Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Orphaned in childhood, Xian lived with his uncle Yong in Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 苻丕稱尊號，復以永為丞相。
manualTranslations.literal: When Fu Pi assumed the imperial title, he again made Yong chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Fu Pi claimed the imperial title, he again appointed Yong chancellor.

manualTranslations.zh: 永為慕容永所殺，憲奔清河，匿於民家。
manualTranslations.literal: Yong was killed by Murong Yong, and Xian fled to Qinghe and hid in a commoner's home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Yong was killed by Murong Yong, Xian fled to Qinghe and hid in a commoner's house.

manualTranslations.zh: 皇始中，輿駕次趙郡之高邑，憲乃歸誠。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Huangshi era, when the imperial carriage halted at Gaoyi in Zhao Commandery, Xian then came over in sincere allegiance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Huangshi era, when the emperor halted at Gaoyi in Zhao commandery, Xian came forward and pledged allegiance.

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖見之，曰：「此王猛孫也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Taizu saw him and said: "This is Wang Meng's grandson."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Taizu saw him and said, "This is Wang Meng's grandson."

manualTranslations.zh: 厚禮待之，以為本州中正，領選曹事，兼掌門下。
manualTranslations.literal: He treated him with generous rites, made him Central Rectifier of his home province, put him in charge of Selection Bureau affairs, and had him concurrently manage the Menxia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He treated Xian generously, made him central rectifier for his home province, placed him over the Selection Bureau, and also put him in charge of the Menxia.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖即位，行廷尉卿。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Shizu took the throne, Xian acted as Chamberlain for Law Enforcement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu came to the throne, Xian served as acting Chamberlain for Law Enforcement.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為上谷太守，加中壘將軍，賜爵高唐子。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as Administrator of Shanggu, was additionally made General of the Central Rampart, and was granted the title Viscount of Gaotang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Administrator of Shanggu, given the added title General of the Central Rampart, and enfeoffed as Viscount of Gaotang.

manualTranslations.zh: 清身率下，風化大行。
manualTranslations.literal: He kept himself pure to lead those below him, and transforming influence spread greatly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He led his subordinates with personal integrity, and his civilizing influence spread widely.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋拜外都大官，後為中都。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed Grand Officer of the Outer Capital, and later served in the Central Capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he became Grand Officer of the Outer Capital, and later served in the Central Capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷任二曹，斷獄稱旨，進爵劇縣侯，加龍驤將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He successively held the two bureaus, and his judgments in legal cases accorded with the imperial intent; his title was advanced to Marquis of Ju County, and he was additionally made Dragon-Prancing General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served successively in the two bureaus, and his judgments pleased the throne; he was promoted to Marquis of Ju County and given the added title Dragon-Prancing General.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為并州刺史，加安南將軍，進爵北海公，境內清肅。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as Inspector of Bing Province, was additionally made General Who Pacifies the South, advanced in title to Duke of Beihai, and within his territory all was clean and orderly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was sent out as inspector of Bing Province, made General Who Pacifies the South, and raised to Duke of Beihai; his territory became clean and orderly.

manualTranslations.zh: 及還京師，以憲元老，特賜錦繡布帛綿綵珍羞禮膳。
manualTranslations.literal: When he returned to the capital, because Xian was a senior elder, he was specially granted brocade, embroidered silk, cloth, silk, cotton, colored fabrics, delicacies, and ceremonial meals.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Xian returned to the capital, his status as a senior elder brought special gifts of brocade, embroidery, cloth, silk, cotton, colored fabrics, delicacies, and ceremonial meals.

manualTranslations.zh: 天安初卒，年八十九。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tian'an he died, aged eighty-nine.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died early in the Tian'an era, aged eighty-nine.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈鎮南將軍、青州刺史，諡曰康。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously granted General Who Guards the South and Inspector of Qing Province, with the posthumous title Kang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made General Who Guards the South and inspector of Qing Province, with the posthumous title Kang.

manualTranslations.zh: 統以父任，侍東宮。
manualTranslations.literal: Tong, through his father's position, served in the Eastern Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tong entered service in the Eastern Palace through his father's position.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖以元舅陽平王杜超女，南安長公主所生妻之。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Shizu took the daughter of Du Chao, Prince of Yangping and the imperial maternal uncle, born to Grand Princess Nan'an, and married her to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu married him to a daughter of Du Chao, Prince of Yangping and imperial maternal uncle, who had been born to Grand Princess Nan'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 車駕親自臨送，太官設供具，賜賚以千計。
manualTranslations.literal: The imperial carriage personally came to send them off; the Imperial Provisioner set out the supplies, and gifts were counted by the thousand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor personally attended the send-off; the Imperial Provisioner laid out the wedding provisions, and gifts were bestowed by the thousand.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗即位，典選部、主客二曹。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Gaozong came to the throne, he managed the two bureaus of Selection and Host and Guest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Emperor Gaozong came to the throne, Tong oversaw the Selection and Host and Guest bureaus.

manualTranslations.zh: 興安二年卒。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the second year of Xing'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of the Xing'an era.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈襄城王，諡曰景。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously presented as Prince of Xiangcheng, with the posthumous name Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Prince of Xiangcheng, with the posthumous name Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 無子。
manualTranslations.literal: He had no son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had no sons.

sourceRange.text: 真君三年冬，車駕幸陰山，魯元以疾不從。侍臣問疾送醫藥，傳驛相屬於路。及薨，世祖甚悼惜之。還，臨其喪，哭之哀慟。東西二宮命太官日送奠，晨昏哭臨，訖則備奏鐘鼓伎樂。輿駕比葬三臨之。喪禮依安城王故事，而贈送有加。贈襄城王，諡曰孝。葬於崞山，為建碑闕。自魏興，貴臣恩寵，無與為比。子統襲爵。

manualTranslations.zh: 真君三年冬，車駕幸陰山，魯元以疾不從。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter of the third year of Zhenjun, the imperial carriage visited Yinshan, and Luyuan did not accompany it because of illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter of the third year of Zhenjun, the emperor visited Yinshan, but Luyuan stayed behind because he was ill.

manualTranslations.zh: 侍臣問疾送醫藥，傳驛相屬於路。
manualTranslations.literal: Attending ministers inquired after his illness and sent medicines, with relay messengers following one another along the road.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Attendants were sent to ask after him and deliver medicine, with relay messengers following one another along the route.

manualTranslations.zh: 及薨，世祖甚悼惜之。
manualTranslations.literal: When he died, Emperor Shizu greatly mourned and regretted him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Luyuan died, Emperor Shizu mourned him deeply.

manualTranslations.zh: 還，臨其喪，哭之哀慟。
manualTranslations.literal: On returning, he attended the mourning and wept for him in bitter grief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On his return, the emperor went to the mourning rites and wept for him with great sorrow.

manualTranslations.zh: 東西二宮命太官日送奠，晨昏哭臨，訖則備奏鐘鼓伎樂。
manualTranslations.literal: The Eastern and Western Palaces ordered the Imperial Provisioner to send offerings daily, attended and wept morning and evening, and when this was finished fully performed bells, drums, and music.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Eastern and Western Palaces ordered the Imperial Provisioner to send offerings each day; morning and evening they came to mourn and weep, and afterward bells, drums, and music were performed in full.

manualTranslations.zh: 輿駕比葬三臨之。
manualTranslations.literal: Before the burial, the imperial carriage came to mourn him three times.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before the burial, the emperor came in person to mourn him three times.

manualTranslations.zh: 喪禮依安城王故事，而贈送有加。
manualTranslations.literal: The funeral rites followed the precedent for Prince Ancheng, but the posthumous gifts and send-off were increased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His funeral rites followed the precedent for Prince Ancheng, with still greater posthumous gifts and honors.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈襄城王，諡曰孝。
manualTranslations.literal: He was buried at Guo Mountain, and a stele and gateway towers were built for him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was buried at Guo Mountain, where a stele and ceremonial gate towers were erected for him.

manualTranslations.zh: 葬於崞山，為建碑闕。
manualTranslations.literal: Since the rise of Wei, among honored ministers, none had favor and privilege comparable to his.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since the founding of Wei, no honored minister had received favor comparable to his.

manualTranslations.zh: 自魏興，貴臣恩寵，無與為比。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Tong inherited the title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Tong succeeded to the title.

manualTranslations.zh: 子統襲爵。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Tong inherited the title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Tong succeeded to the title.

localRange.text: 校勘記子陵襲升爵按上不言升封何爵，疑傳有脫文。比部尚書平原王陸叡密表曰冊府卷四七二〈五六二五頁〉「比」作「北」。按陸叡為北部尚書，見卷四０本傳，疑作「北」是，但冊府宋本也作「比」，今不改。至於願按句未完，與下文也不連貫，當有脫文，今於「願」下句斷。有嵇拔者諸本「嵇」作「奚」，北史卷二五本傳作「嵇」。按卷三太宗紀永興三年十二月甲午見「任城公嵇拔」，泰常四年甲戌，記「獻懷長公主子嵇敬封長樂王」，與此傳合。卷一一三官氏志：「紇奚氏後改為嵇氏。這裏「奚」字乃涉下「紇奚部帥」而訛，今據北史改。又傳失書嵇拔封爵。

localRange.text: 校勘記乃徐徐西遁諸本「西」作「四」，北史卷二一作「西」。按通鑑卷一二一〈三八一二頁〉也作「西」。卷四上世祖紀上神䴥二年五月丁未、卷一０三蠕蠕傳補記此事並云「絕跡西走」。「四」字訛，今據改。至於姑臧城南北史卷二一崔宏附崔浩傳此句作「至於涼州，地純枯石，了無水草，不見流川。又言姑臧城南」，「至於」下多出十六字。按無此十六字，語意不全，當是本書傳本脫去。一日之內未便損傷北史卷二一「內」作「乏」。按上文說「渭北地空，穀草不滿」，所以拓跋燾不想走北道，這裏是說從北道往只一天路程，還長安也止一天，一天的糧食匱乏，不致受損害。作「乏」較長。大誤四千李慈銘云：「四千當作四十。人多託寫急就章諸本「人」上有「蓋」字，北史卷二一無。李慈銘云：「與下文『蓋』字行次適並，因而致誤。按文義不當有此字，今據北史刪。

localRange.text: 校勘記似窮桑之世濟諸本「桑」作「葉」，獨局本作「桑」。按左傳昭二十九年蔡墨稱少皡氏有四叔，「世不失職，遂濟窮桑」，賦用此典故。今從局本。求班莊而不遂按「班莊」不知所出。前幾句都說讀書事，後漢書卷四０班固傳，稱固讀書禁中，或即指此，但「莊」字不可解，疑字訛。若謝兼之來仕按後漢書卷六一左雄傳稱：「汝南謝廉、河南趙建年始十二，各能通經，雄並奏拜童子郎。上云：「騫年十四，國子學生」，事類謝廉，故以此為比。「兼」當是「廉」之訛，否則後漢書「兼」訛「廉」。益州達友趣諸本「友」作「反」，北史卷三三李騫傳作「友」。按漢書卷七二王吉傳云：「吉與貢禹為友，世稱『王陽〈即吉〉在位，貢公彈冠』，言其取舍同也。王吉曾官益州刺史，故稱他為「益州」。御覽卷四０六〈一八七九頁〉引漢書，說王吉為益州刺史時薦貢禹，今漢書本傳無此語，或是誤引，但也可證此詩用的是王吉、貢禹事。「反」字訛，今據改。希遠庶長兄長劍北、汲、殿、局四本「長劍」單作「劍」，百衲本、南本作「長劍」。北史卷三三、墓誌集釋李憲墓誌記李憲諸子皆無此人。檢上文於騫子希遠下記「希遠兄長鈞，興和中，梁州驃騎府長史」。長鈞是希遠兄，却排在希遠後，墓誌亦同，說明其為庶長子。時、地、官位又全與長劍同。八瓊室金石補正卷一八、越縵堂文集卷七跋李憲墓誌都認為長鈞、長劍實是一人，魏書誤分為二。按魏收是長鈞弟李騫的「親友」〈見上騫傳〉，不致謬誤至此。疑他書「長鈞」偶訛「長劍」，後人以為二人，妄加此一行。存問憲等一二家按「一二家」當是「三家」之訛，指李順子敷、式、弈三家，或敷兄弟與從弟顯德、妹夫宋叔珍三家。事見上文李敷傳。事在高允高士頌李慈銘云：「『高士』當從北史作『徵士』。尋除使持節大將軍陝州刺史北史卷三三李裔傳，「大將軍」上有「候衞」二字。按李裔軍號先止「征東將軍」第二品，死後贈官是「驃騎大將軍」從第一品，不可能此時給以大將軍〈正一品〉的軍號。但東魏初也沒有「候衞大將軍」之官。疑是「衞大將軍」，此傳脫「衞」字，北史衍「候」字。子直襲北史卷三三「直」作「子旦」。按隋書卷四六李雄傳也作「子旦」，這裏當脫「子」字，「旦」訛「直」。以仲琁為營構將作北史卷三三本傳無「作」字。李慈銘云：「碑〈李仲琁修孔子廟碑，見金石萃編卷三一〉作『營構都將』，北史作『營構將』，疑當從碑，此『作』字涉下文〈指將作大匠〉而衍。按「營構都將」見卷四五韋閬附姜儉傳、卷四九李靈附李道傳、卷七六盧同傳、卷七九張熠傳，也或作「將作都將」，見卷八九羊祉傳〈補〉，從未見「營構將作」之名。疑本作「營構將」，省「都」字，與北史同，「作」字衍。開府默曹參軍按「默曹」當作「墨曹」，隋書卷二七百官志中稱北齊三師、二大、三公府屬官有「法、墨、田、水、鎧、集、士等曹行參軍」。儀同三司加開府也有諸曹屬官，雖有減少，墨曹却未減。北齊當因魏制。魏書中「墨曹」常作「默曹」，今不改，以後也不再出校記。熙族孫同軌按卷八四儒林傳也有同軌傳，除傳首不同及傳末無「同軌弟幼舉」外，文字全同，實是一人二傳，參卷八四校記[一]。天平中諸本「天平」作「太平」。卷八四李同軌傳〈此傳重出〉作「天平」。按上稱「永熙」，下稱「興和」，只能是「天平」。「太」字訛，今據改。

localRange.text: 校勘記晉宣帝季弟譙王遜之後也南本以下諸本及北史卷二九司馬休之傳「遜」作「進」。百衲本作「遜」，汲、局二本注宋本作「遜」。錢氏考異卷二八、李慈銘魏書札記、張森楷魏書校勘記各有說。按晉書卷三七譙王遜傳，遜是進子，進死於曹魏時，封譙王的是遜，不是進。但進才是晉宣帝司馬懿季弟，遜是從子，作「遜」也有問題。作「進」作「遜」既都有問題，而宋本作「遜」，恐原來就錯。此卷史實上的謬誤較多，疑有訛脫竄亂，非魏收原文。為懷朔鎮將北史卷二九「懷朔」作「懷荒」。按卷三九李寶傳云：「高宗初，代司馬文思鎮懷荒。北史是，這裏作「懷朔」誤。以楚之所率戶民分置汝南南陽南頓新蔡四郡北史卷二九「南陽」作「汝陽」。按宋書卷三六州郡志豫州有「汝陽」，無「南陽」。當時僑置亦必因豫州原有此郡，疑作「汝陽」是。永平元年諸本「平」作「元」。按事見卷八世宗紀永平元年十月，今據北史卷二九司馬悅傳改。劉裕滅姚泓北奔屈丐世祖平統萬兄弟俱入國按卷三太宗紀泰常三年〈四一七〉八月劉裕滅姚泓，九月癸酉記司馬休之父子及國璠等「來降」。泰常五年五月即記國璠被殺。拓跋燾平統萬，事在始光四年〈四二七〉，國璠已先死八年。下文又稱國璠卒，一字不及被殺，却見於此卷司馬文思傳。也可怪。劉裕自立乃來歸闕張森楷云：「帝紀〈卷四上世祖紀上〉延和二年司馬天助來降，於宋為元嘉十年〈四三三〉，代晉久矣。此文殊疏略。按下文稱天助「招率義士，欲襲裕東平、濟北郡及城戍，又破裕將閭萬齡軍」，「裕」字皆誤。

sourceRange.text: 永平元年，城人白早生謀為叛逆，遂斬悅首，送蕭衍。既而邢巒復懸瓠，詔曰：「司馬悅暴罹橫酷，身首異所，國戚舊勳，特可悼念。主書董紹，銜命公行，囚漂殊域，事可矜愍。尚書可量賊將齊苟兒等四人之中分遣二人，敕揚州為移，以易悅首及紹，迎接還本。用慰亡存。」贈平東將軍、青州刺史，賜帛三百匹，諡曰莊。子朏襲爵。

sourceRange.text: 楚之後尚諸王女河內公主，生子金龍，字榮則。少有父風。初為中書學生，入為中散。顯祖在東宮，擢為太子侍講。後襲爵。拜侍中、鎮西大將軍、開府、雲中鎮大將、朔州刺史。徵為吏部尚書。太和八年薨。贈大將軍、司空公、冀州刺史，諡康王。贈絹一千匹。金龍初納太尉、隴西王源賀女，生子延宗，次纂，次悅。後娶沮渠氏，生徽亮，即河西王沮渠牧犍女，世祖妹武威公主所生也。有寵於文明太后，故以徽亮襲。例降為公。坐連穆泰罪失爵。

context.afterSource: 延宗，父亡後數年卒。

manualTranslations.literal: Chuzhi later married the daughter of one of the princes, Princess of Henei, and had a son Jinlong, style name Rongze.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chuzhi later married the Princess of Henei, daughter of one of the princes, and had a son named Jinlong, whose style name was Rongze.

manualTranslations.literal: From youth he had his father's manner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he showed his father's character.

manualTranslations.literal: He first served as a student of the Secretariat, then entered service as a palace attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He began as a student in the Secretariat and then entered palace service as an attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 顯祖在東宮，擢為太子侍講。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xianzu was in the Eastern Palace, Jinlong was promoted to lecturer-in-attendance to the crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While Emperor Xianzu was still in the Eastern Palace, Jinlong was promoted to lecturer-in-attendance to the crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 後襲爵。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later succeeded to the title.

manualTranslations.zh: 拜侍中、鎮西大將軍、開府、雲中鎮大將、朔州刺史。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary, Great General Who Guards the West, office-opener, commander of the Yunzhong garrison, and inspector of Shuozhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 徵為吏部尚書。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was later summoned as Minister of Personnel.

manualTranslations.zh: 太和八年薨。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in the eighth year of the Taihe era.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈大將軍、司空公、冀州刺史，諡康王。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later married a Juqu woman, the daughter of Juqu Mujian, Prince of Hexi, by Princess Wuwei, Emperor Shizu's younger sister; she bore Huiliang.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Huiliang was favored by Empress Dowager Wenming, he was made the heir.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later lost the title after being implicated in Mu Tai's crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 文思與淮南公國璠、池陽子道賜不平，而偽親之，引與飲宴。
manualTranslations.literal: Wensi was at odds with Guofan, Duke of Huainan, and Daoci, Viscount of Chiyang, but pretended friendship with them and invited them to drink at banquets.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wensi was at odds with Guofan, Duke of Huainan, and Daoci, Viscount of Chiyang, but pretended to be friendly and invited them to drinking banquets.

manualTranslations.zh: 國璠性疏直，因酒醉，遂語文思，言己將與溫楷及三城胡酋王珍、曹栗等外叛，因說京師豪強可與為謀數十人。
manualTranslations.literal: Guofan was careless and direct by nature; when he was drunk, he told Wensi that he intended to rebel outside the capital together with Wen Kai and the Sancheng Hu chieftains Wang Zhen, Cao Li, and others, and then named several dozen powerful men in the capital who could be brought into the plot.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guofan was blunt and unguarded by nature. When drunk, he told Wensi that he planned to rebel outside the capital with Wen Kai and the Sancheng Hu chieftains Wang Zhen, Cao Li, and others, and he named several dozen powerful men in the capital who could join the plot.

manualTranslations.zh: 文思告之，皆坐誅。
manualTranslations.literal: Wensi reported this, and all were executed for the crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wensi reported them, and all were executed for the crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 以文思為廷尉卿，賜爵鬱林公。
manualTranslations.literal: Wensi was made Minister of the Court of Judicial Review and enfeoffed as Duke of Yulin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wensi was appointed Minister of the Court of Judicial Review and enfeoffed as Duke of Yulin.

manualTranslations.zh: 善於其職，聽訟斷獄，百姓不復匿其情。
manualTranslations.literal: He was skilled in that office; when hearing lawsuits and deciding cases, the people no longer hid the facts of their cases.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He performed well in that office: when he heard suits and judged cases, the people no longer concealed the facts.

manualTranslations.zh: 劉義隆遣將裴方明擊楊難當於仇池，世祖以文思為假節、征南大將軍，進爵譙王，督洛豫諸軍南趣襄陽，邀其歸路。
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Yilong sent his general Pei Fangming to attack Yang Nandang at Qiuchi; Emperor Shizu made Wensi Acting with the Staff and Great General Who Campaigns South, advanced his title to Prince of Qiao, and put him in command of the armies of Luo and Yu to move south toward Xiangyang and intercept Fangming's return route.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Liu Yilong sent his general Pei Fangming to attack Yang Nandang at Qiuchi, Emperor Shizu made Wensi Acting with the Staff and Great General Who Campaigns South, advanced him to Prince of Qiao, and ordered him to command the Luo and Yu forces south toward Xiangyang to cut off Fangming's retreat.

manualTranslations.zh: 還京，為懷朔鎮將。
manualTranslations.literal: On returning to the capital, he became commander of the Huaishuo garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After returning to the capital, he became commander of the Huaishuo garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 興安初薨。
manualTranslations.literal: He died at the beginning of Xing'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died early in the Xing'an era.

localRange.text: 校勘記南阻大〈闕〉李慈銘云：「『大』下當是『峴』字。朝於行觀北史卷二六刁雍傳「觀」作「宮」，疑是。此城已平李慈銘云：「『此』當作『北』。按上有「平其北城」語，李說是。高於水不過一丈通典卷一水利田引雍表「水」上有「河」字。按下云：「高於河水二丈三尺。疑此脫「河」字。王政有闕所致也諸本脫「所」字，今據冊府卷五八０〈六九五三頁〉補。太和中例降為侯按卷四下世祖紀下太平真君三年九月見「東安公刁雍」，墓誌集釋刁遵墓誌〈圖版二二二〉稱雍為「東安簡公」。是刁雍先曾進封為公，雍傳失書，這裏所謂「例降為侯」，便不可解。子沖字文助北史卷二六「助」作「朗」，本書卷八四儒林刁沖傳〈補〉也作「朗」，疑「助」乃「朗」之訛。相州刺史中山王熙在鄴起兵諸本「中山」作「山陽」。按卷一九下熙傳和其他紀載熙襲中山王，從未封山陽王，今改正。送整與弟宣及子恭等幽繫之諸本「宣」作「宜」。按下文刁雙傳作「宣」，北史卷二六刁雙傳同。刁遵墓誌陰錄諸子名也作「宣」。「宜」字形近而訛，今改正。遷驃騎大將軍左光祿大夫北史卷二九「驃」作「驍」。按卷一一三官氏志載太和後品令驍騎將軍在第四品，既無加「大」之例，也不能兼第二品的左光祿大夫。「驍」字訛。但下文說雙死後「贈車騎大將軍、儀同三司」。「驃騎」班在「車騎」上，一般不可能贈官反低於身前所任官職。這裏當衍「大」字，驃騎將軍兼左光祿大夫魏末多見。慧龍督司馬靈壽等一萬人拔其思陵戍諸本「靈」作「盧」，北史卷三五王慧龍傳作「靈」。按卷三七司馬叔璠傳附長子靈壽，「盧」字訛，今據改。遵業預講延業錄義諸本「延業」作「延明」，北史卷三五作「延業」。按下云：「英英濟濟，王家兄弟。延業是遵業第二弟，見北史卷三五，若是元延明，和所謂「王家兄弟」不合。「明」字涉上「安豐王延明」而訛，今據北史改。又按此傳王瓊四子，只舉遵業一人，傳中却一再稱王家兄弟。北史傳末附見遵業弟廣業、延業、季和，皆魏書所宜有，疑此傳脫去。劉裕率伐司馬休之按北史卷二七韓延之傳無「率」字。張森楷云：「此句殊費解，疑『率』下當有『兵』字。按也可能是衍文。延和二年衞大將軍樂安王範為雍州刺史詔式與中書侍郎高允俱為從事中郎諸本「二年」作「三年」，「中郎」作「郎中」。按範為雍州刺史，見卷四上世祖紀上延和二年正月。「三」字訛，今據改。從事中郎是三公和將軍開府的屬官，卷四八高允傳也說「以本官領衞大將軍樂安王範從事中郎」。「郎中」是倒誤。今乙正。

sourceRange.text: 神儁意尚風流，情在推引人物，而不能守正奉公，無多聲譽。有鉅鹿人李炎上書言神儁之失。天柱將軍尒朱榮曾補人為曲陽縣令，神儁以階縣不用，榮聞大怒，謂神儁自樹親黨，排抑勳人。神儁懼，啟求解官。乃除衞將軍、右光祿大夫。尋屬尒朱兆入京，乘輿幽執，神儁遂逃竄民間。出帝初，始來歸闕，拜散騎常侍、驃騎大將軍、左光祿大夫、儀同三司。孝靜初，行并州事。尋除驃騎大將軍、肆州刺史。入為侍中。興和二年薨，年六十四。贈都督雍秦涇三州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、尚書左僕射、司徒公、雍州刺史，侍中、開國公如故。

localRange.text: 校勘記王盧即瑾之外兄也諸本「王」訛「士」，今據北史卷一００序傳、冊府卷四五八〈五四三五頁〉改。長子曖字仁明北史卷一００「曖」作「」。按以下子孫名字，魏書與北史常有異同，見於唐書卷七二上宰相世系表者多同北史，下不一一列舉。孝莊初與兄曖同時遇害年三十八諸本「三」作「四」，北史卷一００作「三」。本書殿本考證及李慈銘、張森楷均疑昞為曖弟，同時被殺，上文說曖死年四十，不應弟長於兄。但都沒有檢北史，今據北史改。子士元操北史卷一００「操」上有「士」字，不宜省，當是脫文。長子詠北史卷一００「詠」作「諺」。按墓誌集釋元子邃妻李艷華墓誌〈圖版五七八〉稱祖蕤，司農、豫州刺史；父該，散騎常侍、濟州刺史。該官位與詠同，知「詠」「諺」均為「該」之訛。自是優遊里舍百衲本、南本、北本「里舍」作「早含」，汲本、殿本、局本作「早舍」，都不可解，今據北史卷一００改。乃除衞將軍右光祿大夫諸本「右」作「左」，冊府卷九四九〈一一一六九頁〉作「右」。按墓誌集釋李挺〈即神儁〉墓誌〈圖版五九一〉也作「右」，與冊府合。「左」字訛，今據改。興和二年薨按墓誌稱「以興和三年六月十七日薨於位」。此誌當年所作，記年月較確，這裏「二」字當是「三」之訛。請為諮議參軍諸本「為」作「而」，獨局本作「為」。按殿本考證及李慈銘、張森楷都說「而」當作「為」，局本當亦是以意改。但作「而」不可通，今從局本。

sourceRange.text: 仲尚弟季凱，沉敏有識量。坐兄事，與母弟俱徙邊。久之，會赦免，遂寓居於晉陽，沉廢積年。孝昌中，解褐太尉參軍事，加威遠將軍。尋除并州安北府長史。肅宗崩，尒朱榮陰圖義舉，季凱豫謀。莊帝踐阼，徵拜給事黃門侍郎，封博平縣開國侯，邑七百戶。尋加散騎常侍、平東將軍。轉祕書監，進號中軍將軍。普泰元年七月，尒朱世隆以榮之死，謂季凱通知，於是見害，年五十五。出帝初，追贈侍中、驃騎將軍、吏部尚書、定州刺史。

manualTranslations.zh: 仲尚弟季凱，沉敏有識量。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhongshang's younger brother Jikai was deep, quick, and possessed understanding and capacity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhongshang's younger brother Jikai was deep, quick-minded, and capable.

manualTranslations.zh: 坐兄事，與母弟俱徙邊。
manualTranslations.literal: Because he was implicated in his elder brother's affair, he and his younger brothers by the same mother were all moved to the frontier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because of his elder brother's affair, Jikai and his full younger brothers were exiled to the frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，會赦免，遂寓居於晉陽，沉廢積年。
manualTranslations.literal: After a long time, he happened to be pardoned, so he lodged at Jinyang and remained sunk in obscurity and disuse for many years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After a long time he received amnesty, settled temporarily at Jinyang, and spent years in obscurity and neglect.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昌中，解褐太尉參軍事，加威遠將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Xiaochang era, he took off plain clothes to become a staff officer of the Grand Commander's office, with the added title General of Distant Might.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Xiaochang era, he entered official service as a staff officer in the Grand Commander's office and was given the added title General of Distant Might.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋除并州安北府長史。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed chief clerk of the Headquarters That Pacifies the North in Bingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed chief clerk of the Pacify-the-North headquarters in Bingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 肅宗崩，尒朱榮陰圖義舉，季凱豫謀。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Suzong died, Erzhu Rong secretly planned a righteous uprising, and Jikai took part in the planning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Emperor Suzong died, Erzhu Rong secretly planned a loyal uprising, and Jikai participated in the planning.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊帝踐阼，徵拜給事黃門侍郎，封博平縣開國侯，邑七百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Zhuang ascended the throne, Jikai was summoned and appointed Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gate and enfeoffed as Founding Marquis of Boping county with a fief of seven hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhuang took the throne, Jikai was summoned as Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gate and enfeoffed as Founding Marquis of Boping county with seven hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋加散騎常侍、平東將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was given the added titles Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Pacifies the East.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was given the added titles Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and General Who Pacifies the East.

manualTranslations.zh: 轉祕書監，進號中軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Director of the Palace Library and advanced in title to General of the Central Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Director of the Palace Library and advanced to General of the Central Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 普泰元年七月，尒朱世隆以榮之死，謂季凱通知，於是見害，年五十五。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Putai, Erzhu Shilong, because of Rong's death, said that Jikai had known of it, and Jikai was therefore killed, aged fifty-five.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Putai, Erzhu Shilong accused Jikai of having known about Rong's death, and Jikai was killed, aged fifty-five.

manualTranslations.zh: 出帝初，追贈侍中、驃騎將軍、吏部尚書、定州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Chu's reign, he was posthumously presented as Attendant-in-Ordinary, General of Agile Cavalry, Minister of Personnel, and inspector of Dingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Chu's reign, he was posthumously made Attendant-in-Ordinary, General of Agile Cavalry, Minister of Personnel, and inspector of Dingzhou.

localRange.text: 校勘記安定盧水劉超等聚黨萬餘以叛諸本「水」作「永」。北史卷二八陸俟傳作「水」，通鑑卷一二四〈三九二八頁〉「水」下更有「胡」字。按盧水胡屢見後漢書、三國志、晉書等史籍。若作「永」，則是人名，但下文只稱「超」等。知「永」乃「水」之形訛，今據改。與度世子淵婚親相好諸本「淵」作「泉」。按盧淵，卷四七有傳。這裏當是唐人避諱改，今回改。娶東徐州刺史博陵崔鑒女諸本無「東」字，北史卷二八陸叡傳有。按下明云：「叡婚自東徐還。卷六二李彪傳稱陸叡「娶東徐州刺史博陵崔鑒女」。卷四九崔鑒傳也只稱鑒「出為奮威將軍、東徐州刺史」，不云「徐州」。此傳脫「東」字，今據補。侍御中散諸本「御」作「郎」，北史卷二八作「御」。按「侍御中散」魏初已有此官，太和後品令在從五品上。「侍郎中散」無此官名，今據改。

context.beforeSource: 希道風度有聲，子彰令終之美也。

sourceRange.text: 定國在襁抱，高宗幸其第，詔養宮內，至於遊止常與顯祖同處。年六歲，為中庶子。及顯祖踐阼，拜散騎常侍，特賜封東郡王，加鎮南將軍。定國以承父爵，頻辭不許，又求以父爵讓弟叡，乃聽之。俄遷侍中、儀曹尚書，轉殿中尚書。前後大駕征巡，每擢為行臺錄都曹事。超遷司空。定國恃恩，不修法度，延興五年，坐事免官爵為兵。太和初，復除侍中、鎮南將軍、秦益二州刺史，復王爵。八年，薨於州。贈以本官，諡曰莊王，賜命服一襲。

context.beforeSource: 次叡，張氏所生。
context.afterSource: 子昕之，字慶始，風望端雅。
context.beforeLocal: 次叡，張氏所生。
context.afterLocal: 子昕之，字慶始，風望端雅。

manualTranslations.zh: 定國在襁抱，高宗幸其第，詔養宮內，至於遊止常與顯祖同處。
manualTranslations.literal: When Dingguo was still in swaddling clothes, Emperor Gaozong visited his residence and ordered him raised inside the palace; in play and rest he was always kept together with Emperor Xianzu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Dingguo was still an infant, Emperor Gaozong visited his home and ordered him raised in the palace; whether at play or at rest, he was always kept together with Emperor Xianzu.

manualTranslations.zh: 年六歲，為中庶子。
manualTranslations.literal: At the age of six, he became a Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At six he was appointed to a palace attendant post.

manualTranslations.zh: 及顯祖踐阼，拜散騎常侍，特賜封東郡王，加鎮南將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Xianzu ascended the throne, Dingguo was appointed Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, specially enfeoffed as Prince of Dong commandery, and given the added title General Who Guards the South.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xianzu took the throne, Dingguo was made Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, specially enfeoffed as Prince of Dong commandery, and given the added title General Who Guards the South.

manualTranslations.zh: 定國以承父爵，頻辭不許，又求以父爵讓弟叡，乃聽之。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Dingguo had inherited his father's title, he repeatedly declined, but was not permitted; he then asked to yield his father's title to his younger brother Rui, and this was allowed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since Dingguo had already inherited his father's title, he repeatedly tried to decline the new grant, but was refused. He then asked to yield his father's title to his younger brother Rui, and this was accepted.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄遷侍中、儀曹尚書，轉殿中尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was promoted to Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister of the Ceremonial Bureau, then transferred to Minister of the Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister of the Ceremonial Bureau, then transferred to Minister of the Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 前後大駕征巡，每擢為行臺錄都曹事。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever the imperial carriage went on campaign or inspection tour, he was repeatedly selected as registrar of all bureaus in the mobile administration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever the emperor went on campaign or inspection tour, Dingguo was selected to serve as registrar of all bureaus in the mobile administration.

manualTranslations.zh: 超遷司空。
manualTranslations.literal: He was extraordinarily promoted to Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was then promoted out of turn to Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 定國恃恩，不修法度，延興五年，坐事免官爵為兵。
manualTranslations.literal: Dingguo relied on imperial favor and did not cultivate law and discipline; in the fifth year of Yanxing, because of an affair, he was stripped of office and title and made a soldier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dingguo relied on imperial favor and neglected law and discipline; in the fifth year of Yanxing, he was implicated in an affair, stripped of office and title, and reduced to soldier status.

manualTranslations.zh: 太和初，復除侍中、鎮南將軍、秦益二州刺史，復王爵。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Taihe, he was again appointed Attendant-in-Ordinary, General Who Guards the South, and inspector of Qin and Yi provinces, and his princely title was restored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taihe, he was restored as Attendant-in-Ordinary, General Who Guards the South, and inspector of Qin and Yi provinces, and his princely title was returned.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，薨於州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year, he died in his province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, he died while serving in his province.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈以本官，諡曰莊王，賜命服一襲。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously presented with his original offices, given the posthumous title Prince Zhuang, and granted one set of official robes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously restored to his original offices, given the posthumous title Prince Zhuang, and granted a set of official robes.

sourceRange.text: 源賀源賀，自署河西王禿髮傉檀之子也。

localRange.text: 源賀，自署河西王禿髮傉檀之子也。

localRange.text: 校勘記宜其得實李慈銘云：「『其得』當乙作『得其』。北史〈卷二八源賀傳〉作『宜保其實』，『保』乃『得』字之誤。顧憶誠言李慈銘云：「『誠言』本當作『忠言』，此或隋人所追改。下延伯傳『誠孝』二字亦同。西冶都將諸本「冶」作「治」。按「西治」無義，隋書卷二七百官志中北齊太府寺所統有「諸冶東道」及「諸冶西道」諸局，乃鑄冶機構。北齊多本魏制，「西冶都將」當是管理諸冶西道的官員。舊本「冶」字帶草，以後各本訛作「治」。今改正。輕恩尚免北史卷二八源懷傳「輕」作「經」，這裏「輕」字當是形訛。臣亡父先臣賀與長孫渴侯陸麗等表迎高宗北史卷二八「表」作「奉」。按上文源賀傳、卷四０陸麗傳都說「奉迎高宗」。這裏「表」字當是「奉」之訛。麗息叡狀秘書諸本「秘」作「私」，北史卷二八作「秘」。按「狀私書」不可通。秘書省掌修史，藏有文書檔案，當是陸叡上狀秘書省，請查核其父所謂「功績」。這次源懷上表論「功」，下文詔書也說「訪之史官，頗亦言此」。可知這類前朝臣僚事跡例由秘書所屬史官查核。「私」乃「秘」字形訛，今據改。麗以父功而獲河山之賞按「麗」乃「叡」之誤，觀上文自見。可依比授馮翊郡開國公邑百戶北史卷二八「百」上有「九」字。按公的封戶百戶太少，當脫「九」字。子紹襲景明初詔復王爵張森楷云：「按懷以正始三年卒，再傳而至紹，不得在景明初也。按「景明」年號在「正始」前，哪有源懷未死，爵已傳襲到曾孫之理。據卷一０孝莊紀建義元年四月稱：「馮翊郡開國公源紹景復先爵隴西王。「紹景」即「紹」，傳雙名單稱。這裏「景明」二字顯誤。苟逼同行諸本「同」訛「固」，今據冊府卷四二八〈五０九九頁〉改。假蕭衍昏狂諸本「昏」訛「皆」，今據冊府卷四七二〈五六三四頁〉改。河州羌却鐵怱反諸本「怱」作「忽」，北史卷二八源子恭傳作「怱」。按卷九肅宗紀神龜元年七月、卷四二寇讚附寇治傳都作「怱」。「忽」字訛，今據改。參卷二七校記[六]。侍中領軍臣叉總動作官諸本「總」作「物」，冊府卷五八三〈六九八二頁〉作「總勤」。李慈銘云：「『物』當是『總』字之誤。因隸俗書『總』作『惣』，遂誤作『物』。按「總動」「總勤」不知孰是，「物」字據冊府及李說改作「總」。以子恭為當郡別將百衲本、汲本「當」字下空一格，南、北、殿、局四本「當」下注「闕」字。按「當郡別將」可通，似無脫文，今不空格，刪「闕」字。元象元年李慈銘、張森楷並云此句下當脫「卒」字。

sourceRange.text: 前廢帝初，除驃騎將軍、左光祿大夫，侍中如故。尋授散騎侍郎、都督三州諸軍事、本將軍、假車騎大將軍、行臺僕射、荊州刺史。以與定策之勳，封臨汝縣開國子，食邑三百戶。時叛蠻雷亂清受蕭衍兗州刺史章綬，入為寇掠，諸蠻從之，置立郡縣。子恭討平之。永熙中，入為吏部尚書，加驃騎大將軍。以子恭前在豫州戰功，追賞襄城縣開國男，食邑二百戶。又論子恭餘効，封新城縣開國子，食邑四百戶。子恭尋表請轉授第五子文盛，許之。天平初，除中書監。三年，拜魏尹，又為齊獻武王軍司。元象元年。興和二年，贈都督徐兗二州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、尚書左僕射、司空公、兗州刺史，諡曰文獻。

manualTranslations.zh: 前廢帝初，除驃騎將軍、左光祿大夫，侍中如故。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of the Former Deposed Emperor's reign, he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry and Grand Master for Splendid Happiness on the Left, while remaining Attendant-in-Ordinary as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Former Deposed Emperor's reign, he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry and Grand Master for Splendid Happiness on the Left, while retaining his post as Attendant-in-Ordinary.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋授散騎侍郎、都督三州諸軍事、本將軍、假車騎大將軍、行臺僕射、荊州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was appointed Cavalier Attendant, commander-in-chief of military affairs in three provinces, his original generalship, acting Great General of Chariots and Cavalry, Vice Director of the Mobile Department of State Affairs, and inspector of Jingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was made Cavalier Attendant, commander-in-chief of military affairs in three provinces, acting Great General of Chariots and Cavalry, vice director of the mobile Department of State Affairs, and inspector of Jingzhou, while retaining his original generalship.

manualTranslations.zh: 以與定策之勳，封臨汝縣開國子，食邑三百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: For his merit in taking part in settling the succession plan, he was enfeoffed as Founding Viscount of Linru county, with a fief of three hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For helping settle the succession plan, he was enfeoffed as Founding Viscount of Linru county with three hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 時叛蠻雷亂清受蕭衍兗州刺史章綬，入為寇掠，諸蠻從之，置立郡縣。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the rebellious Man Le Luanqing received Xiao Yan's seal and sash as inspector of Yanzhou, entered to raid and plunder, and the various Man followed him as he established commanderies and counties.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the rebellious Man leader Le Luanqing accepted Xiao Yan's seal and sash as inspector of Yanzhou, invaded and plundered, and the other Man groups followed him as he set up commanderies and counties.

manualTranslations.zh: 子恭討平之。
manualTranslations.literal: Zigong campaigned against him and pacified him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zigong campaigned against him and pacified the revolt.

manualTranslations.zh: 永熙中，入為吏部尚書，加驃騎大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: During the Yongxi era, he entered court as Minister of Personnel, with the added title Great General of Agile Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: During the Yongxi era, he entered court as Minister of Personnel and was given the added title Great General of Agile Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 以子恭前在豫州戰功，追賞襄城縣開國男，食邑二百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: For Zigong's earlier battle merit in Yuzhou, he was retrospectively rewarded as Founding Baron of Xiangcheng county, with a fief of two hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his earlier battle merit in Yuzhou, Zigong was retrospectively rewarded as Founding Baron of Xiangcheng county with two hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 又論子恭餘効，封新城縣開國子，食邑四百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: His remaining achievements were also considered, and he was enfeoffed as Founding Viscount of Xincheng county, with a fief of four hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His other achievements were also reviewed, and he was enfeoffed as Founding Viscount of Xincheng county with four hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 子恭尋表請轉授第五子文盛，許之。
manualTranslations.literal: Zigong soon submitted a memorial asking to transfer the grant to his fifth son Wensheng, and this was permitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zigong soon petitioned to transfer the grant to his fifth son Wensheng, and permission was given.

manualTranslations.zh: 天平初，除中書監。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tianping, he was appointed Director of the Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianping, he was appointed Director of the Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，拜魏尹，又為齊獻武王軍司。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, he was appointed Governor of Wei and also served as military administrator for King Xianwu of Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, he was made Governor of Wei and also served as military administrator for King Xianwu of Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 元象元年。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanxiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 興和二年，贈都督徐兗二州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、尚書左僕射、司空公、兗州刺史，諡曰文獻。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Xinghe, he was posthumously presented as commander-in-chief of military affairs in Xu and Yan provinces, Great General of Agile Cavalry, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Excellency of Works, and inspector of Yanzhou, with the posthumous name Wenxian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xinghe, he was posthumously made commander-in-chief of military affairs in Xu and Yan, Great General of Agile Cavalry, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Excellency of Works, and inspector of Yanzhou, with the posthumous name Wenxian.

sourceRange.text: category:魏書

localRange.text: 校勘記始光中世祖詔奚斤討赫連昌諸本「祖」作「宗」。按「始光」是拓跋燾年號，「宗」字顯誤，今改正。三年拔與南兗州刺史游明根錢氏考異卷二八云：「明根傳〈卷五五〉作『東兗』，此誤也。正光中，始置南兗州於譙城，延興中尚無『南兗』之名。按南兗州實是正始間置〈見地形志校記〉，錢氏說微誤，但延興中無南兗，當從游明根傳作「東兗」，錢氏說是。廣平王懷郎中令百衲本「郎中」二字空格，汲本空一格，南、北、殿、局四本有「中」字，上注「闕一字」。李慈銘云：「宋本『懷』下空處有『丩』形，蓋『中』字也。魏制王國有郎中令。宋本『丩』上有黑圍，當是『郎』字。按「中」字宋本有殘跡，南、北等本不闕，今從之。所闕上一字，只能是「郎」，李說是，今補。子祖襲爵墓誌集釋寇演墓誌〈圖版二二六〉稱「父祖𠸍」，即此寇祖。「祖」字乃兄弟排行，下文有祖訓，祖禮，均從兄弟。當時雖多雙名單稱，也不應取兄弟所同的「祖」字，知此傳「祖」下脫「𠸍」字。墓誌集釋載寇氏墓誌多件，官、爵、諡和名、字和此傳頗有不同，今不列舉。比陽鎮將諸本「比」作「北」。墓誌集釋寇臻墓誌〈圖版二０六之二〉作「沘陽鎮將」。按比陽，漢縣，本書地形志雖不載此縣，也不言置鎮，但屢見紀傳。水經注卷二九比水篇、太平寰宇記卷一四二引周地圖記都說魏東荊州刺史治比陽故城。「比」「北」二字常相混，卷四五韋閬傳「比陽」也訛「北陽」。「沘陽」即「比陽」，今據墓誌改。代遷李慈銘、張森楷都說「『遷』當作『還』」。按李、張說是。但「代遷」作受代遷官解，也可通，今仍之。不去攻守按「去」字當訛，冊府卷四二０〈五００四頁〉作「在」，也與文義不洽。比邑有拒守之夫百衲本、南本「比」作「北」，北、汲、殿三本作「此」，獨局本作「比」。按通典卷一五一兵四示義條作「比」。「比邑」與上「連城」對文，當是先訛「北」，北本以下以意改作「此」，局本當亦是以意改，但通典引文同，今從之。文秀必克殄李慈銘云：「『必』上當有『知』字。行臺長孫稚又引為行臺郎諸本「稚」作「雅」，殿本考證以為唐人避諱改，李慈銘、張森楷以為形似而訛。今據卷二六長孫稚傳改。下同。議敦煌得馭遠之算李慈銘云：「『議』上有脫文，當是舉酈範贊取三齊事，與韓秀議敦煌相對，不止脫一『秀』字也。按李說是。此句上有脫文，連上句便似「議敦煌」也是薛辯、寇讚事。魏書傳論通常於正傳諸人都加評論，這裏不應獨遺酈範。

sourceRange.text: 正平元年，和詣闕，世祖優寵之，待以上客。高宗以和歸誠先朝，拜鎮南將軍、酒泉公。太安中，出為濟州刺史，甚有稱績。徵為內都大官，評決獄訟，不加捶楚，察疑獲實者甚多，世以是稱之。皇興中卒，年六十七。贈征西大將軍、太常卿、酒泉王，諡曰宣。

manualTranslations.zh: 皇興中卒，年六十七。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died during the Huangxing era, aged sixty-seven.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Great General Who Campaigns West, Minister of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and Prince of Jiuquan, with the posthumous name Xuan.

localRange.text: 校勘記晉昌冥安人也諸本「冥」作「宜」，北史卷二七唐和傳作「冥」。按冥安，漢舊縣，因冥水得名，北周時始省，見元和志卷四０瓜州晉昌縣條及隋書卷二九地理志上敦煌郡常樂縣注。「宜」字訛，今據北史改。今在升城諸本脫「在」字，今據冊府卷四二六〈五０七六頁〉補。固執不作諸本「固」訛「因」，今據北史卷三九劉休賓傳、冊府〈同上卷頁〉改。卿之所訴諸本「訴」訛「許」，今據冊府卷八三四〈九九０四頁〉改。拜協律中郎諸本「中郎」作「郎中」，北史卷三九作「中郎」。按卷一一三官氏志載太和前品令、通典卷二五太常屬官，魏有「協律中郎」，此傳誤倒作「郎中」，今乙正。二子法鳳法武冊府卷九四０〈一一０六七頁〉「武」作「虎」。按北史卷三九也作「武」。疑魏書本作「虎」，北史避唐諱改，後人又據北史改此傳。冊府所據尚是未改舊本。但別無他證，今仍之。母子皆出家為尼北史卷三九「尼」下有「僧」字。張森楷云：「母為尼，子不應為尼，有『僧』字是。以功賜爵壯武侯加平遠將軍錢氏考異卷二八云：「按上文，法壽已授平遠將軍矣，不應更加「平遠」之號，前後當有一誤。考房彥謙碑〈金石萃編卷四三〉述其先世，云法壽以魏郡太守立功歸魏，封莊武侯、〈『莊』、『壯』二文古相通。使持節、龍驤將軍、東冀州刺史。然則後所加者蓋龍驤將軍也。平遠將軍第四品，龍驤將軍第三品，故云『加』。逼宣明為太守按元愉敗後，宣明如何，傳不應一無交待，此句下當有脫文。高祖聽之諸本「祖」作「宗」，獨局本作「祖」。按上文作「高祖」。伯玉城破被擒在元宏〈高祖〉時，「宗」字顯誤，今從局本。及弟妓亡北史卷三九房景伯傳無「妓」字，冊府卷八五二〈一０一二六頁〉「妓」作「妹」。疑「弟」字下本是其弟之名，訛作「妓」，原作何字，已不可知，北史遂徑刪去。冊府當是以意改作「妹」，按照當時社會禮俗，於妹喪不會那樣重視。廷尉卿崔光韶好標牓人物諸本「光」作「先」，冊府〈同上卷頁〉作「光」。按崔光韶附卷六六崔亮傳，「先」字訛，今據改。況斬焉初之創巨方始語意晦澀。疑「初之」為「之初」誤倒，讀作「況斬焉之初，創巨方始」，但無他據，今姑於「斬焉」斷句，「初之」屬下讀。雖窮勃履朝按齊人殺哀姜，見左傳閔二年。「窮勃」不知所出。

sourceRange.text: 苟頹，代人也。曾祖烏提，登國初，有勳於太祖，賜吳寧子。父洛跋，內行長。頹性厚重少言，嚴毅清直，武力過人。擢為中散，小心謹敬。世祖南討，以頹為前鋒都將，每臨敵對戰，常先登陷陳。世祖至江，賜爵建德男，加寧遠將軍。還，遷奏事中散，典涼州作曹。遷內行令，轉給事中，遷司衞監。以本將軍拜洛州刺史。為政剛嚴，抑強扶弱，山蠻畏威，不敢為寇。承明元年，文明太后令百官舉才堪幹事、人足委仗者，於是公卿咸以頹應選。徵拜散騎常侍、殿中尚書，進爵成德侯，加後將軍。太和元年，加散騎常侍，尋遷侍中、安東將軍、都曹尚書，進爵河南公。

context.beforeSource: 太和六年，遷弩庫曹下大夫，卒。
context.afterSource: 頹方正好直言，雖文明太后生殺不允，頹亦言至懇切，未曾阿諛。
context.beforeLocal: 太和六年，遷弩庫曹下大夫，卒。
context.afterLocal: 頹方正好直言，雖文明太后生殺不允，頹亦言至懇切，未曾阿諛。

manualTranslations.zh: 苟頹，代人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Gou Tui was a man of Dai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gou Tui was a native of Dai.

manualTranslations.zh: 曾祖烏提，登國初，有勳於太祖，賜吳寧子。
manualTranslations.literal: His great-grandfather Wuti had merit toward Taizu at the beginning of the Dengguo era and was granted the title Viscount of Wuning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Wuti rendered meritorious service to Taizu at the start of the Dengguo era and was enfeoffed as Viscount of Wuning.

manualTranslations.zh: 父洛跋，內行長。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Luoba was Chief of the Inner Service.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Luoba served as Chief of the Inner Service.

manualTranslations.zh: 頹性厚重少言，嚴毅清直，武力過人。
manualTranslations.literal: Tui's nature was sincere and grave, and he spoke little; he was stern, resolute, pure, and upright, and his martial strength surpassed other men.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tui was grave and taciturn by nature; stern, resolute, honest, and upright, he possessed exceptional martial strength.

manualTranslations.zh: 擢為中散，小心謹敬。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to Central Scattered Cavalry Attendant and was careful, cautious, and respectful.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After being promoted to Central Scattered Cavalry Attendant, he served with care, caution, and respect.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖南討，以頹為前鋒都將，每臨敵對戰，常先登陷陳。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizu campaigned south, he made Tui Commander of the Vanguard; whenever he faced the enemy in battle, Tui always climbed first and broke into the enemy formation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shizu campaigned south, he made Tui commander of the vanguard. In every engagement, Tui was always first to storm and break the enemy formation.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖至江，賜爵建德男，加寧遠將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Shizu reached the Yangzi, he granted him the title Baron of Jiande and added General Who Pacifies Distant Lands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Shizu reached the Yangzi, he enfeoffed Tui as Baron of Jiande and added the title General Who Pacifies Distant Lands.

manualTranslations.zh: 還，遷奏事中散，典涼州作曹。
manualTranslations.literal: On returning, he was transferred to Central Scattered Cavalry Attendant for Presenting Affairs and managed the Works Section for Liang Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After returning, he was transferred to Central Scattered Cavalry Attendant for Presenting Affairs and placed in charge of the Liang Province Works Section.

manualTranslations.zh: 遷內行令，轉給事中，遷司衞監。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to Chief of the Inner Service, transferred to Gentleman Attendant-in-Ordinary, and then promoted to Director of the Palace Guards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Chief of the Inner Service, then became Gentleman Attendant-in-Ordinary, and later Director of the Palace Guards.

manualTranslations.zh: 以本將軍拜洛州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: With his original general's title, he was appointed Inspector of Luo Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Retaining his original general's title, he was appointed Inspector of Luo Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 為政剛嚴，抑強扶弱，山蠻畏威，不敢為寇。
manualTranslations.literal: His governance was firm and strict; he restrained the strong and aided the weak. The mountain tribes feared his authority and did not dare become raiders.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His administration was firm and strict, restraining the strong and supporting the weak. The mountain tribes feared his authority and did not dare raid.

manualTranslations.zh: 承明元年，文明太后令百官舉才堪幹事、人足委仗者，於是公卿咸以頹應選。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Chengming, the Wenming Empress Dowager ordered the officials to recommend those whose talent was sufficient for managing affairs and whose person was worthy of trust; thereupon the dukes and ministers all considered Tui suitable for selection.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Chengming 1, the Wenming Empress Dowager ordered the officials to recommend men talented enough to handle affairs and trustworthy enough to rely on; the dukes and ministers all put Tui forward.

manualTranslations.zh: 徵拜散騎常侍、殿中尚書，進爵成德侯，加後將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and Director of the Palace Secretariat, advanced in title to Marquis of Chengde, and given General of the Rear.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was summoned to court as Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and Director of the Palace Secretariat, advanced to Marquis of Chengde, and given the title General of the Rear.

manualTranslations.zh: 太和元年，加散騎常侍，尋遷侍中、安東將軍、都曹尚書，進爵河南公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Taihe, he was given the additional post Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry; soon he was transferred to Palace Attendant, General Who Pacifies the East, and Director of the Bureau of All Offices, and advanced in title to Duke of Henan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taihe 1 he was additionally made Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry. Soon afterward he became Palace Attendant, General Who Pacifies the East, and Director of the Bureau of All Offices, and was advanced to Duke of Henan.

sourceRange.text: 子乾歸，襲爵。年十二，為侍御中散。及長，身長八尺，有氣幹，頗習書疏，尤好兵法。復尚恭宗女安樂公主，除駙馬都尉、侍中。顯祖初，除征西將軍、秦州刺史，有惠政。高祖初即位，為征西道都將，又為中道都將。延興五年卒，時年三十一。贈左光祿大夫、開府儀同，諡曰康。

context.beforeSource: 贈太尉公，諡曰恭。
context.afterSource: 子海，字懷仁。

manualTranslations.literal: His son Qiangui inherited the title.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Qiangui inherited the title.

manualTranslations.zh: 年十二，為侍御中散。
manualTranslations.literal: At the age of twelve, he became Attendant of the Imperial Guard and Central Scattered Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At twelve, he was appointed Attendant of the Imperial Guard and Central Scattered Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 及長，身長八尺，有氣幹，頗習書疏，尤好兵法。
manualTranslations.literal: When he grew up, his body was eight chi tall; he had spirit and ability, was fairly practiced in documents and memorials, and especially loved military methods.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As an adult he stood eight chi tall, had spirit and ability, was well practiced in documents and memorials, and especially loved military strategy.

manualTranslations.zh: 復尚恭宗女安樂公主，除駙馬都尉、侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: He also married Princess Anle, daughter of Gongzong, and was appointed Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law and Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also married Princess Anle, daughter of Gongzong, and was appointed Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law and Palace Attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 顯祖初，除征西將軍、秦州刺史，有惠政。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Xianzu's reign, he was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Inspector of Qin Province, and had benevolent governance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xianzu's reign, he was appointed General Who Campaigns West and Inspector of Qin Province, where his administration was benevolent.

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖初即位，為征西道都將，又為中道都將。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozu first ascended the throne, he became Commander of the Western Campaign Route and then Commander of the Central Route.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozu first took the throne, Qiangui served as commander of the western campaign route and then as commander of the central route.

manualTranslations.zh: 延興五年卒，時年三十一。
manualTranslations.literal: He died in the fifth year of Yanxing, at the age of thirty-one.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Yanxing 5 at the age of thirty-one.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈左光祿大夫、開府儀同，諡曰康。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously appointed Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Director with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, with posthumous title Kang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Director with Protocol Equal to the Three Excellencies, with the posthumous title Kang.

sourceRange.text: 」馛性忠謹，世祖愛之，親待日殊，賞賜優厚。真君初，世祖欲拜馛為尚書，封郡公。馛辭曰：「尚書務殷，公爵至重，非臣年少愚近所宜荷任，請收過恩。」世祖問其欲，馛曰：「中、祕二省多諸文士，若恩矜不已，請參其次。」世祖賢之，遂拜為中護將軍、祕書監。以功賜爵魏安侯，加冠軍將軍。後出為東雍州刺史，恩化大行，百姓思之。轉殿中尚書，常典宿衞。世祖親任之。從幸瓜步，頻有戰功，進號鎮軍將軍。興安二年，遷征北大將軍、都曹尚書，加侍中，進爵河南公。興光元年，拜司空。及為三公，清約自守，為政舉大綱而已，不為苛碎。太安二年，領太子太保。三年，與司徒陸麗等並平尚書事。五年薨。

manualTranslations.zh: 馛性忠謹，世祖愛之，親待日殊，賞賜優厚。
manualTranslations.literal: Bo's nature was loyal and cautious; Shizu loved him, his intimate treatment became more special each day, and rewards and gifts were generous.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bo was loyal and cautious by nature. Shizu loved him, treated him with increasing favor, and rewarded him generously.

manualTranslations.zh: 真君初，世祖欲拜馛為尚書，封郡公。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhenjun era, Shizu wished to appoint Bo Director of the Imperial Secretariat and enfeoff him as a commandery duke.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhenjun era, Shizu wanted to appoint Bo Director of the Imperial Secretariat and enfeoff him as a commandery duke.

manualTranslations.zh: 馛辭曰：「尚書務殷，公爵至重，非臣年少愚近所宜荷任，請收過恩。」
manualTranslations.literal: Bo declined, saying: "The duties of Director of the Imperial Secretariat are abundant, and the ducal rank is extremely weighty. They are not responsibilities that a young, foolish, and shallow subject such as I should bear. Please withdraw this excessive favor."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bo declined: "The Secretariat's affairs are heavy, and a ducal rank is extremely weighty. They are not burdens fit for a young and shallow subject like me. Please withdraw this excessive favor."

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖問其欲，馛曰：「中、祕二省多諸文士，若恩矜不已，請參其次。」
manualTranslations.literal: Shizu asked what he wanted. Bo said: "The Central and Secretarial offices have many literary gentlemen. If your favor and pity cannot stop, please let me join them at a lower rank."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizu asked what he wanted. Bo replied: "The Central and Secretarial offices have many men of letters. If your favor cannot be withheld, please let me join them in a lesser post."

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖賢之，遂拜為中護將軍、祕書監。
manualTranslations.literal: Shizu considered him worthy and accordingly appointed him General of the Central Guard and Director of the Palace Library.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizu admired him for this and appointed him General of the Central Guard and Director of the Palace Library.

manualTranslations.zh: 以功賜爵魏安侯，加冠軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit he was granted the title Marquis of Wei'an and given Champion General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his merit he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Wei'an and given the title Champion General.

manualTranslations.zh: 後出為東雍州刺史，恩化大行，百姓思之。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he went out as Inspector of Eastern Yong Province; his beneficent instruction was greatly carried out, and the people missed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he was sent out as Inspector of Eastern Yong Province. His benevolent rule spread widely, and the people missed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 轉殿中尚書，常典宿衞。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Director of the Palace Secretariat and regularly managed the night guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Director of the Palace Secretariat and was often in charge of the overnight guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 世祖親任之。
manualTranslations.literal: Shizu personally trusted and employed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shizu trusted him personally.

manualTranslations.zh: 從幸瓜步，頻有戰功，進號鎮軍將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the imperial visit to Guabu, repeatedly had battle achievements, and was advanced in title to General Who Guards the Army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He accompanied the imperial visit to Guabu, won repeated battle merit, and was advanced to General Who Guards the Army.

manualTranslations.zh: 興安二年，遷征北大將軍、都曹尚書，加侍中，進爵河南公。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Xing'an, he was transferred to Grand General Who Campaigns North and Director of the Bureau of All Offices, given the additional post Palace Attendant, and advanced in title to Duke of Henan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xing'an 2, he became Grand General Who Campaigns North and Director of the Bureau of All Offices, was additionally made Palace Attendant, and was advanced to Duke of Henan.

manualTranslations.zh: 興光元年，拜司空。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xingguang, he was appointed Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xingguang 1, he was appointed Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 及為三公，清約自守，為政舉大綱而已，不為苛碎。
manualTranslations.literal: When he became one of the Three Excellencies, he guarded himself with purity and frugality; in government he raised only the great principles and did not engage in harsh minutiae.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After becoming one of the Three Excellencies, he remained pure and frugal. In government he set out only the broad principles and did not trouble himself with harsh details.

manualTranslations.zh: 太安二年，領太子太保。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Tai'an, he concurrently held the post of Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tai'an 2, he concurrently served as Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，與司徒陸麗等並平尚書事。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, together with Minister of Works Lu Li and others, he jointly oversaw the affairs of the Imperial Secretariat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, he and Minister of Works Lu Li jointly oversaw the affairs of the Imperial Secretariat.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, he died.

sourceRange.text: 子瑗，字雅珍。尚淮陽公主，高祖之女也，除駙馬都尉，汝南王友，固辭不拜。歷濟南太守。時為逆賊劉桃攻郡，瑗踰城獲免。後都督李叔仁討桃平之，瑗乃還郡。後除司農少卿，銀青、金紫、左、右光祿大夫，中軍將軍，西兗州刺史。天平元年，舉兵應樊子鵠，與行臺左丞宋顯戰，敗死，時年四十六。

manualTranslations.zh: 子瑗，字雅珍。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Yuan, styled Yazhen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Yuan was styled Yazhen.

manualTranslations.zh: 尚淮陽公主，高祖之女也，除駙馬都尉，汝南王友，固辭不拜。
manualTranslations.literal: He married Princess Huaiyang, a daughter of Gaozu, and was appointed Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law and Friend to the Prince of Runan, but he firmly declined and did not accept office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He married Princess Huaiyang, Gaozu's daughter, and was appointed Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law and Friend to the Prince of Runan, but he firmly declined the appointments.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷濟南太守。
manualTranslations.literal: He served successively as Administrator of Jinan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later served as Administrator of Jinan.

manualTranslations.zh: 時為逆賊劉桃攻郡，瑗踰城獲免。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time, when the rebel Liu Tao attacked the commandery, Yuan climbed over the wall and escaped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the rebel Liu Tao attacked the commandery, Yuan escaped by climbing over the city wall.

manualTranslations.zh: 後都督李叔仁討桃平之，瑗乃還郡。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren campaigned against Tao and pacified him, and Yuan then returned to the commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren defeated and pacified Liu Tao, Yuan returned to the commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 後除司農少卿，銀青、金紫、左、右光祿大夫，中軍將軍，西兗州刺史。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he held the posts of Vice Minister of Agriculture, Grand Master with Silver Seal and Green Ribbon, Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, Left and Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, General of the Central Army, and Inspector of Western Yan Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 天平元年，舉兵應樊子鵠，與行臺左丞宋顯戰，敗死，時年四十六。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tianping 1, he raised troops in support of Fan Zihu, fought Song Xian, Left Assistant Director of the Mobile Headquarters, and was defeated and killed at the age of forty-six.

localRange.text: 校勘記進爵為王又為西道都將諸本無「王又為」三字，北史卷二五乙瓌傳有。李慈銘云：「元和姓纂五質乙弗氏下云：『乙瓌，定州刺史、西平王。則此當為『進爵為西平王、征西道都將』，兩『西』字相涉而誤脫耳。按「西道都將」不得云「進爵」，今據北史補。與行臺左丞宋顯戰諸本「宋」作「宗」。按事見北齊書卷二０宋顯傳。「宗」字訛，今據改。高宗初諸本「高宗」作「高袓」，北史卷二五和其奴傳作「文成」。李慈銘、張森楷並云「高袓」當作「高宗」。按下文記「太安元年」，太安是拓跋濬〈高宗文成帝〉年號。「袓」字訛，今據北史改。人足委仗者諸本「仗」訛「此」。今據冊府卷四五七〈五四二七頁〉、御覽卷二二四〈一０六五頁〉改。李訢李敷之誅也北史卷二五苟頹傳「李訢、李敷」作「李惠、李訢」。按李敷為拓跋弘〈顯袓〉所殺，見卷三六李順附李敷傳。李惠在卷八三上外戚傳上，則為馮太后所殺。北史是。子景蠻墓誌集釋有苟景墓誌〈圖版二七一之二〉，即此人，云「字景巒」，疑此「蠻」字訛。南征將軍按「南征」疑是「征南」誤倒。歷東宮齋帥諸本「齋」作「齊」，北史卷五０孟威傳作「齋」。按「齊帥」無此名號。「齋帥」及「東宮齋帥」見卷二一上咸陽王僖傳末、卷四九李靈傳附見李纂、卷九八蕭昭業傳。隋書卷二七百官志中北齊門下省有「齋帥局，齋帥四人，掌舖設洒掃事」。北齊當因魏制。這裏「齊」字訛，今據北史改。

localRange.text: 校勘記少為舅兗州刺史鄭羲所器賞諸本「羲」作「義」，北史卷二六韋閬附韋崇傳作「羲」。殿本考證云：「本書鄭羲傳〈卷五六〉羲嘗出為安東將軍、西兗州刺史。按「義」字訛，今據北史改。高祖詔珍移鎮比陽諸本「比」作「北」。按魏有比陽鎮，亦作「沘陽」，見墓誌集釋寇臻墓誌〈圖版二０六〉。「北」乃「比」之形訛，今改正。參卷四二校記[五]。珍從至濟水北史卷二六韋閬附韋珍傳「濟」作「清」。按這次魏軍南下攻取南陽、新野，和濟水遠不相及，「濟」字顯訛。魏書卷一０六下地形志下荊州南陽郡宛縣有「清水」。太平寰宇記卷一四二鄧州南陽縣下清水條云：「隋圖經云：清水經獨山。史定伯碑云瓜里津，即清水上三梁，謂之瓜里。似作「清水」是。但地形志和寰宇記所載的「清水」，實際上就是水經注卷三一的「淯水」。水經注稱：「淯水又南逕預山東，山上有神廟，俗名之為獨山也。又云：「淯水又西南逕史定伯碑南。又西為瓜里津，水上有三梁，謂之瓜里渡。寰宇記引隋圖經所謂「清水」的幾句話，全見於水經淯水注。雖或許當時淯水又名清水，但也可能北史此條和地形志、寰宇記的「清水」皆「淯水」之訛。遷尚書令吏部郎中張森楷云：「『令』字不當有。按「令」字當衍。意欲取京兆中長老一人冊府卷六二０〈七四五七頁〉、御覽卷二三０〈一０九二頁〉「京兆」下有「杜」字，當是傳本脫去，但無「杜」字亦通，今仍之。來襲聞喜諸本脫「喜」字，今據冊府卷七六一〈九０五０頁〉補。詢以凡司戍主蠻酋田朴特地居要險諸本「主」訛「土」，今據北史卷三八裴駿附裴詢傳、冊府卷四二九〈五一０九頁〉改。遷員外散騎侍郎諸本「遷」作「邊」，不可通。李慈銘、張森楷都以為「『邊』當作『遷』」。今改正。孝昌初釋褐南司州龍驤府錄事參軍錢氏考異卷二八云：「按地形志〈卷一０六中〉南司州，正始元年為郢州，孝昌三年陷，蕭衍改為司州，武定七年復，乃有南司之名。辛子馥仕孝昌初，其時，無南司州也。蕭〈闕〉西征李慈銘云：「闕處當是『寶夤』二字。平東後軍按「平東後軍」可能是「平東將軍、後軍將軍」之省，但「平東」品高於「後軍」，敍歷官應自卑至高，疑「後」字乃「將」之訛。

sourceRange.text: 纘弟彧，字遵慶，亦有學識。解褐奉朝請，遷太尉騎兵參軍。出為雍州治中，轉別駕。入為司徒掾，尋轉散騎侍郎。稍遷平遠將軍、東豫州刺史。彧綏懷蠻左，頗得其心。蠻首田益宗子魯生、魯賢先叛父南入，數為寇掠。自彧至州，魯生等咸牋啟修敬，不復為害。彧以蠻俗荒梗，不識禮儀，乃表立太學，選諸郡生徒於州總教。又於城北置宗武館以習武焉。境內清肅。還，遇大將軍、京兆王繼西征，請為長史，拜通直散騎常侍。尋以本官兼尚書，為豳夏行臺。以功封陰盤縣開國男，邑二百戶。孝昌元年秋，卒於長安。贈撫軍將軍、雍州刺史，諡曰文。

manualTranslations.literal: Zuan's younger brother Yu, styled Zunqing, also had learning and knowledge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zuan's younger brother Yu, whose courtesy name was Zunqing, was also learned and knowledgeable.

manualTranslations.zh: 解褐奉朝請，遷太尉騎兵參軍。
manualTranslations.literal: On entering office he became Attendant in Regular Attendance and was promoted to Cavalry Staff Officer to the Grand Commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He entered service as Attendant in Regular Attendance and was later promoted to Cavalry Staff Officer to the Grand Commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為雍州治中，轉別駕。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as Administrative Aide of Yong Province and was transferred to Vice Administrator.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Administrative Aide of Yong Province and later transferred to Vice Administrator.

manualTranslations.zh: 入為司徒掾，尋轉散騎侍郎。
manualTranslations.literal: He entered as Clerk to the Minister of Education and was soon transferred to Attendant Cavalier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On returning to court he became Clerk to the Minister of Education and soon afterward Attendant Cavalier.

manualTranslations.zh: 稍遷平遠將軍、東豫州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He was gradually promoted to General Who Pacifies the Distance and Inspector of Eastern Yu Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He gradually rose to General Who Pacifies the Distance and Inspector of Eastern Yu Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 彧綏懷蠻左，頗得其心。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu soothed and won over the Man and Zuo peoples and quite gained their hearts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu pacified and won over the Man and Zuo peoples, gaining their confidence.

manualTranslations.zh: 蠻首田益宗子魯生、魯賢先叛父南入，數為寇掠。
manualTranslations.literal: The Man chieftain Tian Yizong's sons Lusheng and Luxian had earlier rebelled against their father and gone south, repeatedly carrying out raids.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Man chieftain Tian Yizong's sons, Lusheng and Luxian, had previously rebelled against their father, gone south, and repeatedly raided the region.

manualTranslations.zh: 自彧至州，魯生等咸牋啟修敬，不復為害。
manualTranslations.literal: From the time Yu arrived in the province, Lusheng and the others all sent letters and memorials expressing respect and no longer caused harm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Yu arrived in the province, Lusheng and the others sent respectful letters and memorials and ceased causing harm.

manualTranslations.zh: 彧以蠻俗荒梗，不識禮儀，乃表立太學，選諸郡生徒於州總教。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu, because the customs of the Man were uncultivated and obstructed and they did not know ritual propriety, memorialized to establish an Imperial Academy, selecting students from the commanderies for collective instruction in the province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because the Man customs were rough and remote and they did not understand ritual propriety, Yu memorialized to establish an Imperial Academy, selecting students from the commanderies to be taught together in the province.

manualTranslations.zh: 又於城北置宗武館以習武焉。
manualTranslations.literal: He also established a Hall for Honoring Martiality north of the city so that martial skills could be practiced there.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also set up a Hall for Honoring Martiality north of the city for military training.

manualTranslations.zh: 境內清肅。
manualTranslations.literal: Within the borders there was clarity and order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The territory became peaceful and orderly.

manualTranslations.zh: 還，遇大將軍、京兆王繼西征，請為長史，拜通直散騎常侍。
manualTranslations.literal: On returning, he encountered the Grand General, Prince Ji of Jingzhao, campaigning west; Ji requested him as Chief Clerk, and he was appointed Direct Attendant Cavalier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On returning to court, he met the Grand General, Prince Ji of Jingzhao, as Ji was campaigning west. Ji requested him as chief clerk, and Yu was appointed Direct Attendant Cavalier.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋以本官兼尚書，為豳夏行臺。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon, with his original office, he concurrently served as Director of the Imperial Secretariat and became the Mobile Headquarters for Bin and Xia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon, while retaining his original post, he concurrently served as Director of the Imperial Secretariat and headed the Bin-Xia Mobile Headquarters.

manualTranslations.zh: 以功封陰盤縣開國男，邑二百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit he was enfeoffed as Founding Baron of Yinpan County, with a fief of two hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his merit he was enfeoffed as Founding Baron of Yinpan County, with a fief of two hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昌元年秋，卒於長安。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn of the first year of Xiaochang, he died at Chang'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In autumn of Xiaochang 1, he died at Chang'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈撫軍將軍、雍州刺史，諡曰文。
manualTranslations.literal: He was posthumously appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yong Province, with posthumous title Wen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yong Province, with the posthumous title Wen.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗即位，訢以舊恩親寵，遷儀曹尚書，領中祕書，賜爵扶風公，加安東將軍，贈其母孫氏為容城君。
manualTranslations.literal: When Gaozong came to the throne, Xin, because of former favor and close affection, was promoted to Director of the Ceremonial Bureau, concurrently directed the Inner Secretariat, was granted the title Duke of Fufeng, given the additional post General Who Pacifies the East, and his mother, Lady Sun, was honored as Lady of Rongcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Gaozong came to the throne, Xin was favored for old ties of affection. He was promoted to Director of the Ceremonial Bureau, placed concurrently in charge of the Inner Secretariat, enfeoffed as Duke of Fufeng, given the additional title General Who Pacifies the East, and his mother, Lady Sun, was honored as Lady of Rongcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 高宗顧謂羣臣曰：「朕始學之歲，情未能專，既總萬機，溫習靡暇，是故儒道實有闕焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Gaozong turned and said to the ministers: "In the years when I first began learning, my attention could not yet be focused; after I took charge of the myriad affairs, I had no leisure to review and practice. For this reason there is indeed a deficiency in my Confucian Way.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gaozong turned to the ministers and said: "When I first began my studies, my mind could not yet concentrate; once I took charge of the myriad affairs of state, I had no leisure to review what I had learned. Thus my learning in the Confucian Way is indeed deficient.

manualTranslations.zh: 豈惟予咎，抑亦師傅之不勤。
manualTranslations.literal: How could this be only my fault? It is also because the teachers and tutors were not diligent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is not only my fault; it is also because my teachers and tutors were not diligent.

manualTranslations.zh: 所以爵賞仍隆者，蓋不遺舊也。」
manualTranslations.literal: The reason that title and rewards are nevertheless abundant is probably that I do not abandon old ties."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The reason his title and rewards remain generous is simply that I do not forget old ties."

manualTranslations.zh: 訢免冠拜謝。
manualTranslations.literal: Xin removed his cap, bowed, and gave thanks.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xin removed his cap, bowed, and thanked him.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為使持節、安南將軍、相州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General Who Pacifies the South, and Inspector of Xiang Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was then sent out as Bearer of the Staff of Authority, General Who Pacifies the South, and Inspector of Xiang Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 為政清簡，明於折獄，姦盜止息，百姓稱之。
manualTranslations.literal: His governance was pure and simple; he was clear in deciding lawsuits, criminals and robbers ceased, and the common people praised him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His administration was clean and simple, and he was perceptive in judging legal cases. Crime and theft came to a halt, and the people praised him.

sourceRange.text: 興安中，兼太常卿，立保太后父遼西獻王廟，加鎮遠將軍，進爵為侯。後除散騎侍郎，使劉駿。遣其侍中柳元景與度世對接，度世應對失衷。還，被禁劾，經年乃釋。除假節、鎮遠將軍、齊州刺史。州接邊境，將士數相侵掠。度世乃禁勒所統，還其俘虜，二境以寧。後坐事囚繫，久之，還鄉里。尋徵赴京，除平東將軍、青州刺史，未拜，遇患。延興元年卒，年五十三。諡曰惠侯。四子，淵、敏、昶、尚。
