manualTranslations.zh: 榮抗表之始，遣從子天光、親信奚毅及倉頭王相入洛，與從弟世隆密議廢立。
manualTranslations.literal: When Rong first submitted his forceful memorial, he sent his nephew Tianguang, his trusted associate Xi Yi, and his household servant Wang Xiang into Luoyang to discuss deposition and enthronement secretly with his cousin Shilong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Rong first submitted his forceful memorial, he sent his nephew Tianguang, his trusted associate Xi Yi, and his household servant Wang Xiang into Luoyang to confer secretly with his cousin Shilong about deposing and enthroning a ruler.

manualTranslations.zh: 天光乃見莊帝，具論榮心，帝許之。
manualTranslations.literal: Tianguang then met Emperor Zhuang and explained Rong's intentions fully; the emperor agreed to them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianguang then met Emperor Zhuang, fully explained Rong's intentions, and received the emperor's consent.

manualTranslations.zh: 天光等還北，榮發晉陽。
manualTranslations.literal: Tianguang and the others returned north, and Rong set out from Jinyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianguang and the others returned north, and Rong set out from Jinyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 猶疑所立，乃以銅鑄高祖及咸陽王禧等六王子孫像，成者當奉為主，惟莊帝獨就。
manualTranslations.literal: Still uncertain whom to install, he cast in bronze images of Emperor Gaozu and the descendants of six princes, including Prince Xi of Xianyang. Whoever came out complete would be honored as ruler; only Emperor Zhuang's image alone was completed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Still unsure whom to install, he cast bronze images of Emperor Gaozu and of the descendants of six princes, including Prince Xi of Xianyang. The one whose image came out complete would be honored as ruler, and only Emperor Zhuang's image was completed.

manualTranslations.zh: 師次河內，重遣王相密來奉迎，帝與兄彭城王劭、弟始平王子正於高渚潛渡以赴之。
manualTranslations.literal: When the army halted at Henei, he again sent Wang Xiang secretly to come and receive the emperor. The emperor, with his elder brother Prince Shao of Pengcheng and his younger brother Prince Zizheng of Shiping, secretly crossed at Gaozhu and went to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the army halted at Henei, Rong again secretly sent Wang Xiang to receive the emperor. The emperor, together with his elder brother Prince Shao of Pengcheng and his younger brother Prince Zizheng of Shiping, crossed secretly at Gaozhu and went to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 榮軍將士咸稱萬歲。
manualTranslations.literal: The officers and soldiers in Rong's army all shouted, "Ten thousand years!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The officers and soldiers in Rong's army all cried, "Ten thousand years!"

manualTranslations.zh: 於時武泰元年四月九日也。
manualTranslations.literal: This was the ninth day of the fourth month in Wutai year 1.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This was the ninth day of the fourth month in Wutai year 1.

localRange.text: 校勘記元曄立諸本「曄」作「暉」，北史卷四八尒朱榮附尒朱兆傳作「曄」。按尒朱世隆等立長廣王曄為帝，歷見本卷世隆傳、卷一０孝莊紀永安三年十月條、卷一九下南安王楨附元曄傳，「暉」字訛，今據改。遂害帝於三級寺諸本「三」作「五」，卷一０莊帝紀及通鑑卷一五四〈四七九三頁〉作「三」。按洛陽伽藍記卷一永寧寺條敍述此事也作「三級寺」。本書卷一一二上靈徵志上稱永熙三年三月「并州三級寺南門災」。「五」字訛，今改正。及張勸等掩襲世隆北史卷六齊紀神武紀、卷四九斛斯椿傳，北齊書卷一神武紀〈補〉，通鑑卷一五五〈四八二０頁〉「張勸」作「張歡」。按「張歡」又見北史卷一四后妃傳下周文皇后元氏傳，其人即北齊書卷二０、北史卷五三張瓊傳所記，「瓊子忻」。錢氏考異卷四０認為「齊史避諱，改『歡』為『忻』」。此傳和下世隆傳的「張勸」當亦魏收避齊諱改，本名實是「歡」。顥既克滎陽擒行臺楊昱百衲本「楊昱」作「陽叵」，他本都作「陽回」。按卷一０孝莊紀永安二年五月丁巳記楊昱以東南道大都督鎮滎陽，乙丑又記「元顥陷滎陽，執楊昱」。其事亦見卷五八楊播附昱傳。雖「行臺」和「大都督」官稱有異，其時被元顥所擒的守滎陽的主將只有「楊昱」，「陽叵」或「陽回」都是「楊昱」之訛，今改正。姦諂蛆酷多見信用按「蛆」當作「狙」，意謂狡詐。忽有河內太守田怗家奴告省門亭長云北史卷四八尒朱榮附世隆傳作「帖」，與「怗」通，冊府卷九五一〈一一一八九頁〉作「怙」。按卷八０賀拔勝傳見「田怙」。又北齊書卷二二李元忠附李愍傳說他曾奉命襲擊葛榮「所署廣州刺史田怙」。其人當即在此時叛降魏軍。「怗」疑是「怙」之訛。將車出東掖門諸本「車」訛「軍」，今據北史卷四八、冊府〈同上卷頁〉改。短小黑色諸本脫「小」字，今據北史卷四八、冊府〈同上卷頁〉補。復除軍州刺史按地志無此州名，也不見紀傳，「軍」字當訛。賊涇州刺史侯幾長貴仍以城降諸本「長貴」下旁注「疑」字。按周書卷一四賀拔岳傳也作「侯幾長貴」，並無可疑，今刪。率數千騎而走諸本「率」訛「牽」，今據冊府卷四三二〈五一四四頁〉改。至慶雲所居水洛城諸本「水洛」作「永洛」。按卷一０孝莊紀〈三朝本〉永安三年六月、周書卷一四賀拔岳傳、卷一七若干惠傳〈百衲本〉作「水洛」。今據改，參卷一０校記[一０]。南秦滑城人謀害刺史辛琛顯通鑑卷一五四〈四七七七頁〉作「南秦州城民謀殺刺史辛顯」。按南秦州之滑城不見紀載，疑「滑」字衍，通鑑「琛顯」作「顯」當是雙名單稱。万俟受洛干等據有河西諸本及北史卷四八「干」作「于」。按北齊書卷二七万俟普傳〈補〉云：「子洛，字受洛干」，北史卷六齊紀一、北齊書卷二神武紀下並作「受洛干」。「于」字訛，今據改。

sourceRange.text: 建義元年夏，万俟醜奴僭大號，朝廷憂之。乃除天光使持節、都督雍岐二州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、雍州刺史，率大都督、武衞將軍賀拔岳，大都督侯莫陳悅等以討醜奴。天光初行，唯配軍士千人，詔發京城已西路次民馬以給之。時東雍赤水蜀賊斷路，詔侍中楊侃先行曉慰，并徵其馬。侃雖入慰勞，而蜀持疑不下。天光遂入關擊破之，簡取壯健以充軍士，悉收其馬。至雍，又稅民馬，合得萬餘匹。以軍人寡少，停留未進。榮遣責之，杖天光一百，榮復遣軍士二千人以赴。天光令賀拔岳率千騎先驅，至岐州界長城西與醜奴行臺尉遲菩薩相遇，遂破擒之，獲騎士三千，步卒萬餘。

context.beforeSource: 顥破，尋還京師，遷驃騎將軍，加散騎常侍，改封廣宗郡公，增邑一千戶，仍為左衞將軍。
context.afterSource: 醜奴棄岐州走還安定，置柵於平亭。

manualTranslations.zh: 建義元年夏，万俟醜奴僭大號，朝廷憂之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the summer of Jianyi year 1, Moqi Chounu usurped the great title, and the court was worried about him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the summer of Jianyi year 1, Moqi Chounu usurped the imperial title, alarming the court.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃除天光使持節、都督雍岐二州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、雍州刺史，率大都督、武衞將軍賀拔岳，大都督侯莫陳悅等以討醜奴。
manualTranslations.literal: Accordingly Tianguang was appointed Bearer of the Staff, Commander-in-Chief of military affairs in Yong and Qi provinces, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, and Inspector of Yong Province, leading Grand Commander and Martial Guard General Heba Yue, Grand Commander Houmochen Yue, and others to campaign against Chounu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianguang was therefore appointed Bearer of the Staff, Commander-in-Chief for military affairs in Yong and Qi provinces, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, and Inspector of Yong Province, and was ordered to lead Grand Commander and Martial Guard General Heba Yue, Grand Commander Houmochen Yue, and others against Chounu.

manualTranslations.zh: 天光初行，唯配軍士千人，詔發京城已西路次民馬以給之。
manualTranslations.literal: When Tianguang first set out, only one thousand soldiers were assigned to him, and an edict mobilized civilian horses along the route west of the capital to supply him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Tianguang first set out, he was assigned only one thousand soldiers, and an edict requisitioned civilian horses along the roads west of the capital to supply him.

manualTranslations.zh: 時東雍赤水蜀賊斷路，詔侍中楊侃先行曉慰，并徵其馬。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the Shu rebels of Chishui in Eastern Yong blocked the road, and an edict ordered Palace Attendant Yang Kan to go first to instruct and console them, and also to requisition their horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time, Shu rebels from Chishui in Eastern Yong blocked the road, so an edict sent Palace Attendant Yang Kan ahead to explain matters and soothe them while also requisitioning their horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 侃雖入慰勞，而蜀持疑不下。
manualTranslations.literal: Although Kan entered and offered consolation, the Shu people remained suspicious and would not submit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although Kan went in and consoled them, the Shu people remained suspicious and refused to submit.

manualTranslations.zh: 天光遂入關擊破之，簡取壯健以充軍士，悉收其馬。
manualTranslations.literal: Tianguang then entered the passes and attacked and defeated them, selecting the strong and able to fill out his soldiers and taking all their horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianguang then entered the passes, defeated them, selected their strong men to fill his ranks, and seized all their horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 至雍，又稅民馬，合得萬餘匹。
manualTranslations.literal: When he reached Yong, he again levied horses from the people, altogether obtaining more than ten thousand head.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After reaching Yong, he again levied horses from the people and obtained more than ten thousand in all.

manualTranslations.zh: 以軍人寡少，停留未進。
manualTranslations.literal: Because his troops were few, he halted and did not advance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because his troops were too few, he halted and did not advance.

manualTranslations.zh: 榮遣責之，杖天光一百，榮復遣軍士二千人以赴。
manualTranslations.literal: Rong sent to reprimand him and had Tianguang beaten one hundred strokes; Rong then sent another two thousand soldiers to join him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Rong sent a reprimand and had Tianguang beaten one hundred strokes, then dispatched another two thousand soldiers to reinforce him.

manualTranslations.zh: 天光令賀拔岳率千騎先驅，至岐州界長城西與醜奴行臺尉遲菩薩相遇，遂破擒之，獲騎士三千，步卒萬餘。
manualTranslations.literal: Tianguang ordered Heba Yue to lead one thousand cavalry as the vanguard. West of the Great Wall on the border of Qi Province, Yue encountered Chounu's field headquarters officer Yuchi Pusa, defeated and captured him, and took three thousand cavalrymen and more than ten thousand infantry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tianguang ordered Heba Yue to lead one thousand cavalry as the vanguard. West of the Great Wall on the Qi Province border, Yue encountered Chounu's field headquarters officer Yuchi Pusa, defeated and captured him, and took three thousand cavalrymen and more than ten thousand infantry.

localRange.text: 校勘記郎中別作抄目諸本「目」訛「自」，不可通，今據北史卷三０盧同傳改。臣頃奏以黃素為勳按「勳」下當脫「簿」字，下云「黃素勳簿」可證。節度大都督李叔仁〈闕〉諸本下旁注「闕」字。按卷九肅宗紀孝昌三年二月庚申稱東郡民趙顯德反，詔都督李叔仁討之；三月辛未又稱齊州廣川民劉鈞執清河太守邵懷聚眾反，六月稱詔都督李叔仁討劉鈞平之。東郡屬西兗州。盧同以齊兗二州行臺節度李叔仁，所闕必即鎮壓這兩支變亂軍事，但紀不書盧同以行臺節度事。

context.beforeSource: 趨捨深沉，俱至顯達，雅道正路，其殆病諸。

localRange.text: 正光五年，以國子博士徵之。孝昌二年，徵為散騎侍郎。

sourceRange.text: 靈太后反政，以同叉黨，除名。孝昌三年，除左將軍、太中大夫、兼左丞，為齊兗二州行臺，節度大都督李叔仁。闕莊帝踐祚，詔復本秩，除都官尚書，復兼七兵。以同前慰勞德興之功，封章武縣開國伯，邑四百戶。正除七兵，尋轉殿中，加征南將軍。普泰初，除侍中，進號驃騎將軍、左光祿大夫。同時久病，強牽從務，啟乞儀同。初同之為黃門也，與前廢帝俱在門下，同異其為人，素相款託。廢帝以恩舊許之，除儀同三司，餘官如故。永熙初薨，年五十六。贈侍中、都督冀滄瀛三州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、司空公、冀州刺史，開國伯如故，賜帛四百匹，諡曰孝穆。三年，復加贈尚書右僕射。有四子。

context.beforeSource: 同慮德興難信，勒眾而往，為德興所擊，大敗而還。
context.afterSource: 長子斐，武定中，文襄王大將軍府掾。
context.beforeLocal: 同慮德興難信，勒眾而往，為德興所擊，大敗而還。

manualTranslations.zh: 靈太后反政，以同叉黨，除名。
manualTranslations.literal: When Empress Dowager Ling regained power, because Tong was counted among Cha's faction, his name was struck from the rolls.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Empress Dowager Ling regained power, Tong was struck from the rolls as a member of Cha's faction.

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昌三年，除左將軍、太中大夫、兼左丞，為齊兗二州行臺，節度大都督李叔仁。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Xiaochang, he was appointed Left General, Grand Master of Palace Counsel, and concurrent Left Assistant Director; he served as mobile headquarters over Qi and the two Yanzhou provinces, directing Grand Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xiaochang he was appointed Left General, Grand Master of Palace Counsel, and concurrent Left Assistant Director, and served as mobile headquarters over Qi and the two Yanzhou provinces directing Grand Commander-in-Chief Li Shuren.

manualTranslations.zh: 闕莊帝踐祚，詔復本秩，除都官尚書，復兼七兵。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈Missing text〉 When Emperor Zhuang took the throne, an edict restored his former ranks; he was appointed Minister of the Masters of Scrutiny and again concurrently held the Seven Troops bureau.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Missing text〉 When Emperor Zhuang took the throne, an edict restored his former ranks; he was appointed Minister of the Masters of Scrutiny and again concurrently held the Seven Troops bureau.

manualTranslations.zh: 以同前慰勞德興之功，封章武縣開國伯，邑四百戶。
manualTranslations.literal: For Tong's earlier achievement in comforting Dexing, he was enfeoffed as Baron Who Founded Zhangwu County, with a fief of four hundred households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For Tong's earlier service in pacifying Jiudexing, he was enfeoffed as founding baron of Zhangwu County with a fief of four hundred households.

manualTranslations.zh: 正除七兵，尋轉殿中，加征南將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He was formally appointed to the Seven Troops bureau; shortly afterward he was transferred to the Palace Attendants and given the additional title General Who Campaigns South.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was formally appointed to the Seven Troops bureau; soon afterward he was transferred to the Palace Attendants and additionally named General Who Campaigns South.

manualTranslations.zh: 普泰初，除侍中，進號驃騎將軍、左光祿大夫。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Putai, he was appointed Palace Attendant and advanced to General of Fast Cavalry and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Putai reign he was appointed Palace Attendant and advanced to General of Fast Cavalry and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

manualTranslations.zh: 同時久病，強牽從務，啟乞儀同。
manualTranslations.literal: At the same time Tong had long been ill but was forcibly pressed into service; he memorialized requesting the honorific rank of Yitong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tong had long been ill but was forcibly pressed to continue in office; he memorialized requesting the honorific rank of Yitong.

manualTranslations.zh: 初同之為黃門也，與前廢帝俱在門下，同異其為人，素相款託。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, when Tong served in the Yellow Gate, he and the Deposed Former Emperor were both in the Gate Department; Tong was impressed by his character and they had long been on friendly terms.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Tong served in the Yellow Gate, he and the Deposed Former Emperor were both in the Gate Department; Tong admired his character and they had long been on intimate terms.

manualTranslations.zh: 廢帝以恩舊許之，除儀同三司，餘官如故。
manualTranslations.literal: The Deposed Emperor, out of old friendship, granted it; Tong was given Yitong Third Rank, his other offices remaining as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor granted it out of old friendship; Tong was given Yitong Third Rank, his other offices remaining unchanged.

manualTranslations.zh: 永熙初薨，年五十六。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Yongxi he died, aged fifty-six.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the opening of the Yongxi reign he died at the age of fifty-six.

manualTranslations.zh: 贈侍中、都督冀滄瀛三州諸軍事、驃騎大將軍、司空公、冀州刺史，開國伯如故，賜帛四百匹，諡曰孝穆。
manualTranslations.literal: Posthumously he was given Palace Attendant, Commander-in-Chief of the military affairs of Ji, Cang, and Ying provinces, Grand General of Fast Cavalry, Duke of the Works, and Inspector of Jizhou; his founding barony remained as before; four hundred bolts of silk were granted; his posthumous title was Xiaomu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was given Palace Attendant, command over the military affairs of Ji, Cang, and Ying provinces, Grand General of Fast Cavalry, Duke of the Works, and Inspector of Jizhou; his founding barony was unchanged; four hundred bolts of silk were granted; his posthumous title was Xiaomu.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，復加贈尚書右僕射。
manualTranslations.literal: Three years later he was again posthumously given Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Three years later he was again posthumously given Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

manualTranslations.zh: 有四子。
manualTranslations.literal: He had four sons.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had four sons.

sourceRange.text: ，卒於家，時年七十七。

localRange.text: 元象元年，卒於家，時年七十七。

sourceRange.text: 孝昌元年，徐州刺史元法僧以城南叛，蕭衍遣蕭綜來據彭城。時遣大都督、安豐王延明督臨淮王彧討之，盤桓不進。乃詔雄副太常少卿元誨為使，給齊庫刀，持節、乘驛催軍，有違即令斬決。肅宗謂雄曰：「誨，朕家諸子，摽以親懿。籌策機計，仗卿取勝耳。」到軍，勒令並進徐州，綜送降款。冀州刺史侯剛啟為長史，肅宗以雄長於世務，惜不許之，更除司空長史。於時，諸公皆慕其名，欲屈為佐，莫能得也。

context.beforeSource: 俄兼司州別駕，加前軍將軍。
context.afterSource: 時諸方賊盛，而南寇侵境，山蠻作逆，肅宗欲親討，以荊州為先，詔雄為行臺左丞，與前軍臨淮王彧東趣葉城，別將裴衍西通鵶路。
context.beforeLocal: 俄兼司州別駕，加前軍將軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 孝昌元年，徐州刺史元法僧以城南叛，蕭衍遣蕭綜來據彭城。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xiaochang, Yuan Faseng, Inspector of Xuzhou, rebelled while holding the south of the city; Xiao Yan sent Xiao Zong to seize Pengcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xiaochang year 1, Yuan Faseng, Inspector of Xuzhou, rebelled while holding the south of the city; Xiao Yan sent Xiao Zong to seize Pengcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 時遣大都督、安豐王延明督臨淮王彧討之，盤桓不進。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the court dispatched the Grand Commander, Prince Yanming of Anfeng, to oversee Prince Yu of Huainai in suppressing them, but they lingered and did not advance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the court dispatched Grand Commander Prince Yanming of Anfeng to oversee Prince Yu of Huainai in suppressing them, but they lingered and did not advance.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃詔雄副太常少卿元誨為使，給齊庫刀，持節、乘驛催軍，有違即令斬決。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict then appointed Xiong as deputy to Yuan Hui, Vice Director of the Grand Temple, as envoy; he was given a Qi-armory blade, and with credentials and post relay he was to urge the army forward — any disobedience was to be punished by immediate execution.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict then appointed Xiong as deputy to Yuan Hui, Vice Director of the Grand Temple, as envoy; he was given a Qi-armory blade and, bearing credentials and traveling by post relay, was to urge the army forward — any disobedience was to be punished by immediate execution.

manualTranslations.zh: 肅宗謂雄曰：「誨，朕家諸子，摽以親懿。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Suzong said to Xiong: "Hui is one of my family's sons, singled out by kinship and close ties.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong said to Xiong: "Hui is one of my family's sons, singled out by kinship and close ties.

manualTranslations.zh: 籌策機計，仗卿取勝耳。」
manualTranslations.literal: In counsel and stratagem, I rely on you to secure victory."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In counsel and stratagem, I rely on you to secure victory."

manualTranslations.zh: 到軍，勒令並進徐州，綜送降款。
manualTranslations.literal: Upon reaching the army, he ordered a joint advance into Xuzhou; Zong sent over a surrender petition.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Upon reaching the army, he ordered a joint advance into Xuzhou; Zong sent over a surrender petition.

manualTranslations.zh: 冀州刺史侯剛啟為長史，肅宗以雄長於世務，惜不許之，更除司空長史。
manualTranslations.literal: Hou Gang, Inspector of Jizhou, memorialized to appoint him Chief of Staff; Emperor Suzong, because Xiong excelled in worldly affairs, regretted that he could not approve this and instead appointed him Chief Clerk to the Minister of Works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hou Gang, Inspector of Jizhou, memorialized to appoint Xiong as Chief of Staff; Emperor Suzong, because Xiong excelled in worldly affairs, regretted that he could not approve this and instead appointed him Chief Clerk to the Minister of Works.

manualTranslations.zh: 於時，諸公皆慕其名，欲屈為佐，莫能得也。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time all the grandees admired his reputation and wished to bend him to serve as their aide, but none could gain him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time all the grandees admired his reputation and wished to secure him as an aide, but none could gain him.

localRange.text: 校勘記北溝求救按「北溝」不見記載。卷九肅宗紀孝昌元年十二月詔稱「北淯懸危，南陽告急」，即此傳所敍事。「北溝」當是「北淯」之訛。卷一０六下地形志下荊州有「北清郡」，錢氏考異卷三０據上引肅宗紀及卷七三楊大眼傳以為「清」當作「淯」。其地在今河南南陽市之北，此傳上文說「裴衍西通鵶路」的第一鵶也即在其地，可證。若不除煩收疾冊府卷六五五〈七八四六頁〉「收」作「救」，疑是。東軍不守冊府卷四一七〈四九七五頁〉「軍」作「中」。按上文稱永安二年元顥攻城，尒朱世隆狼狽退還云云，據卷七五世隆傳稱：「元顥逼大梁，詔假儀同三司、前軍都督，鎮虎牢。下文又說纂「還鎮虎牢」，知辛纂所守之城即虎牢。卷一０六地形志中北豫州條，云太和十九年於虎牢置「東中府」。這裏「軍」當是「中」之訛。又上記辛纂官「平東將軍、中郎將」，「中郎將」上亦當有「東」字。父敬宗北史卷五０辛雄傳附辛琛作「祖敬宗，父樹寶」。按元和姓纂輯本卷三辛氏稱「敬宗曾孫術」，術即琛子，又唐書卷七三上宰相世系表也是敬宗、樹寶、琛分列三代，當是此傳脫去「樹寶」，「父敬宗」亦當作「祖敬宗」。子懿北史卷五０辛雄傳末「懿」作「慤」。按辛慤見北齊書卷四三源彪傳、元和姓纂輯本卷三、唐書卷七三上宰相世系表。據姓纂，懿乃慤六世祖，不應同名。這裏「懿」當是「慤」之訛。太山平陽人殿本考證云：「按北史羊祉傳〈卷三九〉祉太山鉅平人。本書地形志〈卷一０六中〉泰山郡有鉅平，若平陽則屬高平郡，又有陽平，則屬魯郡，當以鉅平為是。按本書卷八八良吏羊敦傳、卷八九酷吏羊祉傳並云「太山鉅平人」。羊氏本泰山南城人，羊祜封鉅平侯，後人或稱鉅平，或稱梁父，這裏「平陽」當誤。正平薛鳳賢等聚眾作逆諸本「正」作「王」，北史卷三九羊祉附羊深傳大德本作「正」，百衲本從他本改「王」。按通志卷一四九羊深傳也作「正」，知北史本是「正」字。本書卷一０六上地形志上東雍州有正平郡。薛鳳賢於正平起事，見本書卷二五、北史卷二二長孫道生附長孫稚傳。〈北史避唐諱「稚」作「幼」。「王」字訛，今據改。憚比刑書北史卷五０高道穆附高謙之傳「比」作「此」，疑是。刺史李世哲即尚書令崇之子北史卷五０高道穆傳「刺史」上有「前」字。按卷六六李崇附李世哲傳，世哲此時已徵為兼太常卿，疑此傳脫「前」字。與薛曇尚書使晉陽按薛曇尚，附卷四四薛野䐗傳，這時他以司徒左長史兼吏部尚書出使晉陽，授尒朱榮官。疑「書」字衍。但「曇尚」也可單稱「曇」，「尚書」作官名連讀，亦可通，今仍之。

sourceRange.text: 蕭衍遣將曹義宗攻新野，詔纂持節、兼尚書左丞、南道行臺，率眾赴接，至便破之。義宗等以其勁速，不敢復進。於時海內多虞，京師更無繼援，惟以二千餘兵捍禦疆埸。又詔為荊州軍司，除驍騎將軍，加輔國將軍。纂善撫將士，人多用命，賊甚憚之。會肅宗崩諱至，咸以對敵，欲祕凶問。纂曰：「安危在人，豈關是也。」遂發喪號哭，三軍縞素。還入州城，申以盟約。尋為義宗所圍，相率固守。莊帝即位，除通直散騎常侍、征虜將軍、兼尚書，仍行臺。後大都督費穆擊義宗，擒之。入城，因舉酒屬纂曰：「微辛行臺之在斯，吾亦無由建此功也。」入朝，言於莊帝，稱纂固節危城，宜蒙爵賞，以勸將來。帝乃下詔慰勉之。

context.beforeSource: 雅為彧所稱歎，屢在朝廷薦舉之。

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭衍遣將曹義宗攻新野，詔纂持節、兼尚書左丞、南道行臺，率眾赴接，至便破之。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiao Yan sent the general Cao Yizong to attack Xinye; an edict appointed Zuan Bearer of the Staff, concurrently Left Director of the Secretariat and head of the Southern Route Mobile Office, to lead troops to relieve the city — upon arrival he at once defeated them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan sent the general Cao Yizong to attack Xinye; an edict appointed Zuan Bearer of the Staff, concurrently Left Director of the Secretariat and head of the Southern Route Mobile Office, to lead troops to relieve the city — upon arrival he at once defeated them.

manualTranslations.zh: 義宗等以其勁速，不敢復進。
manualTranslations.literal: Yizong and the others, because of his fierce speed, did not dare advance again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yizong and the others, because of his fierce speed, did not dare advance again.

manualTranslations.zh: 於時海內多虞，京師更無繼援，惟以二千餘兵捍禦疆埸。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the realm was troubled on all sides and the capital had no further reinforcements; he defended the frontier with only a little more than two thousand troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the realm was troubled on all sides and the capital had no further reinforcements; he defended the frontier with only a little more than two thousand troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 又詔為荊州軍司，除驍騎將軍，加輔國將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: He was further ordered as Army Strategist for Jing Province, appointed General of Valiant Cavalry, and given the additional title General Who Assists the State.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was further ordered as Army Strategist for Jing Province, appointed General of Valiant Cavalry, and given the additional title General Who Assists the State.

manualTranslations.zh: 纂善撫將士，人多用命，賊甚憚之。
manualTranslations.literal: Zuan was skilled at comforting officers and men; many gave their utmost in service, and the bandits greatly feared him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zuan was skilled at comforting officers and men; many gave their utmost in service, and the bandits greatly feared him.

manualTranslations.zh: 會肅宗崩諱至，咸以對敵，欲祕凶問。
manualTranslations.literal: When word arrived of Emperor Suzong's death, all were facing the enemy and wished to conceal the death announcement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When word arrived of Emperor Suzong's death, all were facing the enemy and wished to conceal the death announcement.

manualTranslations.zh: 纂曰：「安危在人，豈關是也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Zuan said: "Safety and peril depend on people — what does this matter?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zuan said: "Safety and peril depend on people — what does this have to do with it?"

manualTranslations.zh: 遂發喪號哭，三軍縞素。
manualTranslations.literal: He thereupon proclaimed mourning and weeping, and the whole army wore white.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He thereupon proclaimed mourning and weeping, and the whole army wore white.

manualTranslations.zh: 還入州城，申以盟約。
manualTranslations.literal: He returned to the provincial capital and reaffirmed the covenant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He returned to the provincial capital and reaffirmed the covenant.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋為義宗所圍，相率固守。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he was besieged by Yizong and they jointly held fast in defense.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he was besieged by Yizong and they jointly held fast in defense.

manualTranslations.zh: 莊帝即位，除通直散騎常侍、征虜將軍、兼尚書，仍行臺。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Zhuang took the throne, Zuan was appointed Regular Attendant Directly at the Gate for Regular Cavalry, General Who Subdues the Barbarians, and concurrently Director, still heading the mobile office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhuang took the throne, Zuan was appointed Regular Attendant Directly at the Gate for Regular Cavalry, General Who Subdues the Barbarians, and concurrently Director, still heading the mobile office.

manualTranslations.zh: 後大都督費穆擊義宗，擒之。
manualTranslations.literal: Later Grand Commander Fei Mu attacked Yizong and captured him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Grand Commander Fei Mu attacked Yizong and captured him.

manualTranslations.zh: 入城，因舉酒屬纂曰：「微辛行臺之在斯，吾亦無由建此功也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Upon entering the city, he raised his cup and addressed Zuan: "Had Xin the mobile commander not been here, I would have had no way to achieve this merit."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Upon entering the city, he raised his cup and addressed Zuan: "Had Xin the mobile commander not been here, I would have had no way to achieve this merit."

manualTranslations.zh: 入朝，言於莊帝，稱纂固節危城，宜蒙爵賞，以勸將來。
manualTranslations.literal: He went to court and spoke to Emperor Zhuang, praising Zuan's steadfast defense of a perilous city and saying he should receive rank and reward to encourage those who come after.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went to court and spoke to Emperor Zhuang, praising Zuan's steadfast defense of a perilous city and saying he should receive rank and reward to encourage those who come after.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝乃下詔慰勉之。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor thereupon issued an edict comforting and commending him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon issued an edict comforting and commending him.

localRange.text: 校勘記臣卿乃少諸本「卿」作「節」，北史卷四六孫紹傳、冊府卷九四六〈一一一四二頁〉作「卿」。按孫紹這時官太府少卿，故作此語，「節」字訛，今據改。葬我小君文姜氏北史卷四六張普惠傳無「氏」字。按春秋莊公二十二年經文本無「氏」字，這裏當是衍文。又曰不為君母之黨服則為其母之黨服按禮記未見此語，唯服問云：「為其母之黨服，則不為繼母之黨服。疑普惠即用此文而倒其辭，則「君」字當是「繼」字之訛。普惠諸奏疏中引經文與今傳本間有出入，或是誤記，或當時傳抄本有異文，不悉出校記。禮有下卿上士冊府卷五四一〈六四九四頁〉「下卿」作「上卿」。按這是張普惠駁袁翻「上公」「上大夫」的話，所重在「上」字，諸本作「下卿」當訛。時中山莊弼遺書普惠曰北史卷四六「莊」作「杜」。按北齊書卷二四杜弼傳云：「中山曲陽人也。當即其人。這裏「莊」字當是形近而訛。不適於綿麻而已通鑑卷一四八〈四六三六頁〉「適」作「啻」，疑是。不惟法度之□易冊府卷五三０〈六三三六頁〉所闕字作「幅」，不可解，今不補。今宮人請調度按上云「羣官共竊之」，下云「百官請俸」，疑「宮人」乃「官人」之訛。總常俸之數千俸所出以布綿麻亦應其一歲之用按語意晦澀，疑有訛脫。愚謂從朝夕之因通鑑卷一四八〈四六三六頁〉「從」作「修」，疑是。今始列辭諸本「辭」作「璧」，旁注「疑」字，冊府卷四七二〈五六三七頁〉作「辭」。按「列璧」無義，今據改，並刪「疑」字。豈得混一罔分久近也諸本「罔」訛「內」，今據冊府〈同上卷頁〉改。若是則力少蕃王〈至〉既有全食足戶之異按語不可解，疑有訛脫。自後人率其心紛綸盈庭嫌少誤惑視聽冊府卷四七二〈五六三八頁〉無「嫌少」二字。按「嫌少」上下疑有脫文，冊府恐是以讀不可通，刪二字，但讀作「其心紛綸，盈庭嫌少」，亦可通，今仍之。易曰言行君子之所以動天下冊府卷四七二〈五六三九頁〉「天下」作「天地」。按今傳本易繫辭作「天地」。然或是冊府據今傳本改，今仍之。澆而更張冊府卷四七二〈五六三九頁〉「澆」作「弛」，疑是。不患貧而患不均冊府〈同上卷〉宋本同，明本「貧」作「寡」。按論語季氏作「寡」，與「不患貧而患不安」為對文，這裏「貧」字當誤。

localRange.text: 校勘記何得以朱衣入山庭通鑑卷一三七〈四三０七頁〉「山」作「凶」，當是。拜桃符征虜將軍豫州刺史北史卷四六劉桃符傳「豫州」上有「東」字。按上文稱東豫州刺史田益宗，桃符此授，即代益宗，當脫「東」字。食邑二百戶三朝本、汲本脫「百」字，北本、殿本「百」作「千」，南本、局本作「百」。按下張熠傳稱「封長平縣開國男，食邑二百戶」，同一等級，封戶雖或有多少，不會相去懸殊，今從南、局本。元興世寒因元叉之勢託其交道相用為州主簿按上文不云元興曾官州主簿，託附元叉時，他已由司徒記室參軍遷尚書殿中郎，領中書舍人，不得方因叉勢為州主簿。疑上脫子某，託元叉之勢官州主簿的是元興之子。東清河人房須反卷二一下彭成王卲傳、冊府卷一二一〈一四五一頁〉「須」作「頃」，通鑑卷一五一〈四七二四頁〉作「項」。參卷九校記。師次鄖城按鄖城遠在今湖北安陸，琅邪一帶不聞有此城名，「鄖」字疑訛。張熠北史卷四六「熠」作「燿」。永寧寺塔大興諸本「永寧」下有「中」字。按魏無「永寧」年號。永寧是寺名，屢見本書，「中」字衍，今刪。

localRange.text: 校勘記自襄威將軍超贈車騎將軍諸本「威」作「城」。按卷一一三官氏志無「襄城將軍」，太和後品令從第六品有「襄威將軍」，「城」字乃「威」的形訛，今改正。及刺史元顯達以城降於蕭衍按梁書卷三九有元願達傳，即此人，梁書卷三高祖紀大通二年四月辛丑條、卷二八夏侯亶傳都作「願達」。據梁書本傳，其人為樂平王丕後裔，今魏書卷一七已闕，後人所補，丕傳不載子孫。梁書三處並作「願達」，疑「顯」字訛。時趙脩延起逆荊州諸本「延」作「巡」。殿本考證云：「按本卷樊子鵠傳云：『趙脩延叛於荊州。又本書李琰之傳〈卷八二〉云：南陽太守趙脩延誣琰之規奔蕭衍，襲州城，仍自行州事。城內人斬脩延。則此與下文荊州斬送脩巡，皆訛『延』為『巡』也。按考證說是，卷一０莊帝紀末、卷一一前廢帝紀普泰元年五月記此事，都作「脩延」。「巡」字訛，今改正。又攻馮翊安定沔陽酇陽城並平之冊府卷三六八〈四三八二頁〉「酇」下無「陽」字。按周書卷一四賀拔勝傳、卷二九宇文虬傳並作「歐陽、酇城」。通鑑卷一五六〈四八三五頁〉但有「酇城」，與冊府同。隋書卷三一地理志下襄陽郡陰城縣下云：「西魏置酇城郡。西魏當因梁舊名。歐陽，見本書卷五八楊播附楊侃傳，地在合肥，壽春間，或沔北別有此城。「酇陽」不見紀載，這裏當衍「陽」字。如周書不誤，則也可能是「歐陽、酇城」的倒脫。岳屆長安榮遣兵續至諸本「兵」作「岳」。按既云「岳屆長安」，又云「遣岳續至」，語不可通。卷七五尒朱天光傳稱「榮復遣軍士二千人以赴」，即指此事。這裏「岳」乃「兵」之訛，今改正。先所置騎隨岳而集諸本「騎」上有「驛」字，周書卷一四、北史卷四九賀拔岳傳、通典卷一五四引退設伏取之條無。按「驛」字乃涉上文「駱驛置之」語而衍，今據刪。彼民不促按「促」字不可解，疑是「從」之訛。

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷八十一諸本目錄此卷注「闕」。殿本考證云：「魏收書闕，後人所補。按此卷以北史卷五０綦儁、山偉、宇文忠之三傳及卷二０劉庫仁附劉仁之傳補。卷末無宋人校語，當是脫去。雖為尒朱扶戴諸本「戴」訛「載」，今據北史卷五０綦儁傳改。不能紹宣魏網按文義「網」當是「綱」之訛。後正名士郎張森楷云：「『名士』二字疑誤。按墓誌集釋元湛墓誌〈圖版一五二〉稱「尋補尚書左士郎中」，周書卷三四楊敷傳稱敷「歷尚書左士郎中」。左右士曹見晉書卷二四職官志。疑這裏「名」字乃「右」字之訛。

sourceRange.text: 天平初，遷鄴，景匹馬從駕。是時詔下三日，戶四十萬狼狽就道，收百官馬，尚書丞郎已下非陪從者盡乘驢。齊獻武王以景清貧，特給車牛四乘，妻孥方得達鄴。後除儀同三司，仍本將軍。武定六年，以老疾去官。詔曰：「几杖為禮，安車致養，敬齒尊賢，其來尚矣。景藝業該通，文史淵洽，歷事三京，年彌五紀，朝章言歸，祿俸無餘，家徒壁立，宜從哀恤，以旌元老。可特給右光祿事力，終其身。」八年薨。

context.beforeSource: 」遂與衞將軍羊深矜其所乏，乃率刁雙、司馬彥邕、李諧、畢祖彥、畢義顯等各出錢千文而為買馬焉。
context.afterSource: 景善與人交，終始若一，其遊處者，皆服其深遠之度，未曾見其矜吝之心。

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷八十二諸本目錄此卷注「闕」，百衲本卷末有宋人校語云「魏收書列傳七十」，語未完，當脫「亡」字。殿本考證云：「魏收書闕，後人所補。按北史，祖瑩卷四七有傳，常景附卷四二常爽傳，李琰之見卷一００序傳。檢此卷傳文大體與北史同，間有溢出語。當是後人以北史相同諸人傳補，而增入高氏小史等他書中文句。彭城王勰辟為行臺參軍北史卷一００序傳「臺」作「軍」。按彭城王勰未曾為行臺，且行臺屬僚皆同尚書省，不聞有參軍。但「行軍參軍」也罕見。「臺」或「軍」字或是衍文。可更為誦悲彭城詩諸本「更」作「便」，北史卷四七祖瑩傳、冊府卷八五０〈一０一一二頁〉作「更」。按上稱「勰欲使肅更詠」。「便」字訛，今據改。不尋致服之情北史卷四二常爽附常景傳、冊府卷五八一〈六九六二頁〉「致」作「制」。按所論即在「制服」，疑作「制」是。時肅宗行講學之禮於國子寺諸本「行」訛「以」，今據北史卷四二常爽附常景傳改。俄而安州石離冗城斛鹽三戍兵反冊府卷三五四〈四一九九頁〉「冗城」作「宛城」。通鑑卷一五一〈四七一０頁〉作「穴城」，胡注以見於水經注卷一四鮑丘水篇的「孔山」當之。按水經注稱孔山「上有洞穴開明」，其地與斛鹽戍鄰接。百衲本「冗」字末筆稍直，疑實是「穴」字缺上點，冊府作「宛」雖誤，上也作「宀」可證。自松岍赴賊通鑑卷一五一〈四七一０頁〉胡注：「或曰：『岍』『𡶭』字之誤也，讀作『陘』。唐志〈唐書卷四三下地理志下載入四夷道路〉營州西北有松陘嶺。率屬城人禦之通志卷一五０上常景傳「率」上有「景」字。按此字不宜省，當是脫文。景與都督于榮刺史王延年置兵粟園諸本「粟園」作「粟國」，卷九肅宗紀孝昌二年七月作「粟園」，通鑑卷一五一〈四七一四頁〉作「栗園」。按「國」字必訛，今據改。「粟」疑亦當作「栗」，但諸本及紀皆同，今仍之。參卷九校記粟園條。原夫人□之度諸本「人」下不空格，北史卷四二注「闕」字。按若如諸本，與下「勢位之危」句不相對，「人」下當闕一字，今作方圍。

sourceRange.text: 先是高宗以乳母常氏有保護功，既即位，尊為保太后，後尊為皇太后。興安二年，太后兄英，字世華，自肥如令超為散騎常侍、鎮軍大將軍，賜爵遼西公。弟喜，鎮東大將軍、祠曹尚書、帶方公。三妹皆封縣君，妹夫王睹為平州刺史、遼東公。追贈英祖、父，苻堅扶風太守亥為鎮西將軍、遼西簡公，勃海太守澄為侍中、征東大將軍、太宰、遼西獻王，英母許氏博陵郡君。遣兼太常盧度世持節改葬獻王於遼西，樹碑立廟，置守冢百家。

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷八十三上諸本目錄此卷注「闕」，百衲本、南本、北本、汲本、局本卷末有宋人校記，云：「魏收書外戚傳上亡。殿本入考證，云「後人所補」。按此卷大體以北史卷八０外戚傳中相同諸傳補，但也有溢出北史文句。其序自首至「或以思澤」全同北史。劉羅辰、李峻二傳，北史外戚傳無。羅辰，北史卷二０附劉庫仁傳，此卷羅辰傳前半或掇取本書卷二三劉庫仁附劉眷傳末數語，後半則取之北史。李峻傳不知所出。大致此卷亦是以北史補，而以高氏小史等他書附益之。常相持奬按「常」疑是「當」之訛。進爵北新公諸本及北史卷八０賀訥附賀悅傳無「公」字，通志卷一六五賀訥傳有。按賀悅先封鉅鹿侯，進爵自當為公。這裏脫「公」字，今據補。詐增虜級諸本及北史卷八０賀訥附賀泥傳脫「級」字，不可通，今據通志卷一六五補。及歸而父遺喪按上文不記元寶出外，「及歸」二字無着，上當有脫文。追諡后祖父延定襄康公諸本及北史卷八０閭毗傳無「定」字，通志卷一六五閭毗傳有。按下云「父辰，定襄懿王」，知脫「定」字，今據補。遼西簡公諸本及北史卷八０「簡」作「蘭」，通志卷一五六作「簡」。按諡法無「蘭」字，乃「簡」字形近而訛，今據改。從兄泰為安東將軍朝鮮侯通志卷一六五敍常氏事「泰」作「訢」。按此句下緊接「訢子伯夫」，「次子員」官位，而上却不舉訢名，不知為常氏何人。如通志「泰」作「訢」，便無問題。但泰又見下文，且「泰」「訢」二字聲形俱遠，傳本何以「訢」字訛「泰」？疑通志以意改，非有他據。此句下當脫訢名及官位。伏寶泰等州刺史按此句連上文似也是常英歷官。然伏、寶二州不見紀載。上稱英「從兄泰」，則伏、寶、泰皆人名而非地名。卷九四封津傳云：「父令德，娶黨寶女，寶伏誅，令德以連坐伏法。北史卷九二封津傳「黨寶」作「常寶」。疑即此為「州刺史」之「寶」。伯夫進爵范陽公張森楷云：「伯夫初無封爵之文，何得云『進』？疑『進』是『賜』之誤，否則前文失載。按此傳敍常氏事中多脫誤，恐非原文失載。諸常自興安及至是諸本及北史卷八０「安」作「公」。諸本於「及」下注「疑」字。通志卷一五六「公」作「安」，無「及」字。按上文稱常英兄弟於興安二年授官封爵，為諸常貴盛之始，通志作「興安」是，今據改。「及」字贅，但也可通，今仍之。刪旁注「疑」字。遼西郡公卷一三文成馮皇后傳「遼西」作「西城」，墓誌集釋元悅妃馮季華墓誌〈圖版八三〉作「西郡公」，疑誌是。參卷一三校記西城郡公條。并開魏京之墓按「魏京」罕見。據下文「令公主之柩俱向伊洛」，則公主當先死，葬亦必在代。但當時未見有稱代為「魏京」之例，疑「魏」當作「代」。及斂迭舉北史卷八０無「迭舉」二字，疑涉上「從者亦迭舉音」而衍。聿同產弟風按卷二一廣陵王羽傳見馮夙，以考績下下免中庶子官，自即此「馮風」，疑作「夙」是。不得復外戚謬班抽舉按文義「復」下疑脫「以」字。存已不霑恩澤按「已」當是「亡」之訛。

sourceRange.text: 其間或不泯舊基，弗虧先構者，蓋處之以道，遠權之所致也。category:魏書

localRange.text: 其間或不泯舊基，[9]弗虧先構者，蓋處之以道，遠權之所致也。校勘記魏書卷八十三下諸本目錄此卷注「闕」字，卷末有宋人校語〈殿本入考證〉云：「魏收書外戚傳亡，史臣論全用隋書外戚傳〈卷七九〉。按此卷亦以北史卷八０外戚傳補。其于勁傳採北史卷三一于栗磾附于勁傳，李延寔傳採卷一００自序。諸傳均有溢出語，當是以高氏小史等他書附益之。自栗磾至勁〈至〉三開國公按此數語魏書本在卷三一于栗磾附于忠傳後，北史卷二三于栗磾傳移在于勁傳中，則在後的于忠所歷官爵，不當計算在內，所舉贈公、領軍、尚書令、開國公便都少了一人，實誤。此傳以北史補，不記卷三一已有此語，以致複出。參卷三一校記[九]。高平郡都將按郡無都將，「郡」當是「鎮」之訛。熙平初諸本及北史卷八０胡國珍傳「熙平」作「延和」，通志卷一六五胡國珍傳作「熙平中」。按事見卷九肅宗紀熙平元年八月乙巳，延和乃拓跋燾年號，遠在其前。今據通志改作「熙平」。事在元年，「初」字不誤。又追京兆郡君為秦太上君按「追」下當脫「贈」或「尊」「崇」字。持節就安定監護喪事按胡國珍死和葬都在洛陽，何故「就安定監護喪事」？下文云：「迎太上君神柩還第」，疑「安定」下脫「公第」二字。真長子寧諸本「真」字連上段「諡曰孝」，「長子寧」提行。成為胡僧洗諡「孝真」，「寧」是僧洗的長子。按真乃國珍兄，見上文，寧乃僧洗兄。北史原文本不提行，後人寫刻魏書則凡附見諸子孫無不提行，這裏由於誤讀，提行亦謬，致以兄為子，今改正。襲父爵清泉縣侯按卷五三李沖傳，沖封「清淵縣侯」。「清淵」為漢以來舊縣，卷一０六上地形志上，屬司州陽平郡。此傳以北史補，避唐諱改「泉」。其間或不泯舊基諸本「泯」上有「斃」字。此傳本出北史，北史傳論又本隋書卷七九外戚傳論，今檢隋書、北史都作「今或不隕舊基」，這裏「今或」作「其間」，「隕」作「泯」，均兩通，「斃」字則涉上「其斃亦速」而衍，今刪。

sourceRange.text: 」還，兼散騎常侍，加中軍大將軍。後罷議事省，詔右僕射高隆之及諸朝士與業興等在尚書省議定五禮。興和初，又為甲子元曆，時見施用。復預議麟趾新制。武定元年，除國子祭酒，仍侍讀。三年，出除太原太守。齊獻武王每出征討，時有顧訪，五年，齊文襄王引為中外府諮議參軍。後坐事禁止。業興乃造九宮行棊曆，以五百為章，四千四十為部，九百八十七為斗分，還以己未為元，始終相維，不復移轉，與今曆法術不同。至於氣序交分，景度盈縮，不異也。七年，死於禁所，年六十六。

sourceRange.text: 其他諸傳，凡北史儒林傳所有諸人都比北史詳備。其中徐遵明傳，北史多出勒索學生事，李業興傳多出語音不正和與孫騰、邢子才對答語，當是北史據其他材料增入，非魏書原文所有。傳序也像是北史傳序敍魏事一段所本。據上述情況，除常、刁、盧三傳及史論外，似皆魏書原文。宋人於目錄注「不全」，於校語只說刁、盧二傳「非魏收書」，史臣論「出北史」，則也認為序和其他諸傳是魏書原文。且據校語，當時比對高氏小史，只說三傳此有彼無，沒有說其他諸傳以小史補。小史久亡，清人又何從知之？但也有可疑之處：一，若說此卷只是殘缺不全，除三傳外均魏書原文，何以所缺前後錯出，恰好是北史儒林傳所無之傳？高氏小史節錄魏書，何以小史儒林傳所無的三傳也是北史儒林傳所無？二，李同軌，魏書已附李順傳，儒林傳目應無其名，何以校語說「史目錄有之」？或此所謂「史目錄」乃指宗諫史目等見卷八六孝感傳按語，則後人據目補傳，何以不據本書目錄而據他書？後人既已從李順傳中析出同軌傳入儒林，何以不刪李順傳中所有？這些疑問頗難解釋。|author=魏收|section=列傳儒林第七十二|times=北齊|previous=列傳外戚第七十一下|next=列傳文苑第七十三|type=|from=|notes=梁越盧醜張偉梁祚平恒陳奇常爽劉獻之張吾貴劉蘭孫惠蔚徐遵明董徵刁沖盧景裕李同軌李業興

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷八十四諸本目錄此卷注「不全」，卷末有宋人校語云：「高氏小史儒林傳無刁沖、盧景裕、李同軌三人，史目錄皆有之。此卷刁沖、盧景裕傳全錄北史，非魏收書，史臣論亦出北史，北史全用隋書傳論。殿本以校語入考證，開頭一句又改成「魏收書儒林傳亡，用高氏小史補之」。按此卷常爽、刁沖、盧景裕、李同軌四傳，北史卷八一儒林傳所無。常爽，北史卷四二有專傳，刁沖附卷二六刁雍傳，盧景裕附卷三０盧同傳，李同軌附卷三三李義深傳。今檢此卷常爽傳也全同北史，宋人漏舉。李同軌則魏書本已附卷三六李順傳，與此卷同軌傳幾乎全同，一人二傳，實為重出〈北史同軌傳較簡〉。其他諸傳，凡北史儒林傳所有諸人都比北史詳備。其中徐遵明傳，北史多出勒索學生事，李業興傳多出語音不正和與孫騰、邢子才對答語，當是北史據其他材料增入，非魏書原文所有。傳序也像是北史傳序敍魏事一段所本。據上述情況，除常、刁、盧三傳及史論外，似皆魏書原文。宋人於目錄注「不全」，於校語只說刁、盧二傳「非魏收書」，史臣論「出北史」，則也認為序和其他諸傳是魏書原文。且據校語，當時比對高氏小史，只說三傳此有彼無，沒有說其他諸傳以小史補。小史久亡，清人又何從知之？但也有可疑之處：一，若說此卷只是殘缺不全，除三傳外均魏書原文，何以所缺前後錯出，恰好是北史儒林傳所無之傳？高氏小史節錄魏書，何以小史儒林傳所無的三傳也是北史儒林傳所無？二，李同軌，魏書已附李順傳，儒林傳目應無其名，何以校語說「史目錄有之」？或此所謂「史目錄」乃指宗諫史目等〈見卷八六孝感傳按語〉，則後人據目補傳，何以不據本書目錄而據他書？後人既已從李順傳中析出同軌傳入儒林，何以不刪李順傳中所有？這些疑問頗難解釋。河間邢祐諸本「祐」作「祜」，北史卷八一平恒傳作「祐」。按邢祐附本書卷六五、北史卷四三邢巒傳，都作「祐」。「祜」字訛，今據改。下同。燕東部侯釐通鑑卷九八〈三一０四頁〉見燕「中部俟釐慕輿句」。晉書卷一一０慕容儁載記無文，通鑑當據十六國春秋或范享燕書。按突厥官有「俟利發」，契丹有「夷離堇」，並即此「俟釐」，這裏「侯」字當是「俟」的形訛。見臯魚之歎方歸而養親諸本「臯」作「旱」。北史卷八一劉獻之傳南本、殿本「旱」作「臯」。按臯魚事見韓詩外傳卷九，云「於是門人辭歸而養親者十有三人」，與此傳語合。「旱」字訛，今據改。贈大將軍北史卷八一孫惠蔚傳無「大將軍」三字。按大將軍甚重，以崔亮、崔光之顯貴，死後追贈亦只車騎、驃騎大將軍，孫惠蔚軍號為平東將軍，豈能驟贈此官。疑是衍文，或「大」乃「本」之訛。刺史河東裴植並徵沖為功曹諸本和北史卷二六刁雍附刁沖傳「植」作「桓」。張森楷云：「『桓』當作『植』，植傳〈附卷七一裴叔業傳〉除瀛州刺史，即此時事。按前劉蘭傳亦見瀛州刺史裴植。刁沖稱勃海饒安人。卷一０六上地形志上滄州條和浮陽郡饒安條，熙平二年〈五一七〉分置滄州前，饒安屬瀛州浮陽郡，其稱「勃海」，乃因漢晉舊屬。裴植為瀛州刺史在熙平前，饒安是瀛州縣，刁沖是本州人，故得為功曹。張說是，今改正。國子博士高涼及范陽盧道侃張森楷云：「『涼』當作『諒』。據高佑傳〈卷五七〉，佑孫諒為國子博士，在孝文、宣武間，與刁沖同時，當即其人。初元顥入洛諸本無「初」字，北史卷三０盧同附盧景裕傳有。元顥事在前，前文敍事已至東魏末高澄當國時，李慈銘、張森楷均謂有誤。李且謂「除國子博士前已載之，何必複出，北史於『元顥』上加一『初』字亦非。按這是追敍以前官位升退，刁沖「未曾有得失之色」，本非記歷官。此傳本出北史，乃是脫「初」字，遂似敍事顛倒，今據補。成戊子曆按卷一０七律曆志載崔光表云：「總合九家，共成一曆，元起壬子，律始黃鍾。業興初造之曆起於戊子，為戊子曆，至是「總合九家」則起於壬子，為壬子曆。卷八二常景傳亦稱「先是參議正光壬子曆」可證。這裏「戊子」乃「壬子」之訛。與兼散騎常侍李諧諸本脫「散」字，今據北史卷八一李業興傳補。久矣夫予之不託於音也諸本此句作「久矣，不託音」。冊府卷六五八〈七八七七頁〉如上摘句。按語出禮記檀弓下，諸本有脫文，今據補。

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷八十五諸本目錄此卷注「闕」，卷末脫宋人校語。殿本考證云：「魏收書闕，後人所補。按卷中只封肅傳稍詳於北史本傳〈附卷二四封懿傳〉，乃採之他書，他傳皆同北史，偶有溢出語，當是採他書增入。考本書卷四七盧玄傳附見盧光宗，云：「子觀、觀弟仲宣，事在文苑傳。卷四五裴駿附裴宣傳云：「子敬宣、莊伯並在文苑傳。今此卷無盧仲宣、裴莊伯，當是後人據目補傳，仲宣、莊伯並附其兄，非正傳，故目錄不載，以致失補。靈均逐楚著嘉禍之章按「嘉禍」未見所出，楚辭九章橘頌：「后皇嘉樹，橘徠服兮。疑「嘉禍」乃「嘉橘」之訛。中山王將之部諸本無「王」字，旁注「闕」。通志卷一七六裴敬憲傳作「王」，冊府卷八三九〈九九六０頁〉此句作「中山鎮部」。按卷一九南安王楨附中山王熙傳云：「始熙之鎮鄴也，知友才學之士略裴敬憲等咸餞於河梁，賦詩告別。「中山」下脫「王」字無疑，今據補。冊府「鎮」字，當亦有因，疑此句本作「中山王鎮鄴，將之部」。冊府所據本「鄴」訛「部」，和下「將之部」重出不辭，遂刪三字。永興三年按永興乃拓跋嗣年號〈四０九－四一三〉，遠在其前，元脩雖於太昌元年〈五三二〉十二月改永興，即在此月改永熙，並無三年。北史卷三八裴駿附敬憲傳同作「永興」，而下文其弟莊伯傳，稱「永安三年，贈通直散騎侍郎」。兄弟當是同年追贈，這裏「永興」乃「永安」之訛。南討絳蜀陳雙熾通志卷一七六裴伯茂傳「南」作「及」。按絳在洛陽西北，不得云「南討」，疑作「及」是。還為朝請通志卷一七六溫子昇傳「朝請」上有「奉」字。疑當有此字，但也可能是簡稱，今不補。於是還省諸本及北史卷八三「省」作「員」，通志卷一七六作「省」。按上云：「被徵赴省」，故下云「還省」，「還員」不可通，今據改。文襄館客元僅曰諸人當賀按何事當賀，敍述不明，疑「文襄」下有脫文。又「元僅」當作「元瑾」。瑾謀殺高澄，事見本書卷一二孝靜紀末、卷一四華山王鷙附子大器傳，北史卷六齊文襄紀，北齊書卷四七宋遊道傳，都作「瑾」。

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷八十六諸本目錄注「闕」。卷末有宋人校語〈殿本入考證〉云：「魏收書孝感傳亡，惟張昇事出宗諫史目，與北史小異，高氏小史不載昇事迹。案小史孝感、節義、良吏、列女、閹官五傳敍目並傳，與正史及諸書目次序前後不同，惟楊九齡經史目錄與小史同。九齡撰錄皆在殷仲藏、宗諫等後，是時正史已不完，往往取小史為據，故同之。按此傳序與北史卷八四孝行傳序不同，諸傳只張昇傳出宗諫史目，見上宋人校語，他傳全同北史，論也出北史，而稍有刪節。北史序中記魏書此卷傳目，全同今本，只張昇、倉跋先後互易。從者於路偶得一羊諸本及北史卷二四趙逸附趙琰傳「偶」都作「遇」，冊府卷七九三〈九四一二頁〉作「偶」。按文義作「偶」是，今據改。出為鄯善鎮將諸本及北史卷八四乞伏保傳「鄯善」作「無善」，通志卷一六七乞伏保傳倒作「善無」。按墓誌集釋有乞伏寶墓誌〈圖版二八四〉，即此乞伏保，誌稱「遷鄯善鎮將，以母憂解任」。鄯善鎮屢見本書。元和郡縣志卷三九鄯州條云：「後魏以西平郡為鄯善鎮，孝昌二年，改鎮立鄯州。這裏「鄯」字訛「無」，而恒州的善無郡〈見卷一０六上地形志上〉人所習知，通志遂以為倒文，意為改乙，其實善無並未立鎮。今據墓誌改。又墓誌記歷官較詳，保死在襄州刺史任上，非南中郎將。

九齡撰錄皆在殷仲藏、宗諫等後，是時正史已不完，往往取小史為據，故同之。」

〈圖版二八四〉，

鄯善鎮屢見本書。
元和郡縣志卷三九鄯州條云：「後魏以西平郡為鄯善鎮，孝昌二年，改鎮立鄯州。」
這裏「鄯」字訛「無」，而恒州的善無郡

人所習知，通志遂以為倒文，意為改乙，其實善無並未立鎮。

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷八十七諸本目錄此卷注「闕」，卷末附宋人校語〈殿本入考證〉云：「魏收書節義傳亡。按傳序與北史卷八五節義傳序不同，當自原序刪節。諸傳中只于什門傳稍詳於北史，王玄威傳所載詔書有溢出北史所載的文句，其他諸傳偶有一二字溢出，大抵全同北史。諸人事迹本無可述，原文也必甚簡略。此卷多數傳文全同北史，或由於所據的史鈔和北史都是直錄魏書，非必以北史補。大義重於至聞自日人殿本考證云：「首九字訛舛，不可推尋。歷二十四年通鑑卷一二二〈三八五三頁〉記于什門還魏於元嘉十一年〈魏延和三年(四三四)〉，「二十四」作「二十一」。考異云：「後魏本紀〈卷三〉神瑞元年〈四一四〉八月遣于什門招諭馮跋，至此年二十一年矣。若二十四年，乃在太延三年，而太延二年馮氏亡矣。按傳稱「馮文通上表稱臣，乃送什門歸」，卷四上世祖紀上延和三年三月記「文通遣尚書高顒上表稱藩」，故通鑑置於是年。疑「二十四」當作「二十一」。河中蒲坂人也北史卷八五石文德傳「河中蒲坂」作「中山蒲陰」。按蒲坂自來屬河東郡，魏也無「河中」郡名。卷一０六上地形志上定州北平郡有蒲陰縣，北平郡乃孝昌二年分中山置。若非「中」為「東」字之訛，則「河中蒲坂」為「中山蒲陰」之訛。縣令范道榮先自朐城歸款以除縣令諸本「朐」作「眴」，北史卷八五邵洪哲傳作「眗」。冊府卷一三八〈一六六六頁〉、卷八０三〈九五四八頁〉並作「朐」。按「朐城歸款」事見卷八世宗紀永平四年四月、卷四七盧淵附盧昶傳、卷九八蕭衍傳，「朐城」亦作「朐山」。「眴」「眗」都是「朐」之訛，今據改。

localRange.text: 〈闕〉校勘記張應北史卷八六循吏傳目和傳文都作「張膺」。閻慶胤不知何許人張森楷云：「按慶胤天水人，見裴叔業傳〈卷七一〉附載中。此既重出，又云『不知何許人』，何其善忘！平原人北史卷八六明亮傳「平原」下有「高昌」二字，冊府卷四三九〈五二０八頁〉有「亳」字。按諸傳除不知何地人外，一般皆兼舉郡縣，冊府此條出本書而下有「亳」字，知傳本脫去。然平原無「亳縣」或「高昌縣」。據南齊書卷五四明僧紹傳、梁書卷二七明山賓傳並云「平原鬲人」。卷一０六上地形志上冀州安德郡、齊州東平原郡並有鬲縣。漢晉之鬲本屬冀州平原，劉宋於青州僑置冀州，亦有平原郡鬲縣〈宋書卷三六州郡志〉。魏取青州，分置齊州，以冀州自有平原〈即地形志中之濟州平原郡〉，故加「東」字。卷八九高遵傳稱其妻明氏家在齊州，則明氏實居於齊州東平原之鬲縣。「亳」「高昌」皆「鬲」之訛，此傳脫「鬲」字。由是徽音獲免按「音」字不可通，當是「竟」之訛。從征新野除騎都尉又從駕壽春敕纂緣淮慰勞豫州刺史田益宗率戶歸國按益宗歸魏事在太和十七年四月，上文元宏攻新野，在二十一年，所云「從駕壽春」，又在十九年二月。均見卷七下高祖紀下。此傳敍次先後顛倒，下文又重出「從征新野」。疑有錯簡及衍脫。又詣赭陽武陰二郡錢氏考異卷二八云：「武陰疑是舞陰之訛，地形志無此二郡，蓋後來省併。洪頤煊諸史考異卷一０云：「漢書地理志南陽郡有堵陽、舞陰二縣。堵陽，水經淯水注〈卷三一〉引作『赭陽』〈按戴校仍改作「堵陽」〉。『武陰』即『舞陰』，古字通用。地形志無此二郡名。高祖紀〈卷七下〉太和二十二年見赭陽戍主成公期、舞陰戍主黃瑤起。當是暫置為郡，故不言。遼西遼陽人殿本考證云：「『遼陽』北史〈卷八六〉作『陽洛』。本書地形志〈卷一０六上〉遼西郡領縣三，有『陽樂』，無『遼陽』。今以下文『以軍功賜爵陽洛男』證之，應從北史，但『陽樂』、『陽洛』不知孰是。按陽樂，漢書地理志屬遼東，續漢書郡國志屬玄菟。當時地名常用同音字，本字自當作「陽樂」。其子棄疾為王御士而上告焉按事見左傳襄二十二年，這裏不是引原文，但「上告」無義，疑「上」乃「王」之訛，指楚康王以欲殺子南告棄疾。其罪不為與殺明矣按竇瑗認為服虔注「隱痛深諱」，乃是諱母出，「非為諱母與殺也」。若作「其罪不為與殺」，則是說文姜本無參與殺桓公之罪，和他辯論的本題不合，且與下文引服注「夫人有與殺桓之罪」語相背。這裏「罪」當是「諱」字之訛，言「其諱不為與殺」，和上下文相貫。

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷八十九諸本目錄注「闕」，但卷後無宋人校語。殿本考證云「魏收書亡，後人所補」，乃據目錄而言。今按傳序與北史卷八七酷吏傳序不同，諸傳也多出入。北史高遵傳〈附卷三一高允傳〉、酈道元傳〈附卷二七酈範傳〉均詳於此傳，谷楷傳則北史略去殺變亂人眾事。此卷非以北史補甚明。但序甚簡短，高、酈二傳敍事較北史簡略。傳論全同北史，而北史實本隋書卷七四酷吏傳論，不過稍加改易而已，魏收豈能用隋書語，知是此傳襲取北史。則此卷必非魏書原文，當是以高氏小史等書補，傳末校語偶脫。遂領逃連及諸畜牧者張森楷云：「『逃連』字不可解，疑有誤。今臺使心協前事北史卷八七張赦提傳「心協」作「止挾」。按「協」謂威脅，與文義不叶，疑作「挾」是。為司空令輔國長史按司空屬官無令。「令」字疑衍，意謂以輔國將軍為司空長史。但亦晦澀，或有訛脫。或憂恚顛隕諸本「顛」作「值」，北史卷八七作「俱」，隋書卷七四酷吏傳論作「顛」。按「值」字顯訛，「俱」字雖可通，然「顛隕」與上句「罪戮」對文，今據隋書改。

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷九十諸本卷末〈殿本入考證〉有宋人校語云：「魏收書逸士傳亡，史臣論全用隋書隱逸傳〈卷七七〉論。按傳序刪節北史卷八八隱逸傳序，論也全同北史，唯刪去後數語。宋人認為論全用隋書，其實北史傳論刪節隋書，此傳又襲北史。諸傳皆同北史隱逸傳相同諸人，李謐則北史附卷三二李孝伯傳，除傳首數語外也無不同。此卷應是以北史補。唯眭夸傳有溢出語，或採之他書。世宗給其工力諸本「世宗」作「世祖」，北史卷八八作「宣武」。按上已見「世宗」，「祖」是「宗」之訛，今據改。趙郡人諸本「趙」作「涿」。洪頤煊諸史考異卷一０據李孝伯、李安世傳〈卷五三〉和下文兩言趙郡李謐，以為「涿」字訛。按李安世一族出於趙郡，歷見紀載，洪說是，今改正。其室居中者謂之太室諸本「室」作「廟」，北史卷三二李孝伯附李謐傳百衲本此字缺，他本及冊府卷五七二〈六八七五頁〉作「室」。按下文也都作「太室」。此傳以北史補，當是舊本缺此字，補此傳者妄補「廟」字，今據冊府改。可謂施政及祀諸本「謂」訛「請」，不可通，今據北史卷三０、冊府卷五七二〈六八七六頁〉、通志卷一七八李謐傳改。又「祀」字，諸本作「記」，北史作「俱」，通志作「祀」。按上文云：「夫明堂者蓋所以告月朔、布時令、宗文王、祀五帝者也。又云：「且四時之祀，各據其方之正。「俱」字無義，「記」字也牽強，今據通志改。既依五行當從其方用事之交諸本及北史卷三０無「方」字，通志卷一七八有。按無「方」字語不可解，今據補。帶麻於房中則西房諸本及北史卷三０「房」作「南」，冊府卷五七二〈六八七六頁〉作「房」。按禮記玉藻鄭注本文是「西房」，李謐引鄭注在於指出鄭說路寢有左右房。「南」字訛，今據本文及冊府改。天子諸侯左右房見於注者也李慈銘云：「按鄭注云『天子、諸侯有左右房』，此處當重一句云：『此則天子諸侯有左右房見於注者也』。按文義當是上脫「天子諸侯有左右房〈鄭注引至此〉，此則」十字。李說重一句也不可通。論路寢則明其左右房諸本及北史卷三０無「房」字，冊府卷五七二〈六八七六頁〉有。按上文一再引鄭注都用來證明鄭說路寢有左右房，此句「左右房」和下「左右个」為對文，傳本脫「房」字，今據補。記云四旁兩夾窗諸本「旁」作「房」，北史卷三０作「旁」。按周禮考工記原文作「旁」。「房」字訛，今據改。盛德篇云按下引文今大戴禮傳本實在明堂篇〈第六十七〉，盛德篇在第六十六，或李謐所見本分合與今傳本有異。

localRange.text: 校勘記蔣少游按卷七下高祖紀太和十五年十一月乙亥條、卷五九劉昶傳、卷六八高聰傳「游」並作「遊」。北史此二傳「遊」「游」雜出。南齊書卷五七魏虜傳作「游」。當時名字本通用同音字。此傳出於北史，北史卷九０下作「游」，今皆仍之。魏書卷九十一諸本目錄注「不全」，卷末有宋人校語〈殿本入考證〉云：「此卷王顯以前魏收舊書，崔彧、蔣少游傳全出北史及小史，史臣論亦全出北史藝術傳論，而北史全用周、隋書藝術傳論云。黃帝靈威仰位東方按東方青帝靈威仰，見周禮天官太宰祀五帝條疏。且下文又見「黃帝含樞紐在中央」，這裏「黃帝」當是「青帝」之訛。案天占以言災異北史卷八九張淵附孫僧化傳「天」作「文」。疑當作「天文占」。隋書卷三四經籍志子部天文類著錄天文集占、天文占、天文橫占、天文外官占等書可證，此傳及北史各脫一字。字王琳北史卷八九信都芳傳「王」作「玉」，疑是。又史遷郝振中古大儒諸本「古」訛「吉」，今據冊府卷八六九〈一０三一０頁〉改。明陰陽九宮及兵法諸本「宮」作「官」，北史卷八九作「宮」。按後漢書卷五九張衡傳，衡上疏有云「重之以卜筮，雜之以九宮」。九宮是一種占卜術，隋書卷三四經籍志子部五行類著錄以「九宮」為名的黃帝九宮經等書多種。「官」字訛，今據改。而齊獻武王以明年閏二月破四胡於韓陵山諸本「四」作「西」。按四胡屢見紀傳，指尒朱兆、天光、度律、仲遠四人，卷一一後廢帝紀中興二年閏三月壬戌稱「齊獻武王大破尒朱天光等四胡於韓陵」。今據改。又「閏二月」亦是「閏三月」之訛。古今字詁三朝本、南本、汲本、局本「詁」作「訓」，北本、殿本及北史卷三四江式傳作「詁」。按下文兩稱「古今字詁」，隋書卷三二經籍志經部小學類同。今從北、殿本。博古開藝北史卷三四江式傳此句「古開」互倒，冊府卷六０八〈七二九四頁〉作「博聞古藝」，疑是。小兔為䨲諸本「兔」作「兒」，北史卷三四、冊府〈同上卷頁〉作「兔」。按廣韵十九侯，「䨲，兔子」，故俗寫作「小兔」，「兒」字訛，今據改。祖文宗按此書不見前文，也不見隋書經籍志。昔晉武暴疾程和應增封辛疚數朝錢爵大墜按語不可解，程和事也不見晉書。冊府卷八五九〈一０二０一頁〉作「昔晉武暴疾，程和進藥，增封賜錢，恩奬屢至」，疑是以意改。少與李亮同師諸本「李」作「季」，北史卷九０王顯傳作「李」。按李亮見前李脩傳。「季」字訛，今改正。封衞南伯北史卷九０「衞南」作「衞國縣」。按卷一０六上地形志上司州頓丘郡有衞國縣，「衞南」不見地形志，疑北史是。賾令江南上品王抗與寧兒張森楷云：「『兒』下當有脫文。

localRange.text: 〈闕〉校勘記涇州貞女兕先氏北史卷九一傳目及傳「兕先」作「兒」。張洪初妻劉氏北史卷九一傳目及傳「初」作「祁」。魏書卷九十二諸本目錄此卷注「不全」，卷末有宋人校語云：「此傳雖差多於北史、小史，然亦不完。殿本考證云：「魏收書不全。所以抱怨於黃墟耳北史卷九一魏溥妻房氏傳「墟」作「壚」。按「黃壚」見淮南子兵略篇，即黃泉。「黃墟」不知所出，疑「墟」字訛。顧當以身少相感長往之恨北史卷九一「長往」上有「永深」二字，疑此脫，但「相感」屬下讀亦可通，今不補。新婦少年不幸北史卷九一「不幸」下有「早寡」二字，疑此脫，但無亦通，今不補。子景伯景先崔氏親授經義諸本及北史卷九一房愛親妻崔氏傳「景先」作「景光」。按卷四三房法壽傳附景伯景先傳，景先傳云：「其母自授毛詩、曲禮。與此傳合。「光」乃「先」之訛，今改正。屬世宗崩諸本「宗」作「祖」。按卷八世宗紀事在正始元年二月，「祖」字訛，今改正。金龍為梓潼太守郡帶關城戍主張森楷云：「『郡』字衍。按北史卷九一此傳首稱「梓潼太守苟金龍妻劉氏」，下云「金龍為郡，帶關城戍主」。「為郡」即「為太守」。本書諸傳凡其夫有官者，大都首標官位，如「中書侍郎清河崔覽妻」，「樂部郎胡長命妻」等。這裏恐本同北史，首稱「梓潼太守苟金龍妻」，「梓潼太守」四字錯簡在此，或後人移易，忘刪「郡」字。

sourceRange.text: 高祖於馬圈，自不豫、大漸迄於崩，仲興頗預侍護。達魯陽，世宗即位，轉左中郎將，仍齋帥。及帝親政，與趙脩並見寵任，遷光祿大夫，領武衞將軍。仲興雖與脩並，而畏慎自退，不若脩之倨傲無禮。咸陽王禧之出奔也，當時上下微為駭震。世宗於乾脯山追仲興馳入金墉城安慰。後與領軍于勁共參機要，因自理馬圈侍疾及入金墉之功，乞同元賞，遂封上黨郡開國公，食邑二千戶。自拜武衞及受封之日，車駕每臨饗其宅。世宗游幸，仲興常侍從，不離左右，外事得徑以聞，百僚亦聳體而承望焉。兄可久，以仲興故自散爵為徐州征虜府長史，帶彭城太守。仲興世居趙郡，自以寒微，云舊出京兆霸城，故為雍州大中正。

manualTranslations.zh: 達魯陽，世宗即位，轉左中郎將，仍齋帥。
manualTranslations.literal: When they reached Luyang and Emperor Shizong took the throne, Zhongxing was transferred to Left Middle Guard General and still served as hall chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When they reached Luyang and Emperor Shizong took the throne, Zhongxing was transferred to Left Middle Guard General and still served as hall chief.

manualTranslations.zh: 及帝親政，與趙脩並見寵任，遷光祿大夫，領武衞將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor personally assumed government, he and Zhao Xiu were both favored and entrusted; Zhongxing was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and made General of the Guard.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor personally assumed government, he and Zhao Xiu were both favored and entrusted; Zhongxing was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and made General of the Guard.

manualTranslations.zh: 仲興雖與脩並，而畏慎自退，不若脩之倨傲無禮。
manualTranslations.literal: Although Zhongxing shared favor with Xiu, he was cautious and held himself back, unlike Xiu's arrogance and lack of decorum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Although Zhongxing shared favor with Xiu, he was cautious and held himself back, unlike Xiu's arrogance and lack of decorum.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸陽王禧之出奔也，當時上下微為駭震。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Prince of Xianyang, Xi, fled, those above and below at the time were somewhat shaken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Xianyang, Xi, fled, those above and below at the time were somewhat shaken.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗於乾脯山追仲興馳入金墉城安慰。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Shizong, at Mount Ganpu, sent after Zhongxing and had him rush into Jinyong City to offer consolation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong, at Mount Ganpu, sent after Zhongxing and had him rush into Jinyong City to offer consolation.

manualTranslations.zh: 後與領軍于勁共參機要，因自理馬圈侍疾及入金墉之功，乞同元賞，遂封上黨郡開國公，食邑二千戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he joined Commander Yu Jin in deliberating on crucial affairs; citing on his own behalf his service in attending the illness at the horse enclosure and his entry into Jinyong, he asked for the same reward as others, and was accordingly enfeoffed as founding duke of Shangdang Commandery, with a fief of two thousand households.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he joined Commander Yu Jin in deliberating on crucial affairs; citing on his own behalf his service in attending the illness at the horse enclosure and his entry into Jinyong, he asked for the same reward as others, and was accordingly enfeoffed as founding duke of Shangdang Commandery, with a fief of two thousand households.

manualTranslations.zh: 自拜武衞及受封之日，車駕每臨饗其宅。
manualTranslations.literal: From the day of his appointment as General of the Guard and his enfeoffment, the imperial carriage visited his residence to feast there each time.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the day of his appointment as General of the Guard and his enfeoffment, the imperial carriage visited his residence to feast there each time.

manualTranslations.zh: 世宗游幸，仲興常侍從，不離左右，外事得徑以聞，百僚亦聳體而承望焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever Emperor Shizong went on excursions, Zhongxing constantly attended and followed, never leaving his side; outside affairs could reach the emperor directly through him, and the hundred officials also straightened themselves in anticipation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever Emperor Shizong went on excursions, Zhongxing constantly attended and followed, never leaving his side; outside affairs could reach the emperor directly through him, and the hundred officials also straightened themselves in anticipation.

manualTranslations.zh: 兄可久，以仲興故自散爵為徐州征虜府長史，帶彭城太守。
manualTranslations.literal: His elder brother Kejiu, on Zhongxing's account, voluntarily gave up his title and became Chief Clerk of the Pacifying-Barbarians Headquarters in Xuzhou, acting as Prefect of Pengcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His elder brother Kejiu, on Zhongxing's account, voluntarily gave up his title and became Chief Clerk of the Pacifying-Barbarians Headquarters in Xuzhou, acting as Prefect of Pengcheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 仲興世居趙郡，自以寒微，云舊出京兆霸城，故為雍州大中正。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhongxing had long resided in Zhao Commandery; considering himself of humble origin, he said his family formerly came from Bacheng in Jingzhao, and therefore became Grand Arbiter of Yongzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhongxing had long resided in Zhao Commandery; considering himself of humble origin, he said his family formerly came from Bacheng in Jingzhao, and therefore became Grand Arbiter of Yongzhou.

sourceRange.text: 初叡女妻李沖兄子延賓，次女又適趙國李恢子華。女之將行也，先入宮中，其禮略如公主、王女之儀。太后親御太華殿，寢其女於別帳，叡與張祐侍坐，叡所親及兩李家丈夫婦人列於東西廊下。及車引，太后送過中路。時人竊謂天子、太后嫁女。叡之葬也，假親姻義舊，衰絰縞冠送喪者千餘人，皆舉聲慟泣以要榮利，時謂之義孝。叡既貴，乃言家本太原晉陽，遂移屬焉，故其兄弟封爵移以并州郡縣。薨後，重贈叡父橋侍中、征西將軍、左光祿大夫、儀同三司、武威王，諡曰定，追策叡母賈氏為妃，立碑於墓左。父子並葬城東，相去里餘，遷洛後，更徙葬太原晉陽。

manualTranslations.zh: 初叡女妻李沖兄子延賓，次女又適趙國李恢子華。
manualTranslations.literal: At first Rui's daughter married Yanbin, son of Li Chong's elder brother; his second daughter also married Hua, son of Li Hui of Zhao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first Rui's daughter married Yanbin, son of Li Chong's elder brother; his second daughter also married Hua, son of Li Hui of Zhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 女之將行也，先入宮中，其禮略如公主、王女之儀。
manualTranslations.literal: When his daughters were about to be married off, they first entered the palace; the ceremony was much like that for princesses and royal daughters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When his daughters were about to be married off, they first entered the palace; the ceremony was much like that for princesses and royal daughters.

manualTranslations.zh: 太后親御太華殿，寢其女於別帳，叡與張祐侍坐，叡所親及兩李家丈夫婦人列於東西廊下。
manualTranslations.literal: The empress dowager personally presided in Taihua Hall, lodging her daughters in separate tents; Rui and Zhang You sat in attendance, while Rui's intimates and the husbands and wives of the two Li families lined up along the eastern and western corridors.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress dowager personally presided in Taihua Hall, lodging her daughters in separate tents; Rui and Zhang You sat in attendance, while Rui's intimates and the husbands and wives of the two Li families lined up along the eastern and western corridors.

manualTranslations.zh: 及車引，太后送過中路。
manualTranslations.literal: When the carriages were led out, the empress dowager escorted them halfway.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the carriages were led out, the empress dowager escorted them halfway.

manualTranslations.zh: 時人竊謂天子、太后嫁女。
manualTranslations.literal: People at the time privately said the Son of Heaven and the empress dowager were marrying off daughters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: People at the time privately said the Son of Heaven and the empress dowager were marrying off daughters.

manualTranslations.zh: 叡之葬也，假親姻義舊，衰絰縞冠送喪者千餘人，皆舉聲慟泣以要榮利，時謂之義孝。
manualTranslations.literal: At Rui's funeral, more than a thousand people pretending ties of kinship and old friendship came in mourning garb and white caps to escort the bier; all lifted their voices in wailing lament to seek honor and profit, and the age called this "righteous filiality."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Rui's funeral, more than a thousand people pretending ties of kinship and old friendship came in mourning garb and white caps to escort the bier; all lifted their voices in wailing lament to seek honor and profit, and the age called this "righteous filiality."

manualTranslations.zh: 叡既貴，乃言家本太原晉陽，遂移屬焉，故其兄弟封爵移以并州郡縣。
manualTranslations.literal: Once Rui had risen to eminence, he said his family was originally from Jinyang in Taiyuan and shifted his affiliation there; therefore his brothers' enfeoffments were also transferred to commanderies and counties in Bingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once Rui had risen to eminence, he said his family was originally from Jinyang in Taiyuan and shifted his affiliation there; therefore his brothers' enfeoffments were also transferred to commanderies and counties in Bingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 薨後，重贈叡父橋侍中、征西將軍、左光祿大夫、儀同三司、武威王，諡曰定，追策叡母賈氏為妃，立碑於墓左。
manualTranslations.literal: After his death, Rui's father Qiao was posthumously granted the titles Palace Attendant, General Who Conquers the West, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Peer of Three Offices, and Prince of Wuwei, with the posthumous title Ding; Rui's mother, the Lady Jia, was posthumously ennobled as a consort, and a stele was erected to the left of the tomb.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After his death, Rui's father Qiao was posthumously granted the titles Palace Attendant, General Who Conquers the West, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Peer of Three Offices, and Prince of Wuwei, with the posthumous title Ding; Rui's mother, the Lady Jia, was posthumously ennobled as a consort, and a stele was erected to the left of the tomb.

manualTranslations.zh: 父子並葬城東，相去里餘，遷洛後，更徙葬太原晉陽。
manualTranslations.literal: Father and son were both buried east of the city, about a li apart; after the transfer to Luoyang, they were reburied at Jinyang in Taiyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Father and son were both buried east of the city, about a li apart; after the transfer to Luoyang, they were reburied at Jinyang in Taiyuan.

localRange.text: 〈闕〉校勘記都曹尚書曹百僚之首按上稱「領都曹，為尚書令」，下稱「都曹尚書令可權記」。這裏「尚書曹」疑當作尚書令。語在常景傳按今常景傳〈卷八二〉以北史補，不載其事。滋水沒川之彥冊府卷五三０〈六三三四頁〉「滋水沒川」作「丘樊林藪」。按「滋水沒川」未詳，或有訛字，冊府恐是以意改。趙郡南欒人也按卷一０六上地形志上，南欒屬南趙郡，「南」字不宜省。為齋帥諸本「齋」作「齊」。按下文作「齋」，「齋帥」屢見本書，又見隋書卷二七百官志中。「齊」字訛，今改正。始琛及李憑等曲事於脩諸本「憑」作「馮」。按卷六八甄琛傳、通鑑卷一四五〈四五三五頁〉作「憑」。「馮」即「憑」本字，今統一作「憑」。又有淫宴北史卷九二茹皓附義恭傳「又」作「叉」，這裏「又」當是「叉」之訛。其以剛為右衞大將軍墓誌集釋侯剛墓誌〈圖版二四九之二〉稱「延昌元年，進右衞將軍」。按此時左、右衞將軍不見加「大」之例，下文說「熙平中，除左衞將軍」，也不加「大」，這裏「大」字當衍。解嘗食典御諸本「嘗食」作「尚衣」，北史卷九二侯剛傳作「嘗食」。張森楷云：「按前文剛只為嘗食典御，未嘗為尚衣，疑『尚衣』訛。按侯剛本以善於烹調進用，下文說他「自太和進食，遂為典御，〈中略〉至此始解」。這裏作「尚衣」誤，今據北史改。乃引剛為侍中左衞將軍墓誌集釋〈圖版二四九之二〉稱「入居常伯，還領禁戎」，即指此次除授，集釋卷五以墓誌前文「延昌元年，進右衞將軍」當之，實誤，但引正光六年劉根造象，剛結銜作「右衞將軍」，證這裏「左衞」為「右衞」之訛，疑是。將軍儀同三司按「將軍」上無軍號。據上文稱「俄加車騎大將軍」，又云「尋加儀同」，疑本作「將軍、儀同如故」，後人改「如故」為「三司」。否則「將軍」上脫「車騎〈或驃騎〉大」三字。令數友執筆諸本及北史卷九二徐紇傳「友」作「吏」，獨百衲本作「友」。按作「吏」似是，但下舉黃門侍郎王遵業、王誦亦為紇秉筆，不得稱「吏」。今姑從百衲本。

sourceRange.text: 闕遂散。出為新興太守。肅宗崩，與尒朱榮等議立莊帝。莊帝即位，起拜平北將軍、肆州刺史。尋除撫軍將軍、中侍中。以參謀之勳，封元城縣開國侯，食邑七百戶。仍加金紫光祿大夫、幽州大中正，尋攝燕、安、平、營中正。前廢帝以為車騎將軍、右光祿大夫，中侍中如故。永熙中，加驃騎將軍。季遇疾，詔遣使存問。三年九月卒。天平初，贈使持節、都督幽燕安平四州諸軍事、儀同三司、幽州刺史，中侍中、將軍、侯如故。初季以兄叔良為。襲季爵。卒。

localRange.text: 〈闕〉遂散。

localRange.text: 〈闕〉校勘記趙黑北史卷九０目錄及傳文「黑」作「默」。孟鸞北史卷九０目錄及傳文「鸞」作「欒」。自後逃戶占為細繭羅縠者非一北史卷九０仇洛齊傳「細繭」作「紬綾」，冊府卷五０四〈六０五四頁〉、卷六六七〈七九八二頁〉，通鑑卷一二０〈三七九０頁〉「細」都作「紬」。按本書卷一一０食貨志也作「細繭」，冊府兩條即出本書此傳和食貨志，「細」却都作「紬」，與北史合。「細」當是「紬」之訛。「繭」「綾」音形皆殊，「綾」字當是北史所改。遂歷右將軍中常侍諸本並缺「歷右將軍中」五字，今據冊府卷六六五〈七九五九頁〉補。后之惑薩菩薩也南、北、殿、局四本及北史卷九０劇鵬傳、冊府卷六六六〈七九七二頁〉「薩」都作「薛」，百衲本、汲本作「薩」。按「薛」是「薩」的本字，「菩薩」之「薩」本也作「薛」，似作「薛」是。但卷一三幽后馮氏傳實作「高菩薩」，北史卷一三幽后傳同，則其人本姓高，「薩」「薛」都因涉下「菩薩」而訛。今姑從百衲本。是時有李豐之徒數人諸本「李」作「季」，冊府卷六六五〈七九六０頁〉作「李」。按卷五五劉芳傳見「中官李豐」，是馮太后時人，與此傳合。「季」乃「李」之訛，今據改。進爵隴東公諸本「隴」作「龍」。按「龍東」無此郡名，下文稱養子顯明「襲爵，降為隴東公」。即因祐由隴東公進封新平王，故降爵仍因舊封。卷一０六下地形志下隴東郡屬涇州。「龍」字訛，今改正。遷都曹加侍中祭酒尚書領中曹侍御按祭酒以上是新遷官，尚書領中曹、侍御是原官，上文已云「尚書領中曹如故」，這裏「侍御」下當脫「如故」二字。與雷党不蒙俱為羌中強族百衲本、汲本「党」作「光」，南、北、殿、局四本作「党」。按党是羌大姓，卷三太宗紀泰常四年六月見「羌酋党道子」。元和姓纂輯本卷七党氏條云「本出西羌」。「党」字形近訛「光」。今從南、北諸本。復奪爵北史卷九二王遇傳作「復舊爵」。較明白。這裏意謂復所奪之爵，但易誤解為又一次奪去爵位。世宗封其妻王氏為□□縣君百衲本闕字作相當於二字的墨釘，他本都作「雲陽」，冊府卷六六五〈七九六０頁〉「為縣君」連文不空。按北魏郡君、縣君是加於婦人的爵位，自有封邑，與夫之封邑無關。下文劉騰封長樂縣公，其妻封鉅鹿郡君，初不從夫長樂之封，卷八三下外戚傳下胡國珍封安定郡公，妻皇甫氏封京兆郡君，繼妻梁氏封趙平郡君，亦不從夫安定之封，可證。這裏白整封雲陽男，其妻未必也封雲陽。本闕縣名，冊府遂逕連上文。後人以為婦人必以夫之封邑為號，以意補缺，今從百衲本缺二字。騰使詣行所冊府卷六六五〈七九六一頁〉「行」下有「在」字。按此字似不宜省，然他處亦或作「行所」，非必脫文。轉長兼中常侍諸本「中常」下脫「侍」字。按「中常侍」不得省稱「中常」，亦非他官之訛，上劉騰傳稱「中常侍賈粲」可證，今補「侍」字。中官內侍貴者諸本脫「內」字，不可通，今據北史卷九０補。賜始平伯按下稱「孝昌二年，以勤舊封始平縣開國伯」，疑這裏「伯」當作「子」或「男」，否則下文「伯」當作「侯」，下王溫傳，先封欒城伯，「孝昌二年，封欒城縣開國侯」，事相類。黃絹十匹以供喪用諸本脫「絹」字，今據北史卷九０孟欒傳補。初季以兄叔良為襲季爵按原文當作「初季以兄叔子良為後，襲季爵」，脫「子」「後」二字，語不可解。但無可參證，今不補。又除南本外，他本皆「叔」字起提行。南本「兄」字下空五格，北、殿、局三本「兄」字下注「闕」。按弟名季，兄名叔，「叔」字本與上「兄」字相接，後人強為割裂，讀不可通，遂又於「兄」字下注「闕」字或空格，皆誤，今以「叔」字下六字逕接上文。娶党寶女北史卷九０封津傳「党」作「常」。按卷八三上常英等傳有云「伏、寶、泰等州刺史」，連上文似是常英官，伏、寶、泰皆州名。但魏無「伏」「寶」二州，「泰」見上文，是人名，則「伏」「寶」亦當是諸常之名，但外戚傳此傳脫訛，不知寶為常英何人。党寶未見紀載，疑北史作「常」是。參卷八三上校記[九]。兼中關右慰勞大傳諸本「大傳」作「太傅」，百衲本作「大傳」。按卷八九酈道元傳，道元為「關右大使」，「大使」屢見紀載，封津是宦官，故加「中」字。「使」字舊本訛「傳」，後人遂改為「太傅」。今姑從百衲本。

sourceRange.text: 晉光熙元年，淵進據河東，克平陽、蒲坂，遂都平陽。晉永嘉二年，淵稱帝，年號永鳳。後汾水中得玉璽，文曰「有新保之」，蓋王莽之璽也。得者因增「淵海光」三字而獻之，淵以為己瑞，號年為河瑞。以聰為大司馬、大單于、錄尚書事，置單于臺於平陽西。淵死，子和僭立。聰即和第四弟也，殺和而自立。

manualTranslations.zh: 晉光熙元年，淵進據河東，克平陽、蒲坂，遂都平陽。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Guangxi of Jin, Yuan advanced and seized Hedong, captured Pingyang and Puban, and then made Pingyang his capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangxi of Jin, Liu Yuan advanced into Hedong, took Pingyang and Puban, and made Pingyang his capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 晉永嘉二年，淵稱帝，年號永鳳。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Yongjia of Jin, Yuan declared himself emperor and took the era name Yongfeng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongjia of Jin, Yuan declared himself emperor and adopted the era name Yongfeng.

manualTranslations.zh: 後汾水中得玉璽，文曰「有新保之」，蓋王莽之璽也。
manualTranslations.literal: Later a jade seal was found in the Fen River; its inscription read "There is a new protector," and it was the seal of Wang Mang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later a jade seal was recovered from the Fen River inscribed "There is a new protector"—it was Wang Mang's seal.

manualTranslations.zh: 得者因增「淵海光」三字而獻之，淵以為己瑞，號年為河瑞。
manualTranslations.literal: The finder added the three characters "Yuan Haiguang" and presented it; Yuan took it as his own auspice and changed the era name to He Rui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The finder added the three characters "Yuan Haiguang" and presented it; Yuan took it as his own omen and changed the era name to He Rui.

manualTranslations.zh: 以聰為大司馬、大單于、錄尚書事，置單于臺於平陽西。
manualTranslations.literal: He appointed Cong Grand Marshal, Grand Chanyu, and Recorder of the Masters of Writing, and established the Chanyu Platform west of Pingyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He made Cong Grand Marshal, Grand Chanyu, and Recorder of the Masters of Writing, and set up the Chanyu Platform west of Pingyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 淵死，子和僭立。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yuan died, his son He presumptuously ascended.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yuan died, his son He usurped the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 聰即和第四弟也，殺和而自立。
manualTranslations.literal: Cong was He's fourth younger brother; he killed He and installed himself.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cong was He's fourth younger brother; he killed He and seized power for himself.

sourceRange.text: 遣其將寇鄜城，始平公隗歸討破之。

localRange.text: 遣其將寇鄜城，[11]始平公隗歸討破之。

sourceRange.text: 石虎伐曜，曜擊破之，遂攻石生於洛陽。曜不撫士眾，專與嬖臣飲博，左右或諫，曜怒斬之。石勒進據石門，曜甫知之，解金墉之圍，陳于洛西，將與勒戰。至西陽門，麾軍就平，師遂大潰。曜墜于冰，為石勒將石堪所擒。勒囚之襄國，尋殺之。烈帝元年，曜子毗率百官棄長安西走秦州。尋為石勒所滅。

context.beforeSource: 曜得黑兔，改年為太和。
context.afterSource: 羯胡石勒，字世龍，小字匐勒。
context.beforeLocal: 曜得黑兔，改年為太和。
context.afterLocal: 羯胡石勒，字世龍，小字匐勒。

manualTranslations.zh: 石虎伐曜，曜擊破之，遂攻石生於洛陽。
manualTranslations.literal: Shi Hu attacked Yao; Yao defeated him and then attacked Shi Sheng at Luoyang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shi Hu attacked Liu Yao, but Yao routed him and then besieged Shi Sheng at Luoyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 曜不撫士眾，專與嬖臣飲博，左右或諫，曜怒斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: Yao did not comfort his troops but devoted himself to drinking and gambling with favorite ministers; when attendants remonstrated, Yao angrily beheaded them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yao neglected his troops and spent his time drinking and gambling with favorite ministers; when attendants remonstrated, he had them beheaded in anger.

manualTranslations.zh: 石勒進據石門，曜甫知之，解金墉之圍，陳于洛西，將與勒戰。
manualTranslations.literal: Shi Le advanced and seized Shimen; only then did Yao learn of it. He lifted the siege of Jinyong, drew up his lines west of Luoyang, and prepared to fight Le.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shi Le advanced and seized Shimen; only then did Yao learn of it. Yao lifted the siege of Jinyong, formed ranks west of Luoyang, and prepared to fight Le.

manualTranslations.zh: 至西陽門，麾軍就平，師遂大潰。
manualTranslations.literal: At the Xiyang Gate he waved his army onto level ground, and the host thereupon collapsed in great disorder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the Xiyang Gate he waved his army onto level ground, and his host collapsed in rout.

manualTranslations.zh: 曜墜于冰，為石勒將石堪所擒。
manualTranslations.literal: Yao fell onto ice and was captured by Le's general Shi Kan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yao fell on the ice and was captured by Le's general Shi Kan.

manualTranslations.zh: 勒囚之襄國，尋殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: Le imprisoned him at Xiangguo and soon killed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Le imprisoned him at Xiangguo and soon put him to death.

manualTranslations.zh: 烈帝元年，曜子毗率百官棄長安西走秦州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Emperor Lie, Yao's son Pi led the hundred officials in abandoning Chang'an and fleeing west to Qinzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Lie, Yao's son Pi led the court in abandoning Chang'an and fleeing west to Qinzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋為石勒所滅。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he was destroyed by Shi Le.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he was destroyed by Shi Le.

sourceRange.text: 後與姚萇戰于胡奴阜，大破之。丕死，登國元年，登僭稱尊號於隴東，號年太初，置百官。立堅神主於軍中，載以輜軿，羽葆青蓋，建黃旗，虎賁之士三百人以衞之，每戰必告。繕甲治兵，引師而東，皆刻鉾鎧為「死休」字，示以戰死為志。每戰，以長矛鈎刃為方圓大陳，知有厚薄，從中分配，故人自為戰，所向無前。登每圍萇營，四面大哭，哀聲動人，大呼曰：「殺君賊姚萇，出來！吾與爾決。何為枉害無辜！」萇憚而不應。

context.beforeSource: 丕以登為征西大將軍、開府儀同三司、南安王，餘因其所稱而授之。
context.afterSource: 登進攻安定，萇襲其輜重，獲登妻毛氏，將妻之，毛氏哭罵，萇殺之。

manualTranslations.zh: 後與姚萇戰于胡奴阜，大破之。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he fought Yao Chang at Huainu Ford and inflicted a great defeat on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later he fought Yao Chang at Huainu Ford and routed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 丕死，登國元年，登僭稱尊號於隴東，號年太初，置百官。
manualTranslations.literal: When Pi died, in the first year of Dengguo Deng presumptuously assumed an exalted title in Longdong, took the era name Taichu, and established the hundred offices.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Pi died, in the first year of Dengguo Deng declared himself ruler in Longdong, adopted the era name Taichu, and established a full bureaucracy.

manualTranslations.zh: 立堅神主於軍中，載以輜軿，羽葆青蓋，建黃旗，虎賁之士三百人以衞之，每戰必告。
manualTranslations.literal: He set up Jian's spirit tablet in the army, carried it in a covered carriage with feather canopy and blue parasol, raised a yellow banner, and guarded it with three hundred tiger guards; before every battle he made offering.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He set up Fu Jian's spirit tablet in camp, carried it in an imperial carriage with feather canopy and blue parasol, raised a yellow banner, and posted three hundred tiger guards around it; before every battle he made offering.

manualTranslations.zh: 繕甲治兵，引師而東，皆刻鉾鎧為「死休」字，示以戰死為志。
manualTranslations.literal: He repaired armor and trained troops, led his army east, and had all spearheads and armor engraved with the characters "Death Rest," showing that death in battle was their resolve.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He repaired armor, trained troops, and marched east; on every spearhead and suit of armor he engraved the words "Death Rest," showing that they meant to die fighting.

manualTranslations.zh: 每戰，以長矛鈎刃為方圓大陳，知有厚薄，從中分配，故人自為戰，所向無前。
manualTranslations.literal: In every battle he formed a great square-and-round array with long spears and hooked blades, knew where the line was thick or thin, and assigned men from the center accordingly, so each fought for himself and none could be stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In every battle he formed a great square-and-round array with long spears and hooked blades, judged where the line was strong or weak, and assigned men from the center accordingly, so each fought on his own and none could be stopped.

manualTranslations.zh: 登每圍萇營，四面大哭，哀聲動人，大呼曰：「殺君賊姚萇，出來！
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever Deng surrounded Chang's camp he wept on all four sides with a grief that moved men, and cried out: "Murderer of our lord Yao Chang, come out!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever Deng surrounded Chang's camp he wept on all four sides with a grief that moved every heart, and shouted: "Murderer of our lord Yao Chang, come out!

manualTranslations.zh: 吾與爾決。
manualTranslations.literal: I will settle this with you.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I will settle this with you.

manualTranslations.zh: 何為枉害無辜！」
manualTranslations.literal: Why harm the innocent for nothing!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Why harm the innocent for nothing!"

manualTranslations.zh: 萇憚而不應。
manualTranslations.literal: Chang was afraid and did not answer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chang was afraid and did not answer.

sourceRange.text: 堅敗於淮南，入於垂軍。子寶勸垂殺之，垂以堅遇之厚也，不聽。行至洛陽，請求拜墓，許之，遂起兵。攻苻丕於鄴，乃引漳水以灌之，不沒者尺餘。丁零翟斌怨垂，使人夜往決堰，水潰，故鄴不拔。垂稱燕王，置百官，年號燕元。引師去鄴，開苻丕西歸之路。丕固守鄴城，請援於司馬昌明。垂怒曰：「苻丕，吾縱之不能去，方引南賊規固鄴都，不可置也。」乃復進師。丕乃棄鄴奔并州。垂以兄子魯陽王和為南中郎將，鎮鄴。垂定都中山。登國元年，垂僭稱大位，號年為建興。建宗廟社稷於中山，盡有幽、冀、平州之地。

context.beforeSource: 堅甚重之，拜冠軍將軍，封賓都侯。
context.afterSource: 垂遣使朝貢。
context.beforeLocal: 堅甚重之，拜冠軍將軍，封賓都侯。
context.afterLocal: 垂遣使朝貢。

manualTranslations.zh: 堅敗於淮南，入於垂軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jian was defeated at Huainan he entered Chui's army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Fu Jian was defeated at Huainan he fell into Murong Chui's camp.

manualTranslations.zh: 子寶勸垂殺之，垂以堅遇之厚也，不聽。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Bao urged Chui to kill him, but Chui, because Jian had treated him generously, would not listen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Murong Bao urged Chui to kill him, but Chui, remembering how generously Jian had treated him, refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 行至洛陽，請求拜墓，許之，遂起兵。
manualTranslations.literal: When he reached Luoyang he asked leave to pay respects at the tombs; this was granted, and he thereupon raised troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Reaching Luoyang, he asked permission to visit the tombs; once this was granted, he raised an army.

manualTranslations.zh: 攻苻丕於鄴，乃引漳水以灌之，不沒者尺餘。
manualTranslations.literal: He attacked Fu Pi at Ye and diverted the Zhang River to flood the city, leaving only a little more than a foot above water.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He attacked Fu Pi at Ye and diverted the Zhang River to flood the city, leaving only a little over a foot of wall above the water.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁零翟斌怨垂，使人夜往決堰，水潰，故鄴不拔。
manualTranslations.literal: The Dingling Zhai Bin resented Chui and sent men by night to break the dam; the water burst through, and so Ye could not be taken.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Dingling leader Zhai Bin resented Chui and sent men by night to break the dam; the water burst through, and Ye could not be taken.

manualTranslations.zh: 垂稱燕王，置百官，年號燕元。
manualTranslations.literal: Chui styled himself King of Yan, established the hundred offices, and took the era name Yanyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chui declared himself King of Yan, established a bureaucracy, and adopted the era name Yanyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 引師去鄴，開苻丕西歸之路。
manualTranslations.literal: He led his army away from Ye and opened a road west for Fu Pi to return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He withdrew from Ye and opened a route west for Fu Pi to escape.

manualTranslations.zh: 丕固守鄴城，請援於司馬昌明。
manualTranslations.literal: Pi held Ye firmly and asked Sima Changming for aid.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pi held Ye and appealed to Sima Changming for help.

manualTranslations.zh: 垂怒曰：「苻丕，吾縱之不能去，方引南賊規固鄴都，不可置也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Chui said in anger: "Fu Pi, though I let you go you would not leave; now you bring southern bandits to try to hold Ye — this cannot be allowed."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chui raged: "Fu Pi, I let you go and still you would not leave; now you bring southern enemies to try to hold Ye — this cannot stand."

manualTranslations.zh: 乃復進師。
manualTranslations.literal: He then advanced his army again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then marched on Ye again.

manualTranslations.zh: 丕乃棄鄴奔并州。
manualTranslations.literal: Pi thereupon abandoned Ye and fled to Bingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pi abandoned Ye and fled to Bingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 垂以兄子魯陽王和為南中郎將，鎮鄴。
manualTranslations.literal: Chui appointed his elder brother's son He, Prince of Luyang, Southern Gentlemen-Commander and stationed him at Ye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chui appointed his elder brother's son He, Prince of Luyang, Southern Gentlemen-Commander and garrisoned him at Ye.

manualTranslations.zh: 垂定都中山。
manualTranslations.literal: Chui fixed his capital at Zhongshan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chui made Zhongshan his capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 登國元年，垂僭稱大位，號年為建興。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Dengguo Chui presumptuously assumed the supreme position and took the era name Jianxing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dengguo Chui declared himself supreme ruler and adopted the era name Jianxing.

manualTranslations.zh: 建宗廟社稷於中山，盡有幽、冀、平州之地。
manualTranslations.literal: He built ancestral temples and the altars of soil and grain at Zhongshan and held all the lands of You, Ji, and Ping provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He built ancestral temples and state altars at Zhongshan and held all of You, Ji, and Ping provinces.

sourceRange.text: 沖毒暴關中，人民流散，道路斷絕，千里無煙。及堅出如五將山，沖入長安，縱兵大掠，死者不可勝計。初，堅之未亂也，關中土燃，無火而煙氣大起，方數十里，月餘不滅。堅每臨聽訟觀，令民有怨者，舉煙於城北，觀而錄之。長安為之語曰：「欲得必存，當舉煙。」關中謠曰：「長鞘馬鞭擊左股，太歲南行當復虜。」西人呼徒何為白虜。沖果據長安，樂之忘歸，且以慕容垂威名夙著，跨據山東，憚不敢進，課農築室，為久安之計。眾咸怨之。登國元年，沖左將軍韓延因民之怨，殺沖，立沖將段隨為燕王，改年昌平。沖之入長安，王嘉謂之曰：「鳳皇，鳳皇，何不高飛還故鄉？無故在此取滅亡！

context.beforeSource: 遷永黃門郎。
context.afterSource: 」沖敗，其左僕射慕容恒與永潛謀，襲殺段隨，立宜都王子覬為燕王，號年建明，率鮮卑男女三十餘萬口，乘輿服御、禮樂器物，去長安而東，以永為武衞將軍。
context.beforeLocal: 遷永黃門郎。
context.afterLocal: 沖敗，其左僕射慕容恒與永潛謀，襲殺段隨，立宜都王子覬為燕王，號年建明，率鮮卑男女三十餘萬口，乘輿服御、禮樂器物，去長安而東，以永為武衞將軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 沖毒暴關中，人民流散，道路斷絕，千里無煙。
manualTranslations.literal: Chong was cruel and violent in Guanzhong; the people scattered, roads were cut off, and for a thousand li there was no smoke.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Murong Chong tyrannized Guanzhong; the people scattered, roads were cut, and for a thousand li not a hearth smoked.

manualTranslations.zh: 及堅出如五將山，沖入長安，縱兵大掠，死者不可勝計。
manualTranslations.literal: When Jian went out to Wujiang Mountain, Chong entered Chang'an and let his troops plunder on a great scale; the dead were beyond counting.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Fu Jian went out to Wujiang Mountain, Chong entered Chang'an and let his troops plunder freely; the dead were beyond counting.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，堅之未亂也，關中土燃，無火而煙氣大起，方數十里，月餘不滅。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, before Jian's disorder, the soil of Guanzhong burned without fire and great clouds of smoke rose over several tens of li for more than a month without dying away.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before Jian's downfall, the soil of Guanzhong smoldered without fire and great clouds of smoke rose over tens of li for more than a month.

manualTranslations.zh: 堅每臨聽訟觀，令民有怨者，舉煙於城北，觀而錄之。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever Jian came to the Court for Hearing Lawsuits he ordered that any subject with a grievance should raise smoke north of the city, and he would observe and record it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever Jian held court at the Court for Hearing Lawsuits he ordered that anyone with a grievance should raise smoke north of the city, and he would observe and record it.

manualTranslations.zh: 長安為之語曰：「欲得必存，當舉煙。」
manualTranslations.literal: Chang'an made a saying of it: "If you wish to be sure to survive, raise smoke."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chang'an coined a saying: "If you wish to survive, raise smoke."

manualTranslations.zh: 關中謠曰：「長鞘馬鞭擊左股，太歲南行當復虜。」
manualTranslations.literal: A song in Guanzhong ran: "Long whip, horsewhip striking the left thigh—when the Grand Year moves south the barbarians will return."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A song in Guanzhong ran: "Long whip, horsewhip striking the left thigh—when the Grand Year moves south the barbarians will return."

manualTranslations.zh: 西人呼徒何為白虜。
manualTranslations.literal: Westerners called the Tuhe "White Barbarians."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: People of the west called the Tuhe "White Barbarians."

manualTranslations.zh: 沖果據長安，樂之忘歸，且以慕容垂威名夙著，跨據山東，憚不敢進，課農築室，為久安之計。
manualTranslations.literal: Chong did indeed hold Chang'an, delighted in it and forgot to return; moreover, because Murong Chui's martial fame was long established and he straddled the lands east of the mountains, Chong feared to advance, set the people to farming and building houses, and planned for long-term settlement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chong did hold Chang'an, grew fond of it and forgot to leave; because Murong Chui's fame was long established east of the mountains, Chong feared to advance, set the people to farming and building, and planned to stay.

manualTranslations.zh: 眾咸怨之。
manualTranslations.literal: All resented him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Everyone resented him.

manualTranslations.zh: 登國元年，沖左將軍韓延因民之怨，殺沖，立沖將段隨為燕王，改年昌平。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Dengguo Chong's Left General Han Yan, exploiting the people's resentment, killed Chong and installed Chong's general Duan Sui as King of Yan, changing the era name to Changping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dengguo, Chong's Left General Han Yan, exploiting popular resentment, killed Chong and installed his general Duan Sui as King of Yan, changing the era to Changping.

manualTranslations.zh: 沖之入長安，王嘉謂之曰：「鳳皇，鳳皇，何不高飛還故鄉？
manualTranslations.literal: When Chong entered Chang'an, Wang Jia said to him: "Phoenix, phoenix—why do you not soar high and return to your old home?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Chong entered Chang'an, Wang Jia told him: "Phoenix, phoenix—why do you not soar home to your old country?

manualTranslations.zh: 無故在此取滅亡！
manualTranslations.literal: Why for no reason stay here and court destruction!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Why stay here for no reason and court destruction!

sourceRange.text: 聽吾死問，汝便即尊位。

sourceRange.text: 晉太傅、東海王越率洛陽之眾二十餘萬討勒。越薨於軍，軍人推太尉王衍為主，率眾而東。勒追擊，破之於苦縣。勒分騎圍而射之，相登如山，殺王衍及晉襄陽王範等十餘萬人。越世子毗聞越薨，出自洛陽，從者傾城。勒逆毗於洧倉，破之，執毗及晉宗室二十六王并諸卿士，皆殺之。與王彌、劉曜攻陷洛陽，歸功彌曜。遂出轘轅，執晉大將軍苟晞於蒙城，以為左司馬。劉聰授勒鎮軍大將軍、幽州牧，領并州刺史。用張賓之計，自汝南葛陂北都襄國。襲幽州，擒王浚，殺之。劉聰加勒陝東伯，得專征伐，封拜刺史、將軍、守宰、列侯，歲盡集上。

context.beforeSource: 勒右長史張賓以為不可，引軍而北。
context.afterSource: 及劉粲為靳準所殺，勒率眾赴平陽。
context.beforeLocal: 勒右長史張賓以為不可，引軍而北。
context.afterLocal: 及劉粲為靳準所殺，勒率眾赴平陽。

manualTranslations.zh: 晉太傅、東海王越率洛陽之眾二十餘萬討勒。
manualTranslations.literal: The Jin Grand Tutor and Prince of Donghai, Yue, led more than two hundred thousand men of Luoyang to campaign against Le.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jin Grand Tutor and Prince of Donghai Sima Yue led more than two hundred thousand troops from Luoyang against Shi Le.

manualTranslations.zh: 越薨於軍，軍人推太尉王衍為主，率眾而東。
manualTranslations.literal: Yue died in the army; the soldiers made Grand Commandant Wang Yan their leader and led the host east.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yue died in camp; the soldiers made Grand Commandant Wang Yan their leader and marched east.

manualTranslations.zh: 勒追擊，破之於苦縣。
manualTranslations.literal: Le pursued and defeated them at Kuxian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Le pursued and routed them at Kuxian.

manualTranslations.zh: 勒分騎圍而射之，相登如山，殺王衍及晉襄陽王範等十餘萬人。
manualTranslations.literal: Le divided his cavalry to surround and shoot them; corpses piled up like a mountain, and he killed Wang Yan, Jin Prince of Xiangyang Fan, and more than one hundred thousand others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Le sent cavalry to surround and shoot them down; the dead piled like a mountain, and Wang Yan, Jin Prince of Xiangyang Fan, and more than one hundred thousand others were killed.

manualTranslations.zh: 越世子毗聞越薨，出自洛陽，從者傾城。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yue's heir Pi heard that Yue had died, he came out from Luoyang and the whole city followed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yue's heir Pi heard of his death, he left Luoyang and the whole city followed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 勒逆毗於洧倉，破之，執毗及晉宗室二十六王并諸卿士，皆殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: Le intercepted Pi at Weicang, defeated him, seized Pi together with twenty-six princes of the Jin imperial house and various ministers and nobles, and killed them all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Le intercepted Pi at Weicang, defeated him, seized Pi together with twenty-six Jin princes and various ministers and nobles, and killed them all.

manualTranslations.zh: 與王彌、劉曜攻陷洛陽，歸功彌曜。
manualTranslations.literal: Together with Wang Mi and Liu Yao he captured Luoyang and gave the credit to Mi and Yao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With Wang Mi and Liu Yao he captured Luoyang and gave the credit to Mi and Yao.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂出轘轅，執晉大將軍苟晞於蒙城，以為左司馬。
manualTranslations.literal: He then went out through Huanxuan, seized Jin Grand General Gou Xi at Mengcheng, and made him Left Chief Clerk.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then marched through Huanxuan, seized Jin Grand General Gou Xi at Mengcheng, and made him Left Chief Clerk.

manualTranslations.zh: 劉聰授勒鎮軍大將軍、幽州牧，領并州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Cong appointed Le General Who Pacifies the Army, Governor of Youzhou, and concurrent Inspector of Bingzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Cong appointed Le General Who Pacifies the Army, Governor of Youzhou, and concurrent Inspector of Bingzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 用張賓之計，自汝南葛陂北都襄國。
manualTranslations.literal: Following Zhang Bin's plan, he moved north from Gebei in Runan and made Xiangguo his capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Following Zhang Bin's plan, he moved north from Gebei in Runan and made Xiangguo his capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 襲幽州，擒王浚，殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: He raided Youzhou, captured Wang Jun, and killed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He raided Youzhou, captured Wang Jun, and killed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 劉聰加勒陝東伯，得專征伐，封拜刺史、將軍、守宰、列侯，歲盡集上。
manualTranslations.literal: Liu Cong further enfeoffed Le as Marquis of the East of Shan, allowed him exclusive authority to campaign, and permitted him to enfeoff and appoint inspectors, generals, magistrates, and ranked marquises, all of whom were gathered and reported upward each year.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Cong further made Le Marquis of the East of Shan, granted him sole authority to campaign, and allowed him to appoint and enfeoff inspectors, generals, magistrates, and ranked marquises, all of whom were reported upward each year.

sourceRange.text: 登國元年，僭稱皇帝，置百官，國號大秦，年曰建初，改長安曰常安。以其太子興鎮長安，自擊苻登安定，敗之。萇病，夢苻堅將天官使者、鬼兵數百，突入營中，萇懼走後宮，宮人迎萇刺鬼，誤中萇陰。鬼相謂曰：「正中死處。」拔矛出血石餘。寤而驚悸，遂患陰腫，醫刺之，出血如夢。萇乃狂言，或稱「臣」，或稱「萇」，「殺陛下者兄襄，非臣之罪，願不枉臣」。萇死，子興襲位，祕不發喪。

context.beforeSource: 苻堅出至五將山，萇執而殺之。
context.afterSource: 興，字子略，萇長子也。
context.beforeLocal: 苻堅出至五將山，萇執而殺之。
context.afterLocal: 興，字子略，萇長子也。

manualTranslations.zh: 登國元年，僭稱皇帝，置百官，國號大秦，年曰建初，改長安曰常安。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Dengguo he presumptuously styled himself emperor, established the hundred offices, took the state name Great Qin, named the era Jianchu, and renamed Chang'an to Everlasting Peace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dengguo he declared himself emperor, established a bureaucracy, named his state Great Qin, adopted the era Jianchu, and renamed Chang'an to Everlasting Peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 以其太子興鎮長安，自擊苻登安定，敗之。
manualTranslations.literal: He stationed his heir Xing at Chang'an and himself attacked Fu Deng at Anding and defeated him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He left his heir Xing to hold Chang'an and marched against Fu Deng at Anding, defeating him.

manualTranslations.zh: 萇病，夢苻堅將天官使者、鬼兵數百，突入營中，萇懼走後宮，宮人迎萇刺鬼，誤中萇陰。
manualTranslations.literal: Chang fell ill and dreamed that Fu Jian led several hundred celestial envoys and ghost soldiers in bursting into the camp; Chang fled in fear to the rear palace, and palace women rushed to stab the ghosts for Chang but mistakenly struck Chang's groin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chang fell ill and dreamed that Fu Jian led hundreds of celestial envoys and ghost soldiers bursting into camp; Chang fled in terror to the rear palace, and palace women rushed to stab the ghosts for him but mistakenly struck his groin.

manualTranslations.zh: 鬼相謂曰：「正中死處。」
manualTranslations.literal: The ghosts said to one another: "Right in the fatal spot."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The ghosts said to one another: "Right in the fatal spot."

manualTranslations.zh: 拔矛出血石餘。
manualTranslations.literal: They pulled out the spear and more than a stone's worth of blood flowed out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They pulled out the spear and more than a stone's measure of blood flowed out.

manualTranslations.zh: 寤而驚悸，遂患陰腫，醫刺之，出血如夢。
manualTranslations.literal: Awakening in shock and fear, he then suffered swelling of the groin; when physicians lanced it, blood flowed as in the dream.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Waking in shock, he developed a swelling of the groin; when physicians lanced it, blood flowed as in the dream.

manualTranslations.zh: 萇乃狂言，或稱「臣」，或稱「萇」，「殺陛下者兄襄，非臣之罪，願不枉臣」。
manualTranslations.literal: Chang then raved, sometimes calling himself "your subject," sometimes "Chang": "The one who killed Your Majesty was elder brother Xiang; it is not this subject's crime—please do not wrong this subject."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chang then raved, sometimes calling himself "your subject," sometimes "Chang": "The one who killed Your Majesty was elder brother Xiang; it is not my crime—please do not wrong me."

manualTranslations.zh: 萇死，子興襲位，祕不發喪。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chang died, his son Xing succeeded and kept the death secret without announcing mourning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Chang died, his son Xing succeeded him and kept the death secret.

sourceRange.text: 德，字玄明，雅為兄垂所重。桓溫之至枋頭也，德與垂擊走之。苻堅滅暐，以德為張掖太守。垂稱尊號，封為范陽王，拜車騎大將軍、司隸校尉，尋遷司徒。寶既即位，以德鎮鄴，後拜丞相。寶既東走，羣僚勸德稱尊號，德不從。皇始二年，既拔中山，太祖遣衞王儀攻鄴。德率戶四萬南走滑臺，自稱燕王，號年為燕元，置百官。德冠軍將軍苻廣叛於乞活壘，德留兄子和守滑臺，率眾攻廣，斬之。而和長史李辯殺和，以城來降。

context.beforeSource: 元真少子德。
context.afterSource: 德無所據，乃謀於眾。
