localRange.text: 魏書卷一百三諸本目錄此卷注「闕」字，百衲本、汲本、局本卷末有宋人校語云：「魏收書列傳第九十一亡。殿本考證云：「魏收書亡，後人所補。按此卷以北史卷九八補，唯蠕蠕傳末刪節東、西魏以及齊、周與「蠕蠕」和戰事，遠較北史簡略。依紇突隣部諸本及北史卷九八蠕蠕傳「紇」作「純」。按本卷高車傳末即附有紇突隣部，卷二太祖紀登國五年五月及十二月、皇始二年二月見此部，都作「紇突隣」，「純」乃形近而訛，今改正。狀類於蟲故改其號為蠕蠕諸本「蟲」作「蠱」，北史卷九八作「虫」，冊府卷九五六〈一一二五一頁〉、通典卷一九六蠕蠕條作「蟲」。洪氏考異卷一０以為「蠱」即「蟲」字。按這裏實是字訛，北史作「虫」即俗「蟲」字可證，今據改。又本傳稱此族「自號柔然」，宋書、南齊書稱「芮芮」，北齊書、隋書作「茹茹」，與「柔然」都是一名的異譯，此譯作「蠕蠕」則是拓跋燾有意侮辱。太祖以拔頡為安遠將軍平棘侯按「拔、頡」指上文之「啟拔、吳頡」，不可能二人同封「平棘侯」，疑「拔」下脫授拔之官爵。自廣寧還按卷四上世祖紀神䴥元年八月記拓拔燾「東幸廣寧」，又云「蠕蠕大檀遣子將萬餘騎入塞」，則所謂「自廣寧還」乃指拓跋燾，「自」上當有「帝」字。樂平王督十五將出西道通鑑卷一二四〈三九０一頁〉「樂平王」下有「丕」字。按前後帶兵諸王都具名，不應獨異，當是脫文。高涼王那出東道諸本及北史卷九八「高涼」作「高昌」，通鑑卷一二五〈三九三六頁〉作「高涼」。按那附見卷一四高涼王孤傳，襲高涼王爵。卷七下世祖紀下記歷次重要戰役，幾乎都見高涼王那領兵的紀載，「昌」字訛，今改正。世祖征伐之後按上敍高宗拓跋濬太安四年事，與此句不貫，「世祖」上疑脫「承」字。號伏古敦可汗冊府卷九九六〈一一六九０頁〉「古」作「名」。按通鑑卷一三六〈四二七０頁〉也作「名」。胡注：「魏收曰『伏名敦，魏言恒也』。似司馬光與胡三省所見魏書、北史此傳作「名」，與冊府同。疑「古」字訛。遣使俟斤尉比建朝貢諸本及北史卷九八「俟」作「侯」，通志卷二００蠕蠕傳作「俟」。按通鑑卷一四八〈四六三三頁〉作「俟」，胡注：「俟斤，柔然大臣之名。下文又見「俟斤丘升頭」。「侯」乃「俟」字形訛，今改正。下二年又見同改。伏圖納豆崘之妻候呂陵氏通志卷二００「候」作「俟」。按本卷高車傳附此部，作「侯呂隣」。考卷一一三官氏志有「叱呂氏，後改為呂氏」。元和姓纂卷六、通志氏族略五、古今姓氏書辨證卷二二都作「俟呂鄰」，金石萃編卷二七元宏弔比干墓文碑陰有「俟呂阿倪」。「叱」「俟」音近，「候」或「侯」當是「俟」之訛。下高車傳末「侯呂鄰部」同，不再出校記。是以曹道芝北使之日按上見「曹道」，當是雙名單稱，但「曹道」附見卷七五馮元興傳，他處屢見，並無「芝」字。阿那瓌宜置西吐若奚泉通鑑卷一四九〈四六六九頁〉無「西」字。按上文只稱「吐若奚泉」，疑「西」字衍。未及婚帝入關此下北史記東、西魏以至周、齊和「蠕蠕」和戰事，於東魏尤詳，本書大加刪節。按北史所述不見他書，其東魏事當即出於魏書。補此傳者刪周、齊時事以就魏書斷限，却連魏書範圍內應有的紀載也一併刪去，殊謬。尚平文女錢氏考異卷二八云：「序紀〈卷一〉邱不懃娶平帝綽女，非平文帝鬱律女，此傳誤。翰聞之諸本脫「翰」字，今據北史卷九八補。為翰所虜張森楷云：「據此文似遜昵延已見虜矣，而下稱『遜昵延見而方嚴』，兵敗逃還，又與此相矛盾。詳玩事勢，此蓋說遜昵延之前驅被虜，非謂遜昵延也，屬文殊欠了晰。按通志卷二００宇文莫槐傳「虜」作「敗」，當是以意改。穆帝時幽州刺史王浚以段氏數為己用百衲、南、汲、局四本「穆帝」上有「晉」字，又無「時」字，北本、殿本及北史卷九八如上摘句。按此穆帝指拓跋猗盧，補此傳者妄加「晉」字，又刪「時」字，遂使死於西晉之王浚忽為三十餘年後東晉穆帝的幽州刺史。北、殿本據北史改是，今從之。國人立日陸眷弟護遼為主按日陸眷是末波祖父輩，其弟亦是從祖，似不能嗣末波位。晉書卷六三段匹磾傳稱末波死，弟牙立，牙死，其後從祖就陸眷之孫遼〈即護遼〉立。此傳之「就六眷」，晉書作「疾陸眷」，而晉書之「就陸眷」當即此傳之「日陸眷」。乃同名異譯。這裏「弟」疑當作「孫」。袁紇氏諸本及北史卷九八「袁」作「表」，御覽卷八０一〈三五五五頁〉作「袁」。下文見「高車餘種袁紇」，又見卷二太祖紀登國三年三月。袁紇即隋書卷八四鐵勒傳之韋紇，唐代之迴紇。「表」乃「袁」字形訛，今據御覽改。下「表紇樹者」同改，不再出校記。婚姻用牛馬納聘以為榮御覽卷八０一〈三五五五頁〉「以」下有「多」字。按納聘用牛馬，北族常事，似不得云「引以為榮」，傳本當脫「多」字。北方之人畏嬰兒啼者北史卷九八、御覽卷八０一〈三五五六頁〉「畏」下有「之」字，疑當有此字。二曰吐盧氏通典卷一九七、通志卷二００高車傳「吐」作「叱」。按「叱盧氏」見卷一一三官氏志，疑作「叱」是，但冊府卷九五六〈一一二五三頁〉、御覽卷八０一〈三五五五頁〉都作「吐」。世宗詔之曰諸本「宗」作「祖」，北史卷九八作「宣武」，即「世宗」。按下文即作「世宗」，「祖」字訛，今據改。蠕蠕往來路絕姦勢不得妄令羣小敢有陵犯擁塞王人按「姦勢」下顯有脫文，通典卷一九七高車條作：「蠕蠕既與吐谷渾路絕，姦勢亦沮，於卿彼蕃，便有所益，行途經由，宜相供俟〈疑當作『候』〉，不得令羣小擁塞王人。這裏「姦勢」下應有「亦沮」以下文字。但通典、北史皆本魏書，各有刪節，不盡相同，今不補，於「姦勢」下句斷。詔東城子于亮報之諸本「于」作「干」，獨殿本作「于」。按北史卷九八作「于」，殿本當即依北史改。此傳本以北史補，今從殿本。有吐突隣部按卷二太祖紀登國二年四月癸己條、卷二六尉古真傳「吐」都作「叱」，疑「吐」字訛。而牽屯山鮮卑別種破多蘭部世傳主部落諸本「牽」作「率」，北史卷九八作「帥」。按卷七五尒朱天光傳稱万俟道洛「率眾西依牽屯山」，周書卷一文帝紀、卷一０邵惠公顥附宇文導傳稱導追斬侯莫陳悅於「牽屯山」。通鑑卷一五四〈四七七五頁〉胡注引杜佑說，「牽屯山在今原州高平縣〈今寧夏固原〉」。此傳下稱木易干「劫掠左右，西及金城〈今甘肅蘭州〉，東侵安定{{*|今甘肅鎮原」，地望正合。「率」乃「牽」字形訛，北史「率」又音訛作「帥」，今改正。至木易干有武力壯勇通志卷二００高車傳「干」作「于」。按卷二太祖紀天興四年十二月作「于」。卷九五鐵弗劉虎傳作「沒弈于」〈百衲本〉，晉書卷一三０赫連勃勃載記同劉虎傳，「干」當是「于」之訛。又越勒倍泥部北史卷九八作「勤」。按卷三太宗紀永興五年七月己巳作「勤」，又卷二太祖紀天興五年十二月辛亥見「越勤莫弗」，疑「勒」字訛。參卷一一三校記[四二]。

sourceRange.text: 末波自稱幽州刺史，屯遼西。末波死，國人立日陸眷弟護遼為主，烈帝時，假護遼驃騎大將軍、幽州刺史、大單于、北平公，弟鬱蘭撫軍將軍、冀州刺史、勃海公。建國元年，石虎征護遼於遼西，護遼奔平岡山，遂投慕容晃，晃殺之。鬱蘭奔石虎，以所徙鮮卑五千人配之，使屯令支。鬱蘭死，子龕代之。及冉閔之亂，龕率眾南移，遂據齊地。慕容儁使弟玄恭帥眾伐龕於廣固，執龕送之薊，儁毒其目而殺之，坑其徒三千餘人。

sourceRange.text: 建義初，孝莊詔曰：「夫勳高者賞重，德厚者名隆，蠕蠕主阿那瓌鎮衞北藩，禦侮朔表，遂使陰山息警，弱水無塵，刊跡狼山，銘功瀚海，至誠既篤，勳緒莫酬。故宜標以殊禮，何容格以常式。自今以後，讚拜不言名，上書不稱臣。」太昌元年六月，阿那瓌遣烏句蘭樹什伐等朝貢，并為長子請尚公主。永熙二年四月，出帝詔以范陽王誨之長女琅邪公主許之，未及婚，帝入關。齊獻武王遣使說之，阿那瓌遣使朝貢，求婚。獻武王方招四遠，以常山王妹樂安公主許之，改為蘭陵公主。瓌遣奉馬千匹為娉禮，迎公主，詔宗正元壽送公主往北。自是朝貢相尋。瓌以齊獻武王威德日盛，請致愛女於王，靜帝詔王納之。自此塞外無塵矣。

魏書卷一百三諸本目錄此卷注「闕」字，百衲本、汲本、局本卷末有宋人校語云：「魏收書列傳第九十一亡。殿本考證云：「魏收書亡，後人所補。按此卷以北史卷九八補，唯蠕蠕傳末刪節東、西魏以及齊、周與「蠕蠕」和戰事，遠較北史簡略。依紇突隣部諸本及北史卷九八蠕蠕傳「紇」作「純」。按本卷高車傳末即附有紇突隣部，卷二太祖紀登國五年五月及十二月、皇始二年二月見此部，都作「紇突隣」，「純」乃形近而訛，今改正。狀類於蟲故改其號為蠕蠕諸本「蟲」作「蠱」，北史卷九八作「虫」，冊府卷九五六〈一一二五一頁〉、通典卷一九六蠕蠕條作「蟲」。洪氏考異卷一０以為「蠱」即「蟲」字。按這裏實是字訛，北史作「虫」即俗「蟲」字可證，今據改。又本傳稱此族「自號柔然」，宋書、南齊書稱「芮芮」，北齊書、隋書作「茹茹」，與「柔然」都是一名的異譯，此譯作「蠕蠕」則是拓跋燾有意侮辱。太祖以拔頡為安遠將軍平棘侯按「拔、頡」指上文之「啟拔、吳頡」，不可能二人同封「平棘侯」，疑「拔」下脫授拔之官爵。自廣寧還按卷四上世祖紀神䴥元年八月記拓拔燾「東幸廣寧」，又云「蠕蠕大檀遣子將萬餘騎入塞」，則所謂「自廣寧還」乃指拓跋燾，「自」上當有「帝」字。樂平王督十五將出西道通鑑卷一二四〈三九０一頁〉「樂平王」下有「丕」字。按前後帶兵諸王都具名，不應獨異，當是脫文。高涼王那出東道諸本及北史卷九八「高涼」作「高昌」，通鑑卷一二五〈三九三六頁〉作「高涼」。按那附見卷一四高涼王孤傳，襲高涼王爵。卷七下世祖紀下記歷次重要戰役，幾乎都見高涼王那領兵的紀載，「昌」字訛，今改正。世祖征伐之後按上敍高宗拓跋濬太安四年事，與此句不貫，「世祖」上疑脫「承」字。號伏古敦可汗冊府卷九九六〈一一六九０頁〉「古」作「名」。按通鑑卷一三六〈四二七０頁〉也作「名」。胡注：「魏收曰『伏名敦，魏言恒也』。似司馬光與胡三省所見魏書、北史此傳作「名」，與冊府同。疑「古」字訛。遣使俟斤尉比建朝貢諸本及北史卷九八「俟」作「侯」，通志卷二００蠕蠕傳作「俟」。按通鑑卷一四八〈四六三三頁〉作「俟」，胡注：「俟斤，柔然大臣之名。下文又見「俟斤丘升頭」。「侯」乃「俟」字形訛，今改正。下二年又見同改。伏圖納豆崘之妻候呂陵氏通志卷二００「候」作「俟」。按本卷高車傳附此部，作「侯呂隣」。考卷一一三官氏志有「叱呂氏，後改為呂氏」。元和姓纂卷六、通志氏族略五、古今姓氏書辨證卷二二都作「俟呂鄰」，金石萃編卷二七元宏弔比干墓文碑陰有「俟呂阿倪」。「叱」「俟」音近，「候」或「侯」當是「俟」之訛。下高車傳末「侯呂鄰部」同，不再出校記。是以曹道芝北使之日按上見「曹道」，當是雙名單稱，但「曹道」附見卷七五馮元興傳，他處屢見，並無「芝」字。阿那瓌宜置西吐若奚泉通鑑卷一四九〈四六六九頁〉無「西」字。按上文只稱「吐若奚泉」，疑「西」字衍。未及婚帝入關此下北史記東、西魏以至周、齊和「蠕蠕」和戰事，於東魏尤詳，本書大加刪節。按北史所述不見他書，其東魏事當即出於魏書。補此傳者刪周、齊時事以就魏書斷限，却連魏書範圍內應有的紀載也一併刪去，殊謬。尚平文女錢氏考異卷二八云：「序紀〈卷一〉邱不懃娶平帝綽女，非平文帝鬱律女，此傳誤。翰聞之諸本脫「翰」字，今據北史卷九八補。為翰所虜張森楷云：「據此文似遜昵延已見虜矣，而下稱『遜昵延見而方嚴』，兵敗逃還，又與此相矛盾。詳玩事勢，此蓋說遜昵延之前驅被虜，非謂遜昵延也，屬文殊欠了晰。按通志卷二００宇文莫槐傳「虜」作「敗」，當是以意改。穆帝時幽州刺史王浚以段氏數為己用百衲、南、汲、局四本「穆帝」上有「晉」字，又無「時」字，北本、殿本及北史卷九八如上摘句。按此穆帝指拓跋猗盧，補此傳者妄加「晉」字，又刪「時」字，遂使死於西晉之王浚忽為三十餘年後東晉穆帝的幽州刺史。北、殿本據北史改是，今從之。國人立日陸眷弟護遼為主按日陸眷是末波祖父輩，其弟亦是從祖，似不能嗣末波位。晉書卷六三段匹磾傳稱末波死，弟牙立，牙死，其後從祖就陸眷之孫遼〈即護遼〉立。此傳之「就六眷」，晉書作「疾陸眷」，而晉書之「就陸眷」當即此傳之「日陸眷」。乃同名異譯。這裏「弟」疑當作「孫」。袁紇氏諸本及北史卷九八「袁」作「表」，御覽卷八０一〈三五五五頁〉作「袁」。下文見「高車餘種袁紇」，又見卷二太祖紀登國三年三月。袁紇即隋書卷八四鐵勒傳之韋紇，唐代之迴紇。「表」乃「袁」字形訛，今據御覽改。下「表紇樹者」同改，不再出校記。婚姻用牛馬納聘以為榮御覽卷八０一〈三五五五頁〉「以」下有「多」字。按納聘用牛馬，北族常事，似不得云「引以為榮」，傳本當脫「多」字。北方之人畏嬰兒啼者北史卷九八、御覽卷八０一〈三五五六頁〉「畏」下有「之」字，疑當有此字。二曰吐盧氏通典卷一九七、通志卷二００高車傳「吐」作「叱」。按「叱盧氏」見卷一一三官氏志，疑作「叱」是，但冊府卷九五六〈一一二五三頁〉、御覽卷八０一〈三五五五頁〉都作「吐」。世宗詔之曰諸本「宗」作「祖」，北史卷九八作「宣武」，即「世宗」。按下文即作「世宗」，「祖」字訛，今據改。蠕蠕往來路絕姦勢不得妄令羣小敢有陵犯擁塞王人按「姦勢」下顯有脫文，通典卷一九七高車條作：「蠕蠕既與吐谷渾路絕，姦勢亦沮，於卿彼蕃，便有所益，行途經由，宜相供俟〈疑當作『候』〉，不得令羣小擁塞王人。這裏「姦勢」下應有「亦沮」以下文字。但通典、北史皆本魏書，各有刪節，不盡相同，今不補，於「姦勢」下句斷。詔東城子于亮報之諸本「于」作「干」，獨殿本作「于」。按北史卷九八作「于」，殿本當即依北史改。此傳本以北史補，今從殿本。有吐突隣部按卷二太祖紀登國二年四月癸己條、卷二六尉古真傳「吐」都作「叱」，疑「吐」字訛。而牽屯山鮮卑別種破多蘭部世傳主部落諸本「牽」作「率」，北史卷九八作「帥」。按卷七五尒朱天光傳稱万俟道洛「率眾西依牽屯山」，周書卷一文帝紀、卷一０邵惠公顥附宇文導傳稱導追斬侯莫陳悅於「牽屯山」。通鑑卷一五四〈四七七五頁〉胡注引杜佑說，「牽屯山在今原州高平縣〈今寧夏固原〉」。此傳下稱木易干「劫掠左右，西及金城〈今甘肅蘭州〉，東侵安定」，地望正合。「率」乃「牽」字形訛，北史「率」又音訛作「帥」，今改正。至木易干有武力壯勇通志卷二００高車傳「干」作「于」。按卷二太祖紀天興四年十二月作「于」。卷九五鐵弗劉虎傳作「沒弈于」〈百衲本〉，晉書卷一三０赫連勃勃載記同劉虎傳，「干」當是「于」之訛。又越勒倍泥部北史卷九八作「勤」。按卷三太宗紀永興五年七月己巳作「勤」，又卷二太祖紀天興五年十二月辛亥見「越勤莫弗」，疑「勒」字訛。參卷一一三校記[四二]。

localRange.text: 魏書卷一百四諸本此卷目錄注「闕」。按卷後諸本皆無宋人校語，當是脫去。此序刪節北史卷五六魏收傳，兼採他書，故也有溢出北史字句。成帝世位終鉅鹿太守錢氏考異卷二八云：「此成帝謂漢成帝也。魏歆仕於漢成帝朝，而其子悅乃仕於元魏太武之世，此理之所必無者。伯起亦通人，何至憒憒乃爾。良由魏史自序久亡，後人節取北史補之，而北史又有脫簡，後人無從校正爾。按「成帝世」三字，北史卷五六魏收傳無，當取他書增，據元和姓纂輯本卷八魏氏稱「漢鉅鹿太守歆，居鉅鹿」，錢氏謂成帝謂漢成帝，是。歆子悅北史卷五六無「歆」字。按魏悅為北魏李孝伯壻，魏歆則漢成帝時人，相去四百餘年，豈得為父子。中間世次脫簡，自宋以來即有人指出。但唐書卷七二中宰相世系表魏氏下稱歆「二子，愉、悅」，則歆有子名悅，亦有旁證。至李孝伯之壻魏悅則魏子建之父，魏收之祖，見本書卷九一王叡附王椿傳、卷九二魏溥妻房氏傳，也無可疑。姓纂卷八和唐書世系表所著錄的後裔都是愉之後，悅的後裔無考。疑本有兩魏悅，一是西漢鉅鹿太守歆之子，一是北魏末魏子建之父。由於同名，傳抄時以此悅當彼悅，脫漏中間世系。或唐初魏書已有此誤本，其誤非必出於李延壽。初世宗時平氐諸本「世宗」作「世祖」，北史卷五六作「宣武」〈即世宗元恪〉。按事見卷八世宗紀正始三年正月壬申、卷七０傅豎眼傳、卷一０一氐傳補，「祖」乃「宗」之訛，今據改。乃遣刺史唐永代焉按刺史上無地名，不知何州刺史，據北史卷六七唐永傳但云「行臺蕭寶夤表永為南豳〈原訛『幽』〉州刺史」，不載代魏子建事，當是省略，或北史所據唐氏家傳諱言其事。唐永乃由南豳遷東益，這裏「刺史」上應有「南豳州」三字。吾生年契闊北史卷五六「生年」作「平生」，這裏「生年」當是「生平」之訛。帝曰北史卷五六「帝」上有「白」字，下文云云乃賈思同語。按御覽卷六００〈二七０一頁〉引北齊書也有「白」字〈今本北齊書無〉。若無「白」字，則下文云云是元恭〈後廢帝〉語，上文何必書「賈思同侍立」？這裏當脫「白」字。博總斟酌南、殿、局三本及北齊書卷三七「博」作「專」，百衲本、北本、汲本作「傳」；北史百衲本作「傳」，他本作「專」；冊府卷五五六〈六六七八頁〉作「博」。按「博總」即「博綜」，廣泛收集之意。本作「博」，訛作「傳」，後人以「傳總」不可解，改作「專」。今據冊府改。

localRange.text: 校勘記高祖延興元年十二月癸卯日有蝕之按是年十二月乙酋朔，癸卯是十九日，不應有日蝕。三年十二月癸卯朔日有蝕之四年正月癸酋朔日有蝕之按無連續兩月日蝕之理，必有誤。二月乙酋晦日有蝕之按太和二年二月己卯朔，乙酋乃七日，晦日值丁未。必有誤。延昌二年二月庚辰諸本「二月」作「正月」。按卷八世宗紀，事在是年二月庚辰。是年正月丙戊朔，無庚辰，二月丙辰朔，庚辰乃二十五日。這裏「正月」乃「二月」之訛。今據紀改。十一月乙酉按卷九肅宗紀，事在神龜二年十一月乙酋。這裏「十一月」上脫「二年」二字。三年九月己卯諸本「三年」作「二年」。按卷九肅宗紀，事在孝昌三年九月辛卯，梁書卷五武帝紀三，在梁大通元年〈即魏孝昌三年〉十月。記月不同，當是各據奏報，至元慶和降梁，必在孝昌三年無疑。這裏「二」字乃「三」之訛。今據紀改。是年九月有「己卯」，無「辛卯」，則是紀誤。

sourceRange.text: 孝靜元象元年春正月辛丑朔，日有蝕之。占曰「大臣死」。八月辛卯，司徒公高敖曹戰歿於河陰。六月己丑，日暈一重，有兩珥；上有背，長二丈餘。十一月己巳辰時，日暈，南面不合，東西有珥、背；有白虹，至珥不徹。

context.beforeSource: 七月丁未，出帝為斛斯椿等迫脅，遂出於長安。
context.afterSource: 二年二月己丑巳時，日暈帀，白虹貫日不徹。

manualTranslations.zh: 孝靜元象元年春正月辛丑朔，日有蝕之。
manualTranslations.literal: In spring, the first month of the first year of Yuanxiang under Emperor Xiaojing, on the day xinchou at new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month of Yuanxiang 1, during the reign of Emperor Xiaojing, on the xinchou new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「大臣死」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "A great minister will die."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The omen reads: "A high minister will die."

manualTranslations.zh: 八月辛卯，司徒公高敖曹戰歿於河陰。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinmao, Minister over the Masses Gao Aocao died in battle at Heyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, Gao Aocao, minister over the masses, fell in battle at Heyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月己丑，日暈一重，有兩珥；
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on jichou, there was a single-ring solar halo with two mock-suns;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jichou day, a single-ring solar halo appeared with two mock suns;

manualTranslations.zh: 上有背，長二丈餘。
manualTranslations.literal: above it was a back halo more than two zhang long.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: above them a back halo more than two zhang long.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月己巳辰時，日暈，南面不合，東西有珥、背；
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jisi at the chen hour, there was a solar halo; the southern side did not close, and to the east and west were mock-suns and back halos;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi day at the chen hour, a solar halo appeared with a gap on the south side and mock suns and back halos east and west;

manualTranslations.zh: 有白虹，至珥不徹。
manualTranslations.literal: there was a white rainbow reaching to the mock-suns without penetrating.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: a white rainbow reached the mock suns without crossing through.

localRange.text: 校勘記二年二月司馬德宗譙王司馬文思自江東遣使詣闕上書按此「二年」承上文是泰常二年〈四一七〉。據卷三七司馬休之傳，休之於「神瑞中」〈四一四－四一六〉已出奔襄陽，隨即與其子文思出奔後秦姚興。宋書卷二武帝紀中，劉裕攻司馬休之，休之自江陵奔襄陽在義熙十一年〈四一五〉三月，奔姚興在四月，豈有於泰常二年其子文思尚在「江東」之理。這裏當是誤以神瑞二年為泰常二年。三年正月戊申月犯輿鬼積尸己酉月犯軒轅爟星諸本「三年」作「二年」。按前已記二年，不應重出。天象志三泰常三年條稱「是歲正月己酉，月犯軒轅」。知「二」字乃「三」之訛，今據改。征西將軍金崖與安定鎮將延普及涇州刺史狄子玉爭權諸本「爭」作「為」。殿本考證據卷四上世祖紀上延和二年二月庚午記此事，以為「此『為』字乃『爭』字之訛」。按志三也作「爭」，今據改。九月辛巳統萬鎮將河間王閭虎皮坐貪殘賜死按卷七上高祖紀上記閭虎皮之死在延興二年九月戊申。是年九月庚辰朔，辛巳是二日，戊申是二十八日。這裏當是誤以紀文前條的日干當閭虎皮「賜死」這天的日干。庚子月犯東井北轅按延興二年閏六月壬子朔，無庚子，當有訛字。安成王萬安國坐矯詔殺部長奚買奴於苑中按卷七上高祖紀上承明元年六月、卷二九奚斤傳附見買奴、卷三四萬安國傳〈補〉都作「神部長奚買奴」，這裏「部長」上當脫「神」字。七月癸未月犯心志三在太和三年七月丁未。按志三記月變大抵即採自志二。是年七月辛丑朔，丁未是七日，無癸未。這裏「癸未」當是「丁未」之訛。東井北河北河殿本考證云：「兩『北河』字，其一必『南河』之訛也，或重出。按志三太和五年條下注作「東井、軒轅、北河」，疑上「北河」字本當作「軒轅」，涉下「北河」而訛。六年正月任城王雲薨按卷七上高祖紀上，雲死在五年四月，卷一九中雲本傳也說他死於太和五年。這裏記年月皆誤。二十年七月廢皇后馮氏諸本「七月」作「十月」。按卷七下高祖紀下，事在是年七月。天象志四太和十八年條也在「七月」。這裏「十」字乃「七」之訛，今據改。二十年二月恒州刺史穆泰謀反伏誅多所連及按卷七下高祖紀下，太和二十年十二月戊辰記「恒州刺史穆泰等在州謀反」。二十一年二月癸酉，記元宏「至平城」，穆泰等定罪實在此時。這裏「二十年」當作「二十一年」，脫「一」字。蕭寶卷直後張齊玉殺寶卷按卷八世宗紀景明二年十二月、卷九八蕭道成傳記此事作「張齊」，無「玉」字，南齊書卷七東昏侯紀、通鑑卷一四四〈四五０七頁〉都作「張齊」。這裏當衍「玉」字。乙卯三老元丕薨按上不記年月，承上文乃景明三年八月，據卷八世宗紀元丕死在四年七月乙卯，這裏「乙卯」上當脫「四年七月」四字。左將軍羊祉大破之諸本「祉」訛「社」，殿本考證據卷八世宗紀景明四年正月乙亥條以為「『社』字乃『祉』字之訛」。按事亦見卷八九羊祉傳〈補〉，今改正。戊戌月暈五車三星東井南河北河輿鬼鎮星按志四正始三年條注在元年正月戊午。按是年正月戊申朔，戊午是十一日，無戊戌，這裏「戊戌」當是「戊午」之訛。諸犯罪者恕死從流已下減降按卷八世宗紀延昌二年八月辛卯詔稱：「其殺人、掠賣人〈中略〉依法行決，自餘恕死，徒流已下，各準減降。這裏概括為「諸犯罪者恕死」，既與詔書不符，「從」字也當是「徒」之訛。十二月戊戌月犯熒惑於太微志四「戊戌」作「甲戌」。按延昌元年十二月丁巳朔，甲戌是十八日，無「戊戌」，這裏「戊戌」當是「甲戌」之訛。三年六月南荊州刺史桓叔興破蕭衍軍於九江諸本「三」作「二」，「桓叔興」作「栢叔輿」。按卷八世宗紀延昌三年六月記此事，作「桓叔興」。「桓叔興」又見卷一０一蠻傳，梁書卷三武帝紀三普通二年七月。這裏「二」字和「栢」「輿」字皆訛，今改正。

sourceRange.text: 九年正月丁丑，月在參，暈觜、參兩肩、東井、北河、五車三星。占曰「水」。是年，冀定數州水，民有賣男女者。戊申，月犯東井。占曰「貴人死」，一曰「有水」。十月，侍中、司徒、魏郡王陳建薨。是年，京師及州鎮十二水旱傷稼。

manualTranslations.zh: 九年正月丁丑，月在參，暈觜、參兩肩、東井、北河、五車三星。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, on dingchou, the moon was in Shen and haloed Zi, the two shoulders of Shen, Dongjing, Beihe, and three stars of Wuche.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the first month of the ninth year, the moon was in Shen, with a halo around Zi, the two shoulders of Shen, Dongjing, Beihe, and three stars of Wuche.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「水」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication said, “Water.”
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The omen was read as signifying flood.

manualTranslations.zh: 是年，冀定數州水，民有賣男女者。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, several prefectures including Ji and Ding suffered floods, and among the people there were those who sold sons and daughters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, Ji, Ding, and several other prefectures flooded, and some people sold their sons and daughters.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊申，月犯東井。
manualTranslations.literal: On wushen, the moon encroached on Dongjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wushen, the moon encroached on Dongjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「貴人死」，一曰「有水」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication said, “A noble person will die”; one version says, “There will be water.”
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The omen was read as “a noble person will die”; another reading said, “there will be flood.”

manualTranslations.zh: 十月，侍中、司徒、魏郡王陳建薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month, Chen Jian, Palace Attendant, Minister over the Masses, and Prince of Wei Commandery, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Chen Jian, Palace Attendant, Minister over the Masses, and Prince of Wei Commandery, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 是年，京師及州鎮十二水旱傷稼。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, floods and droughts in the capital and twelve provinces and garrisons damaged the crops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, floods and droughts damaged crops in the capital and in twelve provinces and garrisons.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月乙亥，月掩畢。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, on yihai, the moon occulted Bi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yihai in the eighth month, the moon occulted Bi.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「有邊兵」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication said, “There will be troops on the frontier.”
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The omen was read as: “There will be frontier warfare.”

manualTranslations.zh: 太和元年正月，秦州略陽民王元壽聚眾五千餘家，自號為衝天王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Taihe, Wang Yuanshou, a commoner of Lueyang in Qinzhou, gathered more than five thousand households and styled himself Heaven-Assailing King.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of Taihe 1, Wang Yuanshou, a man of Lueyang in Qinzhou, gathered more than five thousand households and called himself the Heaven-Assailing King.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月，詔秦益二州刺史武都公尉洛侯討破元壽，獲其妻子送京師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, an edict ordered Wei Luohou, Duke of Wudu and Inspector of Qin and Yi provinces, to campaign against and defeat Yuanshou; he captured Yuanshou’s wife and children and sent them to the capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, Wei Luohou, Duke of Wudu and Inspector of Qin and Yi provinces, was ordered to attack and defeat Yuanshou. He captured Yuanshou’s wife and children and sent them to the capital.

sourceRange.text: 皇興元年四月，太白犯鎮星。占曰「有攻城略地之事」。六月壬寅，太白犯鬼，秦分也。二年正月，太白犯熒惑。占曰「大兵起」。是時，鎮南大將軍尉元、征南大將軍慕容白曜略定淮泗。明年，徐州羣盜作亂，元又討平之。後歲正月，上黨王觀西征吐谷渾，又大破之。二年九月癸卯，火犯太微上將。占曰「上將誅」。先是元年六月，熒惑犯氐；是歲十一月，太白又犯之，是為內宮有憂逼之象。占曰「天子失其宮」。四年十月，誅濟南王慕容白曜。明年，上迫於太后，傳位太子，是為孝文帝。宋志以為先是比年月頻犯左角，占曰「天子惡之」。及上遜位，而宋明帝亦殂。

manualTranslations.zh: 皇興元年四月，太白犯鎮星。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Huangxing, fourth month, the Great White transgressed the Sentinel Star.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangxing, in the fourth month, Venus transgressed Saturn.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「有攻城略地之事」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "There are affairs of besieging cities and seizing territory."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "There will be sieges and territorial seizures."

manualTranslations.zh: 六月壬寅，太白犯鬼，秦分也。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, day renyin, the Great White transgressed Ghost—it is Qin's allotted region.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day renyin, Venus transgressed Ghost; this is Qin's allotted region.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年正月，太白犯熒惑。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, first month, the Great White transgressed Mars.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month, Venus transgressed Mars.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「大兵起」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great armies rise."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Major armies will rise."

manualTranslations.zh: 是時，鎮南大將軍尉元、征南大將軍慕容白曜略定淮泗。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time, General Who Guards the South Wei Yuan and General Who Campaigns the South Murong Baiyao broadly pacified the Huai and Si.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At this time, General Who Guards the South Wei Yuan and General Who Campaigns the South Murong Baiyao broadly pacified the Huai and Si regions.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，徐州羣盜作亂，元又討平之。
manualTranslations.literal: The following year, bandits in Xu Province rose in rebellion; Yuan again suppressed and pacified them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year, bandits in Xu Province rose in rebellion, and Yuan again suppressed and pacified them.

manualTranslations.zh: 後歲正月，上黨王觀西征吐谷渾，又大破之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the year after, Prince of Shangdang Guan marched west against Tuyuhun and again inflicted a great defeat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of the year after, Changsun Guan, Prince of Shangdang, marched west against Tuyuhun and again inflicted a crushing defeat.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年九月癸卯，火犯太微上將。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, ninth month, day guimao, fire transgressed the Senior General of the Supreme Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the ninth month, on the day guimao, Mars transgressed the Senior General of the Supreme Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「上將誅」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "The senior general is executed."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The senior general will be put to death."

manualTranslations.zh: 先是元年六月，熒惑犯氐；
manualTranslations.literal: Before this, in the first year, sixth month, Mars transgressed Root;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the first year, in the sixth month, Mars had transgressed Root;

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲十一月，太白又犯之，是為內宮有憂逼之象。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month of this year, the Great White again transgressed it—this is a sign that the inner palace has grief and coercion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of this year, Venus again transgressed it—this signified distress and coercion within the inner palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「天子失其宮」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "The Son of Heaven loses his palace."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The Son of Heaven will lose his palace."

manualTranslations.zh: 四年十月，誅濟南王慕容白曜。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Prince of Jinan Murong Baiyao was executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Murong Baiyao, Prince of Jinan, was executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，上迫於太后，傳位太子，是為孝文帝。
manualTranslations.literal: The following year, the emperor, compelled by the empress dowager, transmitted the throne to the crown prince—this was Emperor Xiaowen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year, compelled by the empress dowager, the emperor abdicated in favor of the crown prince, who became Emperor Xiaowen.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋志以為先是比年月頻犯左角，占曰「天子惡之」。
manualTranslations.literal: The Song Annals holds that before this, in these years and months, the left horn was frequently transgressed; the prognostication says: "The Son of Heaven is displeased by it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Song Annals holds that in the years before this the Left Horn was transgressed repeatedly; the prognostication reads: "The Son of Heaven is displeased by it."

manualTranslations.zh: 及上遜位，而宋明帝亦殂。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor abdicated, Emperor Ming of Song also passed away.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the emperor abdicated, Emperor Ming of Song also died.

sourceRange.text: 四年八月，熒惑守畢，直徼垣之南。占曰「歲饉」。至五年二月，又入東井。占曰「旱兵飢疫，大臣當之」。六月，太白犯鉞。占曰「兵起，更正朔」。是歲二月，司空伊馛薨。十二月，六鎮、雲中、高平、雍、秦饑旱。明年，改年為和平。至六月，諸將討吐谷渾什寅，遂絕河窮躡之，會軍大疫乃還。是歲三月，流星數萬西行。占曰「小流星百數四面行者，庶人遷之象」。既而吐谷渾舉國西遁，大軍又隨躡之。四年九月，月犯軒轅；十二月，犯氐；至五年正月，月掩軒轅，又掩氐東南星。皆后妃之府也。和平元年正月丁未，歲犯鬼。鬼為死喪，歲星，人君也，是為君有喪事。三月，月掩軒轅。四月戊戌，皇太后崩於壽安宮。宋志云：人間宣言，人主帷箔不修，故謫見軒轅。又五年十一月，月犯左執法；明年十一月，又犯之。占曰「大臣有憂」。和平二年，征東將軍、河東王閭毗薨。十月，廣平王洛侯薨。和平元年十月，有長星出於天倉，長丈餘。饉祥也。二年三月，熒惑入鬼。是謂稼穡不成，且曰萬人相食。其後定相阻飢，宥其田租。時三吳亦仍歲凶旱，死者十二三。先是，元年四月，太白犯東井。井、鬼皆秦分，雍州有兵亂。自元年六月，月犯心大星，三犯前後于房。心，宋分。時宋君虐其諸弟，後宮多喪，子女繼夭，哭泣之聲相再。是歲，詔諸將討雍州叛氐，大破之。宋雍州刺史、海陵王休茂亦稱兵作亂。間歲而宋主殂，嗣子淫昏，政刑紊焉。先是，元年十月，太白入氐。占曰「兵起後宮，有白衣會」。三年五月，歲星犯上將。占曰「上將憂之」。三年八月，月犯哭星。皆宋祥也。是歲，樂良王萬壽及征東大將軍、常山王素並薨。

context.beforeSource: 明年，宋兗州刺史竟陵王誕據廣陵作亂，宋主親戎，自夏涉秋，無日不戰，及城陷，悉屠之。
context.afterSource: 二年三月辛巳，有長星出天津，色赤，長匹餘，滅而復出，大小百數。

manualTranslations.zh: 四年八月，熒惑守畢，直徼垣之南。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, eighth month, the Sparkling Deluder stationed at Net, directly south of the encircling wall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the eighth month, Mars stationed at Net, directly south of the encircling wall.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「歲饉」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "Famine that year."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Famine that year."

manualTranslations.zh: 至五年二月，又入東井。
manualTranslations.literal: By the second month of the fifth year, it again entered the Eastern Well.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the second month of the fifth year, it again entered the Eastern Well.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「旱兵飢疫，大臣當之」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "Drought, armies, hunger, and pestilence—great ministers will bear it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Drought, warfare, famine, and pestilence—high ministers will bear the blame."

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，太白犯鉞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, the Great White transgressed the Battle-axe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Venus transgressed the Battle-axe.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「兵起，更正朔」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies rise; the calendar era is revised."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Warfare arises; the calendar era will be changed."

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲二月，司空伊馛薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of that year, Minister of Works Yi Ba died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of that year, Minister of Works Yi Ba died.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，六鎮、雲中、高平、雍、秦饑旱。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Six Garrisons, Yunzhong, Gaoping, Yong, and Qin suffered famine and drought.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Six Garrisons, Yunzhong, Gaoping, Yong, and Qin suffered famine and drought.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，改年為和平。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year, the era name was changed to Heping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year, the reign era was changed to Heping.

manualTranslations.zh: 至六月，諸將討吐谷渾什寅，遂絕河窮躡之，會軍大疫乃還。
manualTranslations.literal: By the sixth month, the generals campaigned against Shiyin of Tuyuhun; thereupon they crossed the river and pursued him to the end, but when the army was struck by a great pestilence they returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the sixth month, the generals had marched against Shiyin of Tuyuhun; they crossed the river and pressed the pursuit to the limit, but when the army was ravaged by pestilence they turned back.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲三月，流星數萬西行。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of that year, tens of thousands of meteors moved westward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of that year, tens of thousands of meteors streamed westward.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「小流星百數四面行者，庶人遷之象」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "When small meteors number in the hundreds and travel on four sides—it is an image of the common people being displaced."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When small meteors number in the hundreds and travel on four sides, it is an omen of commoners being displaced."

manualTranslations.zh: 既而吐谷渾舉國西遁，大軍又隨躡之。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long all Tuyuhun fled west as a state; the great army again followed in pursuit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long Tuyuhun fled west en masse, and the main army again pressed the pursuit.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年九月，月犯軒轅；
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth year, the moon transgressed Chariot Shaft;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the fourth year, the moon transgressed Chariot Shaft;

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，犯氐；
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, it transgressed Di;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, it transgressed Di;

manualTranslations.zh: 至五年正月，月掩軒轅，又掩氐東南星。
manualTranslations.literal: By the first month of the fifth year, the moon concealed Chariot Shaft and also concealed the southeastern star of Di.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the first month of the fifth year, the moon occulted Chariot Shaft and also occulted the southeastern star of Di.

manualTranslations.zh: 皆后妃之府也。
manualTranslations.literal: All are the mansions of empresses and consorts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All are the mansions of empresses and consorts.

manualTranslations.zh: 和平元年正月丁未，歲犯鬼。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of Heping year 1, day dingwei, the Year Star transgressed Ghost.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of Heping 1, on the day dingwei, Jupiter transgressed Ghost.

manualTranslations.zh: 鬼為死喪，歲星，人君也，是為君有喪事。
manualTranslations.literal: Ghost signifies death and mourning; the Year Star is the human ruler—this means the ruler has a bereavement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ghost signifies death and mourning; Jupiter is the human ruler—this means the ruler will have a bereavement.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月，月掩軒轅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, the moon concealed Chariot Shaft.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, the moon occulted Chariot Shaft.

manualTranslations.zh: 四月戊戌，皇太后崩於壽安宮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month, day wuxu, the Empress Dowager died at Shou'an Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the day wuxu, the Empress Dowager died at Shou'an Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋志云：人間宣言，人主帷箔不修，故謫見軒轅。
manualTranslations.literal: The Song Treatise says: A popular declaration held that the ruler did not properly maintain the curtains and screens of his inner quarters, and so Chariot Shaft appeared as a reprimand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Book of Song astronomical treatise says: rumor held that the ruler had not properly maintained the curtains and screens of his inner quarters, and so Chariot Shaft appeared as a heavenly reprimand.

manualTranslations.zh: 又五年十一月，月犯左執法；
manualTranslations.literal: Again, in the eleventh month of the fifth year, the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Again, in the eleventh month of the fifth year, the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer;

manualTranslations.zh: 明年十一月，又犯之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month of the following year, it transgressed it again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the next year, it transgressed it again.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「大臣有憂」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great ministers will have anxiety."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "High ministers will face grave concern."

manualTranslations.zh: 和平二年，征東將軍、河東王閭毗薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In Heping year 2, Eastern Campaign General and Prince of Hedong Lü Pi died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Heping 2, Eastern Campaign General and Prince of Hedong Lü Pi died.

manualTranslations.zh: 十月，廣平王洛侯薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month, Prince Luohou of Guangping died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Prince Luohou of Guangping died.

manualTranslations.zh: 和平元年十月，有長星出於天倉，長丈餘。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month of Heping year 1, a long star appeared from the Celestial Granary, more than one zhang in length.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Heping 1, a long star appeared at the Celestial Granary, more than one zhang in length.

manualTranslations.zh: 饉祥也。
manualTranslations.literal: It is a famine omen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It was a famine omen.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年三月，熒惑入鬼。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the second year, the Sparkling Deluder entered Ghost.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the third month, Mars entered Ghost.

manualTranslations.zh: 是謂稼穡不成，且曰萬人相食。
manualTranslations.literal: This means crops do not come to fruition, and moreover it signifies ten thousand men eating one another.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This means crops fail to come to fruition, and moreover it signifies mass cannibalism.

manualTranslations.zh: 其後定相阻飢，宥其田租。
manualTranslations.literal: Afterward Ding and Xiang were blocked by hunger, and their land tax was remitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Afterward Ding and Xiang Provinces were stricken by famine, and their land tax was remitted.

manualTranslations.zh: 時三吳亦仍歲凶旱，死者十二三。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the Three Wu regions also suffered successive years of calamitous drought; one or two out of every ten died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the Three Wu regions also suffered successive years of disastrous drought, and one or two in every ten died.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，元年四月，太白犯東井。
manualTranslations.literal: Previously, in the fourth month of the first year, the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Previously, in the fourth month of the first year, Venus transgressed the Eastern Well.

manualTranslations.zh: 井、鬼皆秦分，雍州有兵亂。
manualTranslations.literal: The Well and Ghost are both Qin's allotted regions; Yong Province had armed disorder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Well and Ghost are both Qin's allotted regions; Yong Province saw armed disorder.

manualTranslations.zh: 自元年六月，月犯心大星，三犯前後于房。
manualTranslations.literal: From the sixth month of the first year, the moon transgressed the Great Star of Heart, three times transgressing the front and rear in Room.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the sixth month of the first year, the moon transgressed the Great Star of Heart, transgressing front and rear in Room three times.

manualTranslations.zh: 心，宋分。
manualTranslations.literal: Heart is Song's allotted region.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Heart is Song's allotted region.

manualTranslations.zh: 時宋君虐其諸弟，後宮多喪，子女繼夭，哭泣之聲相再。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the Song ruler tyrannized his younger brothers; the inner palace suffered many bereavements, and sons and daughters died in succession—the sound of weeping came again and again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time the Song ruler mistreated his younger brothers; the inner palace suffered many deaths, sons and daughters died in succession, and the sound of weeping never ceased.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，詔諸將討雍州叛氐，大破之。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, an edict ordered the generals to suppress the rebel Di of Yong Province, and they routed them completely.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, an edict ordered the generals to suppress the rebel Di of Yong Province, and they won a great victory.

manualTranslations.zh: 宋雍州刺史、海陵王休茂亦稱兵作亂。
manualTranslations.literal: Song's Inspector of Yong Province, Prince Xiumao of Hailing, also raised troops in revolt.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiumao, Prince of Hailing and Inspector of Yong Province under Song, also raised troops in rebellion.

manualTranslations.zh: 間歲而宋主殂，嗣子淫昏，政刑紊焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Within a year the Song ruler died; the successor was dissolute and dim-witted, and government and punishments were in disorder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Within a year the Song ruler died; the heir was dissolute and incompetent, and government and punishments fell into disorder.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，元年十月，太白入氐。
manualTranslations.literal: Previously, in the tenth month of the first year, the Great White entered Di.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Previously, in the tenth month of the first year, Venus entered Di.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「兵起後宮，有白衣會」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies rise in the inner palace; there is a white-robed assembly."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Warfare rises in the inner palace; there will be a white-robed assembly."

manualTranslations.zh: 三年五月，歲星犯上將。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, fifth month, the Year Star transgressed the Senior General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the fifth month, Jupiter transgressed the Senior General.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「上將憂之」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "The Senior General will grieve over it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The Senior General will face grave concern."

manualTranslations.zh: 三年八月，月犯哭星。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, eighth month, the moon transgressed the Weeping Star.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the eighth month, the moon transgressed the Weeping Star.

manualTranslations.zh: 皆宋祥也。
manualTranslations.literal: All are Song omens.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All were omens for Song.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，樂良王萬壽及征東大將軍、常山王素並薨。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, Prince Wanshou of Leliang and Eastern Campaign Grand General, Prince Su of Changshan, both died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year, Prince Wanshou of Leliang and Eastern Campaign Grand General Prince Su of Changshan both died.

sourceRange.text: 三年三月癸未，月犯太白。占曰「大兵起，合戰」。九月乙丑，有星孛于天牢，入文昌、五車，經昴、畢之間，至天苑，百餘日與宿俱入西方。天象若曰：且有王者之兵，彗除髦頭之域矣，貴臣預有戮焉。明年正月，征西將軍皮豹子大敗宋師于樂鄉。九月，上北伐，樂平王丕統十五將為左軍，中山王辰統十五將為右軍，上自將中軍。蠕蠕可汗不敢戰，亡，追至頓根河，虜二萬餘騎而還。中山王辰等八將軍坐後期，皆斬。或曰：彗由昴、畢，貴人多死。十一月，太保盧魯元薨。五年二月，樂平王丕薨。

manualTranslations.zh: 三年三月癸未，月犯太白。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, third month, day guiwei, the moon transgressed the Great White.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the third month, on the day guiwei, the moon transgressed Venus.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「大兵起，合戰」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great armies rise; battle will be joined."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great armies rise; battle will be joined."

manualTranslations.zh: 九月乙丑，有星孛于天牢，入文昌、五車，經昴、畢之間，至天苑，百餘日與宿俱入西方。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, day yichou, a broom star appeared at Celestial Prison, entered Literary Glory and the Five Chariots, passed between Hairy Head and Net, reached Heavenly Park, and after more than a hundred days set into the west together with its constellation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day yichou, a comet appeared at Celestial Prison, entered Literary Glory and the Five Chariots, passed between Hairy Head and Net, reached Heavenly Park, and after more than a hundred days set into the west together with its constellation.

manualTranslations.zh: 天象若曰：且有王者之兵，彗除髦頭之域矣，貴臣預有戮焉。
manualTranslations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: There will be the armies of a True King; the comet will sweep clean the domain of the helmet-headed armies; noble ministers will beforehand suffer execution.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare that there would be the armies of a True King, that the comet would sweep clean the domain of the helmet-headed armies, and that noble ministers would beforehand suffer execution.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年正月，征西將軍皮豹子大敗宋師于樂鄉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the following year, General Who Conquers the West Pi Baozi greatly defeated the Song army at Lexiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, General Who Conquers the West Pi Baozi routed the Song army at Lexiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，上北伐，樂平王丕統十五將為左軍，中山王辰統十五將為右軍，上自將中軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, the emperor marched north; Prince Ping of Yueping commanded fifteen generals as the left army, Prince Chen of Zhongshan commanded fifteen generals as the right army, and the emperor personally led the central army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the emperor marched north; Prince Ping of Yueping commanded fifteen generals as the left army, Prince Chen of Zhongshan commanded fifteen generals as the right army, and the emperor personally led the central army.

manualTranslations.zh: 蠕蠕可汗不敢戰，亡，追至頓根河，虜二萬餘騎而還。
manualTranslations.literal: The Rouran khan dared not give battle and fled; they were pursued to Dundun River, more than twenty thousand mounted troops were captured, and the army returned.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Rouran khan dared not give battle and fled; the pursuers reached Dundun River, captured more than twenty thousand mounted troops, and returned.

manualTranslations.zh: 中山王辰等八將軍坐後期，皆斬。
manualTranslations.literal: Eight generals including Prince Chen of Zhongshan were punished for arriving late; all were executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Eight generals including Prince Chen of Zhongshan were punished for falling behind schedule; all were executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 或曰：彗由昴、畢，貴人多死。
manualTranslations.literal: Some say: When a comet passes through Hairy Head and Net, many among the nobility die.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some say: When a comet passes through Hairy Head and Net, many among the nobility die.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，太保盧魯元薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, Grand Preceptor Lu Luyuan died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Grand Preceptor Lu Luyuan died.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年二月，樂平王丕薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, Prince Ping of Yueping died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year, Prince Ping of Yueping died.

sourceRange.text: 天關外主勃、碣，山河之險窮焉。

localRange.text: [14]天關外主勃、碣，山河之險窮焉。

sourceRange.text: 五年七月己亥，月犯歲星，在鶉火鳥帑，南國之墟也。至天賜元年二月甲辰又掩之，在角。角為外朝，而歲星君也。又象若曰：有強大之臣干君之庭，以挾其主而播遷于外。是歲桓玄之師敗績于劉裕，玄劫晉帝以奔江陵。至五月，玄死，桓氏之黨復攻江陵，陷之，凡再劫天子云。先是，六年六月甲辰，月掩斗魁第四星；至天賜元年五月壬申，又掩斗魁第三星；二年八月丁巳，又犯斗第一星。斗為吳分。大人憂，將相戮，宮中有自賊者。及桓玄伏誅，貴臣多戮死者。江南兵革十餘歲乃定，故謫見于斗。

manualTranslations.zh: 五年七月己亥，月犯歲星，在鶉火鳥帑，南國之墟也。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, seventh month, day jihai, the moon transgressed the Year Star at Quail Fire, the Bird's Tail—the ruin-site of the southern state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the seventh month, on the day jihai, the moon transgressed Jupiter at Quail Fire, the Bird's Tail—the ruin-site of the southern state.

manualTranslations.zh: 至天賜元年二月甲辰又掩之，在角。
manualTranslations.literal: By the first year of Tianci, second month, day jiachen, it again concealed it at Horn.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the first year of Tianci, in the second month, on the day jiachen, it again concealed it at Horn.

manualTranslations.zh: 角為外朝，而歲星君也。
manualTranslations.literal: Horn is the outer court, and the Year Star is the ruler star.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Horn is the outer court, and Jupiter is the ruler star.

manualTranslations.zh: 又象若曰：有強大之臣干君之庭，以挾其主而播遷于外。
manualTranslations.literal: The sign also seemed to say: There is a powerful minister who encroaches upon the ruler's court, seizing his sovereign and driving him into exile abroad.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The sign also seemed to say that a powerful minister would encroach upon the ruler's court, seize his sovereign, and drive him into exile abroad.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲桓玄之師敗績于劉裕，玄劫晉帝以奔江陵。
manualTranslations.literal: That year Huan Xuan's army suffered defeat at the hands of Liu Yu; Xuan seized the Jin emperor and fled to Jiangling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Huan Xuan's army was routed by Liu Yu; Xuan seized the Jin emperor and fled to Jiangling.

manualTranslations.zh: 至五月，玄死，桓氏之黨復攻江陵，陷之，凡再劫天子云。
manualTranslations.literal: By the fifth month, Xuan was dead; Huan's faction again attacked Jiangling, took it, and twice seized the Son of Heaven in all, it is said.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the fifth month, Xuan was dead; Huan's faction again attacked Jiangling, took it, and twice seized the Son of Heaven in all, it is said.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，六年六月甲辰，月掩斗魁第四星；
manualTranslations.literal: Previously, in the sixth year, sixth month, day jiachen, the moon concealed the fourth star of the Dipper head;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Previously, in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the day jiachen, the moon concealed the fourth star of the Dipper head;

manualTranslations.zh: 至天賜元年五月壬申，又掩斗魁第三星；
manualTranslations.literal: By the first year of Tianci, fifth month, day renshen, it again concealed the third star of the Dipper head;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the first year of Tianci, in the fifth month, on the day renshen, it again concealed the third star of the Dipper head;

manualTranslations.zh: 二年八月丁巳，又犯斗第一星。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, eighth month, day dingsi, it again transgressed the first star of the Dipper.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the eighth month, on the day dingsi, it again transgressed the first star of the Dipper.

manualTranslations.zh: 斗為吳分。
manualTranslations.literal: The Dipper is Wu's allotted region.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Dipper is Wu's allotted region.

manualTranslations.zh: 大人憂，將相戮，宮中有自賊者。
manualTranslations.literal: Great persons grieve; generals and chancellors are executed; within the palace there are self-inflicted traitors.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Great persons grieve; generals and chancellors are executed; within the palace there are self-inflicted traitors.

manualTranslations.zh: 及桓玄伏誅，貴臣多戮死者。
manualTranslations.literal: When Huan Xuan was executed, many noble ministers died by execution.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Huan Xuan was executed, many noble ministers died by execution.

manualTranslations.zh: 江南兵革十餘歲乃定，故謫見于斗。
manualTranslations.literal: War in the Jiangnan region continued for more than ten years before it was settled; therefore punishment appeared in the Dipper.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: War in the Jiangnan region continued for more than ten years before it was settled; therefore punishment appeared in the Dipper.

localRange.text: 校勘記魏書卷一百五之三諸本目錄注「闕」字，卷末附宋人校語云：〈殿本入考證〉「魏收書天象志第一卷載天及日變，第二卷載月變，第三、第四卷應載星變。今此二卷，天、日、月、星變編年總繫魏及南朝禍咎。蓋魏收志第三、第四卷亡，後人取他人所撰志補足之。魏澹書世已無本，據目錄作西魏帝紀，而元善見、司馬昌明、劉裕、蕭道成皆入列傳。此志主東魏，而晉、宋、齊、梁君皆稱帝號，亦非魏澹書明矣。唐書經籍志有張太素魏書一百卷，故世人疑此二卷為太素書志。崇文總目有張太素魏書天文志二卷，今亦亡矣。惟昭文館有史館舊本魏書志第三卷，前題朝議郎、行著作郎修國史張太素撰。太素唐人，故諱『世』『民』等字。按天象志三及四非魏書原文甚明，其中記月變即採志二所載，記星變似兼採已亡之魏書志三、四和宋書天文志。元年十月至二年五月月再掩東蕃上相按志二天興元年十一月丁丑，月掩東上相。這裏「十」下當脫「一」字。是歲秀容胡帥亦聚眾反諸本「帥」訛「師」，今據志二天興四年三月甲子條改。又「是歲」承上文是四年，據志二事在五年十一月。二年八月火犯斗丁亥又犯建按天賜二年八月庚戌朔，無丁亥。宋志是年不載，而次年〈義熙二年，即魏天賜三年〉記八月癸亥，熒惑犯斗第五星；丁巳，犯建星。是年八月甲辰朔，丁巳是十四日。疑這裏抄宋志，誤以義熙二年為天賜二年，又訛「丁巳」為「丁亥」。斗八月辛丑熒惑犯執法按天賜四年八月戊辰朔，無辛丑。宋志在義熙三年〈魏天賜四年〉八月辛卯，乃二十四日。是歲八月壬子太白犯軒轅大星按永興二年八月辛巳朔，無壬子。宋志在義熙六年〈魏永興二年〉八月壬午，是二日。此志「壬子」當是「壬午」之訛。至泰常二年正月晉荊州刺史司馬休之雍州刺史魯宗之為劉裕所襲皆出奔走按劉裕攻司馬休之，休之出奔，據宋書卷二武帝紀二在義熙十一年〈魏神瑞二年〉，次年魏改年泰常。參志二校記[一]。十月又犯之在斗按志二在泰常三年十一月庚申，這裏「十」下當脫「一」字。七月雁門河內大水按卷三太宗紀在泰常三年八月，疑這裏作「七月」誤。明年正月又犯鬼〈至〉而至秦夏出夷威諸本「正月」作「五月」，獨百衲本作「正月」。按宋志元嘉九年正月庚午，熒惑入輿鬼，此志之明年乃魏神䴥五年，亦即宋元嘉九年〈四三二〉，知百衲本獨是，今從之。又「而至秦夏出夷威」，語不可解。「而至」下疑有脫文。「威」當是「滅」之訛。「出」字非字訛即衍文。十月丙辰月又掩之諸本無「月」字。按志二神䴥四年十月丙辰，月掩天關，宋志同。這裏「又」上脫「月」字，承上文，便似太白又掩之。今據補。詔大將軍嵇敬等帥眾二萬屯漠南諸本「嵇」訛「黎」，今據卷四上世祖紀上太延五年六月條、卷一０三蠕蠕傳〈補〉改正。追至頓根河殿本考證云：「頓根河，本書蠕蠕傳作『頞根河』。按「頓」字疑訛。是月太白犯房月入南斗按志二「月入南斗」在太安四年八月。疑「月入南斗」上脫「八月」二字。占曰小流星百數四面行者庶人遷之象按上文稱「流星數萬西行」，這裏「四」當是「西」之訛。二年三月熒惑入鬼按宋志在大明六年〈魏和平三年〉三月。此志下文說「是歲，詔諸將討雍州叛氐」，據卷五高宗紀，事在和平三年六月，則這裏「二年」當是「三年」之訛。但下又云「宋雍州刺史海陵王休茂亦稱兵作亂」，據宋書卷六孝武帝紀，事在大明五年〈魏和平二年〉，又不合。是月熒惑守軒轅按是月承上文乃和平三年〈四六二〉十月，據宋志「熒惑守軒轅」和下文「十一月，歲入氐」都在大明七年〈魏和平四年、四六三〉，此志提早一年。此條下注文和下五年條正文和注中記載的星變，見於宋志者，比對紀年，此志皆提前一年，必是雜抄宋志而於宋、魏紀年的必定有誤。今不逐條列舉。顯祖天安元年正月戊子按天安元年正月己丑朔，無「戊子」。道符作亂之明年司空和其奴太宰李峻皆薨按卷六顯祖紀，拓跋道符起兵在皇興元年正月，和其奴及李峻死於皇興三年正月和十一月，卷四四和其奴傳同紀。這裏作「明年」誤。丙子月犯東井庚子又如之按此承上文乃延興二年正月，志二在是年閏月，疑「丙子」上脫「閏月」二字。但是年閏六月，壬子朔，無「庚子」，志二亦誤。〈正月甲寅朔，亦無庚子。二年正月曲赦京師及秦涼諸鎮諸本「涼」作「梁」。按志二及卷七上高祖紀上作「涼州諸鎮」。「梁」字訛，今改正。四年九月己卯月犯畢志二「九月」作「正月」。按下稱「七月丙申」，不應「九月」在前，「九」當是「正」之訛。七月丙申太白犯歲星在角此承上文乃延興四年〈宋元徽二年四七四〉，據宋志在元徽三年〈魏延興五年〉，當是抄宋志誤前一年。丁卯太白又入氐此承上文乃延興四年七月。按是年七月庚午朔，無丁卯。宋志在元徽三年〈魏延興五年〉七月丁巳。是年七月甲午朔，丁巳是二十四日。這裏誤前一年，又「丁卯」乃「丁巳」之訛。為主女之象按「主女」當是「女主」誤倒。十二月丙戌月犯之諸本「十二月」作「十一月」。按志二太和三年十二月丙戌，月犯太微左執法。是年十一月己亥朔，無丙戌，十二月戊辰朔，丙戌是十九日。這裏「十一月」乃「十二月」之訛。今據改。四年二月辛巳諸本「月」訛「年」，今據志二改。有偏日暈按志二太和五年二月甲辰條「日」作「白」，當是。元陽以饉殿本考證云：「『元』應作『亢』。是謂驚立絕行諸本「立」作「亡」。按這是說歲、辰、太白三星聚氐。隋書卷二０天文志中云：「三星若合，是謂驚立絕行。知這裏「亡」字訛，今改正。

sourceRange.text: 延和元年七月，有大流星出參左肩，東北入河乃滅。參主兵政，晉、魏墟也，山河所首，推之大兵將發于魏以加燕國。八月癸未，太白犯心前星；乙酉，又犯心明堂。占曰「有亡國，近期二年」。十二月，有流星大如甕，尾長二十餘丈，奔君之象。比歲連兵東討，至太延二年三月，燕後主馮文通去國奔高麗。元年四月，月犯左角；五月，月掩斗；七月，月食左角。皆占曰「兵大起」。其後征西將軍金崖、安定鎮將延普、涇州刺史狄子玉爭權，崖及子玉舉兵攻普不克，據胡空谷反，平西將軍陸俟討獲之。三年三月丙辰，金晝見，在參。魏邦戒也。閏月戊寅，金犯五諸侯。占曰「四滑起，官兵起亂」。疑己丑，月入井，犯太白。占曰「兵起合戰，秦邦受之」。七月，上幸隰城，詔諸軍討山胡白龍，入西河。九月，克之，伏誅者數千人。而宋大將軍、彭城王義康方擅威福，後竟幽廢。是歲二月庚午，月犯畢口而出，因暈昴及五車。占曰「貴人死」。五月甲子，陰平王求薨。太延元年五月，月犯右執法；九月，火犯太微上將，又犯左執法；十月丙午，月犯右執法；二年二月，月犯東蕃上相；三月，月及太白俱犯右執法及上相；三年八月，火犯左執法及上將；五年二月，木逆行犯執法。皆大臣謫也。元年十月，左僕射安原謀反，誅。三年正月，征東大將軍、中山王纂，太尉、北平王長孫嵩，鎮南大將軍、丹陽王叔孫建皆薨。其後，宋大將軍義康坐徙豫章，誅其黨與，僕射殷景仁亦尋卒焉。元年五月，彗出軒轅；二年正月，月犯火，月，后妃也；三年七月，木犯軒轅；至五年七月，月掩填星。並女主謫也。真君元年，太后竇氏殂，宋氏皇后亦終。或曰彗出軒轅，女主有為寇者。其後沮渠氏失國，實公主潛啟魏師。

manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yanhe, seventh month, a great meteor emerged from the left shoulder of Three Stars, entered the River to the northeast, and vanished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanhe, in the seventh month, a great meteor emerged from the left shoulder of Three Stars, entered the River to the northeast, and vanished.

manualTranslations.zh: 參主兵政，晉、魏墟也，山河所首，推之大兵將發于魏以加燕國。
manualTranslations.literal: Three Stars governs military administration; it is the ruins of Jin and Wei, the headwaters of mountains and rivers—inferring from this, great armies will issue from Wei to strike the Yan state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Three Stars governs military affairs; it marks the ruins of Jin and Wei and the headwaters of mountains and rivers—hence great armies would issue from Wei against Yan.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月癸未，太白犯心前星；
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month, day guiwei, the Great White transgressed the Fore Star of Heart;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day guiwei, Venus transgressed the Fore Star of Heart;

manualTranslations.zh: 乙酉，又犯心明堂。
manualTranslations.literal: On day yiyou, it again transgressed the Bright Hall of Heart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, it again transgressed the Bright Hall of Heart.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「有亡國，近期二年」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "There will be a perished state, within about two years."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "A state will perish, within about two years."

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，有流星大如甕，尾長二十餘丈，奔君之象。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, there was a meteor as large as a jar, its tail more than twenty zhang long—the image of a fleeing ruler.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month a meteor as large as a jar appeared, its tail more than twenty zhang long—the image of a fleeing ruler.

manualTranslations.zh: 比歲連兵東討，至太延二年三月，燕後主馮文通去國奔高麗。
manualTranslations.literal: Year after year armies campaigned eastward; by the third month of the second year of Taiyan, the Yan ruler Feng Wentong abandoned his state and fled to Goguryeo.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Year after year armies campaigned eastward; by the third month of Taiyan second year the Yan ruler Feng Wentong abandoned his state and fled to Goguryeo.

manualTranslations.zh: 元年四月，月犯左角；
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year, fourth month, the moon transgressed the left horn;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year, in the fourth month, the moon transgressed the left horn;

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，月掩斗；
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, the moon concealed the Dipper;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the moon concealed the Dipper;

manualTranslations.zh: 七月，月食左角。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month, the moon eclipsed the left horn.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, the moon eclipsed the left horn.

manualTranslations.zh: 皆占曰「兵大起」。
manualTranslations.literal: All prognostications say: "Armies will greatly rise."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All prognostications read: "Armies will rise in force."

manualTranslations.zh: 其後征西將軍金崖、安定鎮將延普、涇州刺史狄子玉爭權，崖及子玉舉兵攻普不克，據胡空谷反，平西將軍陸俟討獲之。
manualTranslations.literal: Afterward General Who Conquers the West Jin Ya, Anding garrison commander Yan Pu, and Jingzhou Inspector Di Ziyu contended for power; Ya and Ziyu raised troops to attack Pu but failed, held Hukong Valley in rebellion, and General Who Pacifies the West Lu Si attacked and captured them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Afterward General Who Conquers the West Jin Ya, Anding garrison commander Yan Pu, and Jingzhou prefect Di Ziyu contended for power; Ya and Ziyu raised troops against Pu but failed, seized Hukong Valley and rebelled, and General Who Pacifies the West Lu Si campaigned against them and took them captive.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年三月丙辰，金晝見，在參。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, third month, day bingchen, metal was visible during the day in Three Stars.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the third month, on the day bingchen, Venus was visible during the day in Three Stars.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏邦戒也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is a warning for the Wei state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This was a warning for the Wei state.

manualTranslations.zh: 閏月戊寅，金犯五諸侯。
manualTranslations.literal: In the intercalary month, day wuyin, metal transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the day wuyin, Venus transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「四滑起，官兵起亂」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "The four slippery ones rise; officials and soldiers rise in rebellion."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The four slippery ones rise; officials and soldiers rise in rebellion."

manualTranslations.zh: 疑己丑，月入井，犯太白。
manualTranslations.literal: On day jichou [text uncertain], the moon entered the Well and transgressed the Great White.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, the moon entered the Well and transgressed Venus.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「兵起合戰，秦邦受之」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "Armies rise and join battle; the Qin state will receive it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Armies rise and join battle; the Qin region will bear it."

manualTranslations.zh: 七月，上幸隰城，詔諸軍討山胡白龍，入西河。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month, the emperor visited Xicheng and ordered the armies to campaign against the mountain Hu chieftain Bai Long, entering Xihe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the emperor visited Xicheng and ordered the armies to campaign against the mountain Hu chieftain Bai Long, entering Xihe.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，克之，伏誅者數千人。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, he captured them; those executed numbered several thousand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he captured them, and several thousand were executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 而宋大將軍、彭城王義康方擅威福，後竟幽廢。
manualTranslations.literal: Meanwhile the Song Grand General, Prince of Pengcheng Yi Kang, was just then monopolizing authority and favor; afterward he was ultimately confined and deposed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Song Grand General and Prince of Pengcheng Yi Kang was then monopolizing authority and favor; afterward he was ultimately confined and deposed.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲二月庚午，月犯畢口而出，因暈昴及五車。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of that year, day gengwu, the moon transgressed the mouth of Net and emerged, thereby haloeing Hairy Head and the Five Chariots.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of that year, on the day gengwu, the moon transgressed the mouth of Net and emerged, producing a halo over Hairy Head and the Five Chariots.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「貴人死」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "An honored person will die."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "An honored person will die."

manualTranslations.zh: 五月甲子，陰平王求薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month, day jiazi, Prince of Yinping Qiu died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day jiazi, Prince Qiu of Yinping died.

manualTranslations.zh: 太延元年五月，月犯右執法；
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Taiyan, fifth month, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcement Officer;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiyan, in the fifth month, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcement Officer;

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，火犯太微上將，又犯左執法；
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month, fire transgressed the senior general of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, and again transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Mars transgressed the senior general of the Supreme Palace Enclosure and again transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer;

manualTranslations.zh: 十月丙午，月犯右執法；
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month, day bingwu, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcement Officer;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the day bingwu, the moon transgressed the Right Enforcement Officer;

manualTranslations.zh: 二年二月，月犯東蕃上相；
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, second month, the moon transgressed the senior minister of the eastern enclosure;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the second month, the moon transgressed the senior minister star of the eastern enclosure;

manualTranslations.zh: 三月，月及太白俱犯右執法及上相；
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, the moon and the Great White together transgressed the Right Enforcement Officer and the senior minister;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, the moon and Venus together transgressed the Right Enforcement Officer and the senior minister;

manualTranslations.zh: 三年八月，火犯左執法及上將；
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, eighth month, fire transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer and the senior general;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the eighth month, Mars transgressed the Left Enforcement Officer and the senior general;

manualTranslations.zh: 五年二月，木逆行犯執法。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year, second month, wood moved retrograde and transgressed the Enforcement Officer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the second month, Jupiter moved retrograde and transgressed the Enforcement Officer.

manualTranslations.zh: 皆大臣謫也。
manualTranslations.literal: All were punishments upon great ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All were punishments upon great ministers.

manualTranslations.zh: 元年十月，左僕射安原謀反，誅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year, tenth month, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing An Yuan plotted rebellion and was executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year, in the tenth month, An Yuan, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, plotted rebellion and was put to death.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年正月，征東大將軍、中山王纂，太尉、北平王長孫嵩，鎮南大將軍、丹陽王叔孫建皆薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, first month, General Who Conquers the East, Prince of Zhongshan Zuan; Grand Tutor, Prince of Beiping Changsun Song; and General Who Guards the South, Prince of Danyang Shushun Jian—all died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the first month, Prince Zuan of Zhongshan, General Who Conquers the East; Changsun Song, Grand Tutor and Prince of Beiping; and Shushun Jian, Prince of Danyang and General Who Guards the South—all died.

manualTranslations.zh: 其後，宋大將軍義康坐徙豫章，誅其黨與，僕射殷景仁亦尋卒焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Afterward, the Song Grand General Yi Kang was punished by exile to Yuzhang; his faction was executed, and Vice Director Yin Jingren also soon died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Afterward Song Grand General Yi Kang was punished with exile to Yuzhang; his faction was executed, and Vice Director Yin Jingren also soon died.

manualTranslations.zh: 元年五月，彗出軒轅；
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year, fifth month, a comet emerged at Chariot Shaft;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year, in the fifth month, a comet emerged at Chariot Shaft;

manualTranslations.zh: 二年正月，月犯火，月，后妃也；
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, first month, the moon transgressed fire; the moon is empress and consort;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month, the moon transgressed Mars; the moon represents empress and consort;

manualTranslations.zh: 三年七月，木犯軒轅；
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, seventh month, wood transgressed Chariot Shaft;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the seventh month, Jupiter transgressed Chariot Shaft;

manualTranslations.zh: 至五年七月，月掩填星。
manualTranslations.literal: By the seventh month of the fifth year, the moon concealed the Quelling Star.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the seventh month of the fifth year, the moon concealed Saturn.

manualTranslations.zh: 並女主謫也。
manualTranslations.literal: All were punishments upon the female sovereign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All were punishments upon the female sovereign.

manualTranslations.zh: 真君元年，太后竇氏殂，宋氏皇后亦終。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Zhenjun, Empress Dowager Dou died, and the Song empress also ended.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhenjun Empress Dowager Dou died, and the Song empress also died.

manualTranslations.zh: 或曰彗出軒轅，女主有為寇者。
manualTranslations.literal: Some say when a comet emerges at Chariot Shaft, the female sovereign has one who acts as a marauder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some say that when a comet emerges at Chariot Shaft, the female sovereign will have one who acts as a marauder.

manualTranslations.zh: 其後沮渠氏失國，實公主潛啟魏師。
manualTranslations.literal: Afterward the Juqu clan lost its state; Princess Shihuo secretly opened the way for the Wei armies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Afterward the Juqu clan lost its state; Princess Shihuo secretly opened the way for the Wei armies.

sourceRange.text: 七月丙申，太白犯歲星，在角。丁卯，太白又入氐。太白有母后之幾，主兵喪之政，以干君於外朝而及其宿宮，是將有劫殺之虞矣。

sourceRange.text: 三年夏四月，熒惑犯太白。占曰「是謂相鑠，不可舉事用兵，成師以出而禍其雄之象也」。明年，宋將殷孝祖侵魏南鄙，詔征南將軍皮豹子擊之，宋軍大敗。或曰：金火合，主喪事。明年十月，金又犯哭星。十二月，征東將軍、中山王託真薨。

context.beforeSource: 其後三吳荐饑，仍歲疾疫。
context.afterSource: 三年十一月，熒惑犯房鈎鈐星。
context.beforeLocal: 其後三吳荐饑，仍歲疾疫。
context.afterLocal: 三年十一月，熒惑犯房鈎鈐星。

manualTranslations.zh: 三年夏四月，熒惑犯太白。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, summer, fourth month, Mars transgressed Venus.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the fourth month of summer, Mars transgressed Venus.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「是謂相鑠，不可舉事用兵，成師以出而禍其雄之象也」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "This is called mutual melting; one must not undertake affairs or deploy armies—if an army is formed and sent forth, it will bring calamity upon its champion."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This is called mutual melting; one must not undertake affairs or deploy armies—if an army is formed and sent forth, calamity will befall its champion."

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，宋將殷孝祖侵魏南鄙，詔征南將軍皮豹子擊之，宋軍大敗。
manualTranslations.literal: The following year, the Song general Yin Xiaozu invaded Wei's southern borderlands; an edict ordered General Who Conquers the South Pi Baozi to strike him, and the Song army was greatly defeated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year, the Song general Yin Xiaozu invaded Wei's southern borderlands; an edict ordered General Who Conquers the South Pi Baozi to attack him, and the Song army was routed.

manualTranslations.zh: 或曰：金火合，主喪事。
manualTranslations.literal: Some say: When metal and fire unite, it governs mourning affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some say that when Venus and Mars unite, it portends mourning.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年十月，金又犯哭星。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month of the following year, Venus again transgressed the Weeping Star.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the following year, Venus again transgressed the Weeping Star.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，征東將軍、中山王託真薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, General Who Conquers the East, Prince Tuozhen of Zhongshan, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, General Who Conquers the East, Prince Tuozhen of Zhongshan, died.

sourceRange.text: 「魏收書天象志第一卷載天及日變，第二卷載月變，第三、第四卷應載星變。今此二卷，天、日、月、星變編年總繫魏及南朝禍咎。蓋魏收志第三、第四卷亡，後人取他人所撰志補足之。魏澹書世已無本，據目錄作西魏帝紀，而元善見、司馬昌明、劉裕、蕭道成皆入列傳。此志主東魏，而晉、宋、齊、梁君皆稱帝號，亦非魏澹書明矣。唐書經籍志有張太素魏書一百卷，故世人疑此二卷為太素書志。崇文總目有張太素魏書天文志二卷，今亦亡矣。惟昭文館有史館舊本魏書志第三卷，前題朝議郎、行著作郎修國史張太素撰。太素唐人，故諱『世』『民』等字。」按天象志三及四非魏書原文甚明，其中記月變即採志二所載，記星變似兼採已亡之魏書志三、四和宋書天文志。|author=魏收|section=天象志一之三第三|times=北齊|previous=天象志一之二第二|next=天象志一之四第四|type=|from=|notes=太祖皇始元年夏六月，有星彗于髦頭。彗所以去穢布新也，皇天以黜無道，建有德，故或憑之以昌，或由之以亡。自五胡蹂轥生人，力正諸夏，百有餘年，莫能建經始之謀而底定其命。是秋，太祖啟冀方之地，實始芟夷滌除之，有德教之音，人倫之象焉。終以錫類長代，修復中朝之舊物，故將建元立號，而天街彗之，蓋其祥也。先是，有大黃星出于昴、畢之分，五十餘日。慕容氏太史丞王先曰：「當有真人起於燕代之間，大兵鏘鏘，其鋒不可當。」冬十一月，黃星又見，天下莫敵。是歲六月，木犯哭星。木，人君也，君有哭泣之事。是月，太后賀氏崩。至秋，晉帝殂。二年六月庚戌，月奄金于端門之外。戰祥也，變及南宮，是謂朝庭有兵。時燕王慕容寶已走和龍，秋九月，其弟賀麟復糾合三萬眾，寇新市，上自擊之，大敗燕師于義臺，悉定河北。而晉桓玄等連衡內侮，其朝庭日夕戒嚴。是歲正月，火犯哭星。占有死喪哭泣事。秋八月，又守井、鉞。占曰「大臣誅」。十月，襄城王題薨。明年正月，右軍將軍尹國於冀州謀反，被誅。天興元年八月戊辰，木晝見胃。胃，趙代墟也。□天之事。歲為有國之君，晝見者並明而干陽也。天象若曰：且有負海君，實能自濟其德而行帝王事。是月，始正封畿，定權量，肆禮樂，頒官秩。十二月，羣臣上尊號，正元日，遂禋上帝于南郊。由是魏為北帝，而晉氏為南帝。元年十月至二年五月，月再掩東蕃上相。相所以蕃輔王室而定君臣位。天象若曰：今下凌上替而莫之或振，將焉用之哉？且曰：中坐成刑，貴人奪勢。是歲，桓玄專殺殷仲堪等，制上流之眾，晉室由是遂卑。是歲五月，辰星犯軒轅大星。占曰「女主當之」。三年三月至七月，月再犯鎮星于牽牛，又犯哭星。為兵喪、女憂。或曰月為強大之臣，鎮，所以正綱紀也。是為強臣有干犯者，在吳越。既而晉太后李氏殂，桓玄擅命江南，仍有艱故云。

context.afterSource: 三年三月，有星孛于奎，歷閣道，至紫微西蕃，入北斗魁，犯太陽守，循下台，轥南宮，履帝坐，遂由端門以出。
context.afterLocal: 三年三月，有星孛于奎，歷閣道，至紫微西蕃，入北斗魁，犯太陽守，循下台，轥南宮，履帝坐，遂由端門以出。

manualTranslations.zh: 太祖皇始元年夏六月，有星彗于髦頭。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Huangshi, summer, sixth month, a broom star appeared at Maotou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangshi, in the sixth month of summer, a comet appeared at Maotou.

manualTranslations.zh: 彗所以去穢布新也，皇天以黜無道，建有德，故或憑之以昌，或由之以亡。
manualTranslations.literal: Comets are what remove filth and spread renewal; August Heaven deposes the wayless and establishes the virtuous, so some rely upon them to flourish, while others through them perish.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Comets remove corruption and usher in renewal; Heaven deposes the unprincipled and raises the virtuous, so some ride them to prosperity and others through them to ruin.

manualTranslations.zh: 自五胡蹂轥生人，力正諸夏，百有餘年，莫能建經始之謀而底定其命。
manualTranslations.literal: Since the Five Hu trampled the living, striving to set right the Central Xia for more than a hundred years, none could form founding plans and settle their fate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since the Five Hu peoples trampled the land and fought to dominate the Central Plains for more than a century, none could devise a founding strategy and secure their destiny.

manualTranslations.zh: 是秋，太祖啟冀方之地，實始芟夷滌除之，有德教之音，人倫之象焉。
manualTranslations.literal: That autumn, Emperor Taizu opened the lands of Jifang and truly began to cut down and cleanse them; there were signs of virtuous teaching and the patterns of human relations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That autumn Emperor Taizu opened the Jizhou region and truly began to cut down and purge it; there were signs of moral instruction and the ordering of human relations.

manualTranslations.zh: 終以錫類長代，修復中朝之舊物，故將建元立號，而天街彗之，蓋其祥也。
manualTranslations.literal: Ultimately by bestowing favor upon his kind to long rule, restoring the old possessions of the Central Court, therefore about to establish the era and raise the title—and the Celestial Street was cometed; this was likely its auspice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At last, by extending favor to his kin for long rule and restoring the old regalia of the central court, he was about to establish an era and proclaim a title—and a comet crossed the Celestial Street; this was likely its omen.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，有大黃星出于昴、畢之分，五十餘日。
manualTranslations.literal: Before this, a great yellow star emerged in the divisions of Hairy Head and Net, for more than fifty days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, a great yellow star had appeared in the sectors of Hairy Head and Net and remained for more than fifty days.

manualTranslations.zh: 慕容氏太史丞王先曰：「當有真人起於燕代之間，大兵鏘鏘，其鋒不可當。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Xian, Assistant Grand Astrologer of the Murong clan, said: "There will be a true man rising between Yan and Dai; great armies will clash with ringing arms, and their edge cannot be withstood.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Xian, assistant grand astrologer of the Murong clan, said, "A true lord will rise between Yan and Dai; great armies will clash with ringing arms, and their edge will be irresistible.

manualTranslations.zh: 」冬十一月，黃星又見，天下莫敵。
manualTranslations.literal: " In winter, eleventh month, the yellow star appeared again; none under heaven could match it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " In the eleventh month of winter the yellow star appeared again, and none under heaven could stand against it.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲六月，木犯哭星。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month of that year, wood transgressed the Weeping Star.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of that year, Jupiter transgressed the Weeping Star.

manualTranslations.zh: 木，人君也，君有哭泣之事。
manualTranslations.literal: Wood is the human ruler; the ruler has matters of weeping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jupiter is the ruler; the ruler will have cause for mourning.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，太后賀氏崩。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, Empress Dowager He died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month Empress Dowager He died.

manualTranslations.zh: 至秋，晉帝殂。
manualTranslations.literal: By autumn, the Jin emperor died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By autumn the Jin emperor had died.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年六月庚戌，月奄金于端門之外。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year, sixth month, day gengxu, the moon concealed metal outside the Duan Gate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the sixth month, on the day gengxu, the moon concealed Venus outside the Duan Gate.

manualTranslations.zh: 戰祥也，變及南宮，是謂朝庭有兵。
manualTranslations.literal: It is an omen of battle; the change reached the Southern Palace—this is called armies in the court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This was an omen of war; the change reached the Southern Palace—meaning armies in the imperial court.

manualTranslations.zh: 時燕王慕容寶已走和龍，秋九月，其弟賀麟復糾合三萬眾，寇新市，上自擊之，大敗燕師于義臺，悉定河北。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the Yan king Murong Bao had already fled to Helong; in autumn, ninth month, his younger brother Helin again gathered thirty thousand followers, raided Xinshi; the emperor personally attacked him, greatly defeated the Yan army at Yitai, and fully settled Hebei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By then the Yan king Murong Bao had fled to Helong. In the ninth month of autumn his younger brother Helin rallied thirty thousand men and raided Xinshi; the emperor marched in person, crushed the Yan forces at Yitai, and fully pacified Hebei.

manualTranslations.zh: 而晉桓玄等連衡內侮，其朝庭日夕戒嚴。
manualTranslations.literal: Meanwhile among the Jin, Huan Xuan and others formed alliances and insulted the realm internally; their court was on alert day and night.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Huan Xuan and others of Jin formed alliances and turned inward against the throne; their court stood on alert day and night.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲正月，火犯哭星。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of that year, fire transgressed the Weeping Star.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of that year, Mars transgressed the Weeping Star.

manualTranslations.zh: 占有死喪哭泣事。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication holds that there will be death, mourning, and weeping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication indicated death, mourning, and weeping.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋八月，又守井、鉞。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, it again stationed at Well and Halberd.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn it again stationed at the Well and Halberd.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「大臣誅」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "Great ministers will be executed."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great ministers will be executed."

manualTranslations.zh: 十月，襄城王題薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month, Prince of Xiangcheng Ti died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Prince Yuan Ti of Xiangcheng died.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年正月，右軍將軍尹國於冀州謀反，被誅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the following year, Right Army General Yin Guo plotted rebellion in Jizhou and was executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year Yin Guo, Right Army General, plotted rebellion in Jizhou and was put to death.

manualTranslations.zh: 天興元年八月戊辰，木晝見胃。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tianxing, eighth month, day wuchen, wood was visible during the day at Stomach.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianxing, in the eighth month, on the day wuchen, Jupiter was visible during the day at Stomach.

manualTranslations.zh: 胃，趙代墟也。
manualTranslations.literal: Stomach is the ruins of Zhao and Dai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Stomach marks the ruins of Zhao and Dai.

manualTranslations.zh: □天之事。
manualTranslations.literal: [lacuna] affairs of heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: [lacuna] affairs of heaven.

manualTranslations.zh: 歲為有國之君，晝見者並明而干陽也。
manualTranslations.literal: The Year Star is the ruler of a state; when visible during the day, both are bright and transgress the yang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jupiter is the ruler of a state; when seen by day, both are bright and transgress the yang.

manualTranslations.zh: 天象若曰：且有負海君，實能自濟其德而行帝王事。
manualTranslations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: Moreover there will be a sea-facing lord who can truly sustain his virtue and perform the affairs of emperor and king.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare that a sea-facing lord would arise who could truly sustain his virtue and perform the work of an emperor.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，始正封畿，定權量，肆禮樂，頒官秩。
manualTranslations.literal: That month, he first rectified the royal domain, fixed weights and measures, deployed rites and music, and issued official ranks.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month he first rectified the royal domain, fixed weights and measures, deployed rites and music, and issued official ranks.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，羣臣上尊號，正元日，遂禋上帝于南郊。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, the assembled ministers presented a honorific title; on New Year's Day he then performed the suburban sacrifice to August Heaven at the southern suburb.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the assembled ministers presented a honorific title; on New Year's Day he performed the suburban sacrifice to August Heaven at the southern altar.

manualTranslations.zh: 由是魏為北帝，而晉氏為南帝。
manualTranslations.literal: From this Wei became the Northern Emperor and the Jin clan the Southern Emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From this Wei became the northern emperor and the Jin house the southern emperor.

manualTranslations.zh: 元年十月至二年五月，月再掩東蕃上相。
manualTranslations.literal: From the tenth month of the first year through the fifth month of the second year, the moon twice concealed the senior minister of the eastern enclosure.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the tenth month of the first year through the fifth month of the second year, the moon twice concealed the senior minister star of the eastern enclosure.

manualTranslations.zh: 相所以蕃輔王室而定君臣位。
manualTranslations.literal: The minister is what screens and assists the royal house and fixes the positions of ruler and subject.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The minister star screens and assists the royal house and fixes the positions of ruler and subject.

manualTranslations.zh: 天象若曰：今下凌上替而莫之或振，將焉用之哉？
manualTranslations.literal: The celestial signs seemed to say: Now the lower overtops the upper and replaces it, yet none can rouse it—how then will it be used?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The heavens seemed to declare: the lower now overtops and displaces the upper, yet none can rouse it—of what use then is it?

manualTranslations.zh: 且曰：中坐成刑，貴人奪勢。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover it said: The central seat becomes punishment; the honored lose their power.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It also said: the central seat becomes punishment, and the honored lose their power.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲，桓玄專殺殷仲堪等，制上流之眾，晉室由是遂卑。
manualTranslations.literal: That year, Huan Xuan on his own authority killed Yin Zhongkan and others, controlled the forces of the upper Yangzi, and the Jin house from this became debased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That year Huan Xuan on his own authority killed Yin Zhongkan and others, controlled the forces of the upper Yangzi, and the Jin house was thereby humbled.

manualTranslations.zh: 是歲五月，辰星犯軒轅大星。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of that year, Mercury transgressed the Great Star of Chariot Shaft.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of that year, Mercury transgressed the Great Star of Chariot Shaft.

manualTranslations.zh: 占曰「女主當之」。
manualTranslations.literal: The prognostication says: "The female sovereign will bear it."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The female sovereign will bear it."

manualTranslations.zh: 三年三月至七月，月再犯鎮星于牽牛，又犯哭星。
manualTranslations.literal: From the third month through the seventh month of the third year, the moon twice transgressed the Quelling Star at the Oxherd, and again transgressed the Weeping Star.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the third month through the seventh month of the third year, the moon twice transgressed Saturn at the Oxherd and again transgressed the Weeping Star.

manualTranslations.zh: 為兵喪、女憂。
manualTranslations.literal: This signifies warfare and mourning, and women's grief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This signified warfare and mourning, and women's grief.

manualTranslations.zh: 或曰月為強大之臣，鎮，所以正綱紀也。
manualTranslations.literal: Some say the moon is a powerful minister; the Quelling Star is what rectifies law and order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some say the moon represents a powerful minister, and Saturn is what rectifies law and order.

manualTranslations.zh: 是為強臣有干犯者，在吳越。
manualTranslations.literal: This means a powerful minister who transgresses— in Wu and Yue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This meant a powerful minister who transgressed—in Wu and Yue.

manualTranslations.zh: 既而晉太后李氏殂，桓玄擅命江南，仍有艱故云。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon afterward the Jin empress dowager, Lady Li, died; Huan Xuan presumptuously issued commands in Jiangnan—there were still hardships and calamities, it is said.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Jin empress dowager, Lady Li, died; Huan Xuan presumptuously issued commands in Jiangnan—and hardships still followed, it is said.

items.acceptedSourceText: 太祖皇始元年夏六月，有星彗于髦頭。彗所以去穢布新也，皇天以黜無道，建有德，故或憑之以昌，或由之以亡。自五胡蹂轥生人，力正諸夏，百有餘年，莫能建經始之謀而底定其命。是秋，太祖啟冀方之地，實始芟夷滌除之，有德教之音，人倫之象焉。終以錫類長代，修復中朝之舊物，故將建元立號，而天街彗之，蓋其祥也。先是，有大黃星出于昴、畢之分，五十餘日。慕容氏太史丞王先曰：「當有真人起於燕代之間，大兵鏘鏘，其鋒不可當。」冬十一月，黃星又見，天下莫敵。是歲六月，木犯哭星。木，人君也，君有哭泣之事。是月，太后賀氏崩。至秋，晉帝殂。二年六月庚戌，月奄金于端門之外。戰祥也，變及南宮，是謂朝庭有兵。時燕王慕容寶已走和龍，秋九月，其弟賀麟復糾合三萬眾，寇新市，上自擊之，大敗燕師于義臺，悉定河北。而晉桓玄等連衡內侮，其朝庭日夕戒嚴。是歲正月，火犯哭星。占有死喪哭泣事。秋八月，又守井、鉞。占曰「大臣誅」。十月，襄城王題薨。明年正月，右軍將軍尹國於冀州謀反，被誅。天興元年八月戊辰，木晝見胃。胃，趙代墟也。□天之事。歲為有國之君，晝見者並明而干陽也。天象若曰：且有負海君，實能自濟其德而行帝王事。是月，始正封畿，定權量，肆禮樂，頒官秩。十二月，羣臣上尊號，正元日，遂禋上帝于南郊。由是魏為北帝，而晉氏為南帝。元年十月至二年五月，月再掩東蕃上相。相所以蕃輔王室而定君臣位。天象若曰：今下凌上替而莫之或振，將焉用之哉？且曰：中坐成刑，貴人奪勢。是歲，桓玄專殺殷仲堪等，制上流之眾，晉室由是遂卑。是歲五月，辰星犯軒轅大星。占曰「女主當之」。三年三月至七月，月再犯鎮星于牽牛，又犯哭星。為兵喪、女憂。或曰月為強大之臣，鎮，所以正綱紀也。是為強臣有干犯者，在吳越。既而晉太后李氏殂，桓玄擅命江南，仍有艱故云。

sourceRange.text: 四年，自正月至秋七月，月行四犯太微。天象若曰：太微粹陽之天庭，月者臣也，今橫行轥之，不已甚乎。先是，元年五月，月犯歲星，在角。是歲七月，月又犯歲星。明年，宋始建國。後年而晉主殂，裕鴆之也。昔桓氏之難，月再干歲星，再劫其主。至是，亦再犯之而再勦其君，極其幽逼之患，而濟以篡殺之禍，斯謂之甚矣。先是，三年九月，月犯火于鶉尾；十二月，又犯火于太微。是歲五月，月犯太白，在井；十月，又犯之，在斗，且再犯井星。皆有兵水大喪，諸侯有死者。七月，雁門、河內大水。五年三月，南陽王意文死。十一月，西涼李歆為沮渠所滅，晉君亦殂，秦、吳亡之應。

context.afterSource: 五年十一月乙卯，熒惑犯填星，在角。
